<file path="Source/Engine/Base/Framework.cpp" lines="727">
1: #include "Framework.h"
2: #include "DebugUI.h"
3: #include "Engine/Common/FitRect.h"
4: #include "Engine/Graphics/GameCanvas.h"
5: #include "Engine/Common/Constants.h"
7: // ========================================================
8: // Jembatan Win32 ke ImGui
9: // ========================================================
10: static WNDPROC s_OriginalWndProc = nullptr;
11: static HWND s_HookedWnd = nullptr; // window whose WndProc is currently replaced
13: LRESULT CALLBACK ImGuiHookWndProc(HWND hWnd, UINT msg, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam)
14: {
15:     // 1. Berikan event klik/keyboard ke ImGui terlebih dahulu
16:     if (ImGuiRenderer::HandleMessage(hWnd, msg, wParam, lParam)) {
17:         return true;
18:     }
20:     // 2. Teruskan sisa pesannya ke sistem SDL3
21:     if (s_OriginalWndProc) {
22:         return CallWindowProc(s_OriginalWndProc, hWnd, msg, wParam, lParam);
23:     }
24:     return DefWindowProc(hWnd, msg, wParam, lParam);
25: }
26: // ========================================================
28: Framework* Framework::pInstance = nullptr;
30: namespace
31: {
32:     // Default windowed layout: the game window on the left, the debug window beside it.
33:     // Client-area rects in desktop pixels, laid out for a 1920x1080 display at 100%
34:     // scale; y = 31 leaves room for the title bar.
35:     constexpr Beyond::PixelRect k_defaultMainRect{ 0, 31, 1510, 1000 };
36: #if defined(_DEBUG)
37:     constexpr Beyond::PixelRect k_defaultDebugRect{ 1515, 31, 400, 1000 };
38: #endif
40:     // The smallest size the user can drag the main window to.
41:     constexpr int k_minWindowWidth{ 640 };
42:     constexpr int k_minWindowHeight{ 360 };
44:     // Borderless mode is one row taller than the display. Carried over unchanged from
45:     // the per-scene code this replaces (screenH + 1); the original reason is not
46:     // documented, so it is kept until proven unnecessary.
47:     constexpr int k_borderlessExtraHeight{ 1 };
49: #if defined(_DEBUG)
50:     // Length of one stepped frame. Fixed, so a step always advances the same amount.
51:     constexpr float k_simStepSeconds{ 1.0f / 60.0f };
53:     // Upper bound of a scaled frame, the same limit Main.cpp applies to real time,
54:     // so a high time scale cannot tunnel bullets through the player.
55:     constexpr float k_maxSceneDeltaTime{ 0.05f };
56: #endif
57: }
59: Framework::Framework()
60: {
61:     pInstance = this;
62:     Graphics::Instance().Initialize();
64:     if (!AudioManager::Instance().Initialize()) {  }
66:     AttackParamManager::Instance().Load("AttackParams.json");
68:     // Buat Main Window (Fullscreen Borderless)
69:     auto mainWin = WindowManager::Instance().CreateGameWindow("Main Window (close here)", 1600, 900);
70:     mainWin->SetPriority(0);
71:     mainWin->SetDraggable(false);
73:     // Why before ShowWindow: the window appears in its final shape, without a
74:     // visible jump from the creation size.
75: #if defined(_DEBUG)
76:     m_windowLayout = WindowLayoutStore::Load();
77:     SetMainWindowMode(WindowMode::windowed);
78: #else
79:     SetMainWindowMode(WindowMode::borderless);
80: #endif
81:     SDL_ShowWindow(mainWin->GetSDLWindow());
83:     // Posisikan di tengah saat awal
85:     HWND hwnd = (HWND)SDL_GetPointerProperty(
86:         SDL_GetWindowProperties(mainWin->GetSDLWindow()),
87:         SDL_PROP_WINDOW_WIN32_HWND_POINTER,
88:         NULL
89:     );
91:     Input::Instance().Initialize(hwnd);
93:     // ImGui binds to exactly one OS window: the debug host in Debug builds,
94:     // the game window otherwise.
95:     HWND imguiHwnd{ hwnd };
97: #if defined(_DEBUG)
98:     // The saved rect if there is one, otherwise the default when it fits this display.
99:     // With neither, the config's own size is used and the OS picks the position.
100:     WindowLayoutStore::SavedRect debugRect{ m_windowLayout.debugWindow };
101:     if (!debugRect.isSet && WindowLayoutStore::IsOnScreen(k_defaultDebugRect))
102:     {
103:         debugRect.rect = k_defaultDebugRect;
104:         debugRect.isSet = true;
105:     }
107:     DebugHostWindowConfig debugHostConfig{};
108:     if (debugRect.isSet)
109:     {
110:         debugHostConfig.x = debugRect.rect.x;
111:         debugHostConfig.y = debugRect.rect.y;
112:         debugHostConfig.width = debugRect.rect.width;
113:         debugHostConfig.height = debugRect.rect.height;
114:         debugHostConfig.hasPosition = true;
115:     }
117:     m_debugHost = std::make_unique<DebugHostWindow>(debugHostConfig);
118:     if (m_debugHost->IsValid())
119:     {
120:         imguiHwnd = m_debugHost->GetHwnd();
121:         WindowManager::Instance().SetImGuiOnMainWindow(false);
122:         // Why: showing a new window takes focus; give it back to the game.
123:         SDL_RaiseWindow(mainWin->GetSDLWindow());
124:         RegisterDebugMenuBar();
125:         RegisterDebugTimePanel();
126:     }
127:     else
128:     {
129:         m_debugHost.reset(); // fall back to drawing ImGui on the game window
130:     }
131: #endif
133:     ImGuiRenderer::Initialize(imguiHwnd, Graphics::Instance().GetDevice(), Graphics::Instance().GetDeviceContext());
134:     s_HookedWnd = imguiHwnd;
135:     s_OriginalWndProc = (WNDPROC)SetWindowLongPtr(imguiHwnd, GWLP_WNDPROC, (LONG_PTR)ImGuiHookWndProc);
136:     // Load Resources
137:     ResourceManager::Instance().LoadFont("VGA_FONT", "Data/Font/IBM_VGA_32px_0.png", "Data/Font/IBM_VGA_32px.fnt");
139:     // Why before the scene: needs the device, and must exist before the first Render.
140:     m_gameCanvas = std::make_unique<GameCanvas>();
141:     if (m_gameCanvas->Initialize(Graphics::Instance().GetDevice()))
142:     {
143:         OutputDebugStringA("[GameCanvas] Ready.\n");
144:     }
145:     else
146:     {
147:         OutputDebugStringA("[GameCanvas] Initialize failed, scenes render directly to the main window.\n");
148:         m_gameCanvas.reset();
149:     }
151:     // Init Scene
152: #if 0
153:     scene = std::make_unique<SceneIntro>();
154: #else
155:     scene = std::make_unique<SceneSandbox>();
156: #endif
157: }
159: Framework::~Framework()
160: {
161: #if defined(_DEBUG)
162:     // Why first: the scene's shutdown and ClearAll() below change or destroy the windows.
163:     SaveWindowLayout();
164: #endif
165:     scene.reset();
167:     // Why: restore SDL's WndProc while the hooked window still exists, so its
168:     // destroy messages never reach ImGui after the context is gone.
169:     if (s_HookedWnd && s_OriginalWndProc)
170:     {
171:         SetWindowLongPtr(s_HookedWnd, GWLP_WNDPROC, (LONG_PTR)s_OriginalWndProc);
172:         s_HookedWnd = nullptr;
173:         s_OriginalWndProc = nullptr;
174:     }
176:     WindowManager::Instance().ClearAll();
177:     ImGuiRenderer::Finalize();
178:     pInstance = nullptr;
179: }
181: Framework* Framework::Instance() { return pInstance; }
182: void Framework::ChangeScene(std::unique_ptr<Scene> newScene) { nextScene = std::move(newScene); }
184: Beyond::Window* Framework::GetMainWindow() const

189: void Framework::SetMainWindowMode(WindowMode mode)
190: {
191:     Beyond::Window* mainWin{ GetMainWindow() };
192:     SDL_Window* sdlWin{ mainWin ? mainWin->GetSDLWindow() : nullptr };
193:     if (!sdlWin) return;
195:     switch (mode)
196:     {
197:     case WindowMode::borderless:
198:     {
199:         SDL_Rect display{};
200:         if (!SDL_GetDisplayBounds(SDL_GetPrimaryDisplay(), &display))
201:         {
202:             OutputDebugStringA("[Framework] SDL_GetDisplayBounds failed, window mode unchanged: ");
203:             OutputDebugStringA(SDL_GetError());
204:             OutputDebugStringA("\n");
205:             return;
206:         }
207: #if defined(_DEBUG)
208:         // Why here: once borderless, the windowed rect can no longer be read back.
209:         if (m_mainWindowMode == WindowMode::windowed)
210:         {
211:             const WindowLayoutStore::SavedRect current{ WindowLayoutStore::ReadWindowRect(sdlWin) };
212:             if (current.isSet) m_windowLayout.mainWindow = current;
213:         }
214: #endif
215:         SDL_SetWindowResizable(sdlWin, false);
216:         SDL_SetWindowBordered(sdlWin, false);
217:         SDL_SetWindowPosition(sdlWin, display.x, display.y);
218:         SDL_SetWindowSize(sdlWin, display.w, display.h + k_borderlessExtraHeight);
219:         break;
220:     }
221:     case WindowMode::windowed:
222:     {
223:         Beyond::PixelRect rect{ k_defaultMainRect };
224: #if defined(_DEBUG)
225:         if (m_windowLayout.mainWindow.isSet) rect = m_windowLayout.mainWindow.rect;
226: #endif
227:         SDL_SetWindowBordered(sdlWin, true);
228:         SDL_SetWindowResizable(sdlWin, true);
229:         SDL_SetWindowMinimumSize(sdlWin, k_minWindowWidth, k_minWindowHeight);
230:         SDL_SetWindowSize(sdlWin, rect.width, rect.height);
231:         SDL_SetWindowPosition(sdlWin, rect.x, rect.y);
232:         break;
233:     }
234:     }
236:     m_mainWindowMode = mode;
237: }
239: void Framework::ToggleMainWindowMode()
240: {
241:     SetMainWindowMode(m_mainWindowMode == WindowMode::windowed
242:         ? WindowMode::borderless
243:         : WindowMode::windowed);
244: }

247: void Framework::SaveWindowLayout()
248: {
249:     // In borderless mode the entry already holds the rect captured when leaving windowed mode.
250:     if (m_mainWindowMode == WindowMode::windowed)
251:     {
252:         const Beyond::Window* mainWin{ GetMainWindow() };
253:         const WindowLayoutStore::SavedRect current{
254:             WindowLayoutStore::ReadWindowRect(mainWin ? mainWin->GetSDLWindow() : nullptr) };
255:         if (current.isSet) m_windowLayout.mainWindow = current;
256:     }

259:     if (m_debugHost)

262:             WindowLayoutStore::ReadWindowRect(m_debugHost->GetSDLWindow()) };
263:         if (current.isSet) m_windowLayout.debugWindow = current;
264:     }

269: namespace
270: {
271:     // Why: a maximized window ignores size and position requests.
272:     void LeaveMaximized(SDL_Window* window)
273:     {
274:         if ((SDL_GetWindowFlags(window) & SDL_WINDOW_MAXIMIZED) != 0)
275:         {
276:             SDL_RestoreWindow(window);
277:         }
278:     }
279: }
281: void Framework::ProcessWindowLayoutResetRequest()
282: {
283:     if (!m_isWindowLayoutResetRequested) return;
284:     m_isWindowLayoutResetRequested = false;
286:     // Forget the remembered rects, so windowed mode falls back to the defaults.
287:     m_windowLayout.mainWindow = {};
288:     m_windowLayout.debugWindow = {};
290:     // In borderless mode the main window is left alone; F11 then returns to the default rect.
291:     if (m_mainWindowMode == WindowMode::windowed)
292:     {
293:         const Beyond::Window* mainWin{ GetMainWindow() };
294:         SDL_Window* mainSdlWin{ mainWin ? mainWin->GetSDLWindow() : nullptr };
295:         if (mainSdlWin)
296:         {
297:             LeaveMaximized(mainSdlWin);
298:             SetMainWindowMode(WindowMode::windowed);
299:         }
300:     }
302:     // Left where it is when the default would land off-screen (smaller display).
303:     SDL_Window* debugSdlWin{ m_debugHost ? m_debugHost->GetSDLWindow() : nullptr };
304:     if (debugSdlWin && WindowLayoutStore::IsOnScreen(k_defaultDebugRect))
305:     {
306:         LeaveMaximized(debugSdlWin);
307:         SDL_SetWindowSize(debugSdlWin, k_defaultDebugRect.width, k_defaultDebugRect.height);
308:         SDL_SetWindowPosition(debugSdlWin, k_defaultDebugRect.x, k_defaultDebugRect.y);
309:     }
310: }
311: #endif

318: Beyond::PixelRect Framework::GetGameImageRect() const
319: {
320:     const Beyond::Window* mainWin{ GetMainWindow() };
321:     SDL_Window* sdlWin{ mainWin ? mainWin->GetSDLWindow() : nullptr };
323:     const SDL_WindowFlags notShowing{ SDL_WINDOW_HIDDEN | SDL_WINDOW_MINIMIZED };
324:     if (sdlWin && (SDL_GetWindowFlags(sdlWin) & notShowing) == 0)
325:     {
326:         int windowX{ 0 };
327:         int windowY{ 0 };
328:         SDL_GetWindowPosition(sdlWin, &windowX, &windowY);
330:         // Same rect WindowManager::RenderAll blits the canvas into, moved to desktop space.
331:         return Beyond::FitRect(
332:             Beyond::PixelRect{ windowX, windowY, mainWin->GetWidth(), mainWin->GetHeight() },
333:             Beyond::Config::CANVAS_WIDTH, Beyond::Config::CANVAS_HEIGHT);
334:     }
336:     SDL_Rect display{};
337:     if (!SDL_GetDisplayBounds(SDL_GetPrimaryDisplay(), &display))
338:     {
339:         return Beyond::PixelRect{};
340:     }
341:     return Beyond::FitRect(
342:         Beyond::PixelRect{ display.x, display.y, display.w, display.h },
343:         Beyond::Config::CANVAS_WIDTH, Beyond::Config::CANVAS_HEIGHT);
344: }
346: void Framework::Render(float elapsedTime)
347: {
348:     // SceneBoss is the one scene that skips the canvas: its main window covers the
349:     // monitor and it treats the desktop as the world.
350:     const bool isSceneBoss{ dynamic_cast<SceneBoss*>(scene.get()) != nullptr };
351:     const GameCanvas* canvas{ isSceneBoss ? nullptr : m_gameCanvas.get() };
353:     // Why not elapsedTime: render-side animation (post-process time) must stop
354:     // and scale together with the scene.
355:     WindowManager::Instance().RenderAll(m_sceneDeltaTime, scene.get(), GetActiveCanvas());
357: #if defined(_DEBUG)
359:     // Drawn after every game window so it never affects their render state.
360:     if (m_debugHost)
361:     {
362:         // Last ImGui submission of the frame, after every scene has issued its own.
363:         // Why before BeginRender: panel callbacks may create or destroy game windows,
364:         // and that must not be able to replace the debug window's bound render target.
365:         DebugUI::Instance().Draw(GetDebugLayoutScope());
367:         m_debugHost->BeginRender();
369:         // The frame's ImGui draw data goes to the debug window's back buffer.
370:         ImGuiRenderer::Render(Graphics::Instance().GetDeviceContext());
371:         m_debugHost->Present();
372:     }
373: #endif
374: }
376: void Framework::Update(float elapsedTime)
377: {
378: #if defined(_DEBUG)
379:     ProcessDebugSceneRequest();
380:     ProcessWindowLayoutResetRequest();
381: #endif
383:     if (nextScene)
384:     {
385:         scene = std::move(nextScene); // the previous scene's destructor runs here
386:     }
388:     CalculateFrameStats(elapsedTime);
390: #if defined(_DEBUG)
391:     // Keyboard and mouse buttons stop driving the game while the debug window has focus.
392:     const bool isDebugFocused{ m_debugHost && m_debugHost->HasFocus() };
393:     Input::Instance().SetKeyboardMouseSuppressed(isDebugFocused);
395:     // Why: SDL activates a window whenever it is raised or shown, and the boss scene
396:     // does both constantly (the click blocker is raised every frame). That pulled
397:     // focus off the debug window, which re-enabled game input and broke ImGui drags.
398:     // While the debug window is focused, game windows keep their stacking order but
399:     // do not take focus.
400:     if (isDebugFocused != m_wasDebugFocused)
401:     {
402:         const char* const activation{ isDebugFocused ? "0" : "1" };
403:         SDL_SetHint(SDL_HINT_WINDOW_ACTIVATE_WHEN_RAISED, activation);
404:         SDL_SetHint(SDL_HINT_WINDOW_ACTIVATE_WHEN_SHOWN, activation);
405:         m_wasDebugFocused = isDebugFocused;
406:     }
407: #endif
408:     Input::Instance().Update();
409:     AudioManager::Instance().Update(elapsedTime);
411:     ImGuiRenderer::NewFrame(); // Now safe
413:     bool shouldUpdateScene{ true };
414:     m_sceneDeltaTime = elapsedTime;
416: #if defined(_DEBUG)
417:     if (m_isSimPaused)
418:     {
419:         shouldUpdateScene = m_isSimStepRequested;
420:         m_sceneDeltaTime = m_isSimStepRequested ? k_simStepSeconds : 0.0f;
421:     }
422:     else
423:     {
424:         const float scaled{ elapsedTime * m_simTimeScale };
425:         m_sceneDeltaTime = scaled < k_maxSceneDeltaTime ? scaled : k_maxSceneDeltaTime;
426:     }
427:     m_isSimStepRequested = false;
428: #endif
430:     if (scene && shouldUpdateScene) scene->Update(m_sceneDeltaTime);
432:     if (auto* boss = dynamic_cast<SceneBoss*>(scene.get())) {
433:         if (boss->IsPendingSceneChange()) {
434:             ChangeScene(std::make_unique<SceneTitle>());
435:             return;
436:         }
437:     }
438: }
440: void Framework::ForceUpdateRender()
441: {
442:     static Uint64 lastTime = 0;
443:     if (lastTime == 0) lastTime = SDL_GetPerformanceCounter();
444:     Uint64 currentTime = SDL_GetPerformanceCounter();
445:     float dt = (float)(currentTime - lastTime) / (float)SDL_GetPerformanceFrequency();
446:     lastTime = currentTime;
447:     if (dt > 0.05f) dt = 0.05f;
448:     Update(dt);
449:     Render(dt);
450: }

495: LRESULT CALLBACK Framework::HandleMessage(HWND hWnd, UINT msg, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam)
496: {
497:     Beyond::Window* mainWin = GetMainWindow();
498:     HWND mainHwnd = NULL;
500:     // Ekstrak HWND dari main window yang menggunakan SDL3
501:     if (mainWin && mainWin->GetSDLWindow()) {
502:         mainHwnd = (HWND)SDL_GetPointerProperty(
503:             SDL_GetWindowProperties(mainWin->GetSDLWindow()),
504:             SDL_PROP_WINDOW_WIN32_HWND_POINTER,
505:             NULL
506:         );
507:     }
509:     // Bandingkan hWnd dengan mainHwnd hasil ekstrak
510:     if (mainWin && hWnd == mainHwnd)
511:     {
512:         if (ImGuiRenderer::HandleMessage(hWnd, msg, wParam, lParam)) return true;
513:     }
514:     return 0;

533: bool Framework::HandleDebugHotkey([[maybe_unused]] const SDL_Event& event)
534: {
535: #if defined(_DEBUG)
536:     if (event.type != SDL_EVENT_KEY_DOWN) return false;
538:     switch (event.key.key)
539:     {
540:     case SDLK_F5:
541:         if (!event.key.repeat) m_isSimPaused = !m_isSimPaused;
542:         return true;
543:     case SDLK_F6:
544:         // Key repeat is allowed on purpose: holding F6 advances frame after frame.
545:         m_isSimPaused = true;
546:         m_isSimStepRequested = true;
547:         return true;
548:     case SDLK_F7:
549:         m_simTimeScale = 1.0f;
550:         return true;
551:     default:
552:         break;
553:     }
554: #endif
555:     return false;
556: }

559: void Framework::RegisterDebugMenuBar()
560: {
561:     // Capturing `this` is safe: the handle is a member and is destroyed with this object.
562:     m_menuBarPanel = DebugUI::Instance().RegisterPanel(DebugPanelSlot::menuBar, "Framework", [this]()
563:         {
564:             if (ImGui::BeginMenu("Scene"))
565:             {
566:                 const DebugScene current{ IdentifyDebugScene() };
568:                 // Why only store the request: a scene constructor registers a panel,
569:                 // which is not allowed while panel callbacks are running.
570:                 const auto sceneItem{ [this, current](const char* label, DebugScene target)
571:                     {
572:                         if (ImGui::MenuItem(label, nullptr, current == target))
573:                         {
574:                             m_debugSceneRequest = target;
575:                         }
576:                     } };
578:                 sceneItem("Intro", DebugScene::intro);
579:                 sceneItem("Title", DebugScene::title);
580:                 sceneItem("Game", DebugScene::game);
581:                 sceneItem("Sandbox", DebugScene::sandbox);
582:                 sceneItem("Boss", DebugScene::boss);
584:                 ImGui::Separator();
585:                 if (ImGui::MenuItem("Reload", nullptr, false, current != DebugScene::none))
586:                 {
587:                     m_debugSceneRequest = current;
588:                 }
589:                 ImGui::EndMenu();
590:             }
592:             if (ImGui::BeginMenu("Window"))
593:             {
594:                 // Why only store the request: moving and resizing OS windows belongs
595:                 // outside panel callbacks, like the scene change above.
596:                 if (ImGui::MenuItem("Reset"))
597:                 {
598:                     m_isWindowLayoutResetRequested = true;
599:                 }
600:                 ImGui::EndMenu();
601:             }
604:             // Why a fixed sample: the text keeps one position while its digits change.
605:             constexpr const char* widestText{ "000.00 ms  0000.0 FPS" };
606:             const float textWidth{ ImGui::CalcTextSize(widestText).x };
607:             const float nextMenuX{ ImGui::GetCursorPosX() };
608:             ImGui::SetCursorPosX(ImGui::GetWindowWidth() - textWidth - ImGui::GetStyle().WindowPadding.x);
610:             const float fps{ ImGui::GetIO().Framerate }; // ImGui's rolling average
611:             ImGui::Text("%6.2f ms  %6.1f FPS", fps > 0.0f ? 1000.0f / fps : 0.0f, fps);
613:             // Why: menus registered by other owners must continue after "Scene",
614:             // not to the right of the right-aligned text.
615:             ImGui::SetCursorPosX(nextMenuX);
616:         });
617: }
619: void Framework::RegisterDebugTimePanel()
620: {
621:     // Capturing `this` is safe: the handle is a member and is destroyed with this object.
622:     m_timePanel = DebugUI::Instance().RegisterPanel(DebugPanelSlot::tab, "Time", [this]()
623:         {
624:             constexpr float minTimeScale{ 0.1f };
625:             constexpr float maxTimeScale{ 3.0f };
627:             // Why a fixed width: the label changes, the rest of the row must not shift.
628:             const float toggleWidth{
629:                 ImGui::CalcTextSize("Resume").x + ImGui::GetStyle().FramePadding.x * 2.0f };
631:             // The accent marks the one state that is not the default.
632:             const bool wasPaused{ m_isSimPaused };
633:             if (wasPaused)
634:             {
635:                 ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Button, ImGui::GetStyleColorVec4(ImGuiCol_SliderGrab));
636:                 ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_ButtonHovered, ImGui::GetStyleColorVec4(ImGuiCol_SliderGrabActive));
637:             }
638:             // Text after ### is the ID, so it stays the same button under both labels.
639:             if (ImGui::Button(wasPaused ? "Resume###SimPause" : "Pause###SimPause", ImVec2{ toggleWidth, 0.0f }))
640:             {
641:                 m_isSimPaused = !m_isSimPaused;
642:             }
643:             if (wasPaused) ImGui::PopStyleColor(2);
645:             // Held down, the button repeats: frame after frame, like holding F6.
646:             ImGui::SameLine();
647:             ImGui::PushButtonRepeat(true);
648:             if (ImGui::Button("Step"))
649:             {
650:                 m_isSimPaused = true;
651:                 m_isSimStepRequested = true;
652:             }
653:             ImGui::PopButtonRepeat();
655:             ImGui::SameLine();
656:             ImGui::AlignTextToFramePadding();
657:             ImGui::TextDisabled("%s", m_isSimPaused ? "Paused" : "Running");
659:             DebugProperty::SliderFloat("Speed", m_simTimeScale, minTimeScale, maxTimeScale, "%.1fx");
660:             // Why: Ctrl+click lets a slider accept a typed value outside its range.
661:             if (m_simTimeScale < minTimeScale) m_simTimeScale = minTimeScale;
662:             if (m_simTimeScale > maxTimeScale) m_simTimeScale = maxTimeScale;
664:             if (ImGui::Button("Reset speed")) m_simTimeScale = 1.0f;
666:             ImGui::TextDisabled("F5 pause   F6 step   F7 reset speed");
667:         });
668: }
670: Framework::DebugScene Framework::IdentifyDebugScene() const
671: {
672:     const Scene* const current{ scene.get() };
673:     if (dynamic_cast<const SceneIntro*>(current)) return DebugScene::intro;
674:     if (dynamic_cast<const SceneTitle*>(current)) return DebugScene::title;
675:     if (dynamic_cast<const SceneGame*>(current)) return DebugScene::game;

681: const char* Framework::GetDebugLayoutScope() const
682: {

684:     switch (IdentifyDebugScene())
685:     {
686:     case DebugScene::intro:   return "intro";
687:     case DebugScene::title:   return "title";
688:     case DebugScene::game:    return "game";
689:     case DebugScene::sandbox: return "sandbox";
690:     case DebugScene::boss:    return "boss";
691:     case DebugScene::none:    break;

696: void Framework::ProcessDebugSceneRequest()
697: {
698:     if (m_debugSceneRequest == DebugScene::none) return;
700:     const DebugScene request{ m_debugSceneRequest };
701:     m_debugSceneRequest = DebugScene::none;
703:     // Why destroy first: scenes own OS windows and drive singletons (WindowManager,
704:     // audio, effects); the old one must release them before the new one claims them.
705:     // A scene queued through ChangeScene is dropped, the debug request wins.
706:     nextScene.reset();
707:     scene.reset();
709:     // Why: Windowkill hides the main window and only SceneTitle shows it again.
710:     // Every scene picked from the menu must start with the window visible.
711:     Beyond::Window* const mainWin{ GetMainWindow() };
712:     if (mainWin && mainWin->GetSDLWindow())
713:     {
714:         SDL_ShowWindow(mainWin->GetSDLWindow());
715:     }
717:     switch (request)
718:     {
719:     case DebugScene::intro:   scene = std::make_unique<SceneIntro>(); break;
720:     case DebugScene::title:   scene = std::make_unique<SceneTitle>(); break;
721:     case DebugScene::game:    scene = std::make_unique<SceneGame>(); break;
722:     case DebugScene::sandbox: scene = std::make_unique<SceneSandbox>(); break;
723:     case DebugScene::boss:    scene = std::make_unique<SceneBoss>(); break;
724:     case DebugScene::none:    break;
725:     }
726: }

57: {
58:     // Writes one debug-output line: active DPI awareness and primary display size.
59:     // Must run after SDL_Init(SDL_INIT_VIDEO), because it queries SDL displays.
60:     void LogDisplayStartupInfo()
61:     {
62:         struct NamedContext
63:         {
64:             DPI_AWARENESS_CONTEXT context{ nullptr };
65:             const char* name{ "" };
66:         };
67:         // Not constexpr: the Win32 context macros are pointer casts.
68:         const std::array<NamedContext, 5> knownContexts{ {
69:             { DPI_AWARENESS_CONTEXT_PER_MONITOR_AWARE_V2, "per-monitor v2" },
70:             { DPI_AWARENESS_CONTEXT_PER_MONITOR_AWARE,    "per-monitor v1" },
71:             { DPI_AWARENESS_CONTEXT_SYSTEM_AWARE,         "system" },
72:             { DPI_AWARENESS_CONTEXT_UNAWARE_GDISCALED,    "unaware (GDI scaled)" },
73:             { DPI_AWARENESS_CONTEXT_UNAWARE,              "unaware" },
74:         } };
76:         const DPI_AWARENESS_CONTEXT activeContext{ GetThreadDpiAwarenessContext() };
77:         const char* awarenessName{ "unknown" };
78:         for (const auto& known : knownContexts)
79:         {
80:             if (AreDpiAwarenessContextsEqual(activeContext, known.context))
81:             {
82:                 awarenessName = known.name;
83:                 break;
84:             }
85:         }
87:         const SDL_DisplayID primaryDisplay{ SDL_GetPrimaryDisplay() };
88:         SDL_Rect bounds{};
89:         if (!SDL_GetDisplayBounds(primaryDisplay, &bounds))
90:         {
91:             OutputDebugStringA("[Display] SDL_GetDisplayBounds failed: ");
92:             OutputDebugStringA(SDL_GetError());
93:             OutputDebugStringA("\n");
94:         }
96:         // Why both sizes: SceneBoss and WindowTrackingSystem read GetSystemMetrics,
97:         // which is DPI-virtualized when the process is not per-monitor aware.
98:         std::array<char, 256> line{};
99:         std::snprintf(line.data(), line.size(),
100:             "[Display] DPI awareness: %s | SDL primary: %dx%d | GetSystemMetrics: %dx%d | content scale: %.2f\n",
101:             awarenessName, bounds.w, bounds.h,
102:             GetSystemMetrics(SM_CXSCREEN), GetSystemMetrics(SM_CYSCREEN),
103:             SDL_GetDisplayContentScale(primaryDisplay));
104:         OutputDebugStringA(line.data());
105:     }
106: }
108: int main(int argc, char* argv[])
109: {
110:     std::thread safetyThread(EmergencyWatchdog);
111:     safetyThread.detach();
113:     // Init SDL
114:     if (SDL_Init(SDL_INIT_VIDEO) < 0)
115:     {
116:         MessageBoxA(NULL, SDL_GetError(), "SDL Init Failed", MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
117:         return -1;
118:     }
120:     LogDisplayStartupInfo();
122:     //TestPureWin32Transparency();
123:     try
124:     {
125:         auto framework = std::make_unique<Framework>();
127:         bool running = true;
128:         Uint64 lastTime = SDL_GetPerformanceCounter();
129:         Uint64 frequency = SDL_GetPerformanceFrequency();
131:         // ==========================================
132:         // KONFIGURASI FPS CAP
133:         // ==========================================
134:         const double targetFPS = 60.0; // Silakan ganti ke 30, 90, atau 120
135:         const Uint64 targetTicksPerFrame = frequency / targetFPS;
136:         const Uint64 yieldThreshold = frequency / 500; // Batas aman 2ms untuk CPU napas
138:         while (running)
139:         {
140:             // 1. Catat waktu persis saat frame dimulai
141:             Uint64 frameStart = SDL_GetPerformanceCounter();
144:             SDL_Event event;
145:             while (SDL_PollEvent(&event))
146:             {
147:                 // Why first: these keys must work from the debug window too, and that
148:                 // window swallows its own key events in the next line.
149:                 if (framework && framework->HandleDebugHotkey(event)) continue;
151:                 // Debug host window events never reach game logic.
152:                 if (framework && framework->HandleDebugHostEvent(event)) continue;
154: #if defined(_DEBUG)
155:                 // F11 switches the main window between windowed and borderless.
156:                 // Debug only: a shipped build always covers the display.
157:                 if (event.type == SDL_EVENT_KEY_DOWN && event.key.key == SDLK_F11 && !event.key.repeat)
158:                 {
159:                     if (framework) framework->ToggleMainWindowMode();
160:                 }
161: #endif
163:                 if (event.type == SDL_EVENT_QUIT) running = false;                if (event.type == SDL_EVENT_KEY_DOWN && event.key.key == SDLK_ESCAPE) running = false;
164:                 if (event.type == SDL_EVENT_WINDOW_CLOSE_REQUESTED)
165:                 {
166:                     // Cek window mana yang barusan diklik tombol silangnya
167:                     SDL_Window* closedWin = SDL_GetWindowFromID(event.window.windowID);
168:                     Beyond::Window* mainWin = framework ? framework->GetMainWindow() : nullptr;
170:                     if (mainWin && closedWin == mainWin->GetSDLWindow()) {
171:                         // Yang disilang adalah MAIN WINDOW -> Matikan game!
172:                         running = false;
173:                     }
174:                     else {
175:                         // Yang disilang adalah SUB-WINDOW (Dummy) -> Suruh Framework hapus!
176:                         if (framework) framework->OnSubWindowClosed(event.window.windowID);
177:                     }
178:                 }
180:                 if (event.type == SDL_EVENT_WINDOW_RESIZED || event.type == SDL_EVENT_WINDOW_PIXEL_SIZE_CHANGED)
181:                 {
182:                     SDL_Window* resizedWin = SDL_GetWindowFromID(event.window.windowID);
183:                     if (resizedWin) {
184:                         WindowManager::Instance().HandleResize(resizedWin, event.window.data1, event.window.data2);
185:                     }
186:                 }
188:             }
190:             Uint64 currentTime = SDL_GetPerformanceCounter();
191:             float elapsedTime = (float)(currentTime - lastTime) / (float)frequency;
192:             lastTime = currentTime;
194:             if (elapsedTime > 0.05f) elapsedTime = 0.05f;
196:             if (framework)
197:             {
198:                 framework->Update(elapsedTime);
199:                 framework->Render(elapsedTime);
200:             }
202:             if (!WindowManager::Instance().HasWindows())
203:             {
204:                 running = false;
205:             }
207:             // ==========================================
208:             // 2. LOGIKA PEMBATAS FPS (HYBRID SPIN-WAIT)
209:             // ==========================================
210:             while (true)
211:             {
212:                 Uint64 now = SDL_GetPerformanceCounter();
213:                 Uint64 ticksPassed = now - frameStart;
215:                 // Jika waktu frame sudah mencapai batas (misal 16.66ms), lanjut ke frame berikutnya!
216:                 if (ticksPassed >= targetTicksPerFrame)
217:                 {
218:                     break;
219:                 }
221:                 // Jika sisa waktu masih > 2ms, suruh thread CPU mengalah sebentar
222:                 if (targetTicksPerFrame - ticksPassed > yieldThreshold)
223:                 {
224:                     std::this_thread::yield();
225:                 }
226:             }
227:         }
228:     }
230:     catch (const std::exception& e)
231:     {
232:         std::string errorMessage = "Runtime Error Occurred:\n";
233:         errorMessage += e.what();
234:         MessageBoxA(NULL, errorMessage.c_str(), "CRITICAL ERROR", MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
236:         OutputDebugStringA(errorMessage.c_str());
238:         SDL_Quit();
239:         return -1;
240:     }
241:     catch (...)
242:     {
243:         MessageBoxA(NULL, "Unknown Error Occurred!", "CRITICAL ERROR", MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
244:         SDL_Quit();
245:         return -1;
246:     }
248:     SDL_Quit();
249:     return 0;
250: }

8:     constexpr T Lerp(T a, T b, float t)
9:     {
10:         if (t < 0.0f) return a;
11:         if (t > 1.0f) return b;
12:         return a + (b - a) * t;

<file path="Source/Engine/Common/FitRect.h" lines="88">
1: #pragma once
3: // FitRect - largest centered rectangle of a given aspect ratio inside a pixel rectangle.
4: // Used to letterbox the game canvas into the main window, and (W5) to place the
5: // 16:9 play area on a monitor of any shape.
7: namespace Beyond {
9:     // Axis-aligned rectangle in whole pixels. x/y may be negative (virtual-screen coordinates).
10:     struct PixelRect
11:     {
12:         int x{ 0 };
13:         int y{ 0 };
14:         int width{ 0 };
15:         int height{ 0 };
16:     };
18:     // Returns the largest rect with ratio aspectWidth:aspectHeight that fits inside
19:     // `container`, centered in it. Sizes round down to whole pixels.
20:     // Returns an empty rect at the container origin when the container or the aspect
21:     // is not positive (for example a minimized window reports 0x0).
22:     constexpr PixelRect FitRect(const PixelRect& container, int aspectWidth, int aspectHeight)
23:     {
24:         if (container.width <= 0 || container.height <= 0 || aspectWidth <= 0 || aspectHeight <= 0)
25:         {
26:             return PixelRect{ container.x, container.y, 0, 0 };
27:         }
29:         // Why long long: width * aspect can exceed int range on large virtual desktops.
30:         const long long containerWidth{ container.width };
31:         const long long containerHeight{ container.height };
33:         // Cross-multiplied aspect comparison, so no float rounding decides the branch.
34:         const bool isContainerWider{ containerWidth * aspectHeight >= containerHeight * aspectWidth };
36:         PixelRect fitted{};
37:         if (isContainerWider)
38:         {
39:             // Bars left and right (pillarbox).
40:             fitted.height = container.height;
41:             fitted.width = static_cast<int>(containerHeight * aspectWidth / aspectHeight);
42:         }
43:         else
44:         {
45:             // Bars top and bottom (letterbox).
46:             fitted.width = container.width;
47:             fitted.height = static_cast<int>(containerWidth * aspectHeight / aspectWidth);
48:         }
50:         fitted.x = container.x + (container.width - fitted.width) / 2;
51:         fitted.y = container.y + (container.height - fitted.height) / 2;
52:         return fitted;
53:     }
55:     // ----- Compile-time tests -----
56:     namespace FitRectTest {
58:         constexpr bool IsSameRect(const PixelRect& a, const PixelRect& b)
59:         {
60:             return a.x == b.x && a.y == b.y && a.width == b.width && a.height == b.height;
61:         }
63:         constexpr bool Fits16x9(const PixelRect& container, const PixelRect& expected)
64:         {
65:             return IsSameRect(FitRect(container, 16, 9), expected);
66:         }
68:         // Exact 16:9 containers are filled completely.
69:         static_assert(Fits16x9({ 0, 0, 1920, 1080 }, { 0, 0, 1920, 1080 }), "1080p");
70:         static_assert(Fits16x9({ 0, 0, 1600, 900 }, { 0, 0, 1600, 900 }), "1600x900");
71:         // Wider than 16:9: bars left and right.
72:         static_assert(Fits16x9({ 0, 0, 2560, 1080 }, { 320, 0, 1920, 1080 }), "21:9");
73:         // Taller than 16:9: bars top and bottom.
74:         static_assert(Fits16x9({ 0, 0, 1920, 1200 }, { 0, 60, 1920, 1080 }), "16:10");
75:         static_assert(Fits16x9({ 0, 0, 1280, 1024 }, { 0, 152, 1280, 720 }), "5:4");
76:         static_assert(Fits16x9({ 0, 0, 1080, 1920 }, { 0, 656, 1080, 607 }), "portrait");
77:         // Not exactly 16:9: size rounds down, never exceeds the container.
78:         static_assert(Fits16x9({ 0, 0, 1366, 768 }, { 0, 0, 1365, 768 }), "1366x768");
79:         // Container origin is preserved (second monitor, monitor left of primary).
80:         static_assert(Fits16x9({ 1920, 0, 2560, 1440 }, { 1920, 0, 2560, 1440 }), "second monitor");
81:         static_assert(Fits16x9({ -1920, 0, 1920, 1200 }, { -1920, 60, 1920, 1080 }), "negative origin");
82:         // Degenerate input gives an empty rect, not a division by zero.
83:         static_assert(Fits16x9({ 5, 35, 0, 0 }, { 5, 35, 0, 0 }), "minimized");
84:         static_assert(IsSameRect(FitRect({ 0, 0, 1920, 1080 }, 0, 9), { 0, 0, 0, 0 }), "bad aspect");
85:         // A non-reduced aspect (canvas size) gives the same result as 16:9.
86:         static_assert(IsSameRect(FitRect({ 0, 0, 2560, 1080 }, 1920, 1080), { 320, 0, 1920, 1080 }), "canvas as aspect");
87:     }
88: }
</file>

<file path="Source/Engine/Graphics/BitmapFont.cpp" lines="273">
1: #include "BitmapFont.h"
2: #include "System/Graphics.h" // Untuk mengambil Device & Context
3: #include "Camera.h"
4: #include <fstream>
5: #include <sstream>
6: #include <algorithm>
8: namespace
9: {
10:     size_t NextUtf8Offset(const std::string& text, size_t offset)
11:     {
12:         if (offset >= text.size()) return text.size();
14:         const unsigned char lead = static_cast<unsigned char>(text[offset]);
15:         size_t length = 1;
17:         if ((lead & 0x80) == 0x00) length = 1;
18:         else if ((lead & 0xE0) == 0xC0) length = 2;
19:         else if ((lead & 0xF0) == 0xE0) length = 3;
20:         else if ((lead & 0xF8) == 0xF0) length = 4;
22:         return (std::min)(offset + length, text.size());
23:     }
25:     int DecodeUtf8Codepoint(const std::string& text, size_t offset, size_t nextOffset)
26:     {
27:         const unsigned char c0 = static_cast<unsigned char>(text[offset]);
28:         const size_t length = nextOffset - offset;
30:         if (length == 1) return c0;
31:         if (length == 2)
32:         {
33:             return ((c0 & 0x1F) << 6) |
34:                 (static_cast<unsigned char>(text[offset + 1]) & 0x3F);
35:         }
36:         if (length == 3)
37:         {
38:             return ((c0 & 0x0F) << 12) |
39:                 ((static_cast<unsigned char>(text[offset + 1]) & 0x3F) << 6) |
40:                 (static_cast<unsigned char>(text[offset + 2]) & 0x3F);
41:         }
42:         if (length == 4)
43:         {
44:             return ((c0 & 0x07) << 18) |
45:                 ((static_cast<unsigned char>(text[offset + 1]) & 0x3F) << 12) |
46:                 ((static_cast<unsigned char>(text[offset + 2]) & 0x3F) << 6) |
47:                 (static_cast<unsigned char>(text[offset + 3]) & 0x3F);
48:         }
50:         return c0;
51:     }
52: }
54: BitmapFont::BitmapFont(const std::string& texturePath, const std::string& fontDataPath)
55: {
56:     // 1. Ambil Device dan buat Sprite
57:     auto device = Graphics::Instance().GetDevice();
58:     sprite = std::make_unique<Sprite>(device, texturePath.c_str());
60:     // 2. Parse file .fnt
61:     std::ifstream file(fontDataPath);
62:     if (!file.is_open()) return;
64:     std::string line;
65:     while (std::getline(file, line))
66:     {
67:         // Kita hanya ambil baris yang mendefinisikan karakter ("char id=...")
68:         if (line.find("char id=") != std::string::npos)
69:         {
70:             CharData c;
71:             c.id = ParseValue(line, "id");
72:             c.x = ParseValue(line, "x");
73:             c.y = ParseValue(line, "y");
74:             c.width = ParseValue(line, "width");
75:             c.height = ParseValue(line, "height");
76:             c.xoffset = ParseValue(line, "xoffset");
77:             c.yoffset = ParseValue(line, "yoffset");
78:             c.xadvance = ParseValue(line, "xadvance");
80:             chars[c.id] = c;
81:         }
82:     }
83: }
85: // Fungsi helper untuk mengambil angka dari string seperti "x=10"
86: int BitmapFont::ParseValue(const std::string& line, const std::string& key)
87: {
88:     std::string search = key + "=";
89:     size_t pos = line.find(search);
90:     if (pos == std::string::npos) return 0;
92:     size_t start = pos + search.length();
93:     size_t end = line.find(" ", start);
94:     if (end == std::string::npos) end = line.length();
96:     return std::stoi(line.substr(start, end - start));
97: }
99: void BitmapFont::Draw(const std::string& text, float startX, float startY, float scale, float r, float g, float b, float a)
100: {
101:     if (!sprite) return;
103:     // Ambil Context untuk render
104:     auto dc = Graphics::Instance().GetDeviceContext();
106:     float cursorX = startX;
107:     float cursorY = startY;
109:     // Jarak antar baris (bisa disesuaikan manual atau ambil dari common lineHeight di .fnt)
110:     float lineHeight = 38.0f * scale;
112:     for (size_t offset = 0; offset < text.size(); )
113:     {
114:         const size_t nextOffset = NextUtf8Offset(text, offset);
115:         const int id = DecodeUtf8Codepoint(text, offset, nextOffset);
116:         offset = nextOffset;
118:         if (id == '\n') // Handle Enter/Baris Baru
119:         {
120:             cursorX = startX;
121:             cursorY += lineHeight;
122:             continue;
123:         }
125:         // Jika huruf tidak ada di data, lewati
126:         if (chars.find(id) == chars.end()) continue;
128:         CharData& data = chars[id];
130:         // Hitung posisi visual di layar
131:         float drawX = cursorX + (data.xoffset * scale);
132:         float drawY = cursorY + (data.yoffset * scale);
134:         // --- INI BAGIAN PENTINGNYA ---
135:         // Kita panggil fungsi Render kamu yang support texture slicing (sx, sy, sw, sh)
136:         sprite->Render(
137:             dc,
138:             drawX, drawY, 0.0f,                 // dx, dy, dz (Posisi Layar)
139:             (float)data.width * scale,          // dw (Lebar di Layar)
140:             (float)data.height * scale,         // dh (Tinggi di Layar)
141:             (float)data.x, (float)data.y,       // sx, sy (Posisi Potong di Texture)
142:             (float)data.width, (float)data.height, // sw, sh (Ukuran Potong di Texture)
143:             0.0f,                               // Angle
144:             r, g, b, a                          // Warna
145:         );
147:         // Geser kursor X untuk huruf berikutnya
148:         cursorX += data.xadvance * scale;
149:     }
150: }
152: void BitmapFont::Draw3D(const std::string& text, const Camera* camera,
153:     DirectX::XMFLOAT3 worldPos, float scale, DirectX::XMFLOAT3 rotation, DirectX::XMFLOAT4 color)
154: {
155:     if (!sprite) return;
156:     auto dc = Graphics::Instance().GetDeviceContext();
158:     // -------------------------------------------------------------
159:     // [FIX BLENDING] AKTIFKAN TRANSPARANSI
160:     // -------------------------------------------------------------
161:     auto rs = Graphics::Instance().GetRenderState();
163:     // 1. Aktifkan Alpha Blending (Agar background hitam hilang)
164:     dc->OMSetBlendState(rs->GetBlendState(BlendState::Transparency), nullptr, 0xFFFFFFFF);
166:     // 2. (Opsional tapi PENTING untuk 3D Text) Matikan Z-Write
167:     // Agar kotak transparan teks tidak "membolongi" objek di belakangnya
168:     // Gunakan DepthRead (Test ON, Write OFF) kalau ada, atau biarkan default dulu.
169:     dc->OMSetDepthStencilState(rs->GetDepthStencilState(DepthState::TestOnly), 0);
171:     // -------------------------------------------------------------
173:     using namespace DirectX;
175:     // Matrix Rotasi untuk seluruh teks
176:     XMMATRIX matRot = XMMatrixRotationRollPitchYaw(rotation.x, rotation.y, rotation.z);
178:     // Kursor awal (lokal)
179:     float cursorX = 0.0f;
180:     float cursorY = 0.0f;
181:     float lineHeight = 38.0f * scale;
183:     // Untuk centering text (Opsional, kalau mau teks rata tengah di worldPos)
184:     // DirectX::XMFLOAT2 size = MeasureText(text, scale);
185:     // cursorX = -size.x / 2.0f;
187:     for (size_t offset = 0; offset < text.size(); )
188:     {
189:         const size_t nextOffset = NextUtf8Offset(text, offset);
190:         const int id = DecodeUtf8Codepoint(text, offset, nextOffset);
191:         offset = nextOffset;
193:         if (id == '\n')
194:         {
195:             cursorX = 0.0f; // Reset X
196:             cursorY -= lineHeight; // Di 3D, Y ke bawah itu negatif
197:             continue;
198:         }
200:         if (chars.find(id) == chars.end()) continue;
202:         CharData& data = chars[id];
204:         // 1. Hitung Ukuran Huruf di Dunia
205:         float w = data.width * scale;
206:         float h = data.height * scale;
208:         // 2. Hitung Offset Lokal (Jarak dari titik tumpu teks ke huruf ini)
209:         // Di 2D: Y positif ke bawah. Di 3D: Y positif ke atas. Kita balik Y-nya.
210:         float localX = cursorX + (data.xoffset * scale) + (w / 2.0f); // +w/2 karena Sprite Render pivotnya di tengah
211:         float localY = cursorY - (data.yoffset * scale) - (h / 2.0f);
213:         // 3. Transformasi Posisi Lokal -> Posisi World (Sesuai Rotasi Teks)
214:         XMFLOAT3 localPos = { localX, localY, 0.0f };
215:         XMVECTOR vLocal = XMLoadFloat3(&localPos);
216:         vLocal = XMVector3TransformCoord(vLocal, matRot); // Putar offsetnya
218:         // Tambahkan ke posisi asal teks
219:         XMFLOAT3 finalPos;
220:         XMStoreFloat3(&finalPos, vLocal + XMLoadFloat3(&worldPos));
222:         // 4. Render Huruf
223:         sprite->Render3D(dc, camera,
224:             finalPos.x, finalPos.y, finalPos.z,
225:             w, h,
226:             (float)data.x, (float)data.y,
227:             (float)data.width, (float)data.height,
228:             rotation.x, rotation.y, rotation.z, // Huruf ikut rotasi teks
229:             color.x, color.y, color.z, color.w
230:         );
232:         // 5. Geser Kursor
233:         cursorX += data.xadvance * scale;
234:     }
235: }
237: DirectX::XMFLOAT2 BitmapFont::MeasureText(const std::string& text, float scale)
238: {
239:     float width = 0.0f;
240:     float maxWidth = 0.0f;
241:     int lineCount = 1;
242:     float lineHeight = 38.0f * scale; // Hardcoded sesuai Draw() kamu. Idealnya ini dibaca dari file .fnt ("common lineHeight")
244:     // Kalau kosong, return 0
245:     if (text.empty()) return { 0.0f, 0.0f };
247:     // Hitung Lebar
248:     for (size_t offset = 0; offset < text.size(); )
249:     {
250:         const size_t nextOffset = NextUtf8Offset(text, offset);
251:         const int id = DecodeUtf8Codepoint(text, offset, nextOffset);
252:         offset = nextOffset;
254:         if (id == '\n')
255:         {
256:             maxWidth = (std::max)(maxWidth, width);
257:             width = 0.0f;
258:             ++lineCount;
259:             continue;
260:         }
262:         if (chars.find(id) != chars.end())
263:         {
264:             // xadvance adalah jarak kursor berpindah ke huruf selanjutnya
265:             width += chars[id].xadvance * scale;
266:         }
267:     }
268:     maxWidth = (std::max)(maxWidth, width);
270:     // Untuk tinggi, tombol biasanya cuma 1 baris, jadi kita return tinggi font default
271:     // Kalau mau support multiline, logicnya harus hitung berapa kali '\n' muncul.
272:     return { maxWidth, lineHeight * static_cast<float>(lineCount) };
273: }

133: void Camera::UpdateViewMatrix()
134: {
135:     XMMATRIX matRot = XMMatrixRotationRollPitchYaw(rotation.x, rotation.y, rotation.z);
137:     XMVECTOR vFront = XMVector3TransformNormal(XMVectorSet(0, 0, 1, 0), matRot);
138:     XMVECTOR vRight = XMVector3TransformNormal(XMVectorSet(1, 0, 0, 0), matRot);
139:     XMVECTOR vUp = XMVector3TransformNormal(XMVectorSet(0, 1, 0, 0), matRot);
141:     XMStoreFloat3(&front, vFront);

143:     XMStoreFloat3(&up, vUp);

146:     XMStoreFloat4x4(&view, XMMatrixLookToLH(vPos, vFront, vUp));

149: bool Camera::CheckSphere(float x, float y, float z, float radius)
150: {
151:     // 1. Hitung Matrix View * Projection (Frustum Matrix)
152:     XMMATRIX matView = XMLoadFloat4x4(&view);
153:     XMMATRIX matProj = XMLoadFloat4x4(&projection);
154:     XMMATRIX matViewProj = XMMatrixMultiply(matView, matProj);
156:     XMFLOAT4X4 M;
157:     XMStoreFloat4x4(&M, matViewProj);
159:     // 2. Ekstrak 6 Bidang Frustum (Left, Right, Bottom, Top, Near, Far)
160:     // Rumus: Plane = Row4 +/- RowX
161:     float planes[6][4];
163:     // Left
164:     planes[0][0] = M._14 + M._11; planes[0][1] = M._24 + M._21; planes[0][2] = M._34 + M._31; planes[0][3] = M._44 + M._41;
165:     // Right
166:     planes[1][0] = M._14 - M._11; planes[1][1] = M._24 - M._21; planes[1][2] = M._34 - M._31; planes[1][3] = M._44 - M._41;
167:     // Bottom
168:     planes[2][0] = M._14 + M._12; planes[2][1] = M._24 + M._22; planes[2][2] = M._34 + M._32; planes[2][3] = M._44 + M._42;
169:     // Top
170:     planes[3][0] = M._14 - M._12; planes[3][1] = M._24 - M._22; planes[3][2] = M._34 - M._32; planes[3][3] = M._44 - M._42;
171:     // Near
172:     planes[4][0] = M._13;         planes[4][1] = M._23;         planes[4][2] = M._33;         planes[4][3] = M._43;
173:     // Far
174:     planes[5][0] = M._14 - M._13; planes[5][1] = M._24 - M._23; planes[5][2] = M._34 - M._33; planes[5][3] = M._44 - M._43;
176:     // 3. Cek Jarak Sphere ke 6 Bidang
177:     for (int i = 0; i < 6; ++i)
178:     {
179:         // Normalisasi Plane (Penting agar radius akurat)
180:         float length = sqrtf(planes[i][0] * planes[i][0] + planes[i][1] * planes[i][1] + planes[i][2] * planes[i][2]);
182:         // Dot Product (Jarak titik ke bidang)
183:         float dist = (planes[i][0] * x + planes[i][1] * y + planes[i][2] * z + planes[i][3]) / length;
185:         // Jika jarak < -radius, berarti bola sepenuhnya di BELAKANG bidang ini (luar layar)
186:         if (dist < -radius)
187:         {
188:             return false; // Culling! Jangan render.
189:         }
190:     }
192:     return true; // Visible
193: }
</file>

15: float CameraController::ApplyEasing(float t, EasingType type)
16: {
17:     t = std::clamp(t, 0.0f, 1.0f);
19:     switch (type)
20:     {
21:     case EasingType::EaseInQuad:    return t * t;
22:     case EasingType::EaseOutQuad:   return t * (2.0f - t);
23:     case EasingType::EaseInCubic:   return t * t * t;
24:     case EasingType::EaseOutCubic:  return (--t) * t * t + 1;
25:     case EasingType::SmoothStep:    return t * t * (3.0f - 2.0f * t);
26:     case EasingType::Linear: default: return t;
27:     }
28: }
30: XMFLOAT3 CameraController::LerpFloat3(const XMFLOAT3& start, const XMFLOAT3& end, float t)
31: {
32:     XMVECTOR vStart = XMLoadFloat3(&start);
33:     XMVECTOR vEnd = XMLoadFloat3(&end);
34:     XMVECTOR vResult = XMVectorLerp(vStart, vEnd, t);
36:     XMFLOAT3 result;
37:     XMStoreFloat3(&result, vResult);
38:     return result;
39: }
41: XMFLOAT3 CameraController::CalculateHermitePos(const XMFLOAT3& p0, const XMFLOAT3& p1, const XMFLOAT3& p2, const XMFLOAT3& p3, float t, float tension)
42: {
43:     // Catmull-Rom / Hermite spline implementation
44:     // P1 = Start, P2 = End. P0 & P3 are control points for tangents.
46:     XMVECTOR vP0 = XMLoadFloat3(&p0);
47:     XMVECTOR vP1 = XMLoadFloat3(&p1);
48:     XMVECTOR vP2 = XMLoadFloat3(&p2);
49:     XMVECTOR vP3 = XMLoadFloat3(&p3);
51:     // Calculate segment length for tension scaling
52:     float segLength = XMVectorGetX(XMVector3Length(XMVectorSubtract(vP2, vP1)));
54:     // Tangent 1 (at P1) -> Direction from P0 to P2
55:     XMVECTOR vT1 = XMVector3Normalize(XMVectorSubtract(vP2, vP0)) * segLength * tension;
57:     // Tangent 2 (at P2) -> Direction from P1 to P3
58:     XMVECTOR vT2 = XMVector3Normalize(XMVectorSubtract(vP3, vP1)) * segLength * tension;
60:     // Hermite Basis Functions
61:     float t2 = t * t;
62:     float t3 = t2 * t;
63:     float h1 = 2.0f * t3 - 3.0f * t2 + 1.0f;
64:     float h2 = -2.0f * t3 + 3.0f * t2;
65:     float h3 = t3 - 2.0f * t2 + t;
66:     float h4 = t3 - t2;
68:     XMVECTOR result = (vP1 * h1) + (vP2 * h2) + (vT1 * h3) + (vT2 * h4);
70:     XMFLOAT3 finalPos;
71:     XMStoreFloat3(&finalPos, result);
72:     return finalPos;
73: }
75: // =========================================================
76: // CORE LOGIC
77: // =========================================================

99: void CameraController::Update(float elapsedTime)
100: {
101:     std::shared_ptr<Camera> camera = m_activeCamera.lock();
102:     if (!camera) return;
104:     // Catatan: Gunakan dt murni (unscaled) agar kamera tetap bergetar meski waktu game berhenti (Hit Stop)
105:     if (m_trauma > 0.0f) {
106:         m_trauma -= m_traumaDecay * elapsedTime;
107:         if (m_trauma < 0.0f) m_trauma = 0.0f;
109:         // Vlambeer Formula: getaran = trauma kuadrat (Membuat efek redanya sangat natural)
110:         float shake = m_trauma * m_trauma;
111:         float maxOffset = 2.0f; // Kekuatan getaran maksimal (Unit 3D)
113:         // Random generator sederhana (-1.0 sampai 1.0)
114:         float rx = ((rand() % 200) - 100) / 100.0f;
115:         float rz = ((rand() % 200) - 100) / 100.0f;
117:         m_shakeOffset.x = rx * maxOffset * shake;
118:         m_shakeOffset.y = 0.0f; // Sengaja dikunci agar layar tidak naik-turun terlalu pusing
119:         m_shakeOffset.z = rz * maxOffset * shake;
120:     }
121:     else {
122:         m_shakeOffset = { 0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f };
123:     }
125:     // --- Global Inputs (Cursor Toggle) ---
126:     static bool isF1Pressed = false;
127:     const bool isKbmSuppressed{ Input::Instance().IsKeyboardMouseSuppressed() };
128:     bool f1Down = !isKbmSuppressed && (GetKeyState(VK_F1) & 0x8000) != 0;
129:     if (f1Down && !isF1Pressed)
130:     {
131:         if (m_controlMode == CameraControlMode::Mouse || m_controlMode == CameraControlMode::Free)
132:         {
133:             m_toggleCursor = !m_toggleCursor;
134:         }
135:         isF1Pressed = true;
136:     }
137:     else if (!f1Down)
138:     {
139:         isF1Pressed = false;
140:     }
142:     // Cursor Lock Logic
143:     bool shouldLock = (m_controlMode == CameraControlMode::Sequence ||
144:         m_controlMode == CameraControlMode::FixedStatic ||
145:         m_controlMode == CameraControlMode::FixedFollow)
146:         ? false : m_toggleCursor;
148:     Input::Instance().GetMouse().LockCursor(shouldLock);
150:     // --- State Machine ---
151:     switch (m_controlMode)
152:     {
153:     case CameraControlMode::Sequence:    UpdateSequence(elapsedTime, camera); break;
154:     case CameraControlMode::FixedFollow: UpdateFixedFollow(elapsedTime, camera); break;
155:     case CameraControlMode::FixedStatic: UpdateFixedStatic(camera); break;
156:     case CameraControlMode::Free:        UpdateFreeCamera(elapsedTime, camera); break;
157:     case CameraControlMode::GamePad:
158:     case CameraControlMode::Mouse:       UpdateOrbitCamera(elapsedTime, camera); break;
159:     }
161:     // =========================================================
162:     // POST-UPDATE MODIFIERS (Shake, Sway, Headbob, etc.)
163:     // =========================================================
165:     // 1. Ambil Data Offset dari JuiceEngine
166:     // (Tidak perlu hitung logika di sini, cukup ambil hasilnya)
167:     XMFLOAT3 shakePos = JuiceEngine::Instance().GetShakePosOffset();
168:     XMFLOAT3 shakeRot = JuiceEngine::Instance().GetShakeRotOffset();
170:     // 2. Apply Position (Additive)
171:     XMFLOAT3 currentPos = camera->GetPosition();
172:     currentPos.x += shakePos.x;
173:     currentPos.y += shakePos.y;
174:     currentPos.z += shakePos.z;
175:     camera->SetPosition(currentPos);
177:     // 3. Apply Rotation (Additive)
178:     XMFLOAT3 currentRot = camera->GetRotation();
179:     currentRot.x += shakeRot.x;
180:     currentRot.y += shakeRot.y;
181:     currentRot.z += shakeRot.z;
182:     camera->SetRotation(currentRot);
183: }
185: // =========================================================
186: // STATE HANDLERS
187: // =========================================================
189: void CameraController::UpdateSequence(float dt, std::shared_ptr<Camera>& camera)
190: {
191:     if (m_sequenceQueue.empty())
192:     {
193:         SetControlMode(CameraControlMode::FixedStatic);
194:         return;
195:     }
197:     const CameraKeyframe& targetKey = m_sequenceQueue[m_currentKeyframeIdx];
198:     if (m_seqTimer == 0.0f)
199:     {
200:         // Setup posisi awal interpolasi
201:         if (targetKey.isJumpCut)
202:         {
203:             // MODE CUT & PAN:
204:             // Paksa start point ke posisi Awal yang ditentukan Shot ini
205:             m_seqStartPos = targetKey.StartPosition;
206:             m_seqStartRot = targetKey.StartRotation;
208:             // Langsung teleport kamera ke posisi start biar gak ada glitch visual 1 frame
209:             camera->SetPosition(m_seqStartPos);
210:             camera->SetRotation(m_seqStartRot);
211:         }
212:         else
213:         {
214:             // MODE SAMBUNG (CONTINUOUS):
215:             // Start point adalah posisi kamera saat ini (akhir dari shot sebelumnya)
216:             m_seqStartPos = camera->GetPosition();
217:             m_seqStartRot = camera->GetRotation();
218:         }
219:     }
221:     m_seqTimer += dt;
223:     // Calculate progress (t)
224:     float t = (targetKey.Duration > 0.0f) ? (m_seqTimer / targetKey.Duration) : 1.0f;
226:     if (t >= 1.0f)
227:     {
228:         // Snap to target
229:         camera->SetPosition(targetKey.TargetPosition);
230:         camera->SetRotation(targetKey.TargetRotation);
232:         // Advance Keyframe
233:         m_currentKeyframeIdx++;
234:         m_seqTimer = 0.0f;
236:         if (m_currentKeyframeIdx >= m_sequenceQueue.size())
237:         {
238:             if (m_seqLoop)
239:             {
240:                 m_currentKeyframeIdx = 0;
241:                 m_seqStartPos = camera->GetPosition();
242:                 m_seqStartRot = camera->GetRotation();
243:             }
244:             else
245:             {
246:                 // Sequence Finished
247:                 m_fixedPos = camera->GetPosition();
248:                 // 1. Ambil Rotasi Terakhir
249:                 XMFLOAT3 finalRot = camera->GetRotation();
251:                 // 2. Hitung Forward Vector dari Rotasi tersebut
252:                 XMMATRIX rotMat = XMMatrixRotationRollPitchYaw(finalRot.x, finalRot.y, finalRot.z);
253:                 XMVECTOR vForward = XMVectorSet(0, 0, 1, 0); // Forward default
254:                 vForward = XMVector3TransformNormal(vForward, rotMat);
256:                 // 3. Proyeksikan Target baru di depan kamera (misal jarak 10 unit)
257:                 XMVECTOR vPos = XMLoadFloat3(&m_fixedPos);
258:                 XMVECTOR vNewTarget = XMVectorAdd(vPos, XMVectorScale(vForward, 10.0f));
260:                 // 4. Simpan ke m_targetPos
261:                 XMStoreFloat3(&m_targetPos, vNewTarget);
262:                 // ===========================
264:                 SetControlMode(CameraControlMode::FixedStatic);
265:             }
266:         }
267:         else
268:         {
269:             // Prepare for next segment
270:             m_seqStartPos = camera->GetPosition();
271:             m_seqStartRot = camera->GetRotation();
272:         }
273:     }
274:     else
275:     {
276:         XMFLOAT3 newPos;
277:         XMFLOAT3 newRot;
278:         // Interpolation
279:         if (targetKey.Easing == EasingType::Step)
280:         {
281:             // HARD CUT / JUMP CUT MODE
282:             // Abaikan interpolasi dari StartPos.
283:             // Posisi LANGSUNG di Target sejak detik ke-0 frame ini.
284:             // "Duration" sekarang berfungsi sebagai "Hold Time".
285:             newPos = targetKey.TargetPosition;
286:             newRot = targetKey.TargetRotation;
287:         }
288:         else
289:         {
290:             float easeT = ApplyEasing(t, targetKey.Easing);
291:             if (m_useSpline)
292:             {
293:                 // Get P0 (Prev), P1 (Start), P2 (Target), P3 (Next)
294:                 XMFLOAT3 p0 = (m_currentKeyframeIdx > 0) ? m_sequenceQueue[m_currentKeyframeIdx - 1].TargetPosition : m_seqStartPos;
295:                 XMFLOAT3 p3 = (m_currentKeyframeIdx + 1 < m_sequenceQueue.size()) ? m_sequenceQueue[m_currentKeyframeIdx + 1].TargetPosition : targetKey.TargetPosition;
297:                 newPos = CalculateHermitePos(p0, m_seqStartPos, targetKey.TargetPosition, p3, easeT, m_splineTension);
298:             }
299:             else
300:             {
301:                 newPos = LerpFloat3(m_seqStartPos, targetKey.TargetPosition, easeT);
302:             }
304:             // Simple Lerp for rotation (Switch to Quaternion Slerp if needed later)
305:             XMFLOAT3 newRot = LerpFloat3(m_seqStartRot, targetKey.TargetRotation, easeT);
307:             camera->SetPosition(newPos);
308:             camera->SetRotation(newRot);
310:             // Sync internal state
311:             m_eyePos = newPos;
312:             m_currentAngle = newRot;
313:             m_fixedPos = newPos;
314:         }
315:     }
316: }
318: void CameraController::UpdateFixedFollow(float dt, std::shared_ptr<Camera>& camera)
319: {
320:     // DYNAMIC COMBAT ZOOM (Smooth Lerp)
321:     // How fast the camera zooms in and out during combat
322:     float zoomLerpSpeed = 2.5f;
323:     m_currentZoomOffset += (m_targetZoomOffset - m_currentZoomOffset) * zoomLerpSpeed * dt;
325:     XMFLOAT3 dynamicOffset = m_fixedPos;
326:     // Lower the Y height based on the zoom
327:     dynamicOffset.y += m_currentZoomOffset;
328:     // Push the Z forward slightly as it zooms in to keep the player centered
329:     dynamicOffset.z -= m_currentZoomOffset * 0.5f;
331:     // CALCULATE DESIRED POSITION
332:     XMFLOAT3 desiredPos;
333:     desiredPos.x = m_targetPos.x + dynamicOffset.x;
334:     desiredPos.y = m_targetPos.y + dynamicOffset.y;
335:     desiredPos.z = m_targetPos.z + dynamicOffset.z;
337:     // SOFT FOLLOW (Lerp)
338:     float followSpeed = 5.0f;
340:     XMFLOAT3 currentPos = camera->GetPosition();
341:     XMFLOAT3 newPos;
343:     newPos.x = currentPos.x + (desiredPos.x - currentPos.x) * followSpeed * dt;
344:     newPos.y = currentPos.y + (desiredPos.y - currentPos.y) * followSpeed * dt;
345:     newPos.z = currentPos.z + (desiredPos.z - currentPos.z) * followSpeed * dt;
347:     camera->SetPosition(newPos);
349:     // SMOOTH LOOK AT
350:     XMFLOAT3 desiredLookAt;
351:     desiredLookAt.x = m_targetPos.x + m_targetOffset.x;
352:     desiredLookAt.y = m_targetPos.y + m_targetOffset.y;
353:     desiredLookAt.z = m_targetPos.z + m_targetOffset.z;
355:     camera->LookAt(desiredLookAt);
356: }
358: void CameraController::UpdateFixedStatic(std::shared_ptr<Camera>& camera)
359: {
360:     XMVECTOR vTarget = XMLoadFloat3(&m_targetPos);
361:     XMVECTOR vOffset = XMLoadFloat3(&m_targetOffset);
362:     XMVECTOR vFinalTarget = XMVectorAdd(vTarget, vOffset);
364:     XMFLOAT3 finalTargetPos;
365:     XMStoreFloat3(&finalTargetPos, vFinalTarget);
367:     camera->SetPosition(m_fixedPos);
368:     camera->LookAt(finalTargetPos);
370:     // Apply manual rotation offsets
371:     if (m_fixedYawOffset != 0.0f || m_fixedRollOffset != 0.0f)
372:     {
373:         XMFLOAT3 currentRot = camera->GetRotation();
374:         currentRot.y += m_fixedYawOffset;
375:         currentRot.z = m_fixedRollOffset;
376:         camera->SetRotation(currentRot);
377:     }
378: }
380: void CameraController::UpdateFreeCamera(float dt, std::shared_ptr<Camera>& camera)
381: {
382:     // Rotation
383:     if (m_toggleCursor)
384:     {
385:         Mouse& mouse = Input::Instance().GetMouse();
386:         float sensitivity = 0.5f;
387:         float rotSpeed = m_rollSpeed * dt;
389:         XMFLOAT3 currentRot = camera->GetRotation();
390:         currentRot.y += static_cast<float>(mouse.GetDeltaX()) * sensitivity * rotSpeed;
391:         currentRot.x += static_cast<float>(mouse.GetDeltaY()) * sensitivity * rotSpeed;
393:         camera->SetRotation(currentRot);
394:         m_currentAngle = currentRot; // Sync
395:     }
397:     // Movement (Using Win32 GetKeyState for now, ideally abstract this)
398:     float moveAmount = m_moveSpeed * dt;
399:     XMFLOAT3 moveDir = { 0, 0, 0 };
401:     if (!Input::Instance().IsKeyboardMouseSuppressed())
402:     {
403:         if (GetKeyState('W') & 0x8000) moveDir.z += moveAmount;
404:         if (GetKeyState('S') & 0x8000) moveDir.z -= moveAmount;
405:         if (GetKeyState('A') & 0x8000) moveDir.x -= moveAmount;
406:         if (GetKeyState('D') & 0x8000) moveDir.x += moveAmount;
407:         if (GetKeyState(VK_SPACE) & 0x8000)   moveDir.y += moveAmount;
408:         if (GetKeyState(VK_CONTROL) & 0x8000) moveDir.y -= moveAmount;
409:     }
411:     camera->Translate(moveDir);
412:     m_eyePos = camera->GetPosition();
413: }
415: void CameraController::UpdateOrbitCamera(float dt, std::shared_ptr<Camera>& camera)
416: {
417:     float ax = 0.0f;
418:     float ay = 0.0f;
420:     if (m_controlMode == CameraControlMode::GamePad)
421:     {
422:         GamePad& gamePad = Input::Instance().GetGamePad();
423:         ax = gamePad.GetAxisRX();
424:         ay = gamePad.GetAxisRY();
425:     }
426:     else if (m_controlMode == CameraControlMode::Mouse && m_toggleCursor)
427:     {
428:         Mouse& mouse = Input::Instance().GetMouse();
429:         float sensitivity = 0.5f;
430:         ax = static_cast<float>(mouse.GetDeltaX()) * sensitivity;
431:         ay = static_cast<float>(mouse.GetDeltaY()) * sensitivity;
432:     }
434:     // Update Angles
435:     float speed = m_rollSpeed * dt;
436:     m_currentAngle.x += ay * speed;
437:     m_currentAngle.y += ax * speed;
439:     // Clamp Pitch
440:     m_currentAngle.x = std::clamp(m_currentAngle.x, m_minAngleX, m_maxAngleX);
442:     // Wrap Yaw
443:     if (m_currentAngle.y > XM_PI) m_currentAngle.y -= XM_2PI;
444:     if (m_currentAngle.y < -XM_PI) m_currentAngle.y += XM_2PI;
446:     // Calculate Position
447:     XMMATRIX matRot = XMMatrixRotationRollPitchYaw(m_currentAngle.x, m_currentAngle.y, 0.0f);
448:     XMVECTOR vOffset = XMVectorSet(0, 0, -m_orbitRange, 0);
449:     vOffset = XMVector3TransformCoord(vOffset, matRot);
451:     XMVECTOR vTarget = XMLoadFloat3(&m_targetPos);
452:     XMVECTOR vEye = XMVectorAdd(vTarget, vOffset);
454:     XMFLOAT3 finalPos;
455:     XMStoreFloat3(&finalPos, vEye);
457:     camera->SetPosition(finalPos);
458:     camera->LookAt(m_targetPos);
460:     m_eyePos = finalPos;
461: }

496: void CameraController::PlaySequence(const std::vector<CameraKeyframe>& sequence, bool loop)
497: {
498:     if (sequence.empty()) return;
500:     m_sequenceQueue = sequence;
501:     m_currentKeyframeIdx = 0;
502:     m_seqTimer = 0.0f;
503:     m_seqLoop = loop;
505:     auto camera = m_activeCamera.lock();
506:     if (camera)
507:     {
508:         m_seqStartPos = camera->GetPosition();
509:         m_seqStartRot = camera->GetRotation();
510:     }
512:     SetControlMode(CameraControlMode::Sequence);
513: }
515: void CameraController::PlaySequenceBySpeed(const std::vector<CameraKeyframe>& targets, float speed, EasingType globalEasing, bool useSplinePath, bool loop)
516: {
517:     if (targets.empty() || speed <= 0.0f) return;
519:     m_useSpline = useSplinePath;
520:     std::vector<CameraKeyframe> processedSequence = targets;
522:     XMFLOAT3 currentPos;
523:     auto camera = m_activeCamera.lock();
524:     if (camera) currentPos = camera->GetPosition();
525:     else currentPos = { 0,0,0 };
527:     for (size_t i = 0; i < processedSequence.size(); ++i)
528:     {
529:         CameraKeyframe& key = processedSequence[i];
531:         // 1. Determine Easing
532:         if (globalEasing == EasingType::SequenceAutoCubic && processedSequence.size() > 1)
533:         {
534:             if (i == 0) key.Easing = EasingType::EaseInCubic;
535:             else if (i == processedSequence.size() - 1) key.Easing = EasingType::EaseOutCubic;
536:             else key.Easing = EasingType::Linear;
537:         }
538:         else
539:         {
540:             key.Easing = (globalEasing == EasingType::SequenceAutoCubic) ? EasingType::SmoothStep : globalEasing;
541:         }
543:         // 2. Calculate Duration based on Distance & Speed
544:         XMVECTOR vStart = XMLoadFloat3(&currentPos);
545:         XMVECTOR vEnd = XMLoadFloat3(&key.TargetPosition);
546:         float distance = XMVectorGetX(XMVector3Length(XMVectorSubtract(vEnd, vStart)));
548:         key.Duration = (distance > 0.001f) ? (distance / speed) : 0.0f;
549:         currentPos = key.TargetPosition;
550:     }
552:     PlaySequence(processedSequence, loop);
553: }
