1128: //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
1129: //
1130: // stbtt__buf helpers to parse data from file
1131: //
1133: static stbtt_uint8 stbtt__buf_get8(stbtt__buf* b)
1134: {
1135:     if (b->cursor >= b->size)
1136:         return 0;
1137:     return b->data[b->cursor++];
1138: }
1140: static stbtt_uint8 stbtt__buf_peek8(stbtt__buf* b)
1141: {
1142:     if (b->cursor >= b->size)
1143:         return 0;
1144:     return b->data[b->cursor];
1145: }
1147: static void stbtt__buf_seek(stbtt__buf* b, int o)
1148: {
1149:     STBTT_assert(!(o > b->size || o < 0));
1150:     b->cursor = (o > b->size || o < 0) ? b->size : o;
1151: }
1153: static void stbtt__buf_skip(stbtt__buf* b, int o)
1154: {
1155:     stbtt__buf_seek(b, b->cursor + o);
1156: }
1158: static stbtt_uint32 stbtt__buf_get(stbtt__buf* b, int n)
1159: {
1160:     stbtt_uint32 v = 0;
1161:     int i;
1162:     STBTT_assert(n >= 1 && n <= 4);
1163:     for (i = 0; i < n; i++)
1164:         v = (v << 8) | stbtt__buf_get8(b);
1165:     return v;
1166: }
1168: static stbtt__buf stbtt__new_buf(const void* p, size_t size)
1169: {
1170:     stbtt__buf r;
1171:     STBTT_assert(size < 0x40000000);
1172:     r.data = (stbtt_uint8*)p;
1173:     r.size = (int)size;
1174:     r.cursor = 0;
1175:     return r;
1176: }
1178: #define stbtt__buf_get16(b)  stbtt__buf_get((b), 2)
1179: #define stbtt__buf_get32(b)  stbtt__buf_get((b), 4)
1181: static stbtt__buf stbtt__buf_range(const stbtt__buf* b, int o, int s)
1182: {
1183:     stbtt__buf r = stbtt__new_buf(NULL, 0);
1184:     if (o < 0 || s < 0 || o > b->size || s > b->size - o) return r;
1185:     r.data = b->data + o;
1186:     r.size = s;
1187:     return r;
1188: }
1190: static stbtt__buf stbtt__cff_get_index(stbtt__buf* b)
1191: {
1192:     int count, start, offsize;
1193:     start = b->cursor;
1194:     count = stbtt__buf_get16(b);
1195:     if (count) {
1196:         offsize = stbtt__buf_get8(b);
1197:         STBTT_assert(offsize >= 1 && offsize <= 4);
1198:         stbtt__buf_skip(b, offsize * count);
1199:         stbtt__buf_skip(b, stbtt__buf_get(b, offsize) - 1);
1200:     }
1201:     return stbtt__buf_range(b, start, b->cursor - start);
1202: }
1204: static stbtt_uint32 stbtt__cff_int(stbtt__buf* b)
1205: {
1206:     int b0 = stbtt__buf_get8(b);
1207:     if (b0 >= 32 && b0 <= 246)       return b0 - 139;
1208:     else if (b0 >= 247 && b0 <= 250) return (b0 - 247) * 256 + stbtt__buf_get8(b) + 108;
1209:     else if (b0 >= 251 && b0 <= 254) return -(b0 - 251) * 256 - stbtt__buf_get8(b) - 108;
1210:     else if (b0 == 28)               return stbtt__buf_get16(b);
1211:     else if (b0 == 29)               return stbtt__buf_get32(b);
1212:     STBTT_assert(0);
1213:     return 0;
1214: }
1216: static void stbtt__cff_skip_operand(stbtt__buf* b) {
1217:     int v, b0 = stbtt__buf_peek8(b);
1218:     STBTT_assert(b0 >= 28);
1219:     if (b0 == 30) {
1220:         stbtt__buf_skip(b, 1);
1221:         while (b->cursor < b->size) {
1222:             v = stbtt__buf_get8(b);
1223:             if ((v & 0xF) == 0xF || (v >> 4) == 0xF)
1224:                 break;
1225:         }
1226:     }
1227:     else {
1228:         stbtt__cff_int(b);
1229:     }
1230: }
1232: static stbtt__buf stbtt__dict_get(stbtt__buf* b, int key)
1233: {
1234:     stbtt__buf_seek(b, 0);
1235:     while (b->cursor < b->size) {
1236:         int start = b->cursor, end, op;
1237:         while (stbtt__buf_peek8(b) >= 28)
1238:             stbtt__cff_skip_operand(b);
1239:         end = b->cursor;
1240:         op = stbtt__buf_get8(b);
1241:         if (op == 12)  op = stbtt__buf_get8(b) | 0x100;
1242:         if (op == key) return stbtt__buf_range(b, start, end - start);
1243:     }
1244:     return stbtt__buf_range(b, 0, 0);
1245: }
1247: static void stbtt__dict_get_ints(stbtt__buf* b, int key, int outcount, stbtt_uint32* out)
1248: {
1249:     int i;
1250:     stbtt__buf operands = stbtt__dict_get(b, key);
1251:     for (i = 0; i < outcount && operands.cursor < operands.size; i++)
1252:         out[i] = stbtt__cff_int(&operands);
1253: }
1255: static int stbtt__cff_index_count(stbtt__buf* b)
1256: {
1257:     stbtt__buf_seek(b, 0);
1258:     return stbtt__buf_get16(b);
1259: }
1261: static stbtt__buf stbtt__cff_index_get(stbtt__buf b, int i)
1262: {
1263:     int count, offsize, start, end;
1264:     stbtt__buf_seek(&b, 0);
1265:     count = stbtt__buf_get16(&b);
1266:     offsize = stbtt__buf_get8(&b);
1267:     STBTT_assert(i >= 0 && i < count);
1268:     STBTT_assert(offsize >= 1 && offsize <= 4);
1269:     stbtt__buf_skip(&b, i * offsize);
1270:     start = stbtt__buf_get(&b, offsize);
1271:     end = stbtt__buf_get(&b, offsize);
1272:     return stbtt__buf_range(&b, 2 + (count + 1) * offsize + start, end - start);
1273: }
1275: //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
1276: //
1277: // accessors to parse data from file
1278: //
1280: // on platforms that don't allow misaligned reads, if we want to allow
1281: // truetype fonts that aren't padded to alignment, define ALLOW_UNALIGNED_TRUETYPE
1283: #define ttBYTE(p)     (* (stbtt_uint8 *) (p))
1284: #define ttCHAR(p)     (* (stbtt_int8 *) (p))
1285: #define ttFixed(p)    ttLONG(p)
1287: static stbtt_uint16 ttUSHORT(stbtt_uint8* p) { return p[0] * 256 + p[1]; }
1288: static stbtt_int16 ttSHORT(stbtt_uint8* p) { return p[0] * 256 + p[1]; }
1289: static stbtt_uint32 ttULONG(stbtt_uint8* p) { return (p[0] << 24) + (p[1] << 16) + (p[2] << 8) + p[3]; }
1290: static stbtt_int32 ttLONG(stbtt_uint8* p) { return (p[0] << 24) + (p[1] << 16) + (p[2] << 8) + p[3]; }
1292: #define stbtt_tag4(p,c0,c1,c2,c3) ((p)[0] == (c0) && (p)[1] == (c1) && (p)[2] == (c2) && (p)[3] == (c3))
1293: #define stbtt_tag(p,str)           stbtt_tag4(p,str[0],str[1],str[2],str[3])
1295: static int stbtt__isfont(stbtt_uint8* font)
1296: {
1297:     // check the version number
1298:     if (stbtt_tag4(font, '1', 0, 0, 0))  return 1; // TrueType 1
1299:     if (stbtt_tag(font, "typ1"))   return 1; // TrueType with type 1 font -- we don't support this!
1300:     if (stbtt_tag(font, "OTTO"))   return 1; // OpenType with CFF
1301:     if (stbtt_tag4(font, 0, 1, 0, 0)) return 1; // OpenType 1.0
1302:     if (stbtt_tag(font, "true"))   return 1; // Apple specification for TrueType fonts
1303:     return 0;
1304: }
1306: // @OPTIMIZE: binary search
1307: static stbtt_uint32 stbtt__find_table(stbtt_uint8* data, stbtt_uint32 fontstart, const char* tag)
1308: {
1309:     stbtt_int32 num_tables = ttUSHORT(data + fontstart + 4);
1310:     stbtt_uint32 tabledir = fontstart + 12;
1311:     stbtt_int32 i;
1312:     for (i = 0; i < num_tables; ++i) {
1313:         stbtt_uint32 loc = tabledir + 16 * i;
1314:         if (stbtt_tag(data + loc + 0, tag))
1315:             return ttULONG(data + loc + 8);
1316:     }
1317:     return 0;
1318: }
1320: static int stbtt_GetFontOffsetForIndex_internal(unsigned char* font_collection, int index)
1321: {
1322:     // if it's just a font, there's only one valid index
1323:     if (stbtt__isfont(font_collection))
1324:         return index == 0 ? 0 : -1;
1326:     // check if it's a TTC
1327:     if (stbtt_tag(font_collection, "ttcf")) {
1328:         // version 1?
1329:         if (ttULONG(font_collection + 4) == 0x00010000 || ttULONG(font_collection + 4) == 0x00020000) {
1330:             stbtt_int32 n = ttLONG(font_collection + 8);
1331:             if (index >= n)
1332:                 return -1;
1333:             return ttULONG(font_collection + 12 + index * 4);
1334:         }
1335:     }
1336:     return -1;
1337: }
1339: static int stbtt_GetNumberOfFonts_internal(unsigned char* font_collection)
1340: {
1341:     // if it's just a font, there's only one valid font
1342:     if (stbtt__isfont(font_collection))
1343:         return 1;
1345:     // check if it's a TTC
1346:     if (stbtt_tag(font_collection, "ttcf")) {
1347:         // version 1?
1348:         if (ttULONG(font_collection + 4) == 0x00010000 || ttULONG(font_collection + 4) == 0x00020000) {
1349:             return ttLONG(font_collection + 8);
1350:         }
1351:     }
1352:     return 0;
1353: }
1355: static stbtt__buf stbtt__get_subrs(stbtt__buf cff, stbtt__buf fontdict)
1356: {
1357:     stbtt_uint32 subrsoff = 0, private_loc[2] = { 0, 0 };
1358:     stbtt__buf pdict;
1359:     stbtt__dict_get_ints(&fontdict, 18, 2, private_loc);
1360:     if (!private_loc[1] || !private_loc[0]) return stbtt__new_buf(NULL, 0);
1361:     pdict = stbtt__buf_range(&cff, private_loc[1], private_loc[0]);
1362:     stbtt__dict_get_ints(&pdict, 19, 1, &subrsoff);
1363:     if (!subrsoff) return stbtt__new_buf(NULL, 0);
1364:     stbtt__buf_seek(&cff, private_loc[1] + subrsoff);
1365:     return stbtt__cff_get_index(&cff);
1366: }
1368: // since most people won't use this, find this table the first time it's needed
1369: static int stbtt__get_svg(stbtt_fontinfo* info)
1370: {
1371:     stbtt_uint32 t;
1372:     if (info->svg < 0) {
1373:         t = stbtt__find_table(info->data, info->fontstart, "SVG ");
1374:         if (t) {
1375:             stbtt_uint32 offset = ttULONG(info->data + t + 2);
1376:             info->svg = t + offset;
1377:         }
1378:         else {
1379:             info->svg = 0;
1380:         }
1381:     }
1382:     return info->svg;
1383: }
1385: static int stbtt_InitFont_internal(stbtt_fontinfo* info, unsigned char* data, int fontstart)
1386: {
1387:     stbtt_uint32 cmap, t;
1388:     stbtt_int32 i, numTables;
1390:     info->data = data;
1391:     info->fontstart = fontstart;
1392:     info->cff = stbtt__new_buf(NULL, 0);
1394:     cmap = stbtt__find_table(data, fontstart, "cmap");       // required
1395:     info->loca = stbtt__find_table(data, fontstart, "loca"); // required
1396:     info->head = stbtt__find_table(data, fontstart, "head"); // required
1397:     info->glyf = stbtt__find_table(data, fontstart, "glyf"); // required
1398:     info->hhea = stbtt__find_table(data, fontstart, "hhea"); // required
1399:     info->hmtx = stbtt__find_table(data, fontstart, "hmtx"); // required
1400:     info->kern = stbtt__find_table(data, fontstart, "kern"); // not required
1401:     info->gpos = stbtt__find_table(data, fontstart, "GPOS"); // not required
1403:     if (!cmap || !info->head || !info->hhea || !info->hmtx)
1404:         return 0;
1405:     if (info->glyf) {
1406:         // required for truetype
1407:         if (!info->loca) return 0;
1408:     }
1409:     else {
1410:         // initialization for CFF / Type2 fonts (OTF)
1411:         stbtt__buf b, topdict, topdictidx;
1412:         stbtt_uint32 cstype = 2, charstrings = 0, fdarrayoff = 0, fdselectoff = 0;
1413:         stbtt_uint32 cff;
1415:         cff = stbtt__find_table(data, fontstart, "CFF ");
1416:         if (!cff) return 0;
1418:         info->fontdicts = stbtt__new_buf(NULL, 0);
1419:         info->fdselect = stbtt__new_buf(NULL, 0);
1421:         // @TODO this should use size from table (not 512MB)
1422:         info->cff = stbtt__new_buf(data + cff, 512 * 1024 * 1024);
1423:         b = info->cff;
1425:         // read the header
1426:         stbtt__buf_skip(&b, 2);
1427:         stbtt__buf_seek(&b, stbtt__buf_get8(&b)); // hdrsize
1429:         // @TODO the name INDEX could list multiple fonts,
1430:         // but we just use the first one.
1431:         stbtt__cff_get_index(&b);  // name INDEX
1432:         topdictidx = stbtt__cff_get_index(&b);
1433:         topdict = stbtt__cff_index_get(topdictidx, 0);
1434:         stbtt__cff_get_index(&b);  // string INDEX
1435:         info->gsubrs = stbtt__cff_get_index(&b);
1437:         stbtt__dict_get_ints(&topdict, 17, 1, &charstrings);
1438:         stbtt__dict_get_ints(&topdict, 0x100 | 6, 1, &cstype);
1439:         stbtt__dict_get_ints(&topdict, 0x100 | 36, 1, &fdarrayoff);
1440:         stbtt__dict_get_ints(&topdict, 0x100 | 37, 1, &fdselectoff);
1441:         info->subrs = stbtt__get_subrs(b, topdict);
1443:         // we only support Type 2 charstrings
1444:         if (cstype != 2) return 0;
1445:         if (charstrings == 0) return 0;
1447:         if (fdarrayoff) {
1448:             // looks like a CID font
1449:             if (!fdselectoff) return 0;
1450:             stbtt__buf_seek(&b, fdarrayoff);
1451:             info->fontdicts = stbtt__cff_get_index(&b);
1452:             info->fdselect = stbtt__buf_range(&b, fdselectoff, b.size - fdselectoff);
1453:         }
1455:         stbtt__buf_seek(&b, charstrings);
1456:         info->charstrings = stbtt__cff_get_index(&b);
1457:     }
1459:     t = stbtt__find_table(data, fontstart, "maxp");
1460:     if (t)
1461:         info->numGlyphs = ttUSHORT(data + t + 4);
1462:     else
1463:         info->numGlyphs = 0xffff;
1465:     info->svg = -1;
1467:     // find a cmap encoding table we understand *now* to avoid searching
1468:     // later. (todo: could make this installable)
1469:     // the same regardless of glyph.
1470:     numTables = ttUSHORT(data + cmap + 2);
1471:     info->index_map = 0;
1472:     for (i = 0; i < numTables; ++i) {
1473:         stbtt_uint32 encoding_record = cmap + 4 + 8 * i;
1474:         // find an encoding we understand:
1475:         switch (ttUSHORT(data + encoding_record)) {
1476:         case STBTT_PLATFORM_ID_MICROSOFT:
1477:             switch (ttUSHORT(data + encoding_record + 2)) {
1478:             case STBTT_MS_EID_UNICODE_BMP:
1479:             case STBTT_MS_EID_UNICODE_FULL:
1480:                 // MS/Unicode
1481:                 info->index_map = cmap + ttULONG(data + encoding_record + 4);
1482:                 break;
1483:             }
1484:             break;
1485:         case STBTT_PLATFORM_ID_UNICODE:
1486:             // Mac/iOS has these
1487:             // all the encodingIDs are unicode, so we don't bother to check it
1488:             info->index_map = cmap + ttULONG(data + encoding_record + 4);
1489:             break;
1490:         }
1491:     }
1492:     if (info->index_map == 0)
1493:         return 0;
1495:     info->indexToLocFormat = ttUSHORT(data + info->head + 50);
1496:     return 1;
1497: }
1499: STBTT_DEF int stbtt_FindGlyphIndex(const stbtt_fontinfo* info, int unicode_codepoint)
1500: {
1501:     stbtt_uint8* data = info->data;
1502:     stbtt_uint32 index_map = info->index_map;
1504:     stbtt_uint16 format = ttUSHORT(data + index_map + 0);
1505:     if (format == 0) { // apple byte encoding
1506:         stbtt_int32 bytes = ttUSHORT(data + index_map + 2);
1507:         if (unicode_codepoint < bytes - 6)
1508:             return ttBYTE(data + index_map + 6 + unicode_codepoint);
1509:         return 0;
1510:     }
1511:     else if (format == 6) {
1512:         stbtt_uint32 first = ttUSHORT(data + index_map + 6);
1513:         stbtt_uint32 count = ttUSHORT(data + index_map + 8);
1514:         if ((stbtt_uint32)unicode_codepoint >= first && (stbtt_uint32)unicode_codepoint < first + count)
1515:             return ttUSHORT(data + index_map + 10 + (unicode_codepoint - first) * 2);
1516:         return 0;
1517:     }
1518:     else if (format == 2) {
1519:         STBTT_assert(0); // @TODO: high-byte mapping for japanese/chinese/korean
1520:         return 0;
1521:     }
1522:     else if (format == 4) { // standard mapping for windows fonts: binary search collection of ranges
1523:         stbtt_uint16 segcount = ttUSHORT(data + index_map + 6) >> 1;
1524:         stbtt_uint16 searchRange = ttUSHORT(data + index_map + 8) >> 1;
1525:         stbtt_uint16 entrySelector = ttUSHORT(data + index_map + 10);
1526:         stbtt_uint16 rangeShift = ttUSHORT(data + index_map + 12) >> 1;
1528:         // do a binary search of the segments
1529:         stbtt_uint32 endCount = index_map + 14;
1530:         stbtt_uint32 search = endCount;
1532:         if (unicode_codepoint > 0xffff)
1533:             return 0;
1535:         // they lie from endCount .. endCount + segCount
1536:         // but searchRange is the nearest power of two, so...
1537:         if (unicode_codepoint >= ttUSHORT(data + search + rangeShift * 2))
1538:             search += rangeShift * 2;
1540:         // now decrement to bias correctly to find smallest
1541:         search -= 2;
1542:         while (entrySelector) {
1543:             stbtt_uint16 end;
1544:             searchRange >>= 1;
1545:             end = ttUSHORT(data + search + searchRange * 2);
1546:             if (unicode_codepoint > end)
1547:                 search += searchRange * 2;
1548:             --entrySelector;
1549:         }
1550:         search += 2;
1552:         {
1553:             stbtt_uint16 offset, start, last;
1554:             stbtt_uint16 item = (stbtt_uint16)((search - endCount) >> 1);
1556:             start = ttUSHORT(data + index_map + 14 + segcount * 2 + 2 + 2 * item);
1557:             last = ttUSHORT(data + endCount + 2 * item);
1558:             if (unicode_codepoint < start || unicode_codepoint > last)
1559:                 return 0;
1561:             offset = ttUSHORT(data + index_map + 14 + segcount * 6 + 2 + 2 * item);
1562:             if (offset == 0)
1563:                 return (stbtt_uint16)(unicode_codepoint + ttSHORT(data + index_map + 14 + segcount * 4 + 2 + 2 * item));
1565:             return ttUSHORT(data + offset + (unicode_codepoint - start) * 2 + index_map + 14 + segcount * 6 + 2 + 2 * item);
1566:         }
1567:     }
1568:     else if (format == 12 || format == 13) {
1569:         stbtt_uint32 ngroups = ttULONG(data + index_map + 12);
1570:         stbtt_int32 low, high;
1571:         low = 0; high = (stbtt_int32)ngroups;
1572:         // Binary search the right group.
1573:         while (low < high) {
1574:             stbtt_int32 mid = low + ((high - low) >> 1); // rounds down, so low <= mid < high
1575:             stbtt_uint32 start_char = ttULONG(data + index_map + 16 + mid * 12);
1576:             stbtt_uint32 end_char = ttULONG(data + index_map + 16 + mid * 12 + 4);
1577:             if ((stbtt_uint32)unicode_codepoint < start_char)
1578:                 high = mid;
1579:             else if ((stbtt_uint32)unicode_codepoint > end_char)
1580:                 low = mid + 1;
1581:             else {
1582:                 stbtt_uint32 start_glyph = ttULONG(data + index_map + 16 + mid * 12 + 8);
1583:                 if (format == 12)
1584:                     return start_glyph + unicode_codepoint - start_char;
1585:                 else // format == 13
1586:                     return start_glyph;
1587:             }
1588:         }
1589:         return 0; // not found
1590:     }
1591:     // @TODO
1592:     STBTT_assert(0);
1593:     return 0;
1594: }
1596: STBTT_DEF int stbtt_GetCodepointShape(const stbtt_fontinfo* info, int unicode_codepoint, stbtt_vertex** vertices)
1597: {
1598:     return stbtt_GetGlyphShape(info, stbtt_FindGlyphIndex(info, unicode_codepoint), vertices);
1599: }
1601: static void stbtt_setvertex(stbtt_vertex* v, stbtt_uint8 type, stbtt_int32 x, stbtt_int32 y, stbtt_int32 cx, stbtt_int32 cy)
1602: {
1603:     v->type = type;
1604:     v->x = (stbtt_int16)x;
1605:     v->y = (stbtt_int16)y;
1606:     v->cx = (stbtt_int16)cx;
1607:     v->cy = (stbtt_int16)cy;
1608: }
1610: static int stbtt__GetGlyfOffset(const stbtt_fontinfo* info, int glyph_index)
1611: {
1612:     int g1, g2;
1614:     STBTT_assert(!info->cff.size);
1616:     if (glyph_index >= info->numGlyphs) return -1; // glyph index out of range
1617:     if (info->indexToLocFormat >= 2)    return -1; // unknown index->glyph map format
1619:     if (info->indexToLocFormat == 0) {
1620:         g1 = info->glyf + ttUSHORT(info->data + info->loca + glyph_index * 2) * 2;
1621:         g2 = info->glyf + ttUSHORT(info->data + info->loca + glyph_index * 2 + 2) * 2;
1622:     }
1623:     else {
1624:         g1 = info->glyf + ttULONG(info->data + info->loca + glyph_index * 4);
1625:         g2 = info->glyf + ttULONG(info->data + info->loca + glyph_index * 4 + 4);
1626:     }
1628:     return g1 == g2 ? -1 : g1; // if length is 0, return -1
1629: }
1631: static int stbtt__GetGlyphInfoT2(const stbtt_fontinfo* info, int glyph_index, int* x0, int* y0, int* x1, int* y1);
1633: STBTT_DEF int stbtt_GetGlyphBox(const stbtt_fontinfo* info, int glyph_index, int* x0, int* y0, int* x1, int* y1)
1634: {
1635:     if (info->cff.size) {
1636:         stbtt__GetGlyphInfoT2(info, glyph_index, x0, y0, x1, y1);
1637:     }
1638:     else {
1639:         int g = stbtt__GetGlyfOffset(info, glyph_index);
1640:         if (g < 0) return 0;
1642:         if (x0) *x0 = ttSHORT(info->data + g + 2);
1643:         if (y0) *y0 = ttSHORT(info->data + g + 4);
1644:         if (x1) *x1 = ttSHORT(info->data + g + 6);
1645:         if (y1) *y1 = ttSHORT(info->data + g + 8);
1646:     }
1647:     return 1;
1648: }
1650: STBTT_DEF int stbtt_GetCodepointBox(const stbtt_fontinfo* info, int codepoint, int* x0, int* y0, int* x1, int* y1)
1651: {
1652:     return stbtt_GetGlyphBox(info, stbtt_FindGlyphIndex(info, codepoint), x0, y0, x1, y1);
1653: }
1655: STBTT_DEF int stbtt_IsGlyphEmpty(const stbtt_fontinfo* info, int glyph_index)
1656: {
1657:     stbtt_int16 numberOfContours;
1658:     int g;
1659:     if (info->cff.size)
1660:         return stbtt__GetGlyphInfoT2(info, glyph_index, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL) == 0;
1661:     g = stbtt__GetGlyfOffset(info, glyph_index);
1662:     if (g < 0) return 1;
1663:     numberOfContours = ttSHORT(info->data + g);
1664:     return numberOfContours == 0;
1665: }
1667: static int stbtt__close_shape(stbtt_vertex* vertices, int num_vertices, int was_off, int start_off,
1668:     stbtt_int32 sx, stbtt_int32 sy, stbtt_int32 scx, stbtt_int32 scy, stbtt_int32 cx, stbtt_int32 cy)
1669: {
1670:     if (start_off) {
1671:         if (was_off)
1672:             stbtt_setvertex(&vertices[num_vertices++], STBTT_vcurve, (cx + scx) >> 1, (cy + scy) >> 1, cx, cy);
1673:         stbtt_setvertex(&vertices[num_vertices++], STBTT_vcurve, sx, sy, scx, scy);
1674:     }
1675:     else {
1676:         if (was_off)
1677:             stbtt_setvertex(&vertices[num_vertices++], STBTT_vcurve, sx, sy, cx, cy);
1678:         else
1679:             stbtt_setvertex(&vertices[num_vertices++], STBTT_vline, sx, sy, 0, 0);
1680:     }
1681:     return num_vertices;
1682: }
1684: static int stbtt__GetGlyphShapeTT(const stbtt_fontinfo* info, int glyph_index, stbtt_vertex** pvertices)
1685: {
1686:     stbtt_int16 numberOfContours;
1687:     stbtt_uint8* endPtsOfContours;
1688:     stbtt_uint8* data = info->data;
1689:     stbtt_vertex* vertices = 0;
1690:     int num_vertices = 0;
1691:     int g = stbtt__GetGlyfOffset(info, glyph_index);
1693:     *pvertices = NULL;
1695:     if (g < 0) return 0;
1697:     numberOfContours = ttSHORT(data + g);
1699:     if (numberOfContours > 0) {
1700:         stbtt_uint8 flags = 0, flagcount;
1701:         stbtt_int32 ins, i, j = 0, m, n, next_move, was_off = 0, off, start_off = 0;
1702:         stbtt_int32 x, y, cx, cy, sx, sy, scx, scy;
1703:         stbtt_uint8* points;
1704:         endPtsOfContours = (data + g + 10);
1705:         ins = ttUSHORT(data + g + 10 + numberOfContours * 2);
1706:         points = data + g + 10 + numberOfContours * 2 + 2 + ins;
1708:         n = 1 + ttUSHORT(endPtsOfContours + numberOfContours * 2 - 2);
1710:         m = n + 2 * numberOfContours;  // a loose bound on how many vertices we might need
1711:         vertices = (stbtt_vertex*)STBTT_malloc(m * sizeof(vertices[0]), info->userdata);
1712:         if (vertices == 0)
1713:             return 0;
1715:         next_move = 0;
1716:         flagcount = 0;
1718:         // in first pass, we load uninterpreted data into the allocated array
1719:         // above, shifted to the end of the array so we won't overwrite it when
1720:         // we create our final data starting from the front
1722:         off = m - n; // starting offset for uninterpreted data, regardless of how m ends up being calculated
1724:         // first load flags
1726:         for (i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
1727:             if (flagcount == 0) {
1728:                 flags = *points++;
1729:                 if (flags & 8)
1730:                     flagcount = *points++;
1731:             }
1732:             else
1733:                 --flagcount;
1734:             vertices[off + i].type = flags;
1735:         }
1737:         // now load x coordinates
1738:         x = 0;
1739:         for (i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
1740:             flags = vertices[off + i].type;
1741:             if (flags & 2) {
1742:                 stbtt_int16 dx = *points++;
1743:                 x += (flags & 16) ? dx : -dx; // ???
1744:             }
1745:             else {
1746:                 if (!(flags & 16)) {
1747:                     x = x + (stbtt_int16)(points[0] * 256 + points[1]);
1748:                     points += 2;
1749:                 }
1750:             }
1751:             vertices[off + i].x = (stbtt_int16)x;
1752:         }
1754:         // now load y coordinates
1755:         y = 0;
1756:         for (i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
1757:             flags = vertices[off + i].type;
1758:             if (flags & 4) {
1759:                 stbtt_int16 dy = *points++;
1760:                 y += (flags & 32) ? dy : -dy; // ???
1761:             }
1762:             else {
1763:                 if (!(flags & 32)) {
1764:                     y = y + (stbtt_int16)(points[0] * 256 + points[1]);
1765:                     points += 2;
1766:                 }
1767:             }
1768:             vertices[off + i].y = (stbtt_int16)y;
1769:         }
1771:         // now convert them to our format
1772:         num_vertices = 0;
1773:         sx = sy = cx = cy = scx = scy = 0;
1774:         for (i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
1775:             flags = vertices[off + i].type;
1776:             x = (stbtt_int16)vertices[off + i].x;
1777:             y = (stbtt_int16)vertices[off + i].y;
1779:             if (next_move == i) {
1780:                 if (i != 0)
1781:                     num_vertices = stbtt__close_shape(vertices, num_vertices, was_off, start_off, sx, sy, scx, scy, cx, cy);
1783:                 // now start the new one
1784:                 start_off = !(flags & 1);
1785:                 if (start_off) {
1786:                     // if we start off with an off-curve point, then when we need to find a point on the curve
1787:                     // where we can start, and we need to save some state for when we wraparound.
1788:                     scx = x;
1789:                     scy = y;
1790:                     if (!(vertices[off + i + 1].type & 1)) {
1791:                         // next point is also a curve point, so interpolate an on-point curve
1792:                         sx = (x + (stbtt_int32)vertices[off + i + 1].x) >> 1;
1793:                         sy = (y + (stbtt_int32)vertices[off + i + 1].y) >> 1;
1794:                     }
1795:                     else {
1796:                         // otherwise just use the next point as our start point
1797:                         sx = (stbtt_int32)vertices[off + i + 1].x;
1798:                         sy = (stbtt_int32)vertices[off + i + 1].y;
1799:                         ++i; // we're using point i+1 as the starting point, so skip it
1800:                     }
1801:                 }
1802:                 else {
1803:                     sx = x;
1804:                     sy = y;
1805:                 }
1806:                 stbtt_setvertex(&vertices[num_vertices++], STBTT_vmove, sx, sy, 0, 0);
1807:                 was_off = 0;
1808:                 next_move = 1 + ttUSHORT(endPtsOfContours + j * 2);
1809:                 ++j;
1810:             }
1811:             else {
1812:                 if (!(flags & 1)) { // if it's a curve
1813:                     if (was_off) // two off-curve control points in a row means interpolate an on-curve midpoint
1814:                         stbtt_setvertex(&vertices[num_vertices++], STBTT_vcurve, (cx + x) >> 1, (cy + y) >> 1, cx, cy);
1815:                     cx = x;
1816:                     cy = y;
1817:                     was_off = 1;
1818:                 }
1819:                 else {
1820:                     if (was_off)
1821:                         stbtt_setvertex(&vertices[num_vertices++], STBTT_vcurve, x, y, cx, cy);
1822:                     else
1823:                         stbtt_setvertex(&vertices[num_vertices++], STBTT_vline, x, y, 0, 0);
1824:                     was_off = 0;
1825:                 }
1826:             }
1827:         }
1828:         num_vertices = stbtt__close_shape(vertices, num_vertices, was_off, start_off, sx, sy, scx, scy, cx, cy);
1829:     }
1830:     else if (numberOfContours < 0) {
1831:         // Compound shapes.
1832:         int more = 1;
1833:         stbtt_uint8* comp = data + g + 10;
1834:         num_vertices = 0;
1835:         vertices = 0;
1836:         while (more) {
1837:             stbtt_uint16 flags, gidx;
1838:             int comp_num_verts = 0, i;
1839:             stbtt_vertex* comp_verts = 0, * tmp = 0;
1840:             float mtx[6] = { 1,0,0,1,0,0 }, m, n;
1842:             flags = ttSHORT(comp); comp += 2;
1843:             gidx = ttSHORT(comp); comp += 2;
1845:             if (flags & 2) { // XY values
1846:                 if (flags & 1) { // shorts
1847:                     mtx[4] = ttSHORT(comp); comp += 2;
1848:                     mtx[5] = ttSHORT(comp); comp += 2;
1849:                 }
1850:                 else {
1851:                     mtx[4] = ttCHAR(comp); comp += 1;
1852:                     mtx[5] = ttCHAR(comp); comp += 1;
1853:                 }
1854:             }
1855:             else {
1856:                 // @TODO handle matching point
1857:                 STBTT_assert(0);
1858:             }
1859:             if (flags & (1 << 3)) { // WE_HAVE_A_SCALE
1860:                 mtx[0] = mtx[3] = ttSHORT(comp) / 16384.0f; comp += 2;
1861:                 mtx[1] = mtx[2] = 0;
1862:             }
1863:             else if (flags & (1 << 6)) { // WE_HAVE_AN_X_AND_YSCALE
1864:                 mtx[0] = ttSHORT(comp) / 16384.0f; comp += 2;
1865:                 mtx[1] = mtx[2] = 0;
1866:                 mtx[3] = ttSHORT(comp) / 16384.0f; comp += 2;
1867:             }
1868:             else if (flags & (1 << 7)) { // WE_HAVE_A_TWO_BY_TWO
1869:                 mtx[0] = ttSHORT(comp) / 16384.0f; comp += 2;
1870:                 mtx[1] = ttSHORT(comp) / 16384.0f; comp += 2;
1871:                 mtx[2] = ttSHORT(comp) / 16384.0f; comp += 2;
1872:                 mtx[3] = ttSHORT(comp) / 16384.0f; comp += 2;
1873:             }
1875:             // Find transformation scales.
1876:             m = (float)STBTT_sqrt(mtx[0] * mtx[0] + mtx[1] * mtx[1]);
1877:             n = (float)STBTT_sqrt(mtx[2] * mtx[2] + mtx[3] * mtx[3]);
1879:             // Get indexed glyph.
1880:             comp_num_verts = stbtt_GetGlyphShape(info, gidx, &comp_verts);
1881:             if (comp_num_verts > 0) {
1882:                 // Transform vertices.
1883:                 for (i = 0; i < comp_num_verts; ++i) {
1884:                     stbtt_vertex* v = &comp_verts[i];
1885:                     stbtt_vertex_type x, y;
1886:                     x = v->x; y = v->y;
1887:                     v->x = (stbtt_vertex_type)(m * (mtx[0] * x + mtx[2] * y + mtx[4]));
1888:                     v->y = (stbtt_vertex_type)(n * (mtx[1] * x + mtx[3] * y + mtx[5]));
1889:                     x = v->cx; y = v->cy;
1890:                     v->cx = (stbtt_vertex_type)(m * (mtx[0] * x + mtx[2] * y + mtx[4]));
1891:                     v->cy = (stbtt_vertex_type)(n * (mtx[1] * x + mtx[3] * y + mtx[5]));
1892:                 }
1893:                 // Append vertices.
1894:                 tmp = (stbtt_vertex*)STBTT_malloc((num_vertices + comp_num_verts) * sizeof(stbtt_vertex), info->userdata);
1895:                 if (!tmp) {
1896:                     if (vertices) STBTT_free(vertices, info->userdata);
1897:                     if (comp_verts) STBTT_free(comp_verts, info->userdata);
1898:                     return 0;
1899:                 }
1900:                 if (num_vertices > 0 && vertices) STBTT_memcpy(tmp, vertices, num_vertices * sizeof(stbtt_vertex));
1901:                 STBTT_memcpy(tmp + num_vertices, comp_verts, comp_num_verts * sizeof(stbtt_vertex));
1902:                 if (vertices) STBTT_free(vertices, info->userdata);
1903:                 vertices = tmp;
1904:                 STBTT_free(comp_verts, info->userdata);
1905:                 num_vertices += comp_num_verts;
1906:             }
1907:             // More components ?
1908:             more = flags & (1 << 5);
1909:         }
1910:     }
1911:     else {
1912:         // numberOfCounters == 0, do nothing
1913:     }
1915:     *pvertices = vertices;
1916:     return num_vertices;
1917: }
1919: typedef struct
1920: {
1921:     int bounds;
1922:     int started;
1923:     float first_x, first_y;
1924:     float x, y;
1925:     stbtt_int32 min_x, max_x, min_y, max_y;
1927:     stbtt_vertex* pvertices;
1928:     int num_vertices;
1929: } stbtt__csctx;
1931: #define STBTT__CSCTX_INIT(bounds) {bounds,0, 0,0, 0,0, 0,0,0,0, NULL, 0}
1933: static void stbtt__track_vertex(stbtt__csctx* c, stbtt_int32 x, stbtt_int32 y)
1934: {
1935:     if (x > c->max_x || !c->started) c->max_x = x;
1936:     if (y > c->max_y || !c->started) c->max_y = y;
1937:     if (x < c->min_x || !c->started) c->min_x = x;
1938:     if (y < c->min_y || !c->started) c->min_y = y;
1939:     c->started = 1;
1940: }
1942: static void stbtt__csctx_v(stbtt__csctx* c, stbtt_uint8 type, stbtt_int32 x, stbtt_int32 y, stbtt_int32 cx, stbtt_int32 cy, stbtt_int32 cx1, stbtt_int32 cy1)
1943: {
1944:     if (c->bounds) {
1945:         stbtt__track_vertex(c, x, y);
1946:         if (type == STBTT_vcubic) {
1947:             stbtt__track_vertex(c, cx, cy);
1948:             stbtt__track_vertex(c, cx1, cy1);
1949:         }
1950:     }
1951:     else {
1952:         stbtt_setvertex(&c->pvertices[c->num_vertices], type, x, y, cx, cy);
1953:         c->pvertices[c->num_vertices].cx1 = (stbtt_int16)cx1;
1954:         c->pvertices[c->num_vertices].cy1 = (stbtt_int16)cy1;
1955:     }
1956:     c->num_vertices++;
1957: }
1959: static void stbtt__csctx_close_shape(stbtt__csctx* ctx)
1960: {
1961:     if (ctx->first_x != ctx->x || ctx->first_y != ctx->y)
1962:         stbtt__csctx_v(ctx, STBTT_vline, (int)ctx->first_x, (int)ctx->first_y, 0, 0, 0, 0);
1963: }
1965: static void stbtt__csctx_rmove_to(stbtt__csctx* ctx, float dx, float dy)
1966: {
1967:     stbtt__csctx_close_shape(ctx);
1968:     ctx->first_x = ctx->x = ctx->x + dx;
1969:     ctx->first_y = ctx->y = ctx->y + dy;
1970:     stbtt__csctx_v(ctx, STBTT_vmove, (int)ctx->x, (int)ctx->y, 0, 0, 0, 0);
1971: }
1973: static void stbtt__csctx_rline_to(stbtt__csctx* ctx, float dx, float dy)
1974: {
1975:     ctx->x += dx;
1976:     ctx->y += dy;
1977:     stbtt__csctx_v(ctx, STBTT_vline, (int)ctx->x, (int)ctx->y, 0, 0, 0, 0);
1978: }
1980: static void stbtt__csctx_rccurve_to(stbtt__csctx* ctx, float dx1, float dy1, float dx2, float dy2, float dx3, float dy3)
1981: {
1982:     float cx1 = ctx->x + dx1;
1983:     float cy1 = ctx->y + dy1;
1984:     float cx2 = cx1 + dx2;
1985:     float cy2 = cy1 + dy2;
1986:     ctx->x = cx2 + dx3;
1987:     ctx->y = cy2 + dy3;
1988:     stbtt__csctx_v(ctx, STBTT_vcubic, (int)ctx->x, (int)ctx->y, (int)cx1, (int)cy1, (int)cx2, (int)cy2);
1989: }
1991: static stbtt__buf stbtt__get_subr(stbtt__buf idx, int n)
1992: {
1993:     int count = stbtt__cff_index_count(&idx);
1994:     int bias = 107;
1995:     if (count >= 33900)
1996:         bias = 32768;
1997:     else if (count >= 1240)
1998:         bias = 1131;
1999:     n += bias;
2000:     if (n < 0 || n >= count)
2001:         return stbtt__new_buf(NULL, 0);
2002:     return stbtt__cff_index_get(idx, n);
2003: }
2005: static stbtt__buf stbtt__cid_get_glyph_subrs(const stbtt_fontinfo* info, int glyph_index)
2006: {
2007:     stbtt__buf fdselect = info->fdselect;
2008:     int nranges, start, end, v, fmt, fdselector = -1, i;
2010:     stbtt__buf_seek(&fdselect, 0);
2011:     fmt = stbtt__buf_get8(&fdselect);
2012:     if (fmt == 0) {
2013:         // untested
2014:         stbtt__buf_skip(&fdselect, glyph_index);
2015:         fdselector = stbtt__buf_get8(&fdselect);
2016:     }
2017:     else if (fmt == 3) {
2018:         nranges = stbtt__buf_get16(&fdselect);
2019:         start = stbtt__buf_get16(&fdselect);
2020:         for (i = 0; i < nranges; i++) {
2021:             v = stbtt__buf_get8(&fdselect);
2022:             end = stbtt__buf_get16(&fdselect);
2023:             if (glyph_index >= start && glyph_index < end) {
2024:                 fdselector = v;
2025:                 break;
2026:             }
2027:             start = end;
2028:         }
2029:     }
2030:     if (fdselector == -1) stbtt__new_buf(NULL, 0);
2031:     return stbtt__get_subrs(info->cff, stbtt__cff_index_get(info->fontdicts, fdselector));
2032: }
2034: static int stbtt__run_charstring(const stbtt_fontinfo* info, int glyph_index, stbtt__csctx* c)
2035: {
2036:     int in_header = 1, maskbits = 0, subr_stack_height = 0, sp = 0, v, i, b0;
2037:     int has_subrs = 0, clear_stack;
2038:     float s[48];
2039:     stbtt__buf subr_stack[10], subrs = info->subrs, b;
2040:     float f;
2042: #define STBTT__CSERR(s) (0)
2044:     // this currently ignores the initial width value, which isn't needed if we have hmtx
2045:     b = stbtt__cff_index_get(info->charstrings, glyph_index);
2046:     while (b.cursor < b.size) {
2047:         i = 0;
2048:         clear_stack = 1;
2049:         b0 = stbtt__buf_get8(&b);
2050:         switch (b0) {
2051:             // @TODO implement hinting
2052:         case 0x13: // hintmask
2053:         case 0x14: // cntrmask
2054:             if (in_header)
2055:                 maskbits += (sp / 2); // implicit "vstem"
2056:             in_header = 0;
2057:             stbtt__buf_skip(&b, (maskbits + 7) / 8);
2058:             break;
2060:         case 0x01: // hstem
2061:         case 0x03: // vstem
2062:         case 0x12: // hstemhm
2063:         case 0x17: // vstemhm
2064:             maskbits += (sp / 2);
2065:             break;
2067:         case 0x15: // rmoveto
2068:             in_header = 0;
2069:             if (sp < 2) return STBTT__CSERR("rmoveto stack");
2070:             stbtt__csctx_rmove_to(c, s[sp - 2], s[sp - 1]);
2071:             break;
2072:         case 0x04: // vmoveto
2073:             in_header = 0;
2074:             if (sp < 1) return STBTT__CSERR("vmoveto stack");
2075:             stbtt__csctx_rmove_to(c, 0, s[sp - 1]);
2076:             break;
2077:         case 0x16: // hmoveto
2078:             in_header = 0;
2079:             if (sp < 1) return STBTT__CSERR("hmoveto stack");
2080:             stbtt__csctx_rmove_to(c, s[sp - 1], 0);
2081:             break;
2083:         case 0x05: // rlineto
2084:             if (sp < 2) return STBTT__CSERR("rlineto stack");
2085:             for (; i + 1 < sp; i += 2)
2086:                 stbtt__csctx_rline_to(c, s[i], s[i + 1]);
2087:             break;
2089:             // hlineto/vlineto and vhcurveto/hvcurveto alternate horizontal and vertical
2090:             // starting from a different place.
2092:         case 0x07: // vlineto
2093:             if (sp < 1) return STBTT__CSERR("vlineto stack");
2094:             goto vlineto;
2095:         case 0x06: // hlineto
2096:             if (sp < 1) return STBTT__CSERR("hlineto stack");
2097:             for (;;) {
2098:                 if (i >= sp) break;
2099:                 stbtt__csctx_rline_to(c, s[i], 0);
2100:                 i++;
2101:             vlineto:
2102:                 if (i >= sp) break;
2103:                 stbtt__csctx_rline_to(c, 0, s[i]);
2104:                 i++;
2105:             }
2106:             break;
2108:         case 0x1F: // hvcurveto
2109:             if (sp < 4) return STBTT__CSERR("hvcurveto stack");
2110:             goto hvcurveto;
2111:         case 0x1E: // vhcurveto
2112:             if (sp < 4) return STBTT__CSERR("vhcurveto stack");
2113:             for (;;) {
2114:                 if (i + 3 >= sp) break;
2115:                 stbtt__csctx_rccurve_to(c, 0, s[i], s[i + 1], s[i + 2], s[i + 3], (sp - i == 5) ? s[i + 4] : 0.0f);
2116:                 i += 4;
2117:             hvcurveto:
2118:                 if (i + 3 >= sp) break;
2119:                 stbtt__csctx_rccurve_to(c, s[i], 0, s[i + 1], s[i + 2], (sp - i == 5) ? s[i + 4] : 0.0f, s[i + 3]);
2120:                 i += 4;
2121:             }
2122:             break;
2124:         case 0x08: // rrcurveto
2125:             if (sp < 6) return STBTT__CSERR("rcurveline stack");
2126:             for (; i + 5 < sp; i += 6)
2127:                 stbtt__csctx_rccurve_to(c, s[i], s[i + 1], s[i + 2], s[i + 3], s[i + 4], s[i + 5]);
2128:             break;
2130:         case 0x18: // rcurveline
2131:             if (sp < 8) return STBTT__CSERR("rcurveline stack");
2132:             for (; i + 5 < sp - 2; i += 6)
2133:                 stbtt__csctx_rccurve_to(c, s[i], s[i + 1], s[i + 2], s[i + 3], s[i + 4], s[i + 5]);
2134:             if (i + 1 >= sp) return STBTT__CSERR("rcurveline stack");
2135:             stbtt__csctx_rline_to(c, s[i], s[i + 1]);
2136:             break;
2138:         case 0x19: // rlinecurve
2139:             if (sp < 8) return STBTT__CSERR("rlinecurve stack");
2140:             for (; i + 1 < sp - 6; i += 2)
2141:                 stbtt__csctx_rline_to(c, s[i], s[i + 1]);
2142:             if (i + 5 >= sp) return STBTT__CSERR("rlinecurve stack");
2143:             stbtt__csctx_rccurve_to(c, s[i], s[i + 1], s[i + 2], s[i + 3], s[i + 4], s[i + 5]);
2144:             break;
2146:         case 0x1A: // vvcurveto
2147:         case 0x1B: // hhcurveto
2148:             if (sp < 4) return STBTT__CSERR("(vv|hh)curveto stack");
2149:             f = 0.0;
2150:             if (sp & 1) { f = s[i]; i++; }
2151:             for (; i + 3 < sp; i += 4) {
2152:                 if (b0 == 0x1B)
2153:                     stbtt__csctx_rccurve_to(c, s[i], f, s[i + 1], s[i + 2], s[i + 3], 0.0);
2154:                 else
2155:                     stbtt__csctx_rccurve_to(c, f, s[i], s[i + 1], s[i + 2], 0.0, s[i + 3]);
2156:                 f = 0.0;
2157:             }
2158:             break;
2160:         case 0x0A: // callsubr
2161:             if (!has_subrs) {
2162:                 if (info->fdselect.size)
2163:                     subrs = stbtt__cid_get_glyph_subrs(info, glyph_index);
2164:                 has_subrs = 1;
2165:             }
2166:             // FALLTHROUGH
2167:         case 0x1D: // callgsubr
2168:             if (sp < 1) return STBTT__CSERR("call(g|)subr stack");
2169:             v = (int)s[--sp];
2170:             if (subr_stack_height >= 10) return STBTT__CSERR("recursion limit");
2171:             subr_stack[subr_stack_height++] = b;
2172:             b = stbtt__get_subr(b0 == 0x0A ? subrs : info->gsubrs, v);
2173:             if (b.size == 0) return STBTT__CSERR("subr not found");
2174:             b.cursor = 0;
2175:             clear_stack = 0;
2176:             break;
2178:         case 0x0B: // return
2179:             if (subr_stack_height <= 0) return STBTT__CSERR("return outside subr");
2180:             b = subr_stack[--subr_stack_height];
2181:             clear_stack = 0;
2182:             break;
2184:         case 0x0E: // endchar
2185:             stbtt__csctx_close_shape(c);
2186:             return 1;
2188:         case 0x0C: { // two-byte escape
2189:             float dx1, dx2, dx3, dx4, dx5, dx6, dy1, dy2, dy3, dy4, dy5, dy6;
2190:             float dx, dy;
2191:             int b1 = stbtt__buf_get8(&b);
2192:             switch (b1) {
2193:                 // @TODO These "flex" implementations ignore the flex-depth and resolution,
2194:                 // and always draw beziers.
2195:             case 0x22: // hflex
2196:                 if (sp < 7) return STBTT__CSERR("hflex stack");
2197:                 dx1 = s[0];
2198:                 dx2 = s[1];
2199:                 dy2 = s[2];
2200:                 dx3 = s[3];
2201:                 dx4 = s[4];
2202:                 dx5 = s[5];
2203:                 dx6 = s[6];
2204:                 stbtt__csctx_rccurve_to(c, dx1, 0, dx2, dy2, dx3, 0);
2205:                 stbtt__csctx_rccurve_to(c, dx4, 0, dx5, -dy2, dx6, 0);
2206:                 break;
2208:             case 0x23: // flex
2209:                 if (sp < 13) return STBTT__CSERR("flex stack");
2210:                 dx1 = s[0];
2211:                 dy1 = s[1];
2212:                 dx2 = s[2];
2213:                 dy2 = s[3];
2214:                 dx3 = s[4];
2215:                 dy3 = s[5];
2216:                 dx4 = s[6];
2217:                 dy4 = s[7];
2218:                 dx5 = s[8];
2219:                 dy5 = s[9];
2220:                 dx6 = s[10];
2221:                 dy6 = s[11];
2222:                 //fd is s[12]
2223:                 stbtt__csctx_rccurve_to(c, dx1, dy1, dx2, dy2, dx3, dy3);
2224:                 stbtt__csctx_rccurve_to(c, dx4, dy4, dx5, dy5, dx6, dy6);
2225:                 break;
2227:             case 0x24: // hflex1
2228:                 if (sp < 9) return STBTT__CSERR("hflex1 stack");
2229:                 dx1 = s[0];
2230:                 dy1 = s[1];
2231:                 dx2 = s[2];
2232:                 dy2 = s[3];
2233:                 dx3 = s[4];
2234:                 dx4 = s[5];
2235:                 dx5 = s[6];
2236:                 dy5 = s[7];
2237:                 dx6 = s[8];
2238:                 stbtt__csctx_rccurve_to(c, dx1, dy1, dx2, dy2, dx3, 0);
2239:                 stbtt__csctx_rccurve_to(c, dx4, 0, dx5, dy5, dx6, -(dy1 + dy2 + dy5));
2240:                 break;
2242:             case 0x25: // flex1
2243:                 if (sp < 11) return STBTT__CSERR("flex1 stack");
2244:                 dx1 = s[0];
2245:                 dy1 = s[1];
2246:                 dx2 = s[2];
2247:                 dy2 = s[3];
2248:                 dx3 = s[4];
2249:                 dy3 = s[5];
2250:                 dx4 = s[6];
2251:                 dy4 = s[7];
2252:                 dx5 = s[8];
2253:                 dy5 = s[9];
2254:                 dx6 = dy6 = s[10];
2255:                 dx = dx1 + dx2 + dx3 + dx4 + dx5;
2256:                 dy = dy1 + dy2 + dy3 + dy4 + dy5;
2257:                 if (STBTT_fabs(dx) > STBTT_fabs(dy))
2258:                     dy6 = -dy;
2259:                 else
2260:                     dx6 = -dx;
2261:                 stbtt__csctx_rccurve_to(c, dx1, dy1, dx2, dy2, dx3, dy3);
2262:                 stbtt__csctx_rccurve_to(c, dx4, dy4, dx5, dy5, dx6, dy6);
2263:                 break;
2265:             default:
2266:                 return STBTT__CSERR("unimplemented");
2267:             }
2268:         } break;
2270:         default:
2271:             if (b0 != 255 && b0 != 28 && b0 < 32)
2272:                 return STBTT__CSERR("reserved operator");
2274:             // push immediate
2275:             if (b0 == 255) {
2276:                 f = (float)(stbtt_int32)stbtt__buf_get32(&b) / 0x10000;
2277:             }
2278:             else {
2279:                 stbtt__buf_skip(&b, -1);
2280:                 f = (float)(stbtt_int16)stbtt__cff_int(&b);
2281:             }
2282:             if (sp >= 48) return STBTT__CSERR("push stack overflow");
2283:             s[sp++] = f;
2284:             clear_stack = 0;
2285:             break;
2286:         }
2287:         if (clear_stack) sp = 0;
2288:     }
2289:     return STBTT__CSERR("no endchar");
2291: #undef STBTT__CSERR
2292: }
2294: static int stbtt__GetGlyphShapeT2(const stbtt_fontinfo* info, int glyph_index, stbtt_vertex** pvertices)
2295: {
2296:     // runs the charstring twice, once to count and once to output (to avoid realloc)
2297:     stbtt__csctx count_ctx = STBTT__CSCTX_INIT(1);
2298:     stbtt__csctx output_ctx = STBTT__CSCTX_INIT(0);
2299:     if (stbtt__run_charstring(info, glyph_index, &count_ctx)) {
2300:         *pvertices = (stbtt_vertex*)STBTT_malloc(count_ctx.num_vertices * sizeof(stbtt_vertex), info->userdata);
2301:         output_ctx.pvertices = *pvertices;
2302:         if (stbtt__run_charstring(info, glyph_index, &output_ctx)) {
2303:             STBTT_assert(output_ctx.num_vertices == count_ctx.num_vertices);
2304:             return output_ctx.num_vertices;
2305:         }
2306:     }
2307:     *pvertices = NULL;
2308:     return 0;
2309: }
2311: static int stbtt__GetGlyphInfoT2(const stbtt_fontinfo* info, int glyph_index, int* x0, int* y0, int* x1, int* y1)
2312: {
2313:     stbtt__csctx c = STBTT__CSCTX_INIT(1);
2314:     int r = stbtt__run_charstring(info, glyph_index, &c);
2315:     if (x0)  *x0 = r ? c.min_x : 0;
2316:     if (y0)  *y0 = r ? c.min_y : 0;
2317:     if (x1)  *x1 = r ? c.max_x : 0;
2318:     if (y1)  *y1 = r ? c.max_y : 0;
2319:     return r ? c.num_vertices : 0;
2320: }
2322: STBTT_DEF int stbtt_GetGlyphShape(const stbtt_fontinfo* info, int glyph_index, stbtt_vertex** pvertices)
2323: {
2324:     if (!info->cff.size)
2325:         return stbtt__GetGlyphShapeTT(info, glyph_index, pvertices);
2326:     else
2327:         return stbtt__GetGlyphShapeT2(info, glyph_index, pvertices);
2328: }
2330: STBTT_DEF void stbtt_GetGlyphHMetrics(const stbtt_fontinfo* info, int glyph_index, int* advanceWidth, int* leftSideBearing)
2331: {
2332:     stbtt_uint16 numOfLongHorMetrics = ttUSHORT(info->data + info->hhea + 34);
2333:     if (glyph_index < numOfLongHorMetrics) {
2334:         if (advanceWidth)     *advanceWidth = ttSHORT(info->data + info->hmtx + 4 * glyph_index);
2335:         if (leftSideBearing)  *leftSideBearing = ttSHORT(info->data + info->hmtx + 4 * glyph_index + 2);
2336:     }
2337:     else {
2338:         if (advanceWidth)     *advanceWidth = ttSHORT(info->data + info->hmtx + 4 * (numOfLongHorMetrics - 1));
2339:         if (leftSideBearing)  *leftSideBearing = ttSHORT(info->data + info->hmtx + 4 * numOfLongHorMetrics + 2 * (glyph_index - numOfLongHorMetrics));
2340:     }
2341: }
2343: STBTT_DEF int  stbtt_GetKerningTableLength(const stbtt_fontinfo* info)
2344: {
2345:     stbtt_uint8* data = info->data + info->kern;
2347:     // we only look at the first table. it must be 'horizontal' and format 0.
2348:     if (!info->kern)
2349:         return 0;
2350:     if (ttUSHORT(data + 2) < 1) // number of tables, need at least 1
2351:         return 0;
2352:     if (ttUSHORT(data + 8) != 1) // horizontal flag must be set in format
2353:         return 0;
2355:     return ttUSHORT(data + 10);
2356: }
2358: STBTT_DEF int stbtt_GetKerningTable(const stbtt_fontinfo* info, stbtt_kerningentry* table, int table_length)
2359: {
2360:     stbtt_uint8* data = info->data + info->kern;
2361:     int k, length;
2363:     // we only look at the first table. it must be 'horizontal' and format 0.
2364:     if (!info->kern)
2365:         return 0;
2366:     if (ttUSHORT(data + 2) < 1) // number of tables, need at least 1
2367:         return 0;
2368:     if (ttUSHORT(data + 8) != 1) // horizontal flag must be set in format
2369:         return 0;
2371:     length = ttUSHORT(data + 10);
2372:     if (table_length < length)
2373:         length = table_length;
2375:     for (k = 0; k < length; k++)
2376:     {
2377:         table[k].glyph1 = ttUSHORT(data + 18 + (k * 6));
2378:         table[k].glyph2 = ttUSHORT(data + 20 + (k * 6));
2379:         table[k].advance = ttSHORT(data + 22 + (k * 6));
2380:     }
2382:     return length;
2383: }
2385: static int stbtt__GetGlyphKernInfoAdvance(const stbtt_fontinfo* info, int glyph1, int glyph2)
2386: {
2387:     stbtt_uint8* data = info->data + info->kern;
2388:     stbtt_uint32 needle, straw;
2389:     int l, r, m;
2391:     // we only look at the first table. it must be 'horizontal' and format 0.
2392:     if (!info->kern)
2393:         return 0;
2394:     if (ttUSHORT(data + 2) < 1) // number of tables, need at least 1
2395:         return 0;
2396:     if (ttUSHORT(data + 8) != 1) // horizontal flag must be set in format
2397:         return 0;
2399:     l = 0;
2400:     r = ttUSHORT(data + 10) - 1;
2401:     needle = glyph1 << 16 | glyph2;
2402:     while (l <= r) {
2403:         m = (l + r) >> 1;
2404:         straw = ttULONG(data + 18 + (m * 6)); // note: unaligned read
2405:         if (needle < straw)
2406:             r = m - 1;
2407:         else if (needle > straw)
2408:             l = m + 1;
2409:         else
2410:             return ttSHORT(data + 22 + (m * 6));
2411:     }
2412:     return 0;
2413: }
2415: static stbtt_int32 stbtt__GetCoverageIndex(stbtt_uint8* coverageTable, int glyph)
2416: {
2417:     stbtt_uint16 coverageFormat = ttUSHORT(coverageTable);
2418:     switch (coverageFormat) {
2419:     case 1: {
2420:         stbtt_uint16 glyphCount = ttUSHORT(coverageTable + 2);
2422:         // Binary search.
2423:         stbtt_int32 l = 0, r = glyphCount - 1, m;
2424:         int straw, needle = glyph;
2425:         while (l <= r) {
2426:             stbtt_uint8* glyphArray = coverageTable + 4;
2427:             stbtt_uint16 glyphID;
2428:             m = (l + r) >> 1;
2429:             glyphID = ttUSHORT(glyphArray + 2 * m);
2430:             straw = glyphID;
2431:             if (needle < straw)
2432:                 r = m - 1;
2433:             else if (needle > straw)
2434:                 l = m + 1;
2435:             else {
2436:                 return m;
2437:             }
2438:         }
2439:         break;
2440:     }
2442:     case 2: {
2443:         stbtt_uint16 rangeCount = ttUSHORT(coverageTable + 2);
2444:         stbtt_uint8* rangeArray = coverageTable + 4;
2446:         // Binary search.
2447:         stbtt_int32 l = 0, r = rangeCount - 1, m;
2448:         int strawStart, strawEnd, needle = glyph;
2449:         while (l <= r) {
2450:             stbtt_uint8* rangeRecord;
2451:             m = (l + r) >> 1;
2452:             rangeRecord = rangeArray + 6 * m;
2453:             strawStart = ttUSHORT(rangeRecord);
2454:             strawEnd = ttUSHORT(rangeRecord + 2);
2455:             if (needle < strawStart)
2456:                 r = m - 1;
2457:             else if (needle > strawEnd)
2458:                 l = m + 1;
2459:             else {
2460:                 stbtt_uint16 startCoverageIndex = ttUSHORT(rangeRecord + 4);
2461:                 return startCoverageIndex + glyph - strawStart;
2462:             }
2463:         }
2464:         break;
2465:     }
2467:     default: return -1; // unsupported
2468:     }
2470:     return -1;
2471: }
2473: static stbtt_int32  stbtt__GetGlyphClass(stbtt_uint8* classDefTable, int glyph)
2474: {
2475:     stbtt_uint16 classDefFormat = ttUSHORT(classDefTable);
2476:     switch (classDefFormat)
2477:     {
2478:     case 1: {
2479:         stbtt_uint16 startGlyphID = ttUSHORT(classDefTable + 2);
2480:         stbtt_uint16 glyphCount = ttUSHORT(classDefTable + 4);
2481:         stbtt_uint8* classDef1ValueArray = classDefTable + 6;
2483:         if (glyph >= startGlyphID && glyph < startGlyphID + glyphCount)
2484:             return (stbtt_int32)ttUSHORT(classDef1ValueArray + 2 * (glyph - startGlyphID));
2485:         break;
2486:     }
2488:     case 2: {
2489:         stbtt_uint16 classRangeCount = ttUSHORT(classDefTable + 2);
2490:         stbtt_uint8* classRangeRecords = classDefTable + 4;
2492:         // Binary search.
2493:         stbtt_int32 l = 0, r = classRangeCount - 1, m;
2494:         int strawStart, strawEnd, needle = glyph;
2495:         while (l <= r) {
2496:             stbtt_uint8* classRangeRecord;
2497:             m = (l + r) >> 1;
2498:             classRangeRecord = classRangeRecords + 6 * m;
2499:             strawStart = ttUSHORT(classRangeRecord);
2500:             strawEnd = ttUSHORT(classRangeRecord + 2);
2501:             if (needle < strawStart)
2502:                 r = m - 1;
2503:             else if (needle > strawEnd)
2504:                 l = m + 1;
2505:             else
2506:                 return (stbtt_int32)ttUSHORT(classRangeRecord + 4);
2507:         }
2508:         break;
2509:     }
2511:     default:
2512:         return -1; // Unsupported definition type, return an error.
2513:     }
2515:     // "All glyphs not assigned to a class fall into class 0". (OpenType spec)
2516:     return 0;
2517: }
2519: // Define to STBTT_assert(x) if you want to break on unimplemented formats.
2520: #define STBTT_GPOS_TODO_assert(x)
2522: static stbtt_int32 stbtt__GetGlyphGPOSInfoAdvance(const stbtt_fontinfo* info, int glyph1, int glyph2)
2523: {
2524:     stbtt_uint16 lookupListOffset;
2525:     stbtt_uint8* lookupList;
2526:     stbtt_uint16 lookupCount;
2527:     stbtt_uint8* data;
2528:     stbtt_int32 i, sti;
2530:     if (!info->gpos) return 0;
2532:     data = info->data + info->gpos;
2534:     if (ttUSHORT(data + 0) != 1) return 0; // Major version 1
2535:     if (ttUSHORT(data + 2) != 0) return 0; // Minor version 0
2537:     lookupListOffset = ttUSHORT(data + 8);
2538:     lookupList = data + lookupListOffset;
2539:     lookupCount = ttUSHORT(lookupList);
2541:     for (i = 0; i < lookupCount; ++i) {
2542:         stbtt_uint16 lookupOffset = ttUSHORT(lookupList + 2 + 2 * i);
2543:         stbtt_uint8* lookupTable = lookupList + lookupOffset;
2545:         stbtt_uint16 lookupType = ttUSHORT(lookupTable);
2546:         stbtt_uint16 subTableCount = ttUSHORT(lookupTable + 4);
2547:         stbtt_uint8* subTableOffsets = lookupTable + 6;
2548:         if (lookupType != 2) // Pair Adjustment Positioning Subtable
2549:             continue;
2551:         for (sti = 0; sti < subTableCount; sti++) {
2552:             stbtt_uint16 subtableOffset = ttUSHORT(subTableOffsets + 2 * sti);
2553:             stbtt_uint8* table = lookupTable + subtableOffset;
2554:             stbtt_uint16 posFormat = ttUSHORT(table);
2555:             stbtt_uint16 coverageOffset = ttUSHORT(table + 2);
2556:             stbtt_int32 coverageIndex = stbtt__GetCoverageIndex(table + coverageOffset, glyph1);
2557:             if (coverageIndex == -1) continue;
2559:             switch (posFormat) {
2560:             case 1: {
2561:                 stbtt_int32 l, r, m;
2562:                 int straw, needle;
2563:                 stbtt_uint16 valueFormat1 = ttUSHORT(table + 4);
2564:                 stbtt_uint16 valueFormat2 = ttUSHORT(table + 6);
2565:                 if (valueFormat1 == 4 && valueFormat2 == 0) { // Support more formats?
2566:                     stbtt_int32 valueRecordPairSizeInBytes = 2;
2567:                     stbtt_uint16 pairSetCount = ttUSHORT(table + 8);
2568:                     stbtt_uint16 pairPosOffset = ttUSHORT(table + 10 + 2 * coverageIndex);
2569:                     stbtt_uint8* pairValueTable = table + pairPosOffset;
2570:                     stbtt_uint16 pairValueCount = ttUSHORT(pairValueTable);
2571:                     stbtt_uint8* pairValueArray = pairValueTable + 2;
2573:                     if (coverageIndex >= pairSetCount) return 0;
2575:                     needle = glyph2;
2576:                     r = pairValueCount - 1;
2577:                     l = 0;
2579:                     // Binary search.
2580:                     while (l <= r) {
2581:                         stbtt_uint16 secondGlyph;
2582:                         stbtt_uint8* pairValue;
2583:                         m = (l + r) >> 1;
2584:                         pairValue = pairValueArray + (2 + valueRecordPairSizeInBytes) * m;
2585:                         secondGlyph = ttUSHORT(pairValue);
2586:                         straw = secondGlyph;
2587:                         if (needle < straw)
2588:                             r = m - 1;
2589:                         else if (needle > straw)
2590:                             l = m + 1;
2591:                         else {
2592:                             stbtt_int16 xAdvance = ttSHORT(pairValue + 2);
2593:                             return xAdvance;
2594:                         }
2595:                     }
2596:                 }
2597:                 else
2598:                     return 0;
2599:                 break;
2600:             }
2602:             case 2: {
2603:                 stbtt_uint16 valueFormat1 = ttUSHORT(table + 4);
2604:                 stbtt_uint16 valueFormat2 = ttUSHORT(table + 6);
2605:                 if (valueFormat1 == 4 && valueFormat2 == 0) { // Support more formats?
2606:                     stbtt_uint16 classDef1Offset = ttUSHORT(table + 8);
2607:                     stbtt_uint16 classDef2Offset = ttUSHORT(table + 10);
2608:                     int glyph1class = stbtt__GetGlyphClass(table + classDef1Offset, glyph1);
2609:                     int glyph2class = stbtt__GetGlyphClass(table + classDef2Offset, glyph2);
2611:                     stbtt_uint16 class1Count = ttUSHORT(table + 12);
2612:                     stbtt_uint16 class2Count = ttUSHORT(table + 14);
2613:                     stbtt_uint8* class1Records, * class2Records;
2614:                     stbtt_int16 xAdvance;
2616:                     if (glyph1class < 0 || glyph1class >= class1Count) return 0; // malformed
2617:                     if (glyph2class < 0 || glyph2class >= class2Count) return 0; // malformed
2619:                     class1Records = table + 16;
2620:                     class2Records = class1Records + 2 * (glyph1class * class2Count);
2621:                     xAdvance = ttSHORT(class2Records + 2 * glyph2class);
2622:                     return xAdvance;
2623:                 }
2624:                 else
2625:                     return 0;
2626:                 break;
2627:             }
2629:             default:
2630:                 return 0; // Unsupported position format
2631:             }
2632:         }
2633:     }
2635:     return 0;
2636: }

2750: STBTT_DEF void stbtt_GetGlyphBitmapBoxSubpixel(const stbtt_fontinfo* font, int glyph, float scale_x, float scale_y, float shift_x, float shift_y, int* ix0, int* iy0, int* ix1, int* iy1)
2751: {
2752:     int x0 = 0, y0 = 0, x1, y1; // =0 suppresses compiler warning
2753:     if (!stbtt_GetGlyphBox(font, glyph, &x0, &y0, &x1, &y1)) {
2754:         // e.g. space character
2755:         if (ix0) *ix0 = 0;
2756:         if (iy0) *iy0 = 0;
2757:         if (ix1) *ix1 = 0;
2758:         if (iy1) *iy1 = 0;
2759:     }
2760:     else {
2761:         // move to integral bboxes (treating pixels as little squares, what pixels get touched)?
2762:         if (ix0) *ix0 = STBTT_ifloor(x0 * scale_x + shift_x);
2763:         if (iy0) *iy0 = STBTT_ifloor(-y1 * scale_y + shift_y);
2764:         if (ix1) *ix1 = STBTT_iceil(x1 * scale_x + shift_x);
2765:         if (iy1) *iy1 = STBTT_iceil(-y0 * scale_y + shift_y);
2766:     }
2767: }
2769: STBTT_DEF void stbtt_GetGlyphBitmapBox(const stbtt_fontinfo* font, int glyph, float scale_x, float scale_y, int* ix0, int* iy0, int* ix1, int* iy1)
2770: {
2771:     stbtt_GetGlyphBitmapBoxSubpixel(font, glyph, scale_x, scale_y, 0.0f, 0.0f, ix0, iy0, ix1, iy1);
2772: }
2774: STBTT_DEF void stbtt_GetCodepointBitmapBoxSubpixel(const stbtt_fontinfo* font, int codepoint, float scale_x, float scale_y, float shift_x, float shift_y, int* ix0, int* iy0, int* ix1, int* iy1)
2775: {
2776:     stbtt_GetGlyphBitmapBoxSubpixel(font, stbtt_FindGlyphIndex(font, codepoint), scale_x, scale_y, shift_x, shift_y, ix0, iy0, ix1, iy1);
2777: }

2780: {
2781:     stbtt_GetCodepointBitmapBoxSubpixel(font, codepoint, scale_x, scale_y, 0.0f, 0.0f, ix0, iy0, ix1, iy1);
2782: }
