2786: //  Rasterizer
2788: typedef struct stbtt__hheap_chunk
2789: {
2790:     struct stbtt__hheap_chunk* next;
2791: } stbtt__hheap_chunk;
2793: typedef struct stbtt__hheap
2794: {
2795:     struct stbtt__hheap_chunk* head;
2796:     void* first_free;
2797:     int    num_remaining_in_head_chunk;
2798: } stbtt__hheap;
2800: static void* stbtt__hheap_alloc(stbtt__hheap* hh, size_t size, void* userdata)
2801: {
2802:     if (hh->first_free) {
2803:         void* p = hh->first_free;
2804:         hh->first_free = *(void**)p;
2805:         return p;
2806:     }
2807:     else {
2808:         if (hh->num_remaining_in_head_chunk == 0) {
2809:             int count = (size < 32 ? 2000 : size < 128 ? 800 : 100);
2810:             stbtt__hheap_chunk* c = (stbtt__hheap_chunk*)STBTT_malloc(sizeof(stbtt__hheap_chunk) + size * count, userdata);
2811:             if (c == NULL)
2812:                 return NULL;
2813:             c->next = hh->head;
2814:             hh->head = c;
2815:             hh->num_remaining_in_head_chunk = count;
2816:         }
2817:         --hh->num_remaining_in_head_chunk;
2818:         return (char*)(hh->head) + sizeof(stbtt__hheap_chunk) + size * hh->num_remaining_in_head_chunk;
2819:     }
2820: }
2822: static void stbtt__hheap_free(stbtt__hheap* hh, void* p)
2823: {
2824:     *(void**)p = hh->first_free;
2825:     hh->first_free = p;
2826: }
2828: static void stbtt__hheap_cleanup(stbtt__hheap* hh, void* userdata)
2829: {
2830:     stbtt__hheap_chunk* c = hh->head;
2831:     while (c) {
2832:         stbtt__hheap_chunk* n = c->next;
2833:         STBTT_free(c, userdata);
2834:         c = n;
2835:     }
2836: }
2838: typedef struct stbtt__edge {
2839:     float x0, y0, x1, y1;
2840:     int invert;
2841: } stbtt__edge;
2844: typedef struct stbtt__active_edge
2845: {
2846:     struct stbtt__active_edge* next;
2847: #if STBTT_RASTERIZER_VERSION==1
2848:     int x, dx;
2849:     float ey;
2850:     int direction;
2851: #elif STBTT_RASTERIZER_VERSION==2
2852:     float fx, fdx, fdy;
2853:     float direction;
2854:     float sy;
2855:     float ey;
2856: #else
2857: #error "Unrecognized value of STBTT_RASTERIZER_VERSION"
2858: #endif
2859: } stbtt__active_edge;
2861: #if STBTT_RASTERIZER_VERSION == 1
2862: #define STBTT_FIXSHIFT   10
2863: #define STBTT_FIX        (1 << STBTT_FIXSHIFT)
2864: #define STBTT_FIXMASK    (STBTT_FIX-1)
2866: static stbtt__active_edge* stbtt__new_active(stbtt__hheap* hh, stbtt__edge* e, int off_x, float start_point, void* userdata)
2867: {
2868:     stbtt__active_edge* z = (stbtt__active_edge*)stbtt__hheap_alloc(hh, sizeof(*z), userdata);
2869:     float dxdy = (e->x1 - e->x0) / (e->y1 - e->y0);
2870:     STBTT_assert(z != NULL);
2871:     if (!z) return z;
2873:     // round dx down to avoid overshooting
2874:     if (dxdy < 0)
2875:         z->dx = -STBTT_ifloor(STBTT_FIX * -dxdy);
2876:     else
2877:         z->dx = STBTT_ifloor(STBTT_FIX * dxdy);
2879:     z->x = STBTT_ifloor(STBTT_FIX * e->x0 + z->dx * (start_point - e->y0)); // use z->dx so when we offset later it's by the same amount
2880:     z->x -= off_x * STBTT_FIX;
2882:     z->ey = e->y1;
2883:     z->next = 0;
2884:     z->direction = e->invert ? 1 : -1;
2885:     return z;
2886: }
2887: #elif STBTT_RASTERIZER_VERSION == 2
2888: static stbtt__active_edge* stbtt__new_active(stbtt__hheap* hh, stbtt__edge* e, int off_x, float start_point, void* userdata)
2889: {
2890:     stbtt__active_edge* z = (stbtt__active_edge*)stbtt__hheap_alloc(hh, sizeof(*z), userdata);
2891:     float dxdy = (e->x1 - e->x0) / (e->y1 - e->y0);
2892:     STBTT_assert(z != NULL);
2893:     //STBTT_assert(e->y0 <= start_point);
2894:     if (!z) return z;
2895:     z->fdx = dxdy;
2896:     z->fdy = dxdy != 0.0f ? (1.0f / dxdy) : 0.0f;
2897:     z->fx = e->x0 + dxdy * (start_point - e->y0);
2898:     z->fx -= off_x;
2899:     z->direction = e->invert ? 1.0f : -1.0f;
2900:     z->sy = e->y0;
2901:     z->ey = e->y1;
2902:     z->next = 0;
2903:     return z;
2904: }
2905: #else
2906: #error "Unrecognized value of STBTT_RASTERIZER_VERSION"
2907: #endif
2909: #if STBTT_RASTERIZER_VERSION == 1
2910: // note: this routine clips fills that extend off the edges... ideally this
2911: // wouldn't happen, but it could happen if the truetype glyph bounding boxes
2912: // are wrong, or if the user supplies a too-small bitmap
2913: static void stbtt__fill_active_edges(unsigned char* scanline, int len, stbtt__active_edge* e, int max_weight)
2914: {
2915:     // non-zero winding fill
2916:     int x0 = 0, w = 0;
2918:     while (e) {
2919:         if (w == 0) {
2920:             // if we're currently at zero, we need to record the edge start point
2921:             x0 = e->x; w += e->direction;
2922:         }
2923:         else {
2924:             int x1 = e->x; w += e->direction;
2925:             // if we went to zero, we need to draw
2926:             if (w == 0) {
2927:                 int i = x0 >> STBTT_FIXSHIFT;
2928:                 int j = x1 >> STBTT_FIXSHIFT;
2930:                 if (i < len && j >= 0) {
2931:                     if (i == j) {
2932:                         // x0,x1 are the same pixel, so compute combined coverage
2933:                         scanline[i] = scanline[i] + (stbtt_uint8)((x1 - x0) * max_weight >> STBTT_FIXSHIFT);
2934:                     }
2935:                     else {
2936:                         if (i >= 0) // add antialiasing for x0
2937:                             scanline[i] = scanline[i] + (stbtt_uint8)(((STBTT_FIX - (x0 & STBTT_FIXMASK)) * max_weight) >> STBTT_FIXSHIFT);
2938:                         else
2939:                             i = -1; // clip
2941:                         if (j < len) // add antialiasing for x1
2942:                             scanline[j] = scanline[j] + (stbtt_uint8)(((x1 & STBTT_FIXMASK) * max_weight) >> STBTT_FIXSHIFT);
2943:                         else
2944:                             j = len; // clip
2946:                         for (++i; i < j; ++i) // fill pixels between x0 and x1
2947:                             scanline[i] = scanline[i] + (stbtt_uint8)max_weight;
2948:                     }
2949:                 }
2950:             }
2951:         }
2953:         e = e->next;
2954:     }
2955: }
2957: static void stbtt__rasterize_sorted_edges(stbtt__bitmap* result, stbtt__edge* e, int n, int vsubsample, int off_x, int off_y, void* userdata)
2958: {
2959:     stbtt__hheap hh = { 0, 0, 0 };
2960:     stbtt__active_edge* active = NULL;
2961:     int y, j = 0;
2962:     int max_weight = (255 / vsubsample);  // weight per vertical scanline
2963:     int s; // vertical subsample index
2964:     unsigned char scanline_data[512], * scanline;
2966:     if (result->w > 512)
2967:         scanline = (unsigned char*)STBTT_malloc(result->w, userdata);
2968:     else
2969:         scanline = scanline_data;
2971:     y = off_y * vsubsample;
2972:     e[n].y0 = (off_y + result->h) * (float)vsubsample + 1;
2974:     while (j < result->h) {
2975:         STBTT_memset(scanline, 0, result->w);
2976:         for (s = 0; s < vsubsample; ++s) {
2977:             // find center of pixel for this scanline
2978:             float scan_y = y + 0.5f;
2979:             stbtt__active_edge** step = &active;
2981:             // update all active edges;
2982:             // remove all active edges that terminate before the center of this scanline
2983:             while (*step) {
2984:                 stbtt__active_edge* z = *step;
2985:                 if (z->ey <= scan_y) {
2986:                     *step = z->next; // delete from list
2987:                     STBTT_assert(z->direction);
2988:                     z->direction = 0;
2989:                     stbtt__hheap_free(&hh, z);
2990:                 }
2991:                 else {
2992:                     z->x += z->dx; // advance to position for current scanline
2993:                     step = &((*step)->next); // advance through list
2994:                 }
2995:             }
2997:             // resort the list if needed
2998:             for (;;) {
2999:                 int changed = 0;
3000:                 step = &active;
3001:                 while (*step && (*step)->next) {
3002:                     if ((*step)->x > (*step)->next->x) {
3003:                         stbtt__active_edge* t = *step;
3004:                         stbtt__active_edge* q = t->next;
3006:                         t->next = q->next;
3007:                         q->next = t;
3008:                         *step = q;
3009:                         changed = 1;
3010:                     }
3011:                     step = &(*step)->next;
3012:                 }
3013:                 if (!changed) break;
3014:             }
3016:             // insert all edges that start before the center of this scanline -- omit ones that also end on this scanline
3017:             while (e->y0 <= scan_y) {
3018:                 if (e->y1 > scan_y) {
3019:                     stbtt__active_edge* z = stbtt__new_active(&hh, e, off_x, scan_y, userdata);
3020:                     if (z != NULL) {
3021:                         // find insertion point
3022:                         if (active == NULL)
3023:                             active = z;
3024:                         else if (z->x < active->x) {
3025:                             // insert at front
3026:                             z->next = active;
3027:                             active = z;
3028:                         }
3029:                         else {
3030:                             // find thing to insert AFTER
3031:                             stbtt__active_edge* p = active;
3032:                             while (p->next && p->next->x < z->x)
3033:                                 p = p->next;
3034:                             // at this point, p->next->x is NOT < z->x
3035:                             z->next = p->next;
3036:                             p->next = z;
3037:                         }
3038:                     }
3039:                 }
3040:                 ++e;
3041:             }
3043:             // now process all active edges in XOR fashion
3044:             if (active)
3045:                 stbtt__fill_active_edges(scanline, result->w, active, max_weight);
3047:             ++y;
3048:         }
3049:         STBTT_memcpy(result->pixels + j * result->stride, scanline, result->w);
3050:         ++j;
3051:     }
3053:     stbtt__hheap_cleanup(&hh, userdata);
3055:     if (scanline != scanline_data)
3056:         STBTT_free(scanline, userdata);
3057: }
3059: #elif STBTT_RASTERIZER_VERSION == 2
3061: // the edge passed in here does not cross the vertical line at x or the vertical line at x+1
3062: // (i.e. it has already been clipped to those)
3063: static void stbtt__handle_clipped_edge(float* scanline, int x, stbtt__active_edge* e, float x0, float y0, float x1, float y1)
3064: {
3065:     if (y0 == y1) return;
3066:     STBTT_assert(y0 < y1);
3067:     STBTT_assert(e->sy <= e->ey);
3068:     if (y0 > e->ey) return;
3069:     if (y1 < e->sy) return;
3070:     if (y0 < e->sy) {
3071:         x0 += (x1 - x0) * (e->sy - y0) / (y1 - y0);
3072:         y0 = e->sy;
3073:     }
3074:     if (y1 > e->ey) {
3075:         x1 += (x1 - x0) * (e->ey - y1) / (y1 - y0);
3076:         y1 = e->ey;
3077:     }
3079:     if (x0 == x)
3080:         STBTT_assert(x1 <= x + 1);
3081:     else if (x0 == x + 1)
3082:         STBTT_assert(x1 >= x);
3083:     else if (x0 <= x)
3084:         STBTT_assert(x1 <= x);
3085:     else if (x0 >= x + 1)
3086:         STBTT_assert(x1 >= x + 1);
3087:     else
3088:         STBTT_assert(x1 >= x && x1 <= x + 1);
3090:     if (x0 <= x && x1 <= x)
3091:         scanline[x] += e->direction * (y1 - y0);
3092:     else if (x0 >= x + 1 && x1 >= x + 1)
3093:         ;
3094:     else {
3095:         STBTT_assert(x0 >= x && x0 <= x + 1 && x1 >= x && x1 <= x + 1);
3096:         scanline[x] += e->direction * (y1 - y0) * (1 - ((x0 - x) + (x1 - x)) / 2); // coverage = 1 - average x position
3097:     }
3098: }
3100: static float stbtt__sized_trapezoid_area(float height, float top_width, float bottom_width)
3101: {
3102:     STBTT_assert(top_width >= 0);
3103:     STBTT_assert(bottom_width >= 0);
3104:     return (top_width + bottom_width) / 2.0f * height;
3105: }
3107: static float stbtt__position_trapezoid_area(float height, float tx0, float tx1, float bx0, float bx1)
3108: {
3109:     return stbtt__sized_trapezoid_area(height, tx1 - tx0, bx1 - bx0);
3110: }
3112: static float stbtt__sized_triangle_area(float height, float width)
3113: {
3114:     return height * width / 2;
3115: }
3117: static void stbtt__fill_active_edges_new(float* scanline, float* scanline_fill, int len, stbtt__active_edge* e, float y_top)
3118: {
3119:     float y_bottom = y_top + 1;
3121:     while (e) {
3122:         // brute force every pixel
3124:         // compute intersection points with top & bottom
3125:         STBTT_assert(e->ey >= y_top);
3127:         if (e->fdx == 0) {
3128:             float x0 = e->fx;
3129:             if (x0 < len) {
3130:                 if (x0 >= 0) {
3131:                     stbtt__handle_clipped_edge(scanline, (int)x0, e, x0, y_top, x0, y_bottom);
3132:                     stbtt__handle_clipped_edge(scanline_fill - 1, (int)x0 + 1, e, x0, y_top, x0, y_bottom);
3133:                 }
3134:                 else {
3135:                     stbtt__handle_clipped_edge(scanline_fill - 1, 0, e, x0, y_top, x0, y_bottom);
3136:                 }
3137:             }
3138:         }
3139:         else {
3140:             float x0 = e->fx;
3141:             float dx = e->fdx;
3142:             float xb = x0 + dx;
3143:             float x_top, x_bottom;
3144:             float sy0, sy1;
3145:             float dy = e->fdy;
3146:             STBTT_assert(e->sy <= y_bottom && e->ey >= y_top);
3148:             // compute endpoints of line segment clipped to this scanline (if the
3149:             // line segment starts on this scanline. x0 is the intersection of the
3150:             // line with y_top, but that may be off the line segment.
3151:             if (e->sy > y_top) {
3152:                 x_top = x0 + dx * (e->sy - y_top);
3153:                 sy0 = e->sy;
3154:             }
3155:             else {
3156:                 x_top = x0;
3157:                 sy0 = y_top;
3158:             }
3159:             if (e->ey < y_bottom) {
3160:                 x_bottom = x0 + dx * (e->ey - y_top);
3161:                 sy1 = e->ey;
3162:             }
3163:             else {
3164:                 x_bottom = xb;
3165:                 sy1 = y_bottom;
3166:             }
3168:             if (x_top >= 0 && x_bottom >= 0 && x_top < len && x_bottom < len) {
3169:                 // from here on, we don't have to range check x values
3171:                 if ((int)x_top == (int)x_bottom) {
3172:                     float height;
3173:                     // simple case, only spans one pixel
3174:                     int x = (int)x_top;
3175:                     height = (sy1 - sy0) * e->direction;
3176:                     STBTT_assert(x >= 0 && x < len);
3177:                     scanline[x] += stbtt__position_trapezoid_area(height, x_top, x + 1.0f, x_bottom, x + 1.0f);
3178:                     scanline_fill[x] += height; // everything right of this pixel is filled
3179:                 }
3180:                 else {
3181:                     int x, x1, x2;
3182:                     float y_crossing, y_final, step, sign, area;
3183:                     // covers 2+ pixels
3184:                     if (x_top > x_bottom) {
3185:                         // flip scanline vertically; signed area is the same
3186:                         float t;
3187:                         sy0 = y_bottom - (sy0 - y_top);
3188:                         sy1 = y_bottom - (sy1 - y_top);
3189:                         t = sy0, sy0 = sy1, sy1 = t;
3190:                         t = x_bottom, x_bottom = x_top, x_top = t;
3191:                         dx = -dx;
3192:                         dy = -dy;
3193:                         t = x0, x0 = xb, xb = t;
3194:                     }
3195:                     STBTT_assert(dy >= 0);
3196:                     STBTT_assert(dx >= 0);
3198:                     x1 = (int)x_top;
3199:                     x2 = (int)x_bottom;
3200:                     // compute intersection with y axis at x1+1
3201:                     y_crossing = y_top + dy * (x1 + 1 - x0);
3203:                     // compute intersection with y axis at x2
3204:                     y_final = y_top + dy * (x2 - x0);
3206:                     //           x1    x_top                            x2    x_bottom
3207:                     //     y_top  +------|-----+------------+------------+--------|---+------------+
3208:                     //            |            |            |            |            |            |
3209:                     //            |            |            |            |            |            |
3210:                     //       sy0  |      Txxxxx|............|............|............|............|
3211:                     // y_crossing |            *xxxxx.......|............|............|............|
3212:                     //            |            |     xxxxx..|............|............|............|
3213:                     //            |            |     /-   xx*xxxx........|............|............|
3214:                     //            |            | dy <       |    xxxxxx..|............|............|
3215:                     //   y_final  |            |     \-     |          xx*xxx.........|............|
3216:                     //       sy1  |            |            |            |   xxxxxB...|............|
3217:                     //            |            |            |            |            |            |
3218:                     //            |            |            |            |            |            |
3219:                     //  y_bottom  +------------+------------+------------+------------+------------+
3220:                     //
3221:                     // goal is to measure the area covered by '.' in each pixel
3223:                     // if x2 is right at the right edge of x1, y_crossing can blow up, github #1057
3224:                     // @TODO: maybe test against sy1 rather than y_bottom?
3225:                     if (y_crossing > y_bottom)
3226:                         y_crossing = y_bottom;
3228:                     sign = e->direction;
3230:                     // area of the rectangle covered from sy0..y_crossing
3231:                     area = sign * (y_crossing - sy0);
3233:                     // area of the triangle (x_top,sy0), (x1+1,sy0), (x1+1,y_crossing)
3234:                     scanline[x1] += stbtt__sized_triangle_area(area, x1 + 1 - x_top);
3236:                     // check if final y_crossing is blown up; no test case for this
3237:                     if (y_final > y_bottom) {
3238:                         y_final = y_bottom;
3239:                         dy = (y_final - y_crossing) / (x2 - (x1 + 1)); // if denom=0, y_final = y_crossing, so y_final <= y_bottom
3240:                     }
3242:                     // in second pixel, area covered by line segment found in first pixel
3243:                     // is always a rectangle 1 wide * the height of that line segment; this
3244:                     // is exactly what the variable 'area' stores. it also gets a contribution
3245:                     // from the line segment within it. the THIRD pixel will get the first
3246:                     // pixel's rectangle contribution, the second pixel's rectangle contribution,
3247:                     // and its own contribution. the 'own contribution' is the same in every pixel except
3248:                     // the leftmost and rightmost, a trapezoid that slides down in each pixel.
3249:                     // the second pixel's contribution to the third pixel will be the
3250:                     // rectangle 1 wide times the height change in the second pixel, which is dy.
3252:                     step = sign * dy * 1; // dy is dy/dx, change in y for every 1 change in x,
3253:                     // which multiplied by 1-pixel-width is how much pixel area changes for each step in x
3254:                     // so the area advances by 'step' every time
3256:                     for (x = x1 + 1; x < x2; ++x) {
3257:                         scanline[x] += area + step / 2; // area of trapezoid is 1*step/2
3258:                         area += step;
3259:                     }
3260:                     STBTT_assert(STBTT_fabs(area) <= 1.01f); // accumulated error from area += step unless we round step down
3261:                     STBTT_assert(sy1 > y_final - 0.01f);
3263:                     // area covered in the last pixel is the rectangle from all the pixels to the left,
3264:                     // plus the trapezoid filled by the line segment in this pixel all the way to the right edge
3265:                     scanline[x2] += area + sign * stbtt__position_trapezoid_area(sy1 - y_final, (float)x2, x2 + 1.0f, x_bottom, x2 + 1.0f);
3267:                     // the rest of the line is filled based on the total height of the line segment in this pixel
3268:                     scanline_fill[x2] += sign * (sy1 - sy0);
3269:                 }
3270:             }
3271:             else {
3272:                 // if edge goes outside of box we're drawing, we require
3273:                 // clipping logic. since this does not match the intended use
3274:                 // of this library, we use a different, very slow brute
3275:                 // force implementation
3276:                 // note though that this does happen some of the time because
3277:                 // x_top and x_bottom can be extrapolated at the top & bottom of
3278:                 // the shape and actually lie outside the bounding box
3279:                 int x;
3280:                 for (x = 0; x < len; ++x) {
3281:                     // cases:
3282:                     //
3283:                     // there can be up to two intersections with the pixel. any intersection
3284:                     // with left or right edges can be handled by splitting into two (or three)
3285:                     // regions. intersections with top & bottom do not necessitate case-wise logic.
3286:                     //
3287:                     // the old way of doing this found the intersections with the left & right edges,
3288:                     // then used some simple logic to produce up to three segments in sorted order
3289:                     // from top-to-bottom. however, this had a problem: if an x edge was epsilon
3290:                     // across the x border, then the corresponding y position might not be distinct
3291:                     // from the other y segment, and it might ignored as an empty segment. to avoid
3292:                     // that, we need to explicitly produce segments based on x positions.
3294:                     // rename variables to clearly-defined pairs
3295:                     float y0 = y_top;
3296:                     float x1 = (float)(x);
3297:                     float x2 = (float)(x + 1);
3298:                     float x3 = xb;
3299:                     float y3 = y_bottom;
3301:                     // x = e->x + e->dx * (y-y_top)
3302:                     // (y-y_top) = (x - e->x) / e->dx
3303:                     // y = (x - e->x) / e->dx + y_top
3304:                     float y1 = (x - x0) / dx + y_top;
3305:                     float y2 = (x + 1 - x0) / dx + y_top;
3307:                     if (x0 < x1 && x3 > x2) {         // three segments descending down-right
3308:                         stbtt__handle_clipped_edge(scanline, x, e, x0, y0, x1, y1);
3309:                         stbtt__handle_clipped_edge(scanline, x, e, x1, y1, x2, y2);
3310:                         stbtt__handle_clipped_edge(scanline, x, e, x2, y2, x3, y3);
3311:                     }
3312:                     else if (x3 < x1 && x0 > x2) {  // three segments descending down-left
3313:                         stbtt__handle_clipped_edge(scanline, x, e, x0, y0, x2, y2);
3314:                         stbtt__handle_clipped_edge(scanline, x, e, x2, y2, x1, y1);
3315:                         stbtt__handle_clipped_edge(scanline, x, e, x1, y1, x3, y3);
3316:                     }
3317:                     else if (x0 < x1 && x3 > x1) {  // two segments across x, down-right
3318:                         stbtt__handle_clipped_edge(scanline, x, e, x0, y0, x1, y1);
3319:                         stbtt__handle_clipped_edge(scanline, x, e, x1, y1, x3, y3);
3320:                     }
3321:                     else if (x3 < x1 && x0 > x1) {  // two segments across x, down-left
3322:                         stbtt__handle_clipped_edge(scanline, x, e, x0, y0, x1, y1);
3323:                         stbtt__handle_clipped_edge(scanline, x, e, x1, y1, x3, y3);
3324:                     }
3325:                     else if (x0 < x2 && x3 > x2) {  // two segments across x+1, down-right
3326:                         stbtt__handle_clipped_edge(scanline, x, e, x0, y0, x2, y2);
3327:                         stbtt__handle_clipped_edge(scanline, x, e, x2, y2, x3, y3);
3328:                     }
3329:                     else if (x3 < x2 && x0 > x2) {  // two segments across x+1, down-left
3330:                         stbtt__handle_clipped_edge(scanline, x, e, x0, y0, x2, y2);
3331:                         stbtt__handle_clipped_edge(scanline, x, e, x2, y2, x3, y3);
3332:                     }
3333:                     else {  // one segment
3334:                         stbtt__handle_clipped_edge(scanline, x, e, x0, y0, x3, y3);
3335:                     }
3336:                 }
3337:             }
3338:         }
3339:         e = e->next;
3340:     }
3341: }
3343: // directly AA rasterize edges w/o supersampling
3344: static void stbtt__rasterize_sorted_edges(stbtt__bitmap* result, stbtt__edge* e, int n, int vsubsample, int off_x, int off_y, void* userdata)
3345: {
3346:     stbtt__hheap hh = { 0, 0, 0 };
3347:     stbtt__active_edge* active = NULL;
3348:     int y, j = 0, i;
3349:     float scanline_data[129], * scanline, * scanline2;
3351:     STBTT__NOTUSED(vsubsample);
3353:     if (result->w > 64)
3354:         scanline = (float*)STBTT_malloc((result->w * 2 + 1) * sizeof(float), userdata);
3355:     else
3356:         scanline = scanline_data;
3358:     scanline2 = scanline + result->w;
3360:     y = off_y;
3361:     e[n].y0 = (float)(off_y + result->h) + 1;
3363:     while (j < result->h) {
3364:         // find center of pixel for this scanline
3365:         float scan_y_top = y + 0.0f;
3366:         float scan_y_bottom = y + 1.0f;
3367:         stbtt__active_edge** step = &active;
3369:         STBTT_memset(scanline, 0, result->w * sizeof(scanline[0]));
3370:         STBTT_memset(scanline2, 0, (result->w + 1) * sizeof(scanline[0]));
3372:         // update all active edges;
3373:         // remove all active edges that terminate before the top of this scanline
3374:         while (*step) {
3375:             stbtt__active_edge* z = *step;
3376:             if (z->ey <= scan_y_top) {
3377:                 *step = z->next; // delete from list
3378:                 STBTT_assert(z->direction);
3379:                 z->direction = 0;
3380:                 stbtt__hheap_free(&hh, z);
3381:             }
3382:             else {
3383:                 step = &((*step)->next); // advance through list
3384:             }
3385:         }
3387:         // insert all edges that start before the bottom of this scanline
3388:         while (e->y0 <= scan_y_bottom) {
3389:             if (e->y0 != e->y1) {
3390:                 stbtt__active_edge* z = stbtt__new_active(&hh, e, off_x, scan_y_top, userdata);
3391:                 if (z != NULL) {
3392:                     if (j == 0 && off_y != 0) {
3393:                         if (z->ey < scan_y_top) {
3394:                             // this can happen due to subpixel positioning and some kind of fp rounding error i think
3395:                             z->ey = scan_y_top;
3396:                         }
3397:                     }
3398:                     STBTT_assert(z->ey >= scan_y_top); // if we get really unlucky a tiny bit of an edge can be out of bounds
3399:                     // insert at front
3400:                     z->next = active;
3401:                     active = z;
3402:                 }
3403:             }
3404:             ++e;
3405:         }
3407:         // now process all active edges
3408:         if (active)
3409:             stbtt__fill_active_edges_new(scanline, scanline2 + 1, result->w, active, scan_y_top);
3411:         {
3412:             float sum = 0;
3413:             for (i = 0; i < result->w; ++i) {
3414:                 float k;
3415:                 int m;
3416:                 sum += scanline2[i];
3417:                 k = scanline[i] + sum;
3418:                 k = (float)STBTT_fabs(k) * 255 + 0.5f;
3419:                 m = (int)k;
3420:                 if (m > 255) m = 255;
3421:                 result->pixels[j * result->stride + i] = (unsigned char)m;
3422:             }
3423:         }
3424:         // advance all the edges
3425:         step = &active;
3426:         while (*step) {
3427:             stbtt__active_edge* z = *step;
3428:             z->fx += z->fdx; // advance to position for current scanline
3429:             step = &((*step)->next); // advance through list
3430:         }
3432:         ++y;
3433:         ++j;
3434:     }
3436:     stbtt__hheap_cleanup(&hh, userdata);
3438:     if (scanline != scanline_data)
3439:         STBTT_free(scanline, userdata);
3440: }
3441: #else
3442: #error "Unrecognized value of STBTT_RASTERIZER_VERSION"
3443: #endif
3445: #define STBTT__COMPARE(a,b)  ((a)->y0 < (b)->y0)
3447: static void stbtt__sort_edges_ins_sort(stbtt__edge* p, int n)
3448: {
3449:     int i, j;
3450:     for (i = 1; i < n; ++i) {
3451:         stbtt__edge t = p[i], * a = &t;
3452:         j = i;
3453:         while (j > 0) {
3454:             stbtt__edge* b = &p[j - 1];
3455:             int c = STBTT__COMPARE(a, b);
3456:             if (!c) break;
3457:             p[j] = p[j - 1];
3458:             --j;
3459:         }
3460:         if (i != j)
3461:             p[j] = t;
3462:     }
3463: }
3465: static void stbtt__sort_edges_quicksort(stbtt__edge* p, int n)
3466: {
3467:     /* threshold for transitioning to insertion sort */
3468:     while (n > 12) {
3469:         stbtt__edge t;
3470:         int c01, c12, c, m, i, j;
3472:         /* compute median of three */
3473:         m = n >> 1;
3474:         c01 = STBTT__COMPARE(&p[0], &p[m]);
3475:         c12 = STBTT__COMPARE(&p[m], &p[n - 1]);
3476:         /* if 0 >= mid >= end, or 0 < mid < end, then use mid */
3477:         if (c01 != c12) {
3478:             /* otherwise, we'll need to swap something else to middle */
3479:             int z;
3480:             c = STBTT__COMPARE(&p[0], &p[n - 1]);
3481:             /* 0>mid && mid<n:  0>n => n; 0<n => 0 */
3482:             /* 0<mid && mid>n:  0>n => 0; 0<n => n */
3483:             z = (c == c12) ? 0 : n - 1;
3484:             t = p[z];
3485:             p[z] = p[m];
3486:             p[m] = t;
3487:         }
3488:         /* now p[m] is the median-of-three */
3489:         /* swap it to the beginning so it won't move around */
3490:         t = p[0];
3491:         p[0] = p[m];
3492:         p[m] = t;
3494:         /* partition loop */
3495:         i = 1;
3496:         j = n - 1;
3497:         for (;;) {
3498:             /* handling of equality is crucial here */
3499:             /* for sentinels & efficiency with duplicates */
3500:             for (;; ++i) {
3501:                 if (!STBTT__COMPARE(&p[i], &p[0])) break;
3502:             }
3503:             for (;; --j) {
3504:                 if (!STBTT__COMPARE(&p[0], &p[j])) break;
3505:             }
3506:             /* make sure we haven't crossed */
3507:             if (i >= j) break;
3508:             t = p[i];
3509:             p[i] = p[j];
3510:             p[j] = t;
3512:             ++i;
3513:             --j;
3514:         }
3515:         /* recurse on smaller side, iterate on larger */
3516:         if (j < (n - i)) {
3517:             stbtt__sort_edges_quicksort(p, j);
3518:             p = p + i;
3519:             n = n - i;
3520:         }
3521:         else {
3522:             stbtt__sort_edges_quicksort(p + i, n - i);
3523:             n = j;
3524:         }
3525:     }
3526: }
3528: static void stbtt__sort_edges(stbtt__edge* p, int n)
3529: {
3530:     stbtt__sort_edges_quicksort(p, n);
3531:     stbtt__sort_edges_ins_sort(p, n);
3532: }
3534: typedef struct
3535: {
3536:     float x, y;
3537: } stbtt__point;
3539: static void stbtt__rasterize(stbtt__bitmap* result, stbtt__point* pts, int* wcount, int windings, float scale_x, float scale_y, float shift_x, float shift_y, int off_x, int off_y, int invert, void* userdata)
3540: {
3541:     float y_scale_inv = invert ? -scale_y : scale_y;
3542:     stbtt__edge* e;
3543:     int n, i, j, k, m;
3544: #if STBTT_RASTERIZER_VERSION == 1
3545:     int vsubsample = result->h < 8 ? 15 : 5;
3546: #elif STBTT_RASTERIZER_VERSION == 2
3547:     int vsubsample = 1;
3548: #else
3549: #error "Unrecognized value of STBTT_RASTERIZER_VERSION"
3550: #endif
3551:     // vsubsample should divide 255 evenly; otherwise we won't reach full opacity
3553:     // now we have to blow out the windings into explicit edge lists
3554:     n = 0;
3555:     for (i = 0; i < windings; ++i)
3556:         n += wcount[i];
3558:     e = (stbtt__edge*)STBTT_malloc(sizeof(*e) * (n + 1), userdata); // add an extra one as a sentinel
3559:     if (e == 0) return;
3560:     n = 0;
3562:     m = 0;
3563:     for (i = 0; i < windings; ++i) {
3564:         stbtt__point* p = pts + m;
3565:         m += wcount[i];
3566:         j = wcount[i] - 1;
3567:         for (k = 0; k < wcount[i]; j = k++) {
3568:             int a = k, b = j;
3569:             // skip the edge if horizontal
3570:             if (p[j].y == p[k].y)
3571:                 continue;
3572:             // add edge from j to k to the list
3573:             e[n].invert = 0;
3574:             if (invert ? p[j].y > p[k].y : p[j].y < p[k].y) {
3575:                 e[n].invert = 1;
3576:                 a = j, b = k;
3577:             }
3578:             e[n].x0 = p[a].x * scale_x + shift_x;
3579:             e[n].y0 = (p[a].y * y_scale_inv + shift_y) * vsubsample;
3580:             e[n].x1 = p[b].x * scale_x + shift_x;
3581:             e[n].y1 = (p[b].y * y_scale_inv + shift_y) * vsubsample;
3582:             ++n;
3583:         }
3584:     }
3586:     // now sort the edges by their highest point (should snap to integer, and then by x)
3587:     //STBTT_sort(e, n, sizeof(e[0]), stbtt__edge_compare);
3588:     stbtt__sort_edges(e, n);
3590:     // now, traverse the scanlines and find the intersections on each scanline, use xor winding rule
3591:     stbtt__rasterize_sorted_edges(result, e, n, vsubsample, off_x, off_y, userdata);
3593:     STBTT_free(e, userdata);
3594: }
3596: static void stbtt__add_point(stbtt__point* points, int n, float x, float y)
3597: {
3598:     if (!points) return; // during first pass, it's unallocated
3599:     points[n].x = x;
3600:     points[n].y = y;
3601: }
3603: // tessellate until threshold p is happy... @TODO warped to compensate for non-linear stretching
3604: static int stbtt__tesselate_curve(stbtt__point* points, int* num_points, float x0, float y0, float x1, float y1, float x2, float y2, float objspace_flatness_squared, int n)
3605: {
3606:     // midpoint
3607:     float mx = (x0 + 2 * x1 + x2) / 4;
3608:     float my = (y0 + 2 * y1 + y2) / 4;
3609:     // versus directly drawn line
3610:     float dx = (x0 + x2) / 2 - mx;
3611:     float dy = (y0 + y2) / 2 - my;
3612:     if (n > 16) // 65536 segments on one curve better be enough!
3613:         return 1;
3614:     if (dx * dx + dy * dy > objspace_flatness_squared) { // half-pixel error allowed... need to be smaller if AA
3615:         stbtt__tesselate_curve(points, num_points, x0, y0, (x0 + x1) / 2.0f, (y0 + y1) / 2.0f, mx, my, objspace_flatness_squared, n + 1);
3616:         stbtt__tesselate_curve(points, num_points, mx, my, (x1 + x2) / 2.0f, (y1 + y2) / 2.0f, x2, y2, objspace_flatness_squared, n + 1);
3617:     }
3618:     else {
3619:         stbtt__add_point(points, *num_points, x2, y2);
3620:         *num_points = *num_points + 1;
3621:     }
3622:     return 1;
3623: }
3625: static void stbtt__tesselate_cubic(stbtt__point* points, int* num_points, float x0, float y0, float x1, float y1, float x2, float y2, float x3, float y3, float objspace_flatness_squared, int n)
3626: {
3627:     // @TODO this "flatness" calculation is just made-up nonsense that seems to work well enough
3628:     float dx0 = x1 - x0;
3629:     float dy0 = y1 - y0;
3630:     float dx1 = x2 - x1;
3631:     float dy1 = y2 - y1;
3632:     float dx2 = x3 - x2;
3633:     float dy2 = y3 - y2;
3634:     float dx = x3 - x0;
3635:     float dy = y3 - y0;
3636:     float longlen = (float)(STBTT_sqrt(dx0 * dx0 + dy0 * dy0) + STBTT_sqrt(dx1 * dx1 + dy1 * dy1) + STBTT_sqrt(dx2 * dx2 + dy2 * dy2));
3637:     float shortlen = (float)STBTT_sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
3638:     float flatness_squared = longlen * longlen - shortlen * shortlen;
3640:     if (n > 16) // 65536 segments on one curve better be enough!
3641:         return;
3643:     if (flatness_squared > objspace_flatness_squared) {
3644:         float x01 = (x0 + x1) / 2;
3645:         float y01 = (y0 + y1) / 2;
3646:         float x12 = (x1 + x2) / 2;
3647:         float y12 = (y1 + y2) / 2;
3648:         float x23 = (x2 + x3) / 2;
3649:         float y23 = (y2 + y3) / 2;
3651:         float xa = (x01 + x12) / 2;
3652:         float ya = (y01 + y12) / 2;
3653:         float xb = (x12 + x23) / 2;
3654:         float yb = (y12 + y23) / 2;
3656:         float mx = (xa + xb) / 2;
3657:         float my = (ya + yb) / 2;
3659:         stbtt__tesselate_cubic(points, num_points, x0, y0, x01, y01, xa, ya, mx, my, objspace_flatness_squared, n + 1);
3660:         stbtt__tesselate_cubic(points, num_points, mx, my, xb, yb, x23, y23, x3, y3, objspace_flatness_squared, n + 1);
3661:     }
3662:     else {
3663:         stbtt__add_point(points, *num_points, x3, y3);
3664:         *num_points = *num_points + 1;
3665:     }
3666: }
3668: // returns number of contours
3669: static stbtt__point* stbtt_FlattenCurves(stbtt_vertex* vertices, int num_verts, float objspace_flatness, int** contour_lengths, int* num_contours, void* userdata)
3670: {
3671:     stbtt__point* points = 0;
3672:     int num_points = 0;
3674:     float objspace_flatness_squared = objspace_flatness * objspace_flatness;
3675:     int i, n = 0, start = 0, pass;
3677:     // count how many "moves" there are to get the contour count
3678:     for (i = 0; i < num_verts; ++i)
3679:         if (vertices[i].type == STBTT_vmove)
3680:             ++n;
3682:     *num_contours = n;
3683:     if (n == 0) return 0;
3685:     *contour_lengths = (int*)STBTT_malloc(sizeof(**contour_lengths) * n, userdata);
3687:     if (*contour_lengths == 0) {
3688:         *num_contours = 0;
3689:         return 0;
3690:     }
3692:     // make two passes through the points so we don't need to realloc
3693:     for (pass = 0; pass < 2; ++pass) {
3694:         float x = 0, y = 0;
3695:         if (pass == 1) {
3696:             points = (stbtt__point*)STBTT_malloc(num_points * sizeof(points[0]), userdata);
3697:             if (points == NULL) goto error;
3698:         }
3699:         num_points = 0;
3700:         n = -1;
3701:         for (i = 0; i < num_verts; ++i) {
3702:             switch (vertices[i].type) {
3703:             case STBTT_vmove:
3704:                 // start the next contour
3705:                 if (n >= 0)
3706:                     (*contour_lengths)[n] = num_points - start;
3707:                 ++n;
3708:                 start = num_points;
3710:                 x = vertices[i].x, y = vertices[i].y;
3711:                 stbtt__add_point(points, num_points++, x, y);
3712:                 break;
3713:             case STBTT_vline:
3714:                 x = vertices[i].x, y = vertices[i].y;
3715:                 stbtt__add_point(points, num_points++, x, y);
3716:                 break;
3717:             case STBTT_vcurve:
3718:                 stbtt__tesselate_curve(points, &num_points, x, y,
3719:                     vertices[i].cx, vertices[i].cy,
3720:                     vertices[i].x, vertices[i].y,
3721:                     objspace_flatness_squared, 0);
3722:                 x = vertices[i].x, y = vertices[i].y;
3723:                 break;
3724:             case STBTT_vcubic:
3725:                 stbtt__tesselate_cubic(points, &num_points, x, y,
3726:                     vertices[i].cx, vertices[i].cy,
3727:                     vertices[i].cx1, vertices[i].cy1,
3728:                     vertices[i].x, vertices[i].y,
3729:                     objspace_flatness_squared, 0);
3730:                 x = vertices[i].x, y = vertices[i].y;
3731:                 break;
3732:             }
3733:         }
3734:         (*contour_lengths)[n] = num_points - start;
3735:     }
3737:     return points;
3738: error:
3739:     STBTT_free(points, userdata);
3740:     STBTT_free(*contour_lengths, userdata);
3741:     *contour_lengths = 0;
3742:     *num_contours = 0;
3743:     return NULL;
3744: }
3746: STBTT_DEF void stbtt_Rasterize(stbtt__bitmap* result, float flatness_in_pixels, stbtt_vertex* vertices, int num_verts, float scale_x, float scale_y, float shift_x, float shift_y, int x_off, int y_off, int invert, void* userdata)
3747: {
3748:     float scale = scale_x > scale_y ? scale_y : scale_x;
3749:     int winding_count = 0;
3750:     int* winding_lengths = NULL;
3751:     stbtt__point* windings = stbtt_FlattenCurves(vertices, num_verts, flatness_in_pixels / scale, &winding_lengths, &winding_count, userdata);
3752:     if (windings) {
3753:         stbtt__rasterize(result, windings, winding_lengths, winding_count, scale_x, scale_y, shift_x, shift_y, x_off, y_off, invert, userdata);
3754:         STBTT_free(winding_lengths, userdata);
3755:         STBTT_free(windings, userdata);
3756:     }
3757: }
3759: STBTT_DEF void stbtt_FreeBitmap(unsigned char* bitmap, void* userdata)
3760: {
3761:     STBTT_free(bitmap, userdata);
3762: }
3764: STBTT_DEF unsigned char* stbtt_GetGlyphBitmapSubpixel(const stbtt_fontinfo* info, float scale_x, float scale_y, float shift_x, float shift_y, int glyph, int* width, int* height, int* xoff, int* yoff)
3765: {
3766:     int ix0, iy0, ix1, iy1;
3767:     stbtt__bitmap gbm;
3768:     stbtt_vertex* vertices;
3769:     int num_verts = stbtt_GetGlyphShape(info, glyph, &vertices);
3771:     if (scale_x == 0) scale_x = scale_y;
3772:     if (scale_y == 0) {
3773:         if (scale_x == 0) {
3774:             STBTT_free(vertices, info->userdata);
3775:             return NULL;
3776:         }
3777:         scale_y = scale_x;
3778:     }
3780:     stbtt_GetGlyphBitmapBoxSubpixel(info, glyph, scale_x, scale_y, shift_x, shift_y, &ix0, &iy0, &ix1, &iy1);
3782:     // now we get the size
3783:     gbm.w = (ix1 - ix0);
3784:     gbm.h = (iy1 - iy0);
3785:     gbm.pixels = NULL; // in case we error
3787:     if (width) *width = gbm.w;
3788:     if (height) *height = gbm.h;
3789:     if (xoff) *xoff = ix0;
3790:     if (yoff) *yoff = iy0;
3792:     if (gbm.w && gbm.h) {
3793:         gbm.pixels = (unsigned char*)STBTT_malloc(gbm.w * gbm.h, info->userdata);
3794:         if (gbm.pixels) {
3795:             gbm.stride = gbm.w;
3797:             stbtt_Rasterize(&gbm, 0.35f, vertices, num_verts, scale_x, scale_y, shift_x, shift_y, ix0, iy0, 1, info->userdata);
3798:         }
3799:     }
3800:     STBTT_free(vertices, info->userdata);
3801:     return gbm.pixels;
3802: }

3806:     return stbtt_GetGlyphBitmapSubpixel(info, scale_x, scale_y, 0.0f, 0.0f, glyph, width, height, xoff, yoff);
3807: }

3826: }

3858: //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
3859: //
3860: // bitmap baking
3861: //
3862: // This is SUPER-CRAPPY packing to keep source code small
3864: static int stbtt_BakeFontBitmap_internal(unsigned char* data, int offset,  // font location (use offset=0 for plain .ttf)
3865:     float pixel_height,                     // height of font in pixels
3866:     unsigned char* pixels, int pw, int ph,  // bitmap to be filled in
3867:     int first_char, int num_chars,          // characters to bake
3868:     stbtt_bakedchar* chardata)
3869: {
3870:     float scale;
3871:     int x, y, bottom_y, i;
3872:     stbtt_fontinfo f;
3873:     f.userdata = NULL;
3874:     if (!stbtt_InitFont(&f, data, offset))
3875:         return -1;
3876:     STBTT_memset(pixels, 0, pw * ph); // background of 0 around pixels
3877:     x = y = 1;
3878:     bottom_y = 1;
3880:     scale = stbtt_ScaleForPixelHeight(&f, pixel_height);
3882:     for (i = 0; i < num_chars; ++i) {
3883:         int advance, lsb, x0, y0, x1, y1, gw, gh;
3884:         int g = stbtt_FindGlyphIndex(&f, first_char + i);
3885:         stbtt_GetGlyphHMetrics(&f, g, &advance, &lsb);
3886:         stbtt_GetGlyphBitmapBox(&f, g, scale, scale, &x0, &y0, &x1, &y1);
3887:         gw = x1 - x0;
3888:         gh = y1 - y0;
3889:         if (x + gw + 1 >= pw)
3890:             y = bottom_y, x = 1; // advance to next row
3891:         if (y + gh + 1 >= ph) // check if it fits vertically AFTER potentially moving to next row
3892:             return -i;
3893:         STBTT_assert(x + gw < pw);
3894:         STBTT_assert(y + gh < ph);
3895:         stbtt_MakeGlyphBitmap(&f, pixels + x + y * pw, gw, gh, pw, scale, scale, g);
3896:         chardata[i].x0 = (stbtt_int16)x;
3897:         chardata[i].y0 = (stbtt_int16)y;
3898:         chardata[i].x1 = (stbtt_int16)(x + gw);
3899:         chardata[i].y1 = (stbtt_int16)(y + gh);
3900:         chardata[i].xadvance = scale * advance;
3901:         chardata[i].xoff = (float)x0;
3902:         chardata[i].yoff = (float)y0;
3903:         x = x + gw + 1;
3904:         if (y + gh + 1 > bottom_y)
3905:             bottom_y = y + gh + 1;
3906:     }
3907:     return bottom_y;
3908: }
3910: STBTT_DEF void stbtt_GetBakedQuad(const stbtt_bakedchar* chardata, int pw, int ph, int char_index, float* xpos, float* ypos, stbtt_aligned_quad* q, int opengl_fillrule)
3911: {
3912:     float d3d_bias = opengl_fillrule ? 0 : -0.5f;
3913:     float ipw = 1.0f / pw, iph = 1.0f / ph;
3914:     const stbtt_bakedchar* b = chardata + char_index;
3915:     int round_x = STBTT_ifloor((*xpos + b->xoff) + 0.5f);
3916:     int round_y = STBTT_ifloor((*ypos + b->yoff) + 0.5f);
3918:     q->x0 = round_x + d3d_bias;
3919:     q->y0 = round_y + d3d_bias;
3920:     q->x1 = round_x + b->x1 - b->x0 + d3d_bias;
3921:     q->y1 = round_y + b->y1 - b->y0 + d3d_bias;
3923:     q->s0 = b->x0 * ipw;
3924:     q->t0 = b->y0 * iph;
3925:     q->s1 = b->x1 * ipw;
3926:     q->t1 = b->y1 * iph;
3928:     *xpos += b->xadvance;
3929: }

3940: ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
3941: //                                                                                //
3942: //                                                                                //
3943: // COMPILER WARNING ?!?!?                                                         //
3944: //                                                                                //
3945: //                                                                                //
3946: // if you get a compile warning due to these symbols being defined more than      //
3947: // once, move #include "stb_rect_pack.h" before #include "stb_truetype.h"         //

3951: typedef struct
3952: {
3953:     int width, height;
3954:     int x, y, bottom_y;
3955: } stbrp_context;
3957: typedef struct
3958: {
3959:     unsigned char x;
3960: } stbrp_node;

3964:     stbrp_coord x, y;
3965:     int id, w, h, was_packed;
3966: };
3968: static void stbrp_init_target(stbrp_context* con, int pw, int ph, stbrp_node* nodes, int num_nodes)
3969: {
3970:     con->width = pw;
3971:     con->height = ph;
3972:     con->x = 0;
3973:     con->y = 0;
3974:     con->bottom_y = 0;
3975:     STBTT__NOTUSED(nodes);
3976:     STBTT__NOTUSED(num_nodes);
3977: }
3979: static void stbrp_pack_rects(stbrp_context* con, stbrp_rect* rects, int num_rects)
3980: {
3981:     int i;
3982:     for (i = 0; i < num_rects; ++i) {
3983:         if (con->x + rects[i].w > con->width) {
3984:             con->x = 0;
3985:             con->y = con->bottom_y;
3986:         }
3987:         if (con->y + rects[i].h > con->height)
3988:             break;
3989:         rects[i].x = con->x;
3990:         rects[i].y = con->y;
3991:         rects[i].was_packed = 1;
3992:         con->x += rects[i].w;
3993:         if (con->y + rects[i].h > con->bottom_y)
3994:             con->bottom_y = con->y + rects[i].h;
3995:     }
3996:     for (; i < num_rects; ++i)
3997:         rects[i].was_packed = 0;
3998: }
3999: #endif
4001: //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
4002: //
4003: // bitmap baking
4004: //
4005: // This is SUPER-AWESOME (tm Ryan Gordon) packing using stb_rect_pack.h. If
4006: // stb_rect_pack.h isn't available, it uses the BakeFontBitmap strategy.
4008: STBTT_DEF int stbtt_PackBegin(stbtt_pack_context* spc, unsigned char* pixels, int pw, int ph, int stride_in_bytes, int padding, void* alloc_context)
4009: {
4010:     stbrp_context* context = (stbrp_context*)STBTT_malloc(sizeof(*context), alloc_context);
4011:     int            num_nodes = pw - padding;
4012:     stbrp_node* nodes = (stbrp_node*)STBTT_malloc(sizeof(*nodes) * num_nodes, alloc_context);
4014:     if (context == NULL || nodes == NULL) {
4015:         if (context != NULL) STBTT_free(context, alloc_context);
4016:         if (nodes != NULL) STBTT_free(nodes, alloc_context);
4017:         return 0;
4018:     }
4020:     spc->user_allocator_context = alloc_context;
4021:     spc->width = pw;
4022:     spc->height = ph;
4023:     spc->pixels = pixels;
4024:     spc->pack_info = context;
4025:     spc->nodes = nodes;
4026:     spc->padding = padding;
4027:     spc->stride_in_bytes = stride_in_bytes != 0 ? stride_in_bytes : pw;
4028:     spc->h_oversample = 1;
4029:     spc->v_oversample = 1;
4030:     spc->skip_missing = 0;
4032:     stbrp_init_target(context, pw - padding, ph - padding, nodes, num_nodes);
4034:     if (pixels)
4035:         STBTT_memset(pixels, 0, pw * ph); // background of 0 around pixels
4037:     return 1;
4038: }
4040: STBTT_DEF void stbtt_PackEnd(stbtt_pack_context* spc)
4041: {
4042:     STBTT_free(spc->nodes, spc->user_allocator_context);
4043:     STBTT_free(spc->pack_info, spc->user_allocator_context);
4044: }
4046: STBTT_DEF void stbtt_PackSetOversampling(stbtt_pack_context* spc, unsigned int h_oversample, unsigned int v_oversample)
4047: {
4048:     STBTT_assert(h_oversample <= STBTT_MAX_OVERSAMPLE);
4049:     STBTT_assert(v_oversample <= STBTT_MAX_OVERSAMPLE);
4050:     if (h_oversample <= STBTT_MAX_OVERSAMPLE)
4051:         spc->h_oversample = h_oversample;
4052:     if (v_oversample <= STBTT_MAX_OVERSAMPLE)
4053:         spc->v_oversample = v_oversample;
4054: }

4061: #define STBTT__OVER_MASK  (STBTT_MAX_OVERSAMPLE-1)
4063: static void stbtt__h_prefilter(unsigned char* pixels, int w, int h, int stride_in_bytes, unsigned int kernel_width)
4064: {
4065:     unsigned char buffer[STBTT_MAX_OVERSAMPLE];
4066:     int safe_w = w - kernel_width;
4067:     int j;
4068:     STBTT_memset(buffer, 0, STBTT_MAX_OVERSAMPLE); // suppress bogus warning from VS2013 -analyze
4069:     for (j = 0; j < h; ++j) {
4070:         int i;
4071:         unsigned int total;
4072:         STBTT_memset(buffer, 0, kernel_width);
4074:         total = 0;
4076:         // make kernel_width a constant in common cases so compiler can optimize out the divide
4077:         switch (kernel_width) {
4078:         case 2:
4079:             for (i = 0; i <= safe_w; ++i) {
4080:                 total += pixels[i] - buffer[i & STBTT__OVER_MASK];
4081:                 buffer[(i + kernel_width) & STBTT__OVER_MASK] = pixels[i];
4082:                 pixels[i] = (unsigned char)(total / 2);
4083:             }
4084:             break;
4085:         case 3:
4086:             for (i = 0; i <= safe_w; ++i) {
4087:                 total += pixels[i] - buffer[i & STBTT__OVER_MASK];
4088:                 buffer[(i + kernel_width) & STBTT__OVER_MASK] = pixels[i];
4089:                 pixels[i] = (unsigned char)(total / 3);
4090:             }
4091:             break;
4092:         case 4:
4093:             for (i = 0; i <= safe_w; ++i) {
4094:                 total += pixels[i] - buffer[i & STBTT__OVER_MASK];
4095:                 buffer[(i + kernel_width) & STBTT__OVER_MASK] = pixels[i];
4096:                 pixels[i] = (unsigned char)(total / 4);
4097:             }
4098:             break;
4099:         case 5:
4100:             for (i = 0; i <= safe_w; ++i) {
4101:                 total += pixels[i] - buffer[i & STBTT__OVER_MASK];
4102:                 buffer[(i + kernel_width) & STBTT__OVER_MASK] = pixels[i];
4103:                 pixels[i] = (unsigned char)(total / 5);
4104:             }
4105:             break;
4106:         default:
4107:             for (i = 0; i <= safe_w; ++i) {
4108:                 total += pixels[i] - buffer[i & STBTT__OVER_MASK];
4109:                 buffer[(i + kernel_width) & STBTT__OVER_MASK] = pixels[i];
4110:                 pixels[i] = (unsigned char)(total / kernel_width);
4111:             }
4112:             break;
4113:         }
4115:         for (; i < w; ++i) {
4116:             STBTT_assert(pixels[i] == 0);
4117:             total -= buffer[i & STBTT__OVER_MASK];
4118:             pixels[i] = (unsigned char)(total / kernel_width);
4119:         }
4121:         pixels += stride_in_bytes;
4122:     }
4123: }
4125: static void stbtt__v_prefilter(unsigned char* pixels, int w, int h, int stride_in_bytes, unsigned int kernel_width)
4126: {
4127:     unsigned char buffer[STBTT_MAX_OVERSAMPLE];
4128:     int safe_h = h - kernel_width;
4129:     int j;
4130:     STBTT_memset(buffer, 0, STBTT_MAX_OVERSAMPLE); // suppress bogus warning from VS2013 -analyze
4131:     for (j = 0; j < w; ++j) {
4132:         int i;
4133:         unsigned int total;
4134:         STBTT_memset(buffer, 0, kernel_width);
4136:         total = 0;
4138:         // make kernel_width a constant in common cases so compiler can optimize out the divide
4139:         switch (kernel_width) {
4140:         case 2:
4141:             for (i = 0; i <= safe_h; ++i) {
4142:                 total += pixels[i * stride_in_bytes] - buffer[i & STBTT__OVER_MASK];
4143:                 buffer[(i + kernel_width) & STBTT__OVER_MASK] = pixels[i * stride_in_bytes];
4144:                 pixels[i * stride_in_bytes] = (unsigned char)(total / 2);
4145:             }
4146:             break;
4147:         case 3:
4148:             for (i = 0; i <= safe_h; ++i) {
4149:                 total += pixels[i * stride_in_bytes] - buffer[i & STBTT__OVER_MASK];
4150:                 buffer[(i + kernel_width) & STBTT__OVER_MASK] = pixels[i * stride_in_bytes];
4151:                 pixels[i * stride_in_bytes] = (unsigned char)(total / 3);
4152:             }
4153:             break;
4154:         case 4:
4155:             for (i = 0; i <= safe_h; ++i) {
4156:                 total += pixels[i * stride_in_bytes] - buffer[i & STBTT__OVER_MASK];
4157:                 buffer[(i + kernel_width) & STBTT__OVER_MASK] = pixels[i * stride_in_bytes];
4158:                 pixels[i * stride_in_bytes] = (unsigned char)(total / 4);
4159:             }
4160:             break;
4161:         case 5:
4162:             for (i = 0; i <= safe_h; ++i) {
4163:                 total += pixels[i * stride_in_bytes] - buffer[i & STBTT__OVER_MASK];
4164:                 buffer[(i + kernel_width) & STBTT__OVER_MASK] = pixels[i * stride_in_bytes];
4165:                 pixels[i * stride_in_bytes] = (unsigned char)(total / 5);
4166:             }
4167:             break;
4168:         default:
4169:             for (i = 0; i <= safe_h; ++i) {
4170:                 total += pixels[i * stride_in_bytes] - buffer[i & STBTT__OVER_MASK];
4171:                 buffer[(i + kernel_width) & STBTT__OVER_MASK] = pixels[i * stride_in_bytes];
4172:                 pixels[i * stride_in_bytes] = (unsigned char)(total / kernel_width);
4173:             }
4174:             break;
4175:         }
4177:         for (; i < h; ++i) {
4178:             STBTT_assert(pixels[i * stride_in_bytes] == 0);
4179:             total -= buffer[i & STBTT__OVER_MASK];
4180:             pixels[i * stride_in_bytes] = (unsigned char)(total / kernel_width);
4181:         }
4183:         pixels += 1;
4184:     }
4185: }
4187: static float stbtt__oversample_shift(int oversample)
4188: {
4189:     if (!oversample)
4190:         return 0.0f;
4192:     // The prefilter is a box filter of width "oversample",
4193:     // which shifts phase by (oversample - 1)/2 pixels in
4194:     // oversampled space. We want to shift in the opposite
4195:     // direction to counter this.
4196:     return (float)-(oversample - 1) / (2.0f * (float)oversample);
4197: }
4199: // rects array must be big enough to accommodate all characters in the given ranges
4200: STBTT_DEF int stbtt_PackFontRangesGatherRects(stbtt_pack_context* spc, const stbtt_fontinfo* info, stbtt_pack_range* ranges, int num_ranges, stbrp_rect* rects)
4201: {
4202:     int i, j, k;
4203:     int missing_glyph_added = 0;
4205:     k = 0;
4206:     for (i = 0; i < num_ranges; ++i) {
4207:         float fh = ranges[i].font_size;
4208:         float scale = fh > 0 ? stbtt_ScaleForPixelHeight(info, fh) : stbtt_ScaleForMappingEmToPixels(info, -fh);
4209:         ranges[i].h_oversample = (unsigned char)spc->h_oversample;
4210:         ranges[i].v_oversample = (unsigned char)spc->v_oversample;
4211:         for (j = 0; j < ranges[i].num_chars; ++j) {
4212:             int x0, y0, x1, y1;
4213:             int codepoint = ranges[i].array_of_unicode_codepoints == NULL ? ranges[i].first_unicode_codepoint_in_range + j : ranges[i].array_of_unicode_codepoints[j];
4214:             int glyph = stbtt_FindGlyphIndex(info, codepoint);
4215:             if (glyph == 0 && (spc->skip_missing || missing_glyph_added)) {
4216:                 rects[k].w = rects[k].h = 0;
4217:             }
4218:             else {
4219:                 stbtt_GetGlyphBitmapBoxSubpixel(info, glyph,
4220:                     scale * spc->h_oversample,
4221:                     scale * spc->v_oversample,
4222:                     0, 0,
4223:                     &x0, &y0, &x1, &y1);
4224:                 rects[k].w = (stbrp_coord)(x1 - x0 + spc->padding + spc->h_oversample - 1);
4225:                 rects[k].h = (stbrp_coord)(y1 - y0 + spc->padding + spc->v_oversample - 1);
4226:                 if (glyph == 0)
4227:                     missing_glyph_added = 1;
4228:             }
4229:             ++k;
4230:         }
4231:     }
4233:     return k;
4234: }

4260: STBTT_DEF int stbtt_PackFontRangesRenderIntoRects(stbtt_pack_context* spc, const stbtt_fontinfo* info, stbtt_pack_range* ranges, int num_ranges, stbrp_rect* rects)
4261: {
4262:     int i, j, k, missing_glyph = -1, return_value = 1;
4264:     // save current values
4265:     int old_h_over = spc->h_oversample;
4266:     int old_v_over = spc->v_oversample;
4268:     k = 0;
4269:     for (i = 0; i < num_ranges; ++i) {
4270:         float fh = ranges[i].font_size;
4271:         float scale = fh > 0 ? stbtt_ScaleForPixelHeight(info, fh) : stbtt_ScaleForMappingEmToPixels(info, -fh);
4272:         float recip_h, recip_v, sub_x, sub_y;
4273:         spc->h_oversample = ranges[i].h_oversample;
4274:         spc->v_oversample = ranges[i].v_oversample;
4275:         recip_h = 1.0f / spc->h_oversample;
4276:         recip_v = 1.0f / spc->v_oversample;
4277:         sub_x = stbtt__oversample_shift(spc->h_oversample);
4278:         sub_y = stbtt__oversample_shift(spc->v_oversample);
4279:         for (j = 0; j < ranges[i].num_chars; ++j) {
4280:             stbrp_rect* r = &rects[k];
4281:             if (r->was_packed && r->w != 0 && r->h != 0) {
4282:                 stbtt_packedchar* bc = &ranges[i].chardata_for_range[j];
4283:                 int advance, lsb, x0, y0, x1, y1;
4284:                 int codepoint = ranges[i].array_of_unicode_codepoints == NULL ? ranges[i].first_unicode_codepoint_in_range + j : ranges[i].array_of_unicode_codepoints[j];
4285:                 int glyph = stbtt_FindGlyphIndex(info, codepoint);
4286:                 stbrp_coord pad = (stbrp_coord)spc->padding;
4288:                 // pad on left and top
4289:                 r->x += pad;
4290:                 r->y += pad;
4291:                 r->w -= pad;
4292:                 r->h -= pad;
4293:                 stbtt_GetGlyphHMetrics(info, glyph, &advance, &lsb);
4294:                 stbtt_GetGlyphBitmapBox(info, glyph,
4295:                     scale * spc->h_oversample,
4296:                     scale * spc->v_oversample,
4297:                     &x0, &y0, &x1, &y1);
4298:                 stbtt_MakeGlyphBitmapSubpixel(info,
4299:                     spc->pixels + r->x + r->y * spc->stride_in_bytes,
4300:                     r->w - spc->h_oversample + 1,
4301:                     r->h - spc->v_oversample + 1,
4302:                     spc->stride_in_bytes,
4303:                     scale * spc->h_oversample,
4304:                     scale * spc->v_oversample,
4305:                     0, 0,
4306:                     glyph);
4308:                 if (spc->h_oversample > 1)
4309:                     stbtt__h_prefilter(spc->pixels + r->x + r->y * spc->stride_in_bytes,
4310:                         r->w, r->h, spc->stride_in_bytes,
4311:                         spc->h_oversample);
4313:                 if (spc->v_oversample > 1)
4314:                     stbtt__v_prefilter(spc->pixels + r->x + r->y * spc->stride_in_bytes,
4315:                         r->w, r->h, spc->stride_in_bytes,
4316:                         spc->v_oversample);
4318:                 bc->x0 = (stbtt_int16)r->x;
4319:                 bc->y0 = (stbtt_int16)r->y;
4320:                 bc->x1 = (stbtt_int16)(r->x + r->w);
4321:                 bc->y1 = (stbtt_int16)(r->y + r->h);
4322:                 bc->xadvance = scale * advance;
4323:                 bc->xoff = (float)x0 * recip_h + sub_x;
4324:                 bc->yoff = (float)y0 * recip_v + sub_y;
4325:                 bc->xoff2 = (x0 + r->w) * recip_h + sub_x;
4326:                 bc->yoff2 = (y0 + r->h) * recip_v + sub_y;
4328:                 if (glyph == 0)
4329:                     missing_glyph = j;
4330:             }
4331:             else if (spc->skip_missing) {
4332:                 return_value = 0;
4333:             }
4334:             else if (r->was_packed && r->w == 0 && r->h == 0 && missing_glyph >= 0) {
4335:                 ranges[i].chardata_for_range[j] = ranges[i].chardata_for_range[missing_glyph];
4336:             }
4337:             else {
4338:                 return_value = 0; // if any fail, report failure
4339:             }
4341:             ++k;
4342:         }
4343:     }
4345:     // restore original values
4346:     spc->h_oversample = old_h_over;
4347:     spc->v_oversample = old_v_over;
4349:     return return_value;
4350: }
