<file path="Source/Engine/VFX/AnimationController.cpp" lines="205">
1: #include "AnimationController.h"
2: #include <functional>
4: using namespace DirectX; // Untuk mempermudah penulisan XMVECTOR, dll
6: void AnimationController::Initialize(std::shared_ptr<Model> model)
7: {
8:     ownerModel = model;
9:     size_t nodeCount = ownerModel->GetNodes().size();
11:     // Alokasi memori untuk pose sekarang dan pose blending
12:     nodePoses.resize(nodeCount);
13:     prevNodePoses.resize(nodeCount);
14: }
16: void AnimationController::Play(const std::string& name, bool loop, float blendTime)
17: {
18:     if (!ownerModel) return;
20:     int newIndex = ownerModel->GetAnimationIndex(name.c_str());
21:     if (newIndex == -1) return;
23:     if (newIndex != currentAnimIndex)
24:     {
25:         // --- LOGIKA BLENDING DI MULAI ---
27:         // Jika kita sebelumnya sedang memainkan animasi (bukan dari T-Pose awal),
28:         // Kita snapshot (foto) pose terakhir ke dalam 'prevNodePoses'
29:         if (currentAnimIndex != -1)
30:         {
31:             // Salin state terakhir nodePoses ke prevNodePoses
32:             prevNodePoses = nodePoses;
34:             // Setup blending
35:             isBlending = true;
36:             blendDuration = blendTime;
37:             blendTimer = 0.0f;
38:         }
39:         else
40:         {
41:             // Kalau ini animasi pertama kali dijalankan, tidak perlu blending
42:             isBlending = false;
43:         }
45:         // --- RESET STATE BARU ---
46:         currentAnimIndex = newIndex;
47:         timer = 0.0f;
48:         isLooping = loop;
49:         m_playbackSpeed = 1.0f;
50:     }
51: }
53: void AnimationController::Update(float dt)
54: {
55:     if (!ownerModel || currentAnimIndex == -1) return;
57:     // 1. Update Timer Animasi Utama
58:     const auto& anims = ownerModel->GetAnimations();
59:     float duration = anims.at(currentAnimIndex).secondsLength;
61:     // ---> THE FIX: Guard against Division by Zero <---
62:     if (duration > 0.0f)
63:     {
64:         timer += dt * m_playbackSpeed;
66:         if (isLooping)
67:         {
68:             // ---> THE FIX: AAA Safe Time Wrapping (No fmod crashes!) <---
69:             while (timer < 0.0f) timer += duration;
70:             while (timer >= duration) timer -= duration;
71:         }
72:         else
73:         {
74:             // Clamp strictly
75:             if (timer < 0.0f) timer = 0.0f;
76:             if (timer > duration) timer = duration;
77:         }
78:     }
79:     else
80:     {
81:         timer = 0.0f; // Safe fallback for 0-second animations
82:     }
84:     // 2. Hitung Pose Animasi Target (Animasi Baru)
85:     // Hasil sementara disimpan di 'nodePoses' dulu
86:     ownerModel->ComputeAnimation(currentAnimIndex, timer, nodePoses);
88:     // 3. Proses Blending (Jika aktif)
89:     if (isBlending)
90:     {
91:         blendTimer += dt;
93:         // Hitung persentase blending (0.0 sampai 1.0)
94:         float t = blendTimer / blendDuration;
96:         if (t >= 1.0f)
97:         {
98:             t = 1.0f;
99:             isBlending = false; // Blending selesai
100:         }
102:         // Lakukan interpolasi per-bone (Node)
103:         size_t count = nodePoses.size();
104:         for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i)
105:         {
106:             // [FIX] Menggunakan .position (bukan .translation) sesuai Model.h
107:             // Ambil data dari Pose Lama (Snapshot)
108:             XMVECTOR s0 = XMLoadFloat3(&prevNodePoses[i].scale);
109:             XMVECTOR r0 = XMLoadFloat4(&prevNodePoses[i].rotation);
110:             XMVECTOR t0 = XMLoadFloat3(&prevNodePoses[i].position);
112:             // Ambil data dari Pose Baru (Target)
113:             XMVECTOR s1 = XMLoadFloat3(&nodePoses[i].scale);
114:             XMVECTOR r1 = XMLoadFloat4(&nodePoses[i].rotation);
115:             XMVECTOR t1 = XMLoadFloat3(&nodePoses[i].position);
117:             // Interpolasi
118:             // Lerp untuk Scale dan Position
119:             XMVECTOR sFinal = XMVectorLerp(s0, s1, t);
120:             XMVECTOR tFinal = XMVectorLerp(t0, t1, t);
121:             // Slerp (Spherical Linear Interpolation) untuk Rotasi agar putaran mulus
122:             XMVECTOR rFinal = XMQuaternionSlerp(r0, r1, t);
124:             // Simpan kembali ke nodePoses (ini yang akan dipakai render)
125:             XMStoreFloat3(&nodePoses[i].scale, sFinal);
126:             XMStoreFloat4(&nodePoses[i].rotation, rFinal);
127:             XMStoreFloat3(&nodePoses[i].position, tFinal);
128:         }
129:     }
131:     // 4. Upload ke Model (Visual)
132:     if (upperAnimIndex != -1 && !upperBodyMask.empty())
133:     {
134:         upperTimer += dt;
135:         float upperDuration = anims.at(upperAnimIndex).secondsLength;
137:         // Cek apakah animasi sudah selesai
138:         if (upperTimer >= upperDuration)
139:         {
140:             if (upperIsLooping) {
141:                 upperTimer = fmod(upperTimer, upperDuration); // Ulangi
142:             }
143:             else {
144:                 upperAnimIndex = -1; // Matikan animasi upper body
145:             }
146:         }
148:         // Jika animasi masih berjalan (belum dimatikan)
149:         if (upperAnimIndex != -1)
150:         {
151:             if (upperNodePoses.size() != ownerModel->GetNodes().size()) {
152:                 upperNodePoses.resize(ownerModel->GetNodes().size());
153:             }
154:             ownerModel->ComputeAnimation(upperAnimIndex, upperTimer, upperNodePoses);
156:             // --- BONE MASKING BLEND ---
157:             for (size_t i = 0; i < nodePoses.size(); ++i)
158:             {
159:                 if (upperBodyMask[i])
160:                 {
161:                     // Timpa data dari Base Layer dengan Upper Layer
162:                     nodePoses[i] = upperNodePoses[i];
163:                 }
164:             }
165:         }
166:     }
167:     // 4. Upload ke Model (Visual)
168:     ownerModel->SetNodePoses(nodePoses);
169: }
171: bool AnimationController::IsPlaying(const std::string& name) const
172: {
173:     if (!ownerModel) return false;

47: // Math Helper: Konversi (Posisi + Target) menjadi (Pitch, Yaw)
48: DirectX::XMFLOAT3 CinematicDirector::CalculateRotation(const DirectX::XMFLOAT3& pos, const DirectX::XMFLOAT3& target)
49: {
50:     XMVECTOR vPos = XMLoadFloat3(&pos);
51:     XMVECTOR vTarget = XMLoadFloat3(&target);
52:     XMVECTOR vDir = XMVectorSubtract(vTarget, vPos);
53:     vDir = XMVector3Normalize(vDir);
55:     XMFLOAT3 dir;
56:     XMStoreFloat3(&dir, vDir);
58:     float pitch = asinf(-dir.y);
59:     float yaw = atan2f(dir.x, dir.z);
61:     return { pitch, yaw, 0.0f };
62: }

51: {

75: void EffectManager::PreloadEffect(const std::string& filePath)
76: {
77:     // EARLY EXIT: Don't load it if it's already in the RAM cache!
78:     if (m_effectCache.find(filePath) != m_effectCache.end()) return;
80:     // Thread Safety Lock (Uncomment if using async loading)
81:     // std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(Graphics::Instance().GetMutex());
83:     std::u16string utf16Path{ ConvertToUTF16(filePath) };

86:     if (effect != nullptr)
87:     {
88:         m_effectCache[filePath] = effect; // Cache it permanently
89:     }
90:     else
91:     {
92:         // ==========================================
93:         // [DEBUG] TANGKAP ERROR LOAD FILE DI SINI!
94:         // ==========================================
95:         std::string errMsg = "[EFFEKSEER ERROR] Gagal meload file (Cek path, tekstur, atau versi Effekseer!): " + filePath + "\n";
96:         OutputDebugStringA(errMsg.c_str());
97:     }
98: }
100: Effekseer::Handle EffectManager::Play(const std::string& filePath, const XMFLOAT3& pos, float scale)
101: {
102:     // 1. Guarantee the effect is loaded in RAM
103:     PreloadEffect(filePath);
105:     auto it{ m_effectCache.find(filePath) };
106:     if (it == m_effectCache.end()) {
107:         // ==========================================
108:         // [DEBUG] TANGKAP ERROR CACHE DI SINI!
109:         // ==========================================
110:         std::string errMsg = "[EFFEKSEER ERROR] File tidak ada di cache (Preload gagal sebelumnya): " + filePath + "\n";
111:         OutputDebugStringA(errMsg.c_str());
112:         return -1;
113:     }
115:     // 2. Play the cached resource
116:     Effekseer::Handle handle{ m_manager->Play(it->second, pos.x, pos.y, pos.z) };
118:     if (handle == -1) {
119:         // ==========================================
120:         // [DEBUG] TANGKAP ERROR PLAY HANDLE DI SINI!
121:         // ==========================================
122:         OutputDebugStringA("[EFFEKSEER ERROR] Manager gagal memutar efek (Handle = -1)!\n");
123:     }
124:     else {
125:         // 3. Apply initial scale only if successfully played
126:         m_manager->SetScale(handle, scale, scale, scale);
127:     }
129:     return handle;
130: }

1: #include "JuiceEngine.h"

6: // Helper untuk random float sederhana (-1.0 s/d 1.0)
7: static float GetRandomFloat()
8: {
9:     return ((float)rand() / (float)RAND_MAX) * 2.0f - 1.0f;
10: }
12: JuiceEngine& JuiceEngine::Instance()
13: {
14:     static JuiceEngine instance;
15:     return instance;
16: }
18: void JuiceEngine::Reset()
19: {
20:     m_shakeTrauma = 0.0f;
21:     m_currentGlitchIntensity = 0.0f;
22:     m_shakeResultPos = { 0,0,0 };
23:     m_shakeResultRot = { 0,0,0 };
24: }
26: void JuiceEngine::TriggerShake(const ShakeSettings& settings, float intensityMultiplier)
27: {
28:     m_activeShake = settings;
30:     // Apply multiplier
31:     m_activeShake.AmplitudePos *= intensityMultiplier;
32:     m_activeShake.AmplitudeRot *= intensityMultiplier;
34:     // Tambah trauma (maks 1.0)
35:     m_shakeTrauma = std::clamp(m_shakeTrauma + 1.0f, 0.0f, 1.0f);
36: }
38: void JuiceEngine::TriggerGlitchKick(float power, float decaySpeed)
39: {
40:     // Set kick (bisa diubah jadi += power jika ingin stacking)
41:     m_currentGlitchIntensity = power;
42:     m_glitchDecaySpeed = decaySpeed;
43: }
45: void JuiceEngine::Update(float deltaTime)
46: {
47:     // =========================================================
48:     // 1. UPDATE CAMERA SHAKE (Trauma Based)
49:     // =========================================================
50:     if (m_shakeTrauma > 0.0f)
51:     {
52:         // A. Kurangi Trauma (Decay)
53:         // Rumus: Trauma -= dt * (Falloff / Duration)
54:         float decay = (deltaTime / m_activeShake.Duration) * m_activeShake.TraumaFalloff;
55:         m_shakeTrauma -= decay;
57:         if (m_shakeTrauma < 0.0f) m_shakeTrauma = 0.0f;
59:         // B. Hitung "Shake Power" (Trauma Kuadrat) -> Kunci kehalusan efek
60:         float shakePower = m_shakeTrauma * m_shakeTrauma;
62:         // C. Generate Noise Offset
63:         m_shakeTimeCounter += deltaTime * m_activeShake.Frequency;
65:         // Posisi
66:         float maxPos = m_activeShake.AmplitudePos * shakePower;
67:         m_shakeResultPos.x = maxPos * GetRandomFloat();
68:         m_shakeResultPos.y = maxPos * GetRandomFloat();
69:         m_shakeResultPos.z = maxPos * GetRandomFloat();
71:         // Rotasi (Pitch, Yaw, Roll)
72:         float maxRot = XMConvertToRadians(m_activeShake.AmplitudeRot) * shakePower;
73:         m_shakeResultRot.x = maxRot * GetRandomFloat();
74:         m_shakeResultRot.y = maxRot * GetRandomFloat();
75:         m_shakeResultRot.z = maxRot * GetRandomFloat(); // Roll biasanya paling kerasa
76:     }
77:     else
78:     {
79:         m_shakeResultPos = { 0,0,0 };
80:         m_shakeResultRot = { 0,0,0 };
81:     }
83:     // =========================================================
84:     // 2. UPDATE GLITCH DISTORTION (Kick & Decay)
85:     // =========================================================
86:     if (m_currentGlitchIntensity > 0.0f)
87:     {
88:         m_currentGlitchIntensity -= deltaTime * m_glitchDecaySpeed;
89:         if (m_currentGlitchIntensity < 0.0f) m_currentGlitchIntensity = 0.0f;
90:     }
91: }

20:     SDL_HitTestResult SDLCALL WindowHitTestCallback(SDL_Window* win, const SDL_Point* area, void* data)
21:     {
22:         Window* pWindow = static_cast<Window*>(data);
23:         if (!pWindow) return SDL_HITTEST_NORMAL;
25:         if (pWindow->IsDraggable()) {
26:             return SDL_HITTEST_DRAGGABLE;
27:         }
29:         return SDL_HITTEST_NORMAL;
30:     }
32:     bool Window::Initialize(const char* title, int width, int height, bool isTransparent)
33:     {
34:         m_width = width;
35:         m_height = height;
36:         m_isTransparent = isTransparent;
38:         SDL_WindowFlags flags = SDL_WINDOW_HIDDEN;
40:         if (isTransparent) {
41:             flags |= SDL_WINDOW_TRANSPARENT | SDL_WINDOW_BORDERLESS;
42:         }
43:         else {
44:             flags |= SDL_WINDOW_RESIZABLE;
45:         }
47:         m_sdlWindow = SDL_CreateWindow(title, width, height, flags);
48:         if (!m_sdlWindow) return false;
50:         SDL_SetWindowHitTest(m_sdlWindow, WindowHitTestCallback, this);
52:         return SetupDirectX();
53:     }
55:     bool Window::SetupDirectX()
56:     {
57:         auto device = Graphics::Instance().GetDevice();
59:         HWND hwnd = (HWND)SDL_GetPointerProperty(SDL_GetWindowProperties(m_sdlWindow), SDL_PROP_WINDOW_WIN32_HWND_POINTER, NULL);
60:         if (!hwnd) return false;
62:         Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IDXGIDevice> dxgiDevice;
63:         device->QueryInterface(IID_PPV_ARGS(&dxgiDevice));
64:         Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IDXGIAdapter> dxgiAdapter;
65:         dxgiDevice->GetAdapter(&dxgiAdapter);
66:         Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<IDXGIFactory2> dxgiFactory;
67:         dxgiAdapter->GetParent(IID_PPV_ARGS(&dxgiFactory));
69:         DXGI_SWAP_CHAIN_DESC1 swapChainDesc = {};
70:         swapChainDesc.Width = m_width;
71:         swapChainDesc.Height = m_height;
72:         swapChainDesc.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM;
73:         swapChainDesc.SampleDesc.Count = 1;
74:         swapChainDesc.BufferUsage = DXGI_USAGE_RENDER_TARGET_OUTPUT;
75:         swapChainDesc.BufferCount = 2;
76:         swapChainDesc.SwapEffect = DXGI_SWAP_EFFECT_FLIP_DISCARD;
78:         HRESULT hr;
80:         if (m_isTransparent)
81:         {
82:             // ── JALUR DCOMP (KHUSUS WINDOW TRANSPARAN / VFX) ──
83:             swapChainDesc.AlphaMode = DXGI_ALPHA_MODE_PREMULTIPLIED;
85:             // DirectX MENGHARUSKAN SwapChain komposisi untuk transparansi
86:             hr = dxgiFactory->CreateSwapChainForComposition(
87:                 device, &swapChainDesc, nullptr, &m_swapChain
88:             );
89:             if (FAILED(hr)) return false;
91:             // Setup DirectComposition
92:             hr = DCompositionCreateDevice(dxgiDevice.Get(), IID_PPV_ARGS(&m_dcompDevice));
93:             if (FAILED(hr)) return false;
95:             hr = m_dcompDevice->CreateTargetForHwnd(hwnd, true, &m_dcompTarget);
96:             if (FAILED(hr)) return false;
98:             hr = m_dcompDevice->CreateVisual(&m_dcompVisual);
99:             if (FAILED(hr)) return false;
101:             hr = m_dcompVisual->SetContent(m_swapChain.Get());
102:             if (FAILED(hr)) return false;
104:             hr = m_dcompTarget->SetRoot(m_dcompVisual.Get());
105:             if (FAILED(hr)) return false;
107:             hr = m_dcompDevice->Commit();
108:             if (FAILED(hr)) return false;
109:         }
110:         else
111:         {
112:             // ── JALUR NORMAL (KHUSUS MAIN WINDOW) ──
113:             swapChainDesc.AlphaMode = DXGI_ALPHA_MODE_UNSPECIFIED;
115:             hr = dxgiFactory->CreateSwapChainForHwnd(
116:                 device, hwnd, &swapChainDesc, nullptr, nullptr, &m_swapChain
117:             );
118:             if (FAILED(hr)) return false;
119:         }
121:         // Render Target View
122:         Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID3D11Texture2D> backBuffer;
123:         m_swapChain->GetBuffer(0, IID_PPV_ARGS(&backBuffer));
124:         device->CreateRenderTargetView(backBuffer.Get(), nullptr, &m_renderTargetView);
126:         // Depth Stencil
127:         D3D11_TEXTURE2D_DESC depthDesc = {};
128:         depthDesc.Width = m_width;
129:         depthDesc.Height = m_height;
130:         depthDesc.MipLevels = 1;
131:         depthDesc.ArraySize = 1;
132:         depthDesc.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_D24_UNORM_S8_UINT;
133:         depthDesc.SampleDesc.Count = 1;
134:         depthDesc.Usage = D3D11_USAGE_DEFAULT;
135:         depthDesc.BindFlags = D3D11_BIND_DEPTH_STENCIL;
137:         Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID3D11Texture2D> depthStencil;
138:         device->CreateTexture2D(&depthDesc, nullptr, &depthStencil);
139:         device->CreateDepthStencilView(depthStencil.Get(), nullptr, &m_depthStencilView);
141:         return true;
142:     }
144:     void Window::BeginRender(float r, float g, float b, float a)
145:     {
146:         auto context = Graphics::Instance().GetDeviceContext();
148:         // Kunci Transparansi: Kalikan warna dengan alpha (Premultiplied Alpha)
149:         float clearColor[4] = { r, g, b, a };
150:         if (m_isTransparent) {
151:             clearColor[0] *= a;
152:             clearColor[1] *= a;
153:             clearColor[2] *= a;
154:         }
156:         context->ClearRenderTargetView(m_renderTargetView.Get(), clearColor);
158:         if (m_depthStencilView) {
159:             context->ClearDepthStencilView(m_depthStencilView.Get(), D3D11_CLEAR_DEPTH | D3D11_CLEAR_STENCIL, 1.0f, 0);
160:         }
162:         context->OMSetRenderTargets(1, m_renderTargetView.GetAddressOf(), m_depthStencilView.Get());
164:         D3D11_VIEWPORT vp = {};
165:         vp.Width = (float)m_width;
166:         vp.Height = (float)m_height;
167:         vp.MinDepth = 0.0f;
168:         vp.MaxDepth = 1.0f;
169:         context->RSSetViewports(1, &vp);
170:     }
172:     void Window::EndRender(int syncInterval)
173:     {
174:         if (m_swapChain) {
175:             m_swapChain->Present(syncInterval, 0);
176:         }
177:     }
179:     void Window::Resize(int width, int height)
180:     {
181:         if (width <= 0 || height <= 0 || (width == m_width && height == m_height)) return;
183:         m_width = width;
184:         m_height = height;
186:         if (!m_swapChain) return;
188:         auto context = Graphics::Instance().GetDeviceContext();
189:         context->OMSetRenderTargets(0, nullptr, nullptr);
190:         m_renderTargetView.Reset();
191:         m_depthStencilView.Reset();
193:         // Lepas buffer lama dan ubah ukuran
194:         m_swapChain->ResizeBuffers(2, m_width, m_height, DXGI_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM, 0);
196:         // Buat ulang RTV dan DSV
197:         auto device = Graphics::Instance().GetDevice();
198:         Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID3D11Texture2D> backBuffer;
199:         m_swapChain->GetBuffer(0, IID_PPV_ARGS(&backBuffer));
200:         device->CreateRenderTargetView(backBuffer.Get(), nullptr, &m_renderTargetView);
202:         D3D11_TEXTURE2D_DESC depthDesc = {};
203:         depthDesc.Width = m_width;
204:         depthDesc.Height = m_height;
205:         depthDesc.MipLevels = 1;
206:         depthDesc.ArraySize = 1;
207:         depthDesc.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_D24_UNORM_S8_UINT;
208:         depthDesc.SampleDesc.Count = 1;
209:         depthDesc.Usage = D3D11_USAGE_DEFAULT;
210:         depthDesc.BindFlags = D3D11_BIND_DEPTH_STENCIL;
212:         Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID3D11Texture2D> depthStencil;
213:         device->CreateTexture2D(&depthDesc, nullptr, &depthStencil);
214:         device->CreateDepthStencilView(depthStencil.Get(), nullptr, &m_depthStencilView);
215:     }

225:     void Window::SetDraggable(bool isDraggable)
226:     {
227:         m_isDraggable = isDraggable;
228:         if (!m_sdlWindow) return;
230:         // Why: while a hit-test callback is installed, SDL treats every point the callback
231:         // calls "normal" as client area, so the OS never sees the resize border.
232:         // A non-draggable window therefore runs without a callback (null = OS default).
233:         const bool needsCallback{ isDraggable || m_isUserLocked };
234:         if (!SDL_SetWindowHitTest(m_sdlWindow, needsCallback ? WindowHitTestCallback : nullptr, this))
235:         {
236:             OutputDebugStringA("[BeyondWindow] SDL_SetWindowHitTest failed: ");
237:             OutputDebugStringA(SDL_GetError());
238:             OutputDebugStringA("\n");
239:         }
240:     }
242:     void Window::LockUserMoveAndResize()
243:     {
244:         m_isUserLocked = true;
246:         if (m_sdlWindow && !SDL_SetWindowResizable(m_sdlWindow, false))
247:         {
248:             OutputDebugStringA("[BeyondWindow] SDL_SetWindowResizable failed: ");
249:             OutputDebugStringA(SDL_GetError());
250:             OutputDebugStringA("\n");
251:         }
253:         SetDraggable(false); // re-installs the callback, which now answers "normal" everywhere
254:     }
256:     void Window::SetClickThrough(bool clickThrough)
257:     {
258:         m_isClickThrough = clickThrough;
259:         if (!m_sdlWindow) return;
261:         // Ambil HWND secara rahasia dari properties SDL3
262:         HWND hwnd = (HWND)SDL_GetPointerProperty(SDL_GetWindowProperties(m_sdlWindow), SDL_PROP_WINDOW_WIN32_HWND_POINTER, NULL);
263:         if (hwnd)
264:         {
265:             // Ambil properti Window OS saat ini
266:             LONG_PTR exStyle = GetWindowLongPtr(hwnd, GWL_EXSTYLE);
268:             if (clickThrough) {
269:                 // Tambahkan efek tembus klik ke OS Desktop
270:                 exStyle |= WS_EX_TRANSPARENT | WS_EX_LAYERED;
271:             }
272:             else {
273:                 // Cabut efek tembus klik (normal)
274:                 exStyle &= ~WS_EX_TRANSPARENT;
275:             }
277:             // Terapkan kembali ke OS
278:             SetWindowLongPtr(hwnd, GWL_EXSTYLE, exStyle);
279:         }
280:     }

56: bool DebugHostWindow::HandleEvent(const SDL_Event& event)
57: {
58:     if (!m_isValid) return false;
60:     const bool isWindowEvent{ event.type >= SDL_EVENT_WINDOW_FIRST && event.type <= SDL_EVENT_WINDOW_LAST };
61:     if (isWindowEvent)
62:     {
63:         if (event.window.windowID != m_windowId) return false;
65:         switch (event.type)
66:         {
67:         case SDL_EVENT_WINDOW_CLOSE_REQUESTED:
68:             // Why: destruction is RAII-only; minimizing keeps the tool reachable from the taskbar.
69:             SDL_MinimizeWindow(m_window.GetSDLWindow());
70:             break;
71:         case SDL_EVENT_WINDOW_PIXEL_SIZE_CHANGED:
72:             // Why: the swap chain is sized in pixels, not window coordinates.
73:             m_window.Resize(event.window.data1, event.window.data2);
74:             break;
75:         default:
76:             break;
77:         }
78:         return true;
79:     }
81:     // Why: Main.cpp quits on Escape from any window; keys typed here must not reach it.
82:     const bool isKeyEvent{ event.type == SDL_EVENT_KEY_DOWN || event.type == SDL_EVENT_KEY_UP };
83:     if (isKeyEvent) return event.key.windowID == m_windowId;
85:     return false;
86: }
88: HWND DebugHostWindow::GetHwnd() const
89: {
90:     if (!m_isValid) return nullptr;
92:     return static_cast<HWND>(SDL_GetPointerProperty(
93:         SDL_GetWindowProperties(m_window.GetSDLWindow()),
94:         SDL_PROP_WINDOW_WIN32_HWND_POINTER,
95:         nullptr));
96: }
98: SDL_Window* DebugHostWindow::GetSDLWindow() const
99: {
100:     return m_isValid ? m_window.GetSDLWindow() : nullptr;
101: }
103: bool DebugHostWindow::HasFocus() const
104: {
105:     return m_isValid && ::GetForegroundWindow() == GetHwnd();
106: }

76:         {
77:             registry.closedWindowIds.push_back(windowId);
78:         }
79:     }
81:     // One checkable entry per tab-slot panel of the current scope.
82:     void DrawPanelsMenu(Registry& registry, const char* layoutScope)
83:     {
84:         if (!ImGui::BeginMenu("Panels")) return;
86:         bool hasPanel{ false };
87:         for (const Panel& panel : registry.panels)
88:         {
89:             if (!panel.isAlive || panel.slot != DebugPanelSlot::tab) continue;
90:             hasPanel = true;
92:             const std::string windowId{ MakeWindowId(panel, layoutScope) };
93:             bool isOpen{ IsPanelOpen(registry, windowId) };
95:             ImGui::PushID(static_cast<int>(panel.id)); // two panels may share a title
96:             if (ImGui::MenuItem(panel.title.c_str(), nullptr, &isOpen))
97:             {
98:                 SetPanelOpen(registry, windowId, isOpen);
99:             }
100:             ImGui::PopID();
101:         }
102:         if (!hasPanel) ImGui::TextDisabled("No panels in this scene");
104:         ImGui::EndMenu();
105:     }
107:     // Each open tab-slot panel is one dockable ImGui window; the owner draws contents only.
108:     void DrawPanelWindows(Registry& registry, const char* layoutScope, ImGuiID dockSpaceId)
109:     {
110:         for (const Panel& panel : registry.panels)
111:         {
112:             if (!panel.isAlive || panel.slot != DebugPanelSlot::tab) continue;
114:             const std::string windowId{ MakeWindowId(panel, layoutScope) };
115:             if (!IsPanelOpen(registry, windowId)) continue;
117:             // "Title###id": only the text after ### is the window's identity.
118:             const std::string windowName{ panel.title + "###" + windowId };
120:             // Why FirstUseEver: only a window with no saved layout is put into the
121:             // dockspace; a position the user chose is never overridden.
122:             ImGui::SetNextWindowDockID(dockSpaceId, ImGuiCond_FirstUseEver);
124:             bool isOpen{ true };
125:             // Begin returns false while the window is a hidden dock tab; End is still required.
126:             if (ImGui::Begin(windowName.c_str(), &isOpen))
127:             {
128:                 panel.draw();
129:             }
130:             ImGui::End();
132:             if (!isOpen) SetPanelOpen(registry, windowId, false); // closed with the X button
133:         }
134:     }

227:         // Why before the panel windows: a window can only dock into a dockspace

238:         // Why after End: panel windows are top-level windows, not children of the root.
239:         DrawPanelWindows(registry, layoutScope, dockSpaceId);
240:         registry.isDrawing = false;
241:     }
243:     // Panels unregistered during this frame are erased now that no callback is running.
244:     if (registry.hasDeadPanels)
245:     {
246:         registry.panels.erase(
247:             std::remove_if(registry.panels.begin(), registry.panels.end(),
248:                 [](const Panel& panel) { return !panel.isAlive; }),
249:             registry.panels.end());
250:         registry.hasDeadPanels = false;
251:     }

271:         const float markerWidth{ fontSize * k_markerWidthInEm };
272:         const float rowStartX{ ImGui::GetCursorPosX() };
273:         // Why add scroll back: SameLine() takes an offset from the unscrolled window edge.
274:         const float controlX{ ImGui::GetWindowContentRegionMin().x + ImGui::GetScrollX()

277:         ImGui::AlignTextToFramePadding();

284:                 center, fontSize * k_markerRadiusInEm, ImGui::GetColorU32(k_modifiedColor));
285:         }
286:         ImGui::SetCursorPosX(rowStartX + markerWidth);
288:         // Why clip: a label longer than its column must not run underneath the control.
289:         const ImVec2 labelPos{ ImGui::GetCursorScreenPos() };
290:         const float labelMaxX{ ImGui::GetWindowPos().x - ImGui::GetScrollX() + controlX
291:             - ImGui::GetStyle().ItemSpacing.x };
292:         ImGui::PushClipRect(labelPos, ImVec2{ labelMaxX, labelPos.y + frameHeight }, true);
293:         ImGui::TextUnformatted(label);
294:         ImGui::PopClipRect();
296:         ImGui::SameLine(controlX);
297:         ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(-1.0f);
298:     }

301:     template <typename DrawControl>

303:     {

305:         BeginRow(label, isModified);
306:         const bool isEdited{ drawControl() };
307:         ImGui::PopID();
308:         return isEdited;
309:     }

7: struct SDL_Window;
9: // Remembers where the main window and the debug window were when the game last

24:         SavedRect debugWindow{};

35:     // The same test Load() applies to saved rects.

38:     // Current client-area position and size of `window`. Unset if the window is null,

<file path="Source/Engine/Windowing/WindowLayoutStore.cpp" lines="125">
1: #include "WindowLayoutStore.h"
3: #if defined(_DEBUG)
5: #include <fstream>
6: #include <windows.h>
7: #include <SDL3/SDL.h>
8: #include <json.hpp>
10: namespace
11: {
12:     constexpr const char* k_filePath{ "window_layout.json" };
13:     constexpr const char* k_mainWindowKey{ "main_window" };
14:     constexpr const char* k_debugWindowKey{ "debug_window" };
16:     // Smaller than this is treated as a corrupt entry, not a layout the user chose.
17:     constexpr int k_minWidth{ 200 };
18:     constexpr int k_minHeight{ 150 };
20:     // The rect shrunk by this margin must still touch a monitor, so enough of the
21:     // window is on screen to grab and move it.
22:     constexpr int k_visibleMargin{ 64 };
24:     // True if the rect is large enough and still reachable on the current monitors.
25:     bool IsUsable(const Beyond::PixelRect& rect)
26:     {
27:         if (rect.width < k_minWidth || rect.height < k_minHeight) return false;
29:         const RECT inner{
30:             rect.x + k_visibleMargin,
31:             rect.y + k_visibleMargin,
32:             rect.x + rect.width - k_visibleMargin,
33:             rect.y + rect.height - k_visibleMargin };
34:         return ::MonitorFromRect(&inner, MONITOR_DEFAULTTONULL) != nullptr;
35:     }
37:     // Throws nlohmann::json::exception if the entry exists but is malformed.
38:     WindowLayoutStore::SavedRect ParseRect(const nlohmann::json& root, const char* key)
39:     {
40:         WindowLayoutStore::SavedRect saved{};
41:         if (!root.contains(key)) return saved;
43:         const nlohmann::json& entry{ root.at(key) };
44:         saved.rect.x = entry.at("x").get<int>();
45:         saved.rect.y = entry.at("y").get<int>();
46:         saved.rect.width = entry.at("width").get<int>();
47:         saved.rect.height = entry.at("height").get<int>();
48:         saved.isSet = IsUsable(saved.rect);
49:         return saved;
50:     }
52:     void WriteRect(nlohmann::json& root, const char* key, const WindowLayoutStore::SavedRect& saved)
53:     {
54:         if (!saved.isSet) return;
56:         root[key] = {
57:             { "x", saved.rect.x },
58:             { "y", saved.rect.y },
59:             { "width", saved.rect.width },
60:             { "height", saved.rect.height } };
61:     }
62: }
64: namespace WindowLayoutStore
65: {
66:     bool IsOnScreen(const Beyond::PixelRect& rect)
67:     {
68:         return IsUsable(rect);
69:     }
71:     Layout Load()
72:     {
73:         std::ifstream file{ k_filePath };
74:         if (!file) return {}; // first run: nothing saved yet
76:         try
77:         {
78:             const nlohmann::json root = nlohmann::json::parse(file);
80:             Layout layout{};
81:             layout.mainWindow = ParseRect(root, k_mainWindowKey);
82:             layout.debugWindow = ParseRect(root, k_debugWindowKey);
83:             return layout;
84:         }
85:         catch (const nlohmann::json::exception& e)
86:         {
87:             OutputDebugStringA("[WindowLayoutStore] window_layout.json ignored: ");
88:             OutputDebugStringA(e.what());
89:             OutputDebugStringA("\n");
90:             return {};
91:         }
92:     }
94:     void Save(const Layout& layout)
95:     {
96:         nlohmann::json root = nlohmann::json::object();
97:         WriteRect(root, k_mainWindowKey, layout.mainWindow);
98:         WriteRect(root, k_debugWindowKey, layout.debugWindow);
100:         std::ofstream file{ k_filePath };
101:         if (!file)
102:         {
103:             OutputDebugStringA("[WindowLayoutStore] Could not write window_layout.json.\n");
104:             return;
105:         }
106:         file << root.dump(4);
107:     }
109:     SavedRect ReadWindowRect(SDL_Window* window)
110:     {
111:         SavedRect saved{};
112:         if (!window) return saved;
114:         // Why: a minimized window reports a position and size that are not its real layout.
115:         if ((SDL_GetWindowFlags(window) & SDL_WINDOW_MINIMIZED) != 0) return saved;
117:         if (!SDL_GetWindowPosition(window, &saved.rect.x, &saved.rect.y)) return saved;
118:         if (!SDL_GetWindowSize(window, &saved.rect.width, &saved.rect.height)) return saved;
120:         saved.isSet = true;
121:         return saved;
122:     }
123: }
125: #endif // _DEBUG

38: void WindowManager::EnforceWindowPriorities()
39: {
40:     // 1. Kumpulkan semua window yang valid
41:     std::vector<Beyond::Window*> sortedWindows;
42:     sortedWindows.reserve(windows.size());
44:     for (auto& win : windows)
45:     {
46:         if (win.get() != debugWindow && win->GetPriority() < 100)
47:         {
48:             sortedWindows.push_back(win.get());
49:         }
50:     }
52:     // 2. Urutkan berdasarkan prioritas (Ascending / Terendah dulu)
53:     std::sort(sortedWindows.begin(), sortedWindows.end(),
54:         [](Beyond::Window* a, Beyond::Window* b) {
55:             return a->GetPriority() < b->GetPriority();
56:         });
58:     // =========================================================
59:     // [PENGGANTI WIN32] Gunakan SDL3 untuk mengatur Z-Order
60:     // Kita menaikkan (Raise) window dari prioritas terendah ke tertinggi
61:     // sehingga yang tertinggi akan menumpuk di paling depan.
62:     // =========================================================
63:     for (Beyond::Window* win : sortedWindows)
64:     {
65:         if (win->GetSDLWindow())
66:         {
67:             SDL_RaiseWindow(win->GetSDLWindow());
68:         }
69:     }
70: }
72: void WindowManager::RenderAll(float dt, Scene* scene, const GameCanvas* canvas)
73: {
74:     auto context = Graphics::Instance().GetDeviceContext();
76:     for (auto& win : windows)
77:     {
78:         if (!win->GetSDLWindow()) continue;
80:         const bool isMainWindow{ win.get() == windows.front().get() };
81:         const bool usesCanvas{ isMainWindow && canvas != nullptr };
83:         // Canvas pass comes first: the scene draws at canvas size before the
84:         // window's own render target is bound.
85:         if (usesCanvas)
86:         {
87:             canvas->Begin(context);
88:             if (scene) scene->Render(dt, win->GetCamera());
89:         }
91:         // Ambil Alpha dan mulai render
92:         float bgAlpha = win->GetBackgroundAlpha();
94:         // Why only with the canvas: there the clear colour shows only as the letterbox.
95:         // Without it the scene draws straight onto this target and expects black.
96:         const float clearGray{ usesCanvas ? k_letterboxGray : 0.0f };
97:         win->BeginRender(clearGray, clearGray, clearGray, bgAlpha);
99:         // Jika ini Main Window (Index 0)
100:         if (isMainWindow)
101:         {
102:             if (usesCanvas)
103:             {
104:                 // Largest canvas-shaped rect centered in the window; the cleared
105:                 // black area around it is the letterbox.
106:                 const Beyond::PixelRect windowRect{ 0, 0, win->GetWidth(), win->GetHeight() };
107:                 canvas->Blit(context, Beyond::FitRect(windowRect,
108:                     Beyond::Config::CANVAS_WIDTH, Beyond::Config::CANVAS_HEIGHT));
110:                 // Why: Blit leaves the viewport on the fitted rect; anything drawn
111:                 // after it (ImGui in Release) addresses the whole window.
112:                 D3D11_VIEWPORT windowViewport{};
113:                 windowViewport.Width = static_cast<float>(win->GetWidth());
114:                 windowViewport.Height = static_cast<float>(win->GetHeight());
115:                 windowViewport.MaxDepth = 1.0f;
116:                 context->RSSetViewports(1, &windowViewport);
117:             }
118:             else if (scene)
119:             {
120:                 scene->Render(dt, win->GetCamera());
121:             }
123:             if (m_imguiOnMainWindow) {
124:                 ImGuiRenderer::Render(Graphics::Instance().GetDeviceContext());
125:             }
126:         }        // Jika ini Sub Window (Windowkill, dsb)
127:         else
128:         {
129:             if (scene && win->ShouldRenderScene()) {
130:                 scene->Render(dt, win->GetCamera());
131:             }
132:         }
134:         win->EndRender(k_presentSyncInterval);
135:     }
136: }

140: {
141:     for (auto& win : windows)
142:     {
143:         if (win->GetSDLWindow() == sdlWindow)
144:         {
145:             win->Resize(width, height);
146:             return;
147:         }
148:     }
149: }

1: #include "WindowPool.h"
2: #include <SDL3/SDL.h>
4: namespace Beyond
5: {
6:     bool WindowPool::Acquire(
7:         WindowTrackingSystem& trackingSystem,
8:         const TrackedWindowConfig& config,
9:         std::function<DirectX::XMFLOAT3()> getTargetPos,
10:         std::function<DirectX::XMFLOAT2()> getTargetSize
11:     )
12:     {
13:         if (m_pool.empty())
14:         {
15:             return false; // Pool kosong, beri tahu pemanggil untuk membuat baru
16:         }
18:         // Ambil satu dari gudang
19:         auto recycled = std::move(m_pool.back());
20:         m_pool.pop_back();
22:         // Reset data
23:         recycled->name = config.name;
24:         recycled->trackingOffset = config.trackingOffset;
25:         recycled->getTargetPositionFunc = getTargetPos;
26:         recycled->getTargetSizeFunc = getTargetSize;

31:             if (config.fpsLimit > 0.0f)
32:             {
33:                 recycled->window->SetTargetFPS(config.fpsLimit);
34:             }
36:             // Tampilkan kembali
37:             SDL_ShowWindow(recycled->window->GetSDLWindow());
38:         }
40:         // Masukkan kembali ke sistem tracking agar mulai dihitung posisinya
41:         trackingSystem.RestoreFromPool(std::move(recycled));
43:         return true;
44:     }
46:     void WindowPool::Release(WindowTrackingSystem& trackingSystem, const std::string& name)
47:     {
48:         // Minta tracking system untuk melepaskan kepemilikan window ini

51:         if (extractedWindow)

54:             {
55:                 // Sembunyikan window
56:                 SDL_HideWindow(extractedWindow->window->GetSDLWindow());
57:             }
59:             // Masukkan ke gudang
60:             m_pool.push_back(std::move(extractedWindow));
61:         }
62:     }

13:     // Desktop rect the arena maps onto: the same rect WindowTrackingSystem places its

16:     {

20:         {

62: // [TAMBAH] Implementasi Update yang hilang
63: void WindowShatter::Update(float dt)
64: {
65:     if (m_markedForDestroy) return;
67:     if (m_isSleeping && m_isNativeWindow) return;
69:     m_timeAlive += dt;
71:     if (!m_isNativeWindow)
72:     {
73:         UpdateVirtualState(dt);
74:     }
75:     else
76:     {
77:         UpdateNativeState(dt);
78:     }

81: void WindowShatter::UpdateVirtualState(float dt)
82: {
83:     float worldSpeedX = m_physics.velocity.x / PIXEL_TO_UNIT_RATIO;
84:     float worldSpeedZ = m_physics.velocity.y / PIXEL_TO_UNIT_RATIO;
86:     m_virtualWorldPos.x += worldSpeedX * dt;
87:     m_virtualWorldPos.z += worldSpeedZ * dt;
89:     if (m_timeAlive > 0.05f)
90:     {
91:         TransitionToNativeWindow();
92:     }
93: }
95: void WindowShatter::UpdateNativeState(float dt)
96: {
97:     if (!m_window) return;
99:     m_physics.velocity.x *= m_physics.deceleration;
100:     m_physics.velocity.y *= m_physics.deceleration;
102:     try {
103:         // [WRAPPED] Protect SDL calls
104:         const float desktopScale{ GetDesktopScale(GetArenaRect()) };
106:         int curX, curY;
107:         SDL_GetWindowPosition(m_window->GetSDLWindow(), &curX, &curY);
109:         int nextX = static_cast<int>(roundf(curX + m_physics.velocity.x * desktopScale * dt));
110:         int nextY = static_cast<int>(roundf(curY + m_physics.velocity.y * desktopScale * dt));
112:         if (nextX != curX || nextY != curY)
113:         {
114:             SDL_SetWindowPosition(m_window->GetSDLWindow(), nextX, nextY);
115:         }
117:         float shrinkAmount = m_shrinkRate * dt;
118:         m_width -= shrinkAmount;
119:         m_height -= shrinkAmount;
121:         if (m_width < 10.0f) m_width = 10.0f;
122:         if (m_height < 10.0f) m_height = 10.0f;
124:         SDL_SetWindowSize(m_window->GetSDLWindow(),
125:             static_cast<int>(m_width * desktopScale), static_cast<int>(m_height * desktopScale));
127:         int realW, realH;
128:         SDL_GetWindowSize(m_window->GetSDLWindow(), &realW, &realH);
129:         m_window->Resize(realW, realH);
131:         if (m_width <= 100.0f)
132:         {
133:             m_markedForDestroy = true;
134:         }
136:         EnforceScreenBounds();
137:     }
138:     catch (...) {
139:         // [FAILSAFE] Mark for destruction if SDL fails
140:         m_markedForDestroy = true;
141:     }
142: }
144: // [TAMBAH] Implementasi TransitionToNativeWindow yang hilang
145: void WindowShatter::TransitionToNativeWindow()
146: {
147:     float screenX, screenY;
148:     ConvertWorldToScreen(m_virtualWorldPos, screenX, screenY);
150:     const float desktopScale{ GetDesktopScale(GetArenaRect()) };
151:     const float desktopWidth{ m_width * desktopScale };
152:     const float desktopHeight{ m_height * desktopScale };
154:     m_window = WindowManager::Instance().CreateGameWindow(m_title.c_str(), (int)desktopWidth, (int)desktopHeight);
156:     if (m_window)
157:     {
159:         if (m_isSleeping) {
160:             SDL_HideWindow(m_window->GetSDLWindow());
161:         }
163:         m_window->SetPriority(-1);
164:         m_window->SetAlwaysOnTop(true);
166:         // Border Aktif
167:         SDL_SetWindowBordered(m_window->GetSDLWindow(), true);
169:         int finalX = (int)(screenX - (desktopWidth * 0.5f));
170:         int finalY = (int)(screenY - (desktopHeight * 0.5f));
172:         SDL_SetWindowPosition(m_window->GetSDLWindow(), finalX, finalY);
174:         m_camera = std::make_shared<Camera>();
175:         m_camera->SetRotation(90.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
176:         m_window->SetCamera(m_camera.get());
178:         m_isNativeWindow = true;
179:     }
180:     else
181:     {
182:         m_markedForDestroy = true;
183:     }
184: }
186: void WindowShatter::WakeUp()
187: {
188:     m_isSleeping = false;
189:     if (m_window) {
190:         // Why re-placed here: the window was created hidden seconds ago, and the arena
191:         // rect may have moved or changed size since (main window dragged or resized).
192:         float screenX, screenY;

195:         const float desktopScale{ GetDesktopScale(GetArenaRect()) };
196:         const float desktopWidth{ m_width * desktopScale };

199:         SDL_SetWindowSize(m_window->GetSDLWindow(), (int)desktopWidth, (int)desktopHeight);
200:         SDL_SetWindowPosition(m_window->GetSDLWindow(),
201:             (int)(screenX - (desktopWidth * 0.5f)), (int)(screenY - (desktopHeight * 0.5f)));
203:         SDL_ShowWindow(m_window->GetSDLWindow());
204:     }
205: }

227: void WindowShatter::EnforceScreenBounds()
228: {
229:     if (!m_window) return;
230:     int x, y;
231:     SDL_GetWindowPosition(m_window->GetSDLWindow(), &x, &y);
233:     // Ambil ukuran FISIK real (karena mungkin beda sama m_width logika)
234:     int realW, realH;
235:     SDL_GetWindowSize(m_window->GetSDLWindow(), &realW, &realH);
237:     bool bounced = false;
239:     // Shards bounce off the edges of the arena rect, like every other sub-window.
240:     const Beyond::PixelRect arena{ GetArenaRect() };
241:     const int left{ arena.x };
242:     const int top{ arena.y };
243:     const int right{ arena.x + arena.width };
244:     const int bottom{ arena.y + arena.height };
246:     if (x <= left) { x = left; m_physics.velocity.x *= -m_physics.bounceDamping; bounced = true; }
247:     else if (x + realW >= right) { x = right - realW; m_physics.velocity.x *= -m_physics.bounceDamping; bounced = true; }
249:     if (y <= top) { y = top; m_physics.velocity.y *= -m_physics.bounceDamping; bounced = true; }
250:     else if (y + realH >= bottom) { y = bottom - realH; m_physics.velocity.y *= -m_physics.bounceDamping; bounced = true; }
252:     if (bounced) {
253:         SDL_SetWindowPosition(m_window->GetSDLWindow(), x, y);
254:         m_physics.bounceCount++;
255:     }
256: }
258: void WindowShatter::ConvertWorldToScreen(const DirectX::XMFLOAT3& worldPos, float& outX, float& outY) const
259: {
260:     // Same mapping as WindowTrackingSystem::WorldToScreenPos: world origin at the
261:     // centre of the arena rect.
262:     const Beyond::PixelRect arena{ GetArenaRect() };
263:     const float desktopPixelsPerUnit{ PIXEL_TO_UNIT_RATIO * GetDesktopScale(arena) };
265:     outX = static_cast<float>(arena.x) + (static_cast<float>(arena.width) * 0.5f) + (worldPos.x * desktopPixelsPerUnit);
266:     outY = static_cast<float>(arena.y) + (static_cast<float>(arena.height) * 0.5f) - (worldPos.z * desktopPixelsPerUnit);
267: }

270: // MANAGER IMPLEMENTATION
271: // =========================================================

274: {
275:     for (int i = 0; i < count; ++i)
276:     {
277:         SpawnSingleInstance(centerWorldPos, i, count);
278:     }
279: }
281: void WindowShatterManager::Update(float dt)
282: {
283:     // 1. Update semua shatter
284:     for (auto& shatter : m_shatters)
285:     {
286:         shatter->Update(dt);
287:     }
289:     // 2. [BARU] Cleanup window SEBELUM erase
290:     for (auto& shatter : m_shatters)
291:     {
292:         if (shatter->ShouldDestroy())
293:         {
294:             shatter->Cleanup(); // Safe cleanup window dulu
295:         }
296:     }
298:     // 3. Baru hapus dari container (safe karena window sudah di-cleanup)
299:     m_shatters.erase(
300:         std::remove_if(m_shatters.begin(), m_shatters.end(),
301:             [](const std::unique_ptr<WindowShatter>& s) {
302:                 return s->IsPreppedForDestroy();
303:             }),
304:         m_shatters.end()
305:     );
306: }
308: void WindowShatterManager::SpawnSingleInstance(DirectX::XMFLOAT2 centerPos, int index, int totalCount)
309: {
310:     static std::mt19937 gen(std::random_device{}());
312:     // 1. Angle & Speed
313:     float angleStep = 360.0f / totalCount;
314:     std::uniform_real_distribution<float> jitterAngle(-10.0f, 10.0f);
315:     float angleRad = DirectX::XMConvertToRadians((index * angleStep) + jitterAngle(gen));
317:     // Speed kencang (800-1200)
318:     std::uniform_real_distribution<float> speedDist(4000.0f, 5000.0f);
319:     float speed = speedDist(gen);
320:     DirectX::XMFLOAT2 velocity = { cosf(angleRad) * speed, sinf(angleRad) * speed };
322:     // 2. Position Offset
323:     std::uniform_real_distribution<float> offsetDist(-2.0f, 2.0f);
324:     DirectX::XMFLOAT2 spawnPos = { centerPos.x + offsetDist(gen), centerPos.y + offsetDist(gen) };
326:     // 3. Size (Agak besar supaya kelihatan mengecilnya)
327:     int size = static_cast<int>(std::uniform_real_distribution<float>(200.0f, 400.0f)(gen));
329:     // 4. Unique Name
330:     char title[64];
331:     sprintf_s(title, "Shatter_%u_%d", SDL_GetTicks(), index);
333:     m_shatters.push_back(std::make_unique<WindowShatter>(title, spawnPos, velocity, size, 1));
334: }
336: void WindowShatterManager::Clear()
337: {
338:     m_shatters.clear();
339: }

5: WindowSwarmRenderer::WindowSwarmRenderer(ID3D11Device* device)
6: {
7:     // 1. INPUT LAYOUT (Gabungan Data Vertex & Data Instance)
8:     D3D11_INPUT_ELEMENT_DESC layout[] =
9:     {
10:         // --- SLOT 0: Data Vertex Statis (Per-Vertex) ---
11:         { "POSITION", 0, DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32B32_FLOAT, 0, 0, D3D11_INPUT_PER_VERTEX_DATA, 0 },
12:         { "TEXCOORD", 0, DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32_FLOAT,    0, D3D11_APPEND_ALIGNED_ELEMENT, D3D11_INPUT_PER_VERTEX_DATA, 0 },
14:         // --- SLOT 1: Data Instance Dinamis (Per-Instance) ---
15:         // PENTING: Perhatikan angka '1' di parameter dan flag D3D11_INPUT_PER_INSTANCE_DATA!
16:         { "INST_POS",  0, DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32B32_FLOAT,    1, 0, D3D11_INPUT_PER_INSTANCE_DATA, 1 },
17:         { "INST_SIZE", 0, DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32_FLOAT,       1, D3D11_APPEND_ALIGNED_ELEMENT, D3D11_INPUT_PER_INSTANCE_DATA, 1 },
18:         { "INST_COL",  0, DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32B32A32_FLOAT, 1, D3D11_APPEND_ALIGNED_ELEMENT, D3D11_INPUT_PER_INSTANCE_DATA, 1 },
19:     };
21:     // Load Shaders (Pastikan path file .cso kamu benar!)
22:     GpuResourceUtils::LoadVertexShader(device, "Data/Shader/SwarmVS.cso", layout, ARRAYSIZE(layout), inputLayout.GetAddressOf(), vertexShader.GetAddressOf());
23:     GpuResourceUtils::LoadPixelShader(device, "Data/Shader/SwarmPS.cso", pixelShader.GetAddressOf());
24:     GpuResourceUtils::CreateConstantBuffer(device, sizeof(CbScene), constantBuffer.GetAddressOf());
26:     // 2. CREATE VERTEX BUFFER (Bentuk Kotak - Dibuat mengelilingi titik tengah 0,0)
27:     QuadVertex quad[4] = {
28:         { {-0.5f,  0.5f, 0.0f}, {0.0f, 0.0f} }, // Kiri Atas
29:         { { 0.5f,  0.5f, 0.0f}, {1.0f, 0.0f} }, // Kanan Atas
30:         { {-0.5f, -0.5f, 0.0f}, {0.0f, 1.0f} }, // Kiri Bawah
31:         { { 0.5f, -0.5f, 0.0f}, {1.0f, 1.0f} }  // Kanan Bawah
32:     };
34:     D3D11_BUFFER_DESC vbDesc = {};
35:     vbDesc.ByteWidth = sizeof(QuadVertex) * 4;
36:     vbDesc.Usage = D3D11_USAGE_IMMUTABLE; // Tidak akan pernah berubah
37:     vbDesc.BindFlags = D3D11_BIND_VERTEX_BUFFER;
38:     D3D11_SUBRESOURCE_DATA vbData = { quad, 0, 0 };
39:     device->CreateBuffer(&vbDesc, &vbData, vertexBuffer.GetAddressOf());
41:     // 3. CREATE INSTANCE BUFFER
42:     D3D11_BUFFER_DESC ibDesc = {};
43:     ibDesc.ByteWidth = sizeof(InstanceData) * MaxInstances;
44:     ibDesc.Usage = D3D11_USAGE_DYNAMIC;           // Bisa di-update tiap frame
45:     ibDesc.BindFlags = D3D11_BIND_VERTEX_BUFFER;  // Secara teknis ini diperlakukan seperti Vertex Buffer
46:     ibDesc.CPUAccessFlags = D3D11_CPU_ACCESS_WRITE;
47:     device->CreateBuffer(&ibDesc, nullptr, instanceBuffer.GetAddressOf());
49:     instances.reserve(MaxInstances);
50: }
52: void WindowSwarmRenderer::Begin()
53: {
54:     instances.clear(); // Bersihkan antrean dari frame sebelumnya
55: }
57: void WindowSwarmRenderer::AddWindow(const DirectX::XMFLOAT3& pos, const DirectX::XMFLOAT2& size, const DirectX::XMFLOAT4& color)
58: {
59:     if (instances.size() < MaxInstances)
60:     {
61:         instances.push_back({ pos, size, color });
62:     }
63: }
65: void WindowSwarmRenderer::Render(ID3D11DeviceContext* dc, const DirectX::XMFLOAT4X4& viewProj, ID3D11ShaderResourceView* textureSRV)
66: {
67:     if (instances.empty() || !textureSRV) return;
69:     // 1. Update Constant Buffer (Matriks Kamera)
70:     CbScene cb = { viewProj };
71:     dc->UpdateSubresource(constantBuffer.Get(), 0, 0, &cb, 0, 0);
73:     // 2. Update Instance Buffer (Map -> memcpy -> Unmap)
74:     // D3D11_MAP_WRITE_DISCARD memastikan CPU tidak stall menunggu GPU selesai merender frame sebelumnya.
75:     D3D11_MAPPED_SUBRESOURCE mapped;
76:     if (SUCCEEDED(dc->Map(instanceBuffer.Get(), 0, D3D11_MAP_WRITE_DISCARD, 0, &mapped)))
77:     {
78:         memcpy(mapped.pData, instances.data(), instances.size() * sizeof(InstanceData));
79:         dc->Unmap(instanceBuffer.Get(), 0);
80:     }
82:     // 3. Bind State ke Pipeline
83:     dc->VSSetShader(vertexShader.Get(), nullptr, 0);
84:     dc->PSSetShader(pixelShader.Get(), nullptr, 0);
85:     dc->IASetInputLayout(inputLayout.Get());
86:     dc->VSSetConstantBuffers(0, 1, constantBuffer.GetAddressOf());
87:     dc->PSSetShaderResources(0, 1, &textureSRV);
89:     // 4. BIND 2 BUFFER SEKALIGUS! (Ini rahasia Instancing)
90:     ID3D11Buffer* buffers[2] = { vertexBuffer.Get(), instanceBuffer.Get() };
91:     UINT strides[2] = { sizeof(QuadVertex), sizeof(InstanceData) };
92:     UINT offsets[2] = { 0, 0 };
94:     dc->IASetPrimitiveTopology(D3D11_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY_TRIANGLESTRIP);
95:     dc->IASetVertexBuffers(0, 2, buffers, strides, offsets);
97:     // 5. EKSEKUSI! (Gambar 4 titik, tapi diulang otomatis oleh GPU sebanyak jumlah instance)
98:     dc->DrawInstanced(4, static_cast<UINT>(instances.size()), 0, 0);
99: }

52: bool WindowTrackingSystem::AddTrackedWindow(

54:     std::function<DirectX::XMFLOAT3()> getTargetPos,
55:     std::function<DirectX::XMFLOAT2()> getTargetSize // Parameter baru
56: )
57: {
58:     auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
60:     // =========================================================

74:             tw->state.targetH = (float)config.height;

76:             tw->state.actualH = ToDesktopPixels(tw->state.targetH);

79:                 SDL_Window* sdlWin = tw->window->GetSDLWindow();
80:                 SDL_SetWindowTitle(sdlWin, config.title.c_str());
81:                 SDL_SetWindowSize(sdlWin, tw->state.actualW, tw->state.actualH);
82:                 tw->window->SetBackgroundAlpha(config.isTransparent ? 0.0f : 1.0f);
83:                 tw->window->SetPriority(config.priority);
84:                 tw->window->SetAlwaysOnTop(config.isAlwaysOnTop);
86:                 if (config.fpsLimit > 0.0f) tw->window->SetTargetFPS(config.fpsLimit);
87:                 tw->window->LockUserMoveAndResize();
89:                 // Set Posisi Awal agar tidak nge-blink dari koordinat -10000
90:                 if (getTargetPos) {
91:                     DirectX::XMFLOAT3 initialPos = getTargetPos();
92:                     float screenX, screenY;
93:                     WorldToScreenPos(initialPos, screenX, screenY);

95:                     tw->state.targetY = screenY - (tw->state.actualH * 0.5f);
96:                     tw->state.actualX = static_cast<int>(roundf(tw->state.targetX));
97:                     tw->state.actualY = static_cast<int>(roundf(tw->state.targetY));
98:                     SDL_SetWindowPosition(sdlWin, tw->state.actualX, tw->state.actualY);
99:                 }
101:                 SDL_ShowWindow(sdlWin); // Bangunkan window!
102:             }
104:             m_windowLookup[config.name] = tw.get(); // Masukkan kembali ke lookup
105:             WindowManager::Instance().MarkPriorityDirty();
107:             auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
108:             std::chrono::duration<float, std::milli> duration = end - start;
109:             PerformanceLogger::Instance().LogWindowAction("Pooled", config.name, duration.count());

131:     WindowManager::Instance().MarkPriorityDirty();
133:     if (config.fpsLimit > 0.0f)

135:         window->SetTargetFPS(config.fpsLimit);

147:     tracked->name = config.name;

182:     PerformanceLogger::Instance().LogWindowAction("Spawned", config.name, duration.count());
184:     return true;

194: void WindowTrackingSystem::Update(float dt)
195: {
196:     for (auto& tracked : m_trackedWindows)
197:     {
198:         if (!tracked->isActive) continue;
199:         UpdateSingleWindow(dt, *tracked);
200:     }
201: }
203: void WindowTrackingSystem::UpdateSingleWindow(float dt, TrackedWindow& tracked)
204: {
205:     if (!tracked.window || !tracked.camera || !tracked.getTargetPositionFunc)
206:         return;
208:     // 1. AMBIL POSISI OS SAAT INI (Kunci Anti-Ghosting / DWM Lag)
209:     int osX, osY, osW, osH;
210:     SDL_GetWindowPosition(tracked.window->GetSDLWindow(), &osX, &osY);
211:     SDL_GetWindowSize(tracked.window->GetSDLWindow(), &osW, &osH);
213:     bool isBeingDragged = false;
214:     if (osW != tracked.state.actualW || osH != tracked.state.actualH)
215:     {
216:         tracked.state.actualW = osW;
217:         tracked.state.actualH = osH;
218:         // Update target juga agar tidak snap balik. Target is kept in canvas pixels.
219:         tracked.state.targetW = (float)osW / m_desktopScale;
220:         tracked.state.targetH = (float)osH / m_desktopScale;
221:     }
223:     // 2. UPDATE SIZE
224:     // Why not the main window: its size belongs to the user and the engine.
225:     if (tracked.role != WindowRole::MAIN_VIEWPORT)
226:     {
227:         if (tracked.getTargetSizeFunc)
228:         {
229:             DirectX::XMFLOAT2 desiredSize = tracked.getTargetSizeFunc(); // canvas pixels
230:             float tSize = min(m_followSpeed * dt, 1.0f);
231:             tracked.state.targetW += (desiredSize.x - tracked.state.targetW) * tSize;
232:             tracked.state.targetH += (desiredSize.y - tracked.state.targetH) * tSize;
233:         }
235:         // Applied every frame, also without a size function, so a window follows
236:         // the arena rect when the game image is resized on the desktop.
237:         const int newW{ ToDesktopPixels(tracked.state.targetW) };
238:         const int newH{ ToDesktopPixels(tracked.state.targetH) };
239:         if (newW != osW || newH != osH)
240:         {
241:             SDL_SetWindowSize(tracked.window->GetSDLWindow(), newW, newH);
242:             tracked.state.actualW = newW;
243:             tracked.state.actualH = newH;
244:         }
245:     }
247:     // 3. UPDATE POSITION LOGIC
248:     // Every sub-window is placed against the current arena rect, so it follows when
249:     // that rect moves (window dragged in Act 2, or the switch to the monitor rect on
250:     // entering Windowkill). Only the main window is left where the user put it.
251:     if (!isBeingDragged && tracked.role != WindowRole::MAIN_VIEWPORT)
252:     {
253:         DirectX::XMFLOAT3 targetWorldPos = tracked.getTargetPositionFunc();
254:         targetWorldPos.x += tracked.trackingOffset.x;
255:         targetWorldPos.y += tracked.trackingOffset.y;
256:         targetWorldPos.z += tracked.trackingOffset.z;
258:         float targetScreenX, targetScreenY;
259:         WorldToScreenPos(targetWorldPos, targetScreenX, targetScreenY);
261:         float destX = targetScreenX - (tracked.state.actualW * 0.5f);
262:         float destY = targetScreenY - (tracked.state.actualH * 0.5f);
264:         float tPos = min(m_followSpeed * dt, 1.0f);
265:         tracked.state.targetX += (destX - tracked.state.targetX) * tPos;
266:         tracked.state.targetY += (destY - tracked.state.targetY) * tPos;
268:         int newX = static_cast<int>(roundf(tracked.state.targetX));
269:         int newY = static_cast<int>(roundf(tracked.state.targetY));
271:         // =========================================================
272:         // [FIX MUTLAK] OS WINDOW SHAKE (GETARAN FISIK JENDELA)
273:         // =========================================================
274:         float trauma = CameraController::Instance().GetTrauma();
276:         // Why entities only: viewport windows (FX overlay, click blocker) span the whole
277:         // play field, and their image already shakes through the camera.
278:         const bool shakesWithCamera{ tracked.role == WindowRole::TRACKED_ENTITY };
280:         if (shakesWithCamera && trauma > 0.01f) {
281:             float shakeIntensity = trauma * trauma; // Pangkat 2 untuk natural falloff
282:             float maxShakePixels = 35.0f; // Jarak loncatan maksimal jendela di monitor!
284:             // RNG dari -1.0 sampai 1.0
285:             float randX = ((rand() % 200) / 100.0f) - 1.0f;
286:             float randY = ((rand() % 200) / 100.0f) - 1.0f;
288:             int shakeOffsetX = static_cast<int>(randX * shakeIntensity * maxShakePixels);
289:             int shakeOffsetY = static_cast<int>(randY * shakeIntensity * maxShakePixels);
291:             // Terapkan getaran langsung ke OS Windows!
292:             SDL_SetWindowPosition(tracked.window->GetSDLWindow(), newX + shakeOffsetX, newY + shakeOffsetY);
294:             // PENTING: Biarkan actualX/Y memegang koordinat 'newX' aslinya.
295:             // Ini menjamin saat getaran selesai, jendela langsung snap-back ke jalur aslinya!
296:             tracked.state.actualX = newX;
297:             tracked.state.actualY = newY;
298:         }
299:         else {
300:             // --- LOGIKA NORMAL GUARD (Tanpa Getaran) ---
301:             float deltaX = fabsf(tracked.state.targetX - tracked.state.actualX);
302:             float deltaY = fabsf(tracked.state.targetY - tracked.state.actualY);
304:             if ((newX != tracked.state.actualX || newY != tracked.state.actualY)
305:                 && (deltaX >= 0.5f || deltaY >= 0.5f))
306:             {
307:                 SDL_SetWindowPosition(tracked.window->GetSDLWindow(), newX, newY);
308:                 tracked.state.actualX = newX;
309:                 tracked.state.actualY = newY;
310:             }
311:         }
312:     }
314:     if (tracked.role == WindowRole::MAIN_VIEWPORT)
315:     {
316:         // The main window shows the whole arena through the game canvas, wherever the
317:         // OS window sits and whatever its size: project the full screen rect instead
318:         // of the window's own rect.
319:         UpdateOffCenterProjection(tracked.camera.get(),
320:             m_arenaRect.x, m_arenaRect.y, m_arenaRect.width, m_arenaRect.height, GetUnifiedCameraHeight());
321:         return;
322:     }
324:     // 4. THE MAGIC FIX: Proyeksikan 3D menggunakan posisi OS Asli, BUKAN target.
325:     UpdateOffCenterProjection(tracked.camera.get(), osX, osY, tracked.state.actualW, tracked.state.actualH, GetUnifiedCameraHeight());
326: }
328: void WindowTrackingSystem::UpdateOffCenterProjection(Camera* targetCam, int winX, int winY, int winW, int winH, float camHeight)
329: {
330:     // [FIX 3] Gunakan posisi kamera saat ini (yang sudah mengandung Shake dari CameraController)
331:     // Jangan dipaksa ke (0, camHeight, 0) agar getarannya sinkron di semua jendela.
332:     DirectX::XMFLOAT3 currentPos = targetCam->GetPosition();
333:     targetCam->SetPosition(currentPos);
335:     // Pastikan arah hadap kamera portal selalu tegak lurus ke bawah (Top-Down)
336:     // agar proyeksi portal tetap konsisten dengan koordinat Desktop.
337:     targetCam->LookAt({ currentPos.x, 0.0f, currentPos.z });
339:     float nearZ = 0.1f;
340:     float farZ = 1000.0f;
341:     float halfFovTan = tanf(DirectX::XMConvertToRadians(m_fov) * 0.5f);
343:     // The full frustum covers the arena rect; a window gets the slice of it
344:     // that its own desktop rect cuts out.
345:     const double arenaW{ static_cast<double>(m_arenaRect.width) };
346:     const double arenaH{ static_cast<double>(m_arenaRect.height) };
348:     float halfHeight = nearZ * halfFovTan;
349:     float halfWidth = halfHeight * static_cast<float>(arenaW / arenaH);
351:     const double localX{ static_cast<double>(winX - m_arenaRect.x) };
352:     const double localY{ static_cast<double>(winY - m_arenaRect.y) };
354:     float l = (float)((localX / arenaW) * 2.0 - 1.0);
355:     float r = (float)(((localX + winW) / arenaW) * 2.0 - 1.0);
356:     float t = (float)(1.0 - (localY / arenaH) * 2.0);
357:     float b = (float)(1.0 - ((localY + winH) / arenaH) * 2.0);
359:     targetCam->SetOffCenterProjection(l * halfWidth, r * halfWidth, b * halfHeight, t * halfHeight, nearZ, farZ);
360: }

365: void WindowTrackingSystem::WorldToScreenPos(const DirectX::XMFLOAT3& worldPos, float& outScreenX, float& outScreenY)
366: {
367:     // World origin sits at the centre of the arena rect.
368:     // Note: Z world menjadi Y layar (negatif) karena coordinate system game ini
369:     const float centerX{ static_cast<float>(m_arenaRect.x) + static_cast<float>(m_arenaRect.width) * 0.5f };
370:     const float centerY{ static_cast<float>(m_arenaRect.y) + static_cast<float>(m_arenaRect.height) * 0.5f };
372:     const float desktopPixelsPerUnit{ Beyond::Config::PIXEL_TO_UNIT_RATIO * m_desktopScale };
373:     outScreenX = centerX + (worldPos.x * desktopPixelsPerUnit);
374:     outScreenY = centerY - (worldPos.z * desktopPixelsPerUnit);
375: }
377: float WindowTrackingSystem::GetUnifiedCameraHeight()
378: {
379:     // Height at which the vertical FOV spans exactly the arena height. It no longer
380:     // depends on the monitor: pixels per unit already absorb the rect size.
381:     float halfFovTan = tanf(XMConvertToRadians(m_fov) * 0.5f);
382:     return (Beyond::Config::ARENA_HEIGHT_UNITS * 0.5f) / halfFovTan;
383: }
385: void WindowTrackingSystem::RemoveTrackedWindow(const std::string& name)

457: std::unique_ptr<TrackedWindow> WindowTrackingSystem::ExtractForPool(const std::string& name)
458: {
459:     auto it = m_windowLookup.find(name);
460:     if (it == m_windowLookup.end()) return nullptr;
462:     auto vecIt = std::find_if(m_trackedWindows.begin(), m_trackedWindows.end(),
463:         [&name](const std::unique_ptr<TrackedWindow>& p) {
464:             return p->name == name;

467:     if (vecIt != m_trackedWindows.end())
468:     {
469:         std::unique_ptr<TrackedWindow> extracted = std::move(*vecIt);
470:         m_trackedWindows.erase(vecIt);
471:         m_windowLookup.erase(it);
472:         return extracted;
473:     }
474:     return nullptr;
475: }

18: void Bullet::Fire(const DirectX::XMFLOAT3& startPos, const DirectX::XMFLOAT3& direction, float projectileSpeed)
19: {
20:     isActive = true;
21:     m_lifeTime = 0.0f;
22:     movement->SetPosition(startPos);
24:     XMVECTOR vDir = XMLoadFloat3(&direction);
25:     vDir = XMVector3Normalize(vDir);
26:     XMVECTOR vVel = vDir * projectileSpeed;
27:     XMStoreFloat3(&velocity, vVel);
29:     SyncData();
30: }
32: void Bullet::Update(float elapsedTime, Camera* camera)
33: {
34:     if (!isActive) return;
36:     m_lifeTime += elapsedTime;
37:     // =========================================================
38:     // [BARU] LOGIKA KURVA BEZIER (PARABOLA SEMPURNA)
39:     // =========================================================
40:     if (m_isParabolic && m_bossTarget) {
41:         m_parabolaTime += elapsedTime;
42:         float t = min(1.0f, m_parabolaTime / m_parabolaDuration);
44:         // Rumus Quadratic Bezier: (1-t)^2*P0 + 2(1-t)t*P1 + t^2*P2
45:         float u = 1.0f - t;
46:         float tt = t * t;
47:         float uu = u * u;
49:         DirectX::XMFLOAT3 p0 = m_parabolaStart;
50:         DirectX::XMFLOAT3 p1 = m_parabolaCtrl;
51:         DirectX::XMFLOAT3 p2 = m_bossTarget->GetPosition();
53:         DirectX::XMFLOAT3 newPos;
54:         newPos.x = uu * p0.x + 2 * u * t * p1.x + tt * p2.x;
55:         newPos.y = uu * p0.y + 2 * u * t * p1.y + tt * p2.y;
56:         newPos.z = uu * p0.z + 2 * u * t * p1.z + tt * p2.z;
58:         // Hitung kecepatan palsu untuk keperluan update sistem / efek partikel
59:         DirectX::XMFLOAT3 currentPos = movement->GetPosition();
60:         velocity.x = (newPos.x - currentPos.x) / max(elapsedTime, 0.0001f);
61:         velocity.y = (newPos.y - currentPos.y) / max(elapsedTime, 0.0001f);
62:         velocity.z = (newPos.z - currentPos.z) / max(elapsedTime, 0.0001f);
64:         movement->SetPosition(newPos);
65:         SyncData();
66:         return; // LANGSUNG RETURN agar logika lurus di bawah tidak dieksekusi!
67:     }
69:     if (m_homingTarget || m_bossTarget)
70:     {
71:         DirectX::XMFLOAT3 myPos = movement->GetPosition();
73:         // Ambil posisi target (Gunakan logika percabangan)
74:         DirectX::XMFLOAT3 ePos = m_homingTarget ? m_homingTarget->GetPosition() : m_bossTarget->GetPosition();
76:         // Ambil kecepatan target untuk kalkulasi "Lead Shooting"
77:         DirectX::XMFLOAT3 eVel = { 0, 0, 0 };
78:         if (m_homingTarget) {
79:             eVel = m_homingTarget->GetMovement()->GetVelocity();
80:         }
81:         else {
82:             // Untuk Boss, kita anggap kecepatannya 0 atau statis saat ini
83:             eVel = { 0, 0, 0 };
84:         }
86:         float dx = ePos.x - myPos.x;
87:         float dz = ePos.z - myPos.z;
88:         float distance = std::sqrt((dx * dx) + (dz * dz));
90:         DirectX::XMVECTOR vCurrentVel = DirectX::XMLoadFloat3(&velocity);
91:         float currentSpeed = DirectX::XMVectorGetX(DirectX::XMVector3Length(vCurrentVel));
93:         float leadTime = distance / currentSpeed;
95:         DirectX::XMFLOAT3 predictedPos = {
96:             ePos.x + (eVel.x * leadTime),
97:             ePos.y,
98:             ePos.z + (eVel.z * leadTime)
99:         };
101:         DirectX::XMVECTOR vPos = DirectX::XMLoadFloat3(&myPos);
102:         DirectX::XMVECTOR vTarget = DirectX::XMLoadFloat3(&predictedPos);
103:         DirectX::XMVECTOR vDirToTarget = DirectX::XMVector3Normalize(DirectX::XMVectorSubtract(vTarget, vPos));
105:         float dynamicTurnSpeed = m_turnSpeed;
106:         if (distance < 5.0f) {
107:             dynamicTurnSpeed *= (5.0f / max(distance, 0.1f));
108:         }
110:         DirectX::XMVECTOR vDesiredVel = DirectX::XMVectorScale(vDirToTarget, currentSpeed);
111:         vCurrentVel = DirectX::XMVectorLerp(vCurrentVel, vDesiredVel, dynamicTurnSpeed * elapsedTime);
113:         vCurrentVel = DirectX::XMVectorScale(DirectX::XMVector3Normalize(vCurrentVel), currentSpeed);
114:         DirectX::XMStoreFloat3(&velocity, vCurrentVel);
115:     }
117:     XMFLOAT3 pos = movement->GetPosition();
119:     // Apply full 3D velocity
120:     pos.x += velocity.x * elapsedTime;
121:     pos.y += velocity.y * elapsedTime;
122:     pos.z += velocity.z * elapsedTime;
124:     movement->SetPosition(pos);
125:     SyncData();
127:     // =========================================================
128:         // [BARU] UPDATE POSISI, SKALA & ARAH HADAP VFX
129:         // =========================================================
130:     if (m_vfxHandle != -1 && EffectManager::Instance().IsPlaying(m_vfxHandle))
131:     {
132:         DirectX::XMFLOAT3 vfxPos = pos;
133:         float speed = std::sqrt((velocity.x * velocity.x) + (velocity.y * velocity.y) + (velocity.z * velocity.z));
135:         // 1. Tentukan seberapa jauh efek harus didorong maju.
136:                 // Gunakan variabel m_vfxForwardOffsetMult yang kita buat di langkah sebelumnya.
137:                 // - Untuk Bijuudama: m_vfxForwardOffsetMult = 0.0f (jadi offset = 0, efek pas di tengah!)
138:                 // - Untuk Phalanx: m_vfxForwardOffsetMult = 0.5f (jadi didorong ke ujung pedang)
139:         float actualOffset = scale.x * m_vfxForwardOffsetMult;
141:         float pitch = 0.0f;
142:         float yaw = 0.0f;
144:         if (speed > 0.1f) {
145:             // Jika meluncur: Arah dan offset ikuti Velocity
146:             float horizontalDist = std::sqrt((velocity.x * velocity.x) + (velocity.z * velocity.z));
147:             yaw = std::atan2(velocity.x, velocity.z);
148:             pitch = std::atan2(-velocity.y, horizontalDist);
150:             // [FIX] Kalikan arah maju (velocity/speed) dengan actualOffset!
151:             vfxPos.x += (velocity.x / speed) * actualOffset;
152:             vfxPos.y += (velocity.y / speed) * actualOffset;
153:             vfxPos.z += (velocity.z / speed) * actualOffset;
154:         }
155:         else {
156:             // Jika diam (Charging): Arah dan offset ikuti Rotasi Model 3D
157:             yaw = DirectX::XMConvertToRadians(movement->GetRotation().y);
158:             pitch = DirectX::XMConvertToRadians(movement->GetRotation().x);
160:             // [FIX] Kalikan juga arah maju saat diam dengan actualOffset!
161:             vfxPos.x += std::sin(yaw) * actualOffset;
162:             vfxPos.z += std::cos(yaw) * actualOffset;
163:         }
165:         // Jangan lupa putar 180 derajat (Pi) agar Phalanx tidak hadap belakang
166:         yaw += DirectX::XM_PI;
168:         // Terapkan Posisi & Rotasi
169:         EffectManager::Instance().SetPosition(m_vfxHandle, vfxPos);
170:         EffectManager::Instance().SetRotation(m_vfxHandle, { pitch, yaw, 0.0f });
172:         // Terapkan Skala Dinamis setiap frame
173:         EffectManager::Instance().SetScale(m_vfxHandle, {
174:             scale.x * m_vfxScaleMultiplier,
175:             scale.y * m_vfxScaleMultiplier,
176:             scale.z * m_vfxScaleMultiplier
177:             });
178:     }
179:     else if (m_vfxHandle != -1)
180:     {
181:         m_vfxHandle = -1;
182:     }
183: }

22: void Enemy::Update(float elapsedTime, Camera* camera)
23: {
24:     m_lifeTime += elapsedTime;
26:     if (m_blinkTimer > 0.0f)
27:     {
28:         m_blinkTimer = (std::max)(0.0f, m_blinkTimer - elapsedTime);
29:     }
31:     if (m_type == EnemyType::Pentagon)
32:     {
33:         XMFLOAT3 rot = movement->GetRotation();
34:         rot.y += 10.0f * elapsedTime;
35:         movement->SetRotation(rot);
36:     }
38:     if (m_attackType == AttackType::TrackingHorizontal)
39:     {
40:         XMFLOAT3 pos = movement->GetPosition();
41:         pos.x += m_currentSpeed * elapsedTime;
43:         if (pos.x >= m_patrolMaxX)
44:         {
45:             pos.x = m_patrolMaxX;
46:             m_currentSpeed = -std::abs(m_baseMoveSpeed);
47:         }
48:         else if (pos.x <= m_patrolMinX)
49:         {
50:             pos.x = m_patrolMinX;
51:             m_currentSpeed = std::abs(m_baseMoveSpeed);
52:         }
53:         movement->SetPosition(pos);
54:     }
55:     else if (m_attackType == AttackType::TrackingRandom)
56:     {
57:         XMFLOAT3 pos = movement->GetPosition();
58:         float dx = m_randomTargetPos.x - pos.x;
59:         float dz = m_randomTargetPos.z - pos.z;
60:         float distSq = dx * dx + dz * dz;
62:         if (distSq < 0.1f)
63:         {
64:             m_randomTargetPos.x = GetRandomFloat(m_patrolMinX, m_patrolMaxX);
65:             m_randomTargetPos.z = GetRandomFloat(m_patrolMinZ, m_patrolMaxZ);
66:             m_randomTargetPos.y = pos.y;
67:         }
69:         XMVECTOR vPos = XMLoadFloat3(&pos);
70:         XMVECTOR vTarget = XMLoadFloat3(&m_randomTargetPos);
71:         XMVECTOR vDir = XMVectorSubtract(vTarget, vPos);
72:         vDir = XMVector3Normalize(vDir);
73:         XMVECTOR vOffset = vDir * m_baseMoveSpeed * elapsedTime;
74:         XMVECTOR vNewPos = XMVectorAdd(vPos, vOffset);
75:         XMStoreFloat3(&pos, vNewPos);
76:         movement->SetPosition(pos);
77:     }
79:     UpdateProjectiles(elapsedTime, camera);
81:     XMFLOAT3 pos = movement->GetPosition();
82:     XMFLOAT3 rot = movement->GetRotation();
84:     XMMATRIX S = XMMatrixScaling(m_scale.x, m_scale.y, m_scale.z);
85:     XMMATRIX R = XMMatrixRotationRollPitchYaw(
86:         XMConvertToRadians(rot.x),
87:         XMConvertToRadians(rot.y),
88:         XMConvertToRadians(rot.z)
89:     );
90:     XMMATRIX T = XMMatrixTranslation(pos.x, pos.y, pos.z);
92:     XMFLOAT4X4 worldMatrix;
93:     XMStoreFloat4x4(&worldMatrix, S * R * T);
95:     if (m_model) m_model->UpdateTransform(worldMatrix);
96: }

101:     if (allowAttack)

103:         UpdateAttackLogic(elapsedTime, camera, playerPos, allowAttack);
