39:         nextAttack = AttackSequence::Radial;
40:     }
42:     // Tukar status agar serangan berikutnya bergantian
43:     m_isNextMainAttack = !m_isNextMainAttack;
45:     return nextAttack;
46: }
48: void BossAI_Phase01::Update(float dt, Boss* boss) {
49:     if (!m_enabled || !m_target || !m_phase) return;
51:     // Tunggu sampai serangan utama dan hujan selesai sebelum melancarkan serangan berikutnya
52:     if (m_phase->HasActiveAttacks() || m_phase->HasRainActive()) return;
54:     m_cooldownTimer -= dt;
56:     if (m_cooldownTimer <= 0.0f) {
57:         float hpPercent = static_cast<float>(m_phase->GetHP()) / static_cast<float>(m_phase->GetMaxHP());
58:         bool isEnraged = (hpPercent <= 0.5f);
60:         // [BARU] Transisi mulus saat boss masuk Chaos Mode (HP < 50%)
61:         if (isEnraged && !m_isEnraged) {
62:             m_isEnraged = true;
63:             m_currentAttack = AttackSequence::Phalanx; // Memulai combo pertama dari Phalanx
64:         }
66:         DirectX::XMFLOAT3 pPos = m_target->GetPosition();
67:         DirectX::XMFLOAT3 bPos = boss->GetPosition();
68:         float lockedAngle = std::atan2f(pPos.x - bPos.x, pPos.z - bPos.z);
70:         switch (m_currentAttack) {
72:             // ========================================================
73:             // FILLER ATTACK (Tactician Mode)
74:             // [DIUBAH] Direct & Fan dipensiunkan dari rotasi filler aktif.
75:             // Case di bawah dipertahankan (bukan dihapus) untuk kemungkinan
76:             // dipakai sebagai layer tambahan di kombinasi Fase 2 nanti.
77:             // Tidak lagi reachable dari GetNextTacticianAttack() atau default state.
78:             // ========================================================
79:         case AttackSequence::Direct:
80:             m_phase->AddPooledAttack(std::make_unique<AttackDirect>(AttackParamManager::Instance().GetDirectParams(), m_target));
81:             m_cooldownTimer = 1.0f;
82:             m_currentAttack = GetNextTacticianAttack();
83:             break;
85:         case AttackSequence::Fan:
86:             m_phase->AddPooledAttack(std::make_unique<AttackFan>(AttackParamManager::Instance().GetFanNormalParams(), lockedAngle, m_target));
87:             m_cooldownTimer = 1.0f;
88:             m_currentAttack = GetNextTacticianAttack();
89:             break;
91:         case AttackSequence::Radial:
92:             m_phase->AddPooledAttack(std::make_unique<AttackRadial>(AttackParamManager::Instance().GetRadialNormalParams()));
93:             m_cooldownTimer = 1.0f;
94:             m_currentAttack = GetNextTacticianAttack();
95:             break;
97:             // ========================================================
98:             // SHARED MAIN ATTACKS (Tactician = Single, Enraged = Combo + Rain)
99:             // ========================================================
100:         case AttackSequence::Phalanx:
101:             m_phase->AddPooledAttack(std::make_unique<AttackPhalanx>(AttackParamManager::Instance().GetPhalanxParams(), m_target));
102:             if (isEnraged) {

104:                 m_phase->TriggerRain(AttackParamManager::Instance().GetRainParams(), RainMode::VerticalSweep, m_target->GetPosition().x > 0);
105:                 m_currentAttack = AttackSequence::Wave; // Siklus Chaos berikutnya
106:             }
107:             else {
108:                 m_currentAttack = GetNextTacticianAttack();
109:             }
110:             m_cooldownTimer = 1.0f;
111:             break;
113:         case AttackSequence::Wave:
114:             m_phase->AddPooledAttack(std::make_unique<AttackWave>(AttackParamManager::Instance().GetWaveParams()));
115:             if (isEnraged) {
116:                 m_phase->TriggerRain(AttackParamManager::Instance().GetRainParams(), RainMode::VerticalSweep, m_target->GetPosition().x > 0);
117:                 m_currentAttack = AttackSequence::Meteor;
118:             }
119:             else {
120:                 m_currentAttack = GetNextTacticianAttack();
121:             }
122:             m_cooldownTimer = 1.0f;
123:             break;
125:         case AttackSequence::Meteor:
126:             m_phase->AddPooledAttack(std::make_unique<AttackMeteor>(AttackParamManager::Instance().GetMeteorParams()));
127:             if (isEnraged) {
128:                 m_phase->TriggerRain(AttackParamManager::Instance().GetRainParams(), RainMode::VerticalSweep, m_target->GetPosition().x > 0);
129:                 m_currentAttack = AttackSequence::Ultimate;
130:             }
131:             else {
132:                 m_currentAttack = GetNextTacticianAttack();

134:             m_cooldownTimer = 1.0f;
135:             break;
137:         case AttackSequence::Ultimate:
138:             m_phase->AddPooledAttack(std::make_unique<AttackUltimate>(AttackParamManager::Instance().GetUltimateParams(), m_target));
139:             if (isEnraged) {
140:                 m_phase->TriggerRain(AttackParamManager::Instance().GetRainParams(), RainMode::VerticalSweep, m_target->GetPosition().x > 0);

15: void AttackBlasters::Start(Boss* boss) {
16:     auto device = Graphics::Instance().GetDevice();
17:     m_solidRenderer = std::make_unique<Primitive>(device);
18:     m_placeholderModel = std::make_shared<Model>(device, "Data/Model/Character/PLACEHOLDER_mdl_Ball.glb");
20:     m_isSpawning = true;
21:     m_spawnedCount = 0;
22:     m_spawnTimer = m_params.spawnDelay;

25: void AttackBlasters::Update(float dt, Boss* boss) {
26:     if (!boss || !boss->GetWindowSystem()) return;
28:     // 1. Spawning Sequence
29:     if (m_isSpawning) {
30:         m_spawnTimer += dt;
31:         while (m_isSpawning && m_spawnTimer >= m_params.spawnDelay) {
32:             m_spawnTimer = (m_params.spawnDelay > 0.0f) ? m_spawnTimer - m_params.spawnDelay : 1.0f;
34:             auto blaster = std::make_shared<OrbitalBlaster>();
35:             float startX = m_isTargeted ? m_targetX : -m_params.spawnSpreadX * 0.5f;
36:             float stepX = (m_params.spawnCount > 1 && !m_isTargeted) ? (m_params.spawnSpreadX / (m_params.spawnCount - 1)) : 0.0f;
38:             blaster->baseX = m_isTargeted ? m_targetX : startX + (stepX * m_spawnedCount);
39:             blaster->pos = { blaster->baseX, 1.0f, 25.0f }; // Starts high
40:             blaster->targetPos = { blaster->baseX, 1.0f, 10.0f }; // Drops down
42:             int uniqueID = rand() % 100000;
43:             blaster->beamWindowName = "blaster_beam_" + std::to_string(uniqueID);
44:             blaster->windowName = "blaster_cannon_" + std::to_string(uniqueID);
46:             // Beam Window Config
47:             TrackedWindowConfig beamCfg = { blaster->beamWindowName, "!!! BEAM REACHING !!!", 1, 1, 1 };
48:             beamCfg.isTransparent = false;
49:             boss->GetWindowSystem()->AddTrackedWindow(beamCfg,
50:                 [ptr = blaster.get()]() { return (ptr->state < 2) ? DirectX::XMFLOAT3(ptr->pos.x, ptr->pos.y, -10000.0f) : ptr->pos; },
51:                 [ptr = blaster.get(), boss]() {
52:                     if (ptr->state < 2) return DirectX::XMFLOAT2(1.0f, 1.0f);
53:                     float p2u = boss->GetWindowSystem()->GetPixelToUnitRatio();
54:                     float w = max(50.0f, (ptr->beamScaleX + 1.5f) * p2u);
55:                     float h = max(1.0f, ptr->beamCurrentLength * p2u);
56:                     return DirectX::XMFLOAT2(w, h);
57:                 }
58:             );
60:             // Cannon Window Config
61:             TrackedWindowConfig cfg = { blaster->windowName, "DANGER: CANNON", (int)m_params.cannonWindowSize, (int)m_params.cannonWindowSize, 10 };
62:             cfg.isTransparent = false;
63:             boss->GetWindowSystem()->AddTrackedWindow(cfg,
64:                 [ptr = blaster.get()]() { return ptr->pos; },
65:                 [this]() { return DirectX::XMFLOAT2(m_params.cannonWindowSize, m_params.cannonWindowSize); }
66:             );
68:             m_blasters.push_back(blaster);
69:             m_spawnedCount++;
70:             if (m_spawnedCount >= m_params.spawnCount) m_isSpawning = false;
71:         }
72:     }
74:     // 2. Logic Update per Blaster
75:     for (auto it = m_blasters.begin(); it != m_blasters.end(); ) {
76:         auto& b = *it;
77:         if (!b->active) {
78:             it = m_blasters.erase(it);
79:             continue;
80:         }
82:         b->timer += dt;
83:         DirectX::XMFLOAT3 vfxPos = {
84:             b->pos.x + m_params.effectOffset.x,
85:             b->pos.y + m_params.effectOffset.y,
86:             b->pos.z + m_params.effectOffset.z
87:         };
89:         if (b->state == 1) { // DROP IN
90:             b->pos.z += (b->targetPos.z - b->pos.z) * 12.0f * dt;
91:             if (b->timer >= m_params.dropInDuration) {
92:                 b->state = 2; b->timer = 0.0f;
93:                 AudioManager::Instance().PlaySFX("Data/Sound/SE_Boss_Laser_Charge.wav", 0.1f);
94:                 b->chargeEffectHandle = EffectManager::Instance().Play(m_params.chargeEffectPath, vfxPos, m_params.chargeEffectScale);
95:                 EffectManager::Instance().SetRotation(b->chargeEffectHandle, { XMConvertToRadians(m_params.effectPitchDegrees), 0, 0 });
96:             }
97:         }
98:         else if (b->state == 2) { // CHARGE
99:             b->beamScaleX = 0.2f; // Thin warning line
100:             b->beamCurrentLength += (m_params.beamMaxLength - b->beamCurrentLength) * m_params.beamSlideSpeed * dt;
101:             EffectManager::Instance().SetPosition(b->chargeEffectHandle, vfxPos);
103:             if (b->timer >= m_params.chargeDelay) {
104:                 b->state = 3; b->timer = 0.0f;
105:                 CameraController::Instance().AddTrauma(0.6f);
106:                 AudioManager::Instance().PlaySFX("Data/Sound/SE_Boss_Laser_Shoot.wav", 0.2f);
107:                 EffectManager::Instance().Stop(b->chargeEffectHandle);
109:                 b->fireEffectHandle = EffectManager::Instance().Play(m_params.fireEffectPath, vfxPos, m_params.fireEffectScale);
110:                 EffectManager::Instance().SetRotation(b->fireEffectHandle, { XMConvertToRadians(m_params.effectPitchDegrees), 0, 0 });
111:             }
112:         }
113:         else if (b->state == 3) { // FIRE
114:             b->pos.x = b->baseX; // Lock X against shake drift
115:             b->beamScaleX += (m_params.beamVisualWidth - b->beamScaleX) * m_params.beamGrowSpeed * dt;
116:             CameraController::Instance().AddTrauma(0.1f);
117:             EffectManager::Instance().SetPosition(b->fireEffectHandle, vfxPos);
119:             if (b->timer >= m_params.fireDuration) {
120:                 b->state = 4; b->timer = 0.0f;
121:                 EffectManager::Instance().Stop(b->fireEffectHandle);
122:             }
123:         }
124:         else if (b->state == 4) { // RETREAT
125:             b->beamScaleX -= dt * m_params.windowFadeSpeed;
126:             if (b->beamScaleX <= 0.1f && boss->GetWindowSystem()->GetTrackedWindow(b->beamWindowName)) {
127:                 b->pos.z = -10000.0f;
128:                 boss->GetWindowSystem()->RemoveTrackedWindow(b->beamWindowName);
129:             }
131:             b->pos.z += m_params.retreatSpeed * dt;
132:             if (b->timer >= 0.3f) {
133:                 b->active = false;
134:                 boss->GetWindowSystem()->RemoveTrackedWindow(b->windowName);
135:             }
136:         }
137:         ++it;
138:     }
139: }
141: void AttackBlasters::Render(ID3D11DeviceContext* context, Camera* camera, Boss* boss) {
142:     if (!m_placeholderModel || !m_solidRenderer) return;
143:     auto modelRenderer = Graphics::Instance().GetModelRenderer();
145:     for (auto& b : m_blasters) {
146:         if (!b->active) continue;
148:         // Render Cannon Head
149:         if (!m_placeholderModel->GetNodes().empty()) {
150:             auto& rootNode = m_placeholderModel->GetNodes().at(0);
151:             DirectX::XMFLOAT4X4 identity;
152:             XMStoreFloat4x4(&identity, XMMatrixIdentity());
153:             rootNode.position = b->pos;
154:             rootNode.scale = { m_params.cannonVisualScale, m_params.cannonVisualScale, m_params.cannonVisualScale };
155:             m_placeholderModel->UpdateTransform(identity);
156:             modelRenderer->Draw(ShaderId::Phong, m_placeholderModel, { 0.2f, 0.5f, 0.5f, 1.0f });
157:         }
159:         // Render Beam Rect (Solid 2D)
160:         if (b->beamScaleX > 0.0f) {
161:             // The beam is a ground rect (y = 0) from the cannon towards -Z. Its two
162:             // opposite corners are projected through the camera of the window being
163:             // drawn, which already accounts for that window's position and shake.
164:             const float halfBeamWidth{ b->beamScaleX * 0.5f };
165:             const DirectX::XMFLOAT2 topLeft{ WorldToViewportPixels(context, *camera,
166:                 { b->pos.x - halfBeamWidth, 0.0f, b->pos.z }) };
167:             const DirectX::XMFLOAT2 bottomRight{ WorldToViewportPixels(context, *camera,
168:                 { b->pos.x + halfBeamWidth, 0.0f, b->pos.z - b->beamCurrentLength }) };
170:             DirectX::XMFLOAT4 color = (b->state == 2) ? DirectX::XMFLOAT4{ 1,0,0,0.5f } : DirectX::XMFLOAT4{ 0,1,1,0.9f };
172:             m_solidRenderer->Rect(topLeft.x, topLeft.y,
173:                 bottomRight.x - topLeft.x, bottomRight.y - topLeft.y,
174:                 0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f, color.x, color.y, color.z, color.w);
175:             m_solidRenderer->Render(context);
176:         }
177:     }
178: }
180: void AttackBlasters::Stop(Boss* boss) {
181:     for (auto& b : m_blasters) {
182:         EffectManager::Instance().Stop(b->chargeEffectHandle);
183:         EffectManager::Instance().Stop(b->fireEffectHandle);
184:         if (boss && boss->GetWindowSystem()) {
185:             boss->GetWindowSystem()->RemoveTrackedWindow(b->beamWindowName);
186:             boss->GetWindowSystem()->RemoveTrackedWindow(b->windowName);
187:         }
188:     }
189:     m_blasters.clear();
190:     m_isSpawning = false;
191: }

21:     // Edges of the arena in world units, the same on every monitor.
22:     const float limitX{ Beyond::Config::ARENA_WIDTH_UNITS * 0.5f };
23:     const float limitZ{ Beyond::Config::ARENA_HEIGHT_UNITS * 0.5f };
25:     // 1. Spawning Sequence
26:     if (m_isSpawning) {
27:         m_spawnTimer += dt;

33:             bw.bullet->SetRadius(m_params.hitboxRadius);
34:             bw.bullet->SetDamage(m_params.damage);

39:             bw.targetX = bw.startX - (bw.spawnSide * m_params.maxTravelDistance);

43:                 : ((rand() % 200) / 100.0f - 1.0f) * (limitZ - 3.0f);

46:             bw.targetVelX = -1.0f * bw.spawnSide * m_params.speed;
48:             DirectX::XMFLOAT3 startDir = { bw.targetVelX > 0 ? 1.0f : -1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f };
49:             bw.bullet->Fire(startPos, startDir, m_params.speed);
50:             bw.windowName = "boomerang_win_" + std::to_string(rand() % 100000);
52:             TrackedWindowConfig cfg = { bw.windowName, "BOOMERANG WARNING", (int)m_params.windowSize, (int)m_params.windowSize, 8 };
53:             cfg.isTransparent = false;
54:             boss->GetWindowSystem()->AddTrackedWindow(cfg,
55:                 [ptr = bw.bullet.get()]() { return ptr->GetMovement()->GetPosition(); },
56:                 [this]() { return DirectX::XMFLOAT2(m_params.windowSize, m_params.windowSize); }
57:             );
59:             m_bullets.push_back(std::move(bw));

24:     if (!boss || !boss->GetWindowSystem()) return;
26:     // 1. Handle Spawning Sequence

28:         m_spawnTimer += dt;

30:             m_spawnTimer = (m_params.spawnDelay > 0.0f) ? m_spawnTimer - m_params.spawnDelay : 1.0f;
32:             // Asymmetric pattern: Right, Top-Right, Top-Left
33:             float patternAngles[3] = {
34:                 XMConvertToRadians(35.0f),
35:                 XMConvertToRadians(75.0f),
36:                 XMConvertToRadians(145.0f)
37:             };
39:             float angle = patternAngles[m_spawnedCount % 3];
40:             if (m_spawnedCount >= 3) {
41:                 angle += XMConvertToRadians((float)((rand() % 10) - 5)); // Add chaos
42:             }
44:             BouncingWindowBullet bwb;
45:             bwb.bullet = std::make_unique<Bullet>();
46:             bwb.bullet->SetRadius(m_params.hitboxRadius);
47:             bwb.bullet->SetDamage(m_params.damage);
48:             bwb.bullet->scale = { m_params.visualScale, m_params.visualScale, m_params.visualScale };
49:             bwb.maxBounces = m_params.maxBounces;
51:             DirectX::XMFLOAT3 dir = { cosf(angle), 0, sinf(angle) };
52:             bwb.bullet->Fire(boss->GetPosition(), dir, m_params.speed);
53:             bwb.windowName = "bouncing_win_" + std::to_string(rand() % 100000);
55:             // Register Window tracking
56:             TrackedWindowConfig cfg;
57:             cfg.name = bwb.windowName;
58:             cfg.title = "PROJECTILE";
59:             cfg.width = (int)m_params.windowWidth;
60:             cfg.height = (int)m_params.windowHeight;
61:             cfg.isTransparent = false;
63:             boss->GetWindowSystem()->AddTrackedWindow(cfg,
64:                 [ptr = bwb.bullet.get()]() { return ptr->GetMovement()->GetPosition(); },
65:                 [this]() { return DirectX::XMFLOAT2(m_params.windowWidth, m_params.windowHeight); }
66:             );
68:             m_bullets.push_back(std::move(bwb));
69:             m_spawnedCount++;
71:             CameraController::Instance().AddTrauma(0.2f);
72:             AudioManager::Instance().PlaySFX("Data/Sound/SE_Boss_Bouncing_Shoot.wav", 0.1f);
74:             if (m_spawnedCount >= m_params.spawnCount) m_isSpawning = false;
75:         }
76:     }
78:     // 2. Process Physics & Screen Bouncing
79:     bool anyBouncedThisFrame = false;
80:     for (auto it = m_bullets.begin(); it != m_bullets.end(); ) {
81:         auto& bwb = *it;
83:         if (!bwb.bullet->IsActive()) {
84:             boss->GetWindowSystem()->RemoveTrackedWindow(bwb.windowName);
85:             it = m_bullets.erase(it);

96:             bool bounced = false;
97:             // X-Axis bounds
98:             if (pos.x > m_screenLimitX - radius) { pos.x = m_screenLimitX - radius; vel.x *= -1.0f; bounced = true; }
99:             else if (pos.x < -m_screenLimitX + radius) { pos.x = -m_screenLimitX + radius; vel.x *= -1.0f; bounced = true; }
101:             // Z-Axis bounds
102:             if (pos.z > m_screenLimitZ - radius) { pos.z = m_screenLimitZ - radius; vel.z *= -1.0f; bounced = true; }
103:             else if (pos.z < -m_screenLimitZ + radius) { pos.z = -m_screenLimitZ + radius; vel.z *= -1.0f; bounced = true; }
105:             if (bounced) {
106:                 bwb.bounceCount++;
107:                 bwb.bullet->ApplyMovement(pos, vel);
108:                 anyBouncedThisFrame = true;
109:             }
110:         }
111:         else {
112:             // Destroy if out of bounds after max bounces
113:             if (abs(pos.x) > m_screenLimitX + 15.0f || abs(pos.z) > m_screenLimitZ + 15.0f) {
114:                 boss->GetWindowSystem()->RemoveTrackedWindow(bwb.windowName);

117:             }
118:         }

125:             "Data/Sound/SE_Boss_Bouncing_Thud_01.wav",
126:             "Data/Sound/SE_Boss_Bouncing_Thud_02.wav",
127:             "Data/Sound/SE_Boss_Bouncing_Thud_03.wav"
128:         };
129:         AudioManager::Instance().PlaySFX(dashSounds[rand() % 3], 0.2f);

14: void AttackDirect::StartPooled(Boss* boss, std::vector<std::unique_ptr<Bullet>>* pool) {
15:     m_pool = pool;
16:     m_boss = boss;
17:     m_active = true;
18:     m_spawnedCount = 0;

20:     m_isTriggerWaiting = false;

27: void AttackDirect::Update(float dt, Boss* boss) {
28:     if (!m_active || !m_pool || !m_boss || !m_target) return;
30:     if (m_isTriggerWaiting) {
31:         m_triggerTimer += dt;
32:         if (m_triggerTimer >= m_params.triggerDelay) {
33:             m_isTriggerWaiting = false;
34:             m_spawnedCount = 0;
35:             m_spawnTimer = m_params.spawnDelay;
36:         }
37:         return;
38:     }
40:     m_spawnTimer += dt;
41:     if (m_spawnTimer >= m_params.spawnDelay) {
42:         m_spawnTimer -= m_params.spawnDelay;
44:         FireBullet();
46:         if (++m_spawnedCount >= m_params.count) {
47:             m_currentTrigger++;
48:             if (m_currentTrigger >= m_params.triggerCount) {
49:                 m_active = false;
50:             }
51:             else {
52:                 m_isTriggerWaiting = true;
53:                 m_triggerTimer = 0.0f;
54:             }
55:         }
56:     }
57: }

68:     return !m_active;
69: }
71: void AttackDirect::FireBullet() {
72:     if (!m_pool || !m_boss || !m_target) return;
74:     for (auto& bullet : *m_pool) {
75:         if (!bullet->IsActive()) {
77:             // ========================================================
78:             // LOGIKA TRACKING REAL-TIME
79:             // ========================================================
80:             XMFLOAT3 bPos = m_boss->GetPosition();
81:             XMFLOAT3 pPos = m_target->GetPosition();
83:             float dx = pPos.x - bPos.x;
84:             float dz = pPos.z - bPos.z;
85:             float dist = sqrtf((dx * dx) + (dz * dz));
87:             XMFLOAT3 direction = { 0.0f, 0.0f, 1.0f }; // Default jika jarak 0
88:             if (dist > 0.001f) {
89:                 direction = { dx / dist, 0.0f, dz / dist };
90:             }
92:             bullet->SetRadius(m_params.radius);
93:             bullet->scale = { m_params.visualScale, m_params.visualScale, m_params.visualScale };
94:             bullet->SetHomingTarget(nullptr);
95:             bullet->SetBossTarget(nullptr);
96:             bullet->SetParabolic(false);
97:             bullet->SetParryReturn(false);
98:             bullet->SetTurnSpeed(8.0f);
99:             bullet->SetDamage(m_params.damage);
101:             bullet->Fire(bPos, direction, m_params.speed);
102:             break;
103:         }
104:     }
106:     AudioManager::Instance().PlaySFX("Data/Sound/SE_Boss_Shoot.wav", 0.2f * m_params.sfxVolume);
107: }

24:     float triggerDelay = 1.0f;
25: };
27: class AttackFan : public IPooledAttackPattern {
28: public:
29:     // lockedBaseAngle: atan2(playerX - bossX, playerZ - bossZ) at trigger time

28:     if (!m_active || !m_pool) return;
30:     // 1. Jika sedang dalam jeda antar trigger (nunggu untuk trigger berikutnya)
31:     if (m_isTriggerWaiting) {
32:         m_triggerTimer += dt;
33:         if (m_triggerTimer >= m_params.triggerDelay) {
34:             m_isTriggerWaiting = false;
35:             m_wavesFired = 0; // Reset wave untuk trigger baru
36:             m_waveTimer = m_params.waveDelay;
37:         }
38:         return;
39:     }
41:     // 2. Logika tembakan normal
42:     m_waveTimer += dt;
43:     if (m_waveTimer >= m_params.waveDelay) {
44:         m_waveTimer -= m_params.waveDelay;
46:         if (m_target && boss) {
47:             DirectX::XMFLOAT3 pPos = m_target->GetPosition();
48:             DirectX::XMFLOAT3 bPos = boss->GetPosition();
49:             m_lockedBaseAngle = std::atan2f(pPos.x - bPos.x, pPos.z - bPos.z);
50:         }
52:         FireWave(boss);
54:         // Jika satu set tembakan (semua wave) sudah selesai
55:         if (++m_wavesFired >= m_params.waves) {
56:             m_currentTrigger++; // Hitung trigger selesai
58:             if (m_currentTrigger >= m_params.triggerCount) {
59:                 m_active = false; // Serangan benar-benar selesai
60:             }
61:             else {
62:                 // Masuk ke mode tunggu untuk trigger berikutnya
63:                 m_isTriggerWaiting = true;
64:                 m_triggerTimer = 0.0f;
65:             }
66:         }
67:     }
68: }

86: void AttackFan::FireWave(Boss* boss) {
87:     if (!m_pool || !boss) return;
89:     int   fired = 0;
90:     // --- UBAH m_params.lines JADI m_params.rows ---
91:     float startAngle = m_lockedBaseAngle - ((m_params.rows - 1) * m_params.spreadAngle * 0.5f);
93:     for (auto& bullet : *m_pool) {

95:             bullet->SetRadius(0.25f);

100:             bullet->SetParryReturn(false);
101:             bullet->SetTurnSpeed(8.0f);

104:             float angle = startAngle + (fired * m_params.spreadAngle);
105:             bullet->Fire(boss->GetPosition(), { sinf(angle), 0.0f, cosf(angle) }, m_params.speed);
107:             // --- UBAH m_params.lines JADI m_params.rows ---
108:             if (++fired >= m_params.rows) break;
109:         }
110:     }
112:     AudioManager::Instance().PlaySFX("Data/Sound/SE_Boss_Shoot.wav", 0.2f * m_params.sfxVolume);

19:     m_isTriggerWaiting = false;

26: void AttackMeteor::Update(float dt, Boss* boss) {
27:     if (!m_active || !m_pool) return;
29:     if (m_isTriggerWaiting) {
30:         m_triggerTimer += dt;
31:         if (m_triggerTimer >= m_params.triggerDelay) {
32:             m_isTriggerWaiting = false;
33:             m_spawnedCount = 0;
34:             m_spawnTimer = m_params.spawnDelay;
35:         }
36:         return;
37:     }
39:     m_spawnTimer += dt;
40:     if (m_spawnTimer >= m_params.spawnDelay) {
41:         m_spawnTimer -= m_params.spawnDelay;
43:         FireMeteor();
45:         if (++m_spawnedCount >= m_params.count) {
46:             m_currentTrigger++;
47:             if (m_currentTrigger >= m_params.triggerCount) {
48:                 m_active = false;
49:             }
50:             else {
51:                 m_isTriggerWaiting = true;
52:                 m_triggerTimer = 0.0f;
53:             }
54:         }
55:     }

59:     // Peluru dirender terpusat oleh Phase
60: }

63:     m_active = false;
64: }
66: bool AttackMeteor::IsFinished() const {
67:     return !m_active;
68: }
70: void AttackMeteor::FireMeteor() {
71:     if (!m_pool) return;
73:     for (auto& bullet : *m_pool) {
74:         if (!bullet->IsActive()) {
76:             // 1. Hitung arah lintasan utama (Dari Start ke Target Anchor)
77:             float dx = m_params.targetX - m_params.startX;
78:             float dz = m_params.targetZ - m_params.startZ;
79:             float dist = sqrtf((dx * dx) + (dz * dz));
81:             float dirX = 0.0f;
82:             float dirZ = 1.0f; // Fallback jika jarak 0
83:             if (dist > 0.0001f) {
84:                 dirX = dx / dist;
85:                 dirZ = dz / dist;
86:             }
88:             // 2. Cari vektor tegak lurus (Perpendicular) untuk garis sebar
89:             float perpX = -dirZ;
90:             float perpZ = dirX;
92:             // ========================================================
93:             // PERUBAHAN 1: TIDAK URUT (SCATTER INDEX)
94:             // ========================================================
95:             // Gunakan Prime Jump agar urutan jatuhnya melompat-lompat
96:             // Contoh untuk count=5: urutan yang jatuh adalah indeks 0, 2, 4, 1, 3
97:             int primeJump = 5;
98:             int scatterIndex = (m_spawnedCount * primeJump) % m_params.count;
100:             // 3. Kalkulasi jarak offset menggunakan scatterIndex
101:             float centerIndex = (m_params.count - 1) / 2.0f;
102:             float currentOffset = (scatterIndex - centerIndex) * m_params.spreadOffset;
104:             // ========================================================
105:             // PERUBAHAN 2: RANDOM OFFSET X (JITTER)
106:             // ========================================================
107:             // Menghasilkan angka acak antara -2.5f hingga 2.5f
108:             float randomOffsetX = ((rand() % 100) / 50.0f - 1.0f) * 8.0f;
110:             // 4. Set Titik Spawn final untuk meteor ini
111:             DirectX::XMFLOAT3 spawnPos = {
112:                 m_params.startX + (perpX * currentOffset) + randomOffsetX,  // <--- Ditambah jitter X
113:                 1.0f,
114:                 m_params.startZ + (perpZ * currentOffset)
115:             };
117:             DirectX::XMFLOAT3 direction = { dirX, 0.0f, dirZ };
118:             // ========================================================
119:             // PERUBAHAN 3: RANDOM SPEED OFFSET (VARIANCE)
120:             // ========================================================
121:             // Menghasilkan angka acak antara -1.0 hingga 1.0, lalu dikali batas variance
122:             float randomSpeedOffset = ((rand() % 100) / 50.0f - 1.0f) * m_params.speedVariance;
123:             float finalSpeed = m_params.speed + randomSpeedOffset;
125:             // Pastikan kecepatan tidak pernah 0 atau negatif (minimal 5.0f)
126:             if (finalSpeed < 5.0f) finalSpeed = 5.0f;
128:             bullet->SetRadius(m_params.radius);
129:             bullet->scale = { m_params.visualScale, m_params.visualScale, m_params.visualScale };
130:             bullet->SetHomingTarget(nullptr);
131:             bullet->SetBossTarget(nullptr);
132:             bullet->SetParabolic(false);
133:             bullet->SetParryReturn(false);
134:             bullet->SetTurnSpeed(8.0f);
135:             bullet->SetDamage(m_params.damage);
137:             // [PERBAIKAN] Gunakan finalSpeed, bukan m_params.speed
138:             bullet->Fire(spawnPos, direction, finalSpeed);
139:             break;
140:         }
141:     }
143:     AudioManager::Instance().PlaySFX("Data/Sound/SE_Boss_Shoot.wav", 0.2f * m_params.sfxVolume);
144: }

1: #include "AttackParamManager.h"
2: #include <fstream>
3: #include <iostream>
5: bool AttackParamManager::Load(const std::string& filepath) {
6:     // Remembered even when the load fails, so Reload() can retry after the file is fixed.
7:     m_filepath = filepath;
9:     std::ifstream file(filepath);
10:     if (!file.is_open()) {
11:         std::cerr << "[AttackParamManager] Failed to open: " << filepath << "\n";
12:         return false;
13:     }
15:     // Parse into a fresh default set: keys missing from the file fall back to struct
16:     // defaults instead of stale runtime edits, and a failure never half-updates m_params.
17:     AttackParamSet fresh{};
18:     try {
19:         json j = json::parse(file, nullptr, true, true);
21:         if (j.contains("Phase01")) {
22:             const auto& p1 = j["Phase01"];
23:             if (p1.contains("RadialNormal"))     ParseRadialParams(p1["RadialNormal"], fresh.radialNormal);
24:             if (p1.contains("RadialContinuous")) ParseRadialParams(p1["RadialContinuous"], fresh.radialContinuous);
25:             if (p1.contains("FanNormal"))        ParseFanParams(p1["FanNormal"], fresh.fanNormal);
26:             if (p1.contains("FanContinuous"))    ParseFanParams(p1["FanContinuous"], fresh.fanContinuous);
27:             if (p1.contains("Phalanx"))          ParsePhalanxParams(p1["Phalanx"], fresh.phalanx);
28:             if (p1.contains("Rain"))             ParseRainParams(p1["Rain"], fresh.rain);
29:             if (p1.contains("RainTargeted"))     ParseRainParams(p1["RainTargeted"], fresh.rainTargeted);
30:             if (p1.contains("Ultimate"))         ParseUltimateParams(p1["Ultimate"], fresh.ultimate);
31:             if (p1.contains("Wave"))             ParseWaveParams(p1["Wave"], fresh.wave);
32:             if (p1.contains("Meteor"))           ParseMeteorParams(p1["Meteor"], fresh.meteor);
33:             if (p1.contains("Direct"))           ParseDirectParams(p1["Direct"], fresh.direct);
34:         }
36:         if (j.contains("Phase02")) {
37:             const auto& p2 = j["Phase02"];
38:             if (p2.contains("Bouncing"))         ParseBouncingParams(p2["Bouncing"], fresh.bouncing);
39:             if (p2.contains("Boomerang"))        ParseBoomerangParams(p2["Boomerang"], fresh.boomerang);
40:             if (p2.contains("Blaster"))          ParseBlasterParams(p2["Blaster"], fresh.blaster);
41:             if (p2.contains("Spear"))            ParseSpearParams(p2["Spear"], fresh.spear);
42:         }
43:     }
44:     catch (const json::exception& e) { // syntax errors and wrong value types
45:         std::cerr << "[AttackParamManager] JSON error in " << filepath << ": " << e.what() << "\n";
46:         return false;
47:     }
49:     m_params = fresh;
50:     m_loaded = fresh;
52:     std::cout << "[AttackParamManager] Parameters successfully loaded from " << filepath << "\n";
53: }

<file path="Source/Game/Entities/Boss/AttackPatterns/AttackPhalanx.h" lines="78">
1: #pragma once
2: #include "IPooledAttackPattern.h"
3: #include <DirectXMath.h>

6: // ============================================================
7: // AttackPhalanx - Phase 1 attack pattern.
8: //
9: // Boss slides to one side of the arena, summons N orbiting
10: // homing bullets in a spread fan facing the player, holds
11: // briefly, then launches them one by one.
12: //
13: // States:
14: //   1 = Moving + Charging (spawning bullets one by one)
15: //   2 = Holding (all bullets orbit, waiting before fire)

19: // ============================================================

25:     float fireDelay = 0.05f;  // Delay between each bullet launch
26:     float speed = 70.0f;
27:     float hoverRadius = 4.0f;   // Orbit radius around boss
28:     float turnSpeed = 3.0f;   // Homing turn speed after launch
29:     float smoothSpeed = 12.0f;  // Orbit slot lerp speed
30:     float postFireDelay = 1.0f;
31:     float attackMoveSpeed = 3.0f;   // Boss lateral move speed during attack
32:     float returnMoveSpeed = 2.0f;
33:     int   damage = 3;
34:     float sfxVolume = 1.0f;
35: };

14: AttackPhalanx::AttackPhalanx(const PhalanxParams& params, Player* target)
15:     : m_params(params), m_target(target) {}
17: void AttackPhalanx::StartPooled(Boss* boss, std::vector<std::unique_ptr<Bullet>>* pool) {
18:     m_pool = pool;
19:     m_boss = boss;
20:     m_state = 1;
21:     m_timer = 0.0f;
22:     m_spawned = 0;
23:     m_fired = 0;
24:     m_flareTriggered = false;
25:     m_bullets.clear();
27:     // Pick a random side to slide to
28:     std::mt19937 gen(std::random_device{}());
29:     m_targetPosition.x = (std::uniform_int_distribution<>(0, 1)(gen) == 0) ? -15.0f : 15.0f;
30:     m_targetPosition.z = 0.0f;
31:     m_moveLerpSpeed = m_params.attackMoveSpeed;
32:     m_resetLerpFlag = true;
33: }
35: void AttackPhalanx::Update(float dt, Boss* boss) {
36:     if (m_state == 0 || !m_pool || !boss) return;
38:     m_timer += dt;
39:     XMFLOAT3 bPos = boss->GetPosition();
41:     // Keep un-fired bullets orbiting the boss, aimed at the player
42:     for (int i = m_fired; i < m_spawned; ++i) {
43:         if (!m_bullets[i] || !m_bullets[i]->IsActive()) continue;
45:         XMFLOAT3 pPos = m_target->GetPosition();
46:         float dx = pPos.x - bPos.x;
47:         float dz = pPos.z - bPos.z;
48:         float angleToPlayer = atan2f(dx, dz);
50:         float totalSpread = XM_PI;
51:         float startOffset = -totalSpread * 0.5f;
52:         float step = m_params.count > 1 ? totalSpread / (float)(m_params.count - 1) : 0.0f;
53:         float bulletAngle = angleToPlayer + startOffset + (i * step);
55:         XMFLOAT3 hoverPos = bPos;
56:         hoverPos.x += sinf(bulletAngle) * m_params.hoverRadius;
57:         hoverPos.z += cosf(bulletAngle) * m_params.hoverRadius;
58:         hoverPos.y += 1.0f;
60:         XMFLOAT3 bletPos = m_bullets[i]->GetMovement()->GetPosition();
61:         float    s = m_params.smoothSpeed;
62:         bletPos.x += (hoverPos.x - bletPos.x) * s * dt;
63:         bletPos.y += (hoverPos.y - bletPos.y) * s * dt;
64:         bletPos.z += (hoverPos.z - bletPos.z) * s * dt;
65:         m_bullets[i]->GetMovement()->SetPosition(bletPos);
66:         m_bullets[i]->GetMovement()->SetRotationY(XMConvertToDegrees(angleToPlayer));
67:     }
69:     // --- State 1: Moving + Charging ---
70:     if (m_state == 1) {
71:         float dx = m_targetPosition.x - bPos.x;
72:         float dz = m_targetPosition.z - bPos.z;
74:         if ((dx * dx + dz * dz) > 1.0f) {
75:             m_timer = 0.0f; // Not at position yet, keep waiting
76:         }
77:         else {
78:             if (m_timer >= m_params.chargeDelay) {
79:                 m_timer -= m_params.chargeDelay;
81:                 for (auto& bullet : *m_pool) {
82:                     if (!bullet->IsActive()) {
83:                         bullet->SetActive(true);
84:                         bullet->ApplyMovement(bPos, { 0, 0, 0 });
85:                         bullet->SetHomingTarget(nullptr);
86:                         bullet->SetBossTarget(nullptr);
87:                         bullet->SetParabolic(false);
88:                         bullet->SetParryReturn(false);
89:                         bullet->SetRadius(0.35f);
90:                         bullet->scale = { 2.0f, 2.0f, 2.0f };
91:                         bullet->SetTurnSpeed(m_params.turnSpeed);
92:                         bullet->SetDamage(m_params.damage);
93:                         bullet->AttachVFX("Data/Effect/VFX_Boss_Phalanx_Smoke.efk", 0.3f);
95:                         m_bullets.push_back(bullet.get());
96:                         AudioManager::Instance().PlaySFX("Data/Sound/SE_Boss_Phalanx_Ready.wav", 0.1f * m_params.sfxVolume);
97:                         m_spawned++;
98:                         break;
99:                     }
100:                 }
102:                 if (m_spawned >= m_params.count) {
103:                     m_state = 2;
104:                     m_timer = 0.0f;
105:                 }
106:             }
107:         }
108:     }
109:     // --- State 2: Holding ---
110:     else if (m_state == 2) {
111:         // Switch smoke VFX to flare 0.5s before hold ends
112:         if (m_timer >= (m_params.holdDuration - 0.5f) && !m_flareTriggered) {
113:             m_flareTriggered = true;
114:             for (Bullet* b : m_bullets) {
115:                 if (b && b->IsActive()) {
116:                     b->AttachVFX("Data/Effect/VFX_Boss_Phalanx_Flare.efk", 0.3f);
117:                 }
118:             }
119:         }
120:         if (m_timer >= m_params.holdDuration) {
121:             m_state = 3;
122:             m_timer = 0.0f;
123:         }
124:     }
125:     // --- State 3: Firing ---
126:     else if (m_state == 3) {
127:         if (m_timer >= m_params.fireDelay) {
128:             m_timer -= m_params.fireDelay;
130:             if (m_fired < m_spawned) {
131:                 Bullet* b = m_bullets[m_fired];
132:                 if (b && b->IsActive()) {
133:                     b->SetHomingTarget(m_target);
135:                     XMFLOAT3 myPos = b->GetMovement()->GetPosition();
136:                     XMFLOAT3 pPos = m_target->GetPosition();
137:                     float dx = pPos.x - myPos.x;
138:                     float dz = pPos.z - myPos.z;
139:                     float dist = sqrtf(dx * dx + dz * dz);
141:                     XMFLOAT3 dir = (dist > 0.001f)
142:                         ? XMFLOAT3{ dx / dist, 0.0f, dz / dist }
143:                     : XMFLOAT3{ 0.0f, 0.0f, 1.0f };
145:                     b->Fire(myPos, dir, m_params.speed);
146:                 }
147:                 AudioManager::Instance().PlaySFX("Data/Sound/SE_Boss_Phalanx_Shoot.wav", 0.1f * m_params.sfxVolume);
148:                 m_fired++;
149:             }
151:             if (m_fired >= m_spawned) {
152:                 m_state = 4;
153:                 m_timer = 0.0f;
154:                 m_bullets.clear();
155:             }
156:         }
157:     }
158:     // --- State 4: Post-fire pause ---
159:     else if (m_state == 4) {
160:         if (m_timer >= m_params.postFireDelay) {
161:             m_state = 5;
162:             m_targetPosition = { 0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f };
163:             m_moveLerpSpeed = m_params.returnMoveSpeed;
164:             m_resetLerpFlag = true;
165:         }
166:     }
167:     // --- State 5: Returning to center ---
168:     else if (m_state == 5) {
169:         XMFLOAT3 pos = boss->GetPosition();
170:         float dx = m_targetPosition.x - pos.x;
171:         float dz = m_targetPosition.z - pos.z;
172:         if ((dx * dx + dz * dz) < 1.0f) {
173:             m_state = 0;
174:             m_bullets.clear();
175:         }
176:     }
177: }

<file path="Source/Game/Entities/Boss/AttackPatterns/AttackRadial.cpp" lines="104">
1: #pragma execution_character_set("utf-8")
2: #include "AttackRadial.h"
3: #include "Boss.h"
4: #include "System/AudioManager.h"
5: #include <DirectXMath.h>
7: using namespace DirectX;
9: AttackRadial::AttackRadial(const RadialParams& params)
10:     : m_params(params) {}
12: void AttackRadial::StartPooled(Boss* boss, std::vector<std::unique_ptr<Bullet>>* pool) {
13:     m_pool = pool;
14:     m_boss = boss;
15:     m_active = true;
16:     m_burstsFired = 0;
17:     m_burstTimer = 0.0f;
18:     m_lifeTimer = 0.0f;
20:     // Fire first burst immediately on start
21:     FireBurst(boss, 0.0f);
22:     m_burstsFired++;
23: }
25: void AttackRadial::Update(float dt, Boss* boss) {
26:     if (!m_active || !m_pool) return;
28:     // ========================================================
29:     // LOGIKA PENGHENTIAN SERANGAN (DURATION vs BURST COUNT)
30:     // ========================================================
31:     if (m_params.activeDuration > 0.0f) {
32:         // Mode Stream: Berhenti jika waktu durasi sudah habis
33:         m_lifeTimer += dt;
34:         if (m_lifeTimer >= m_params.activeDuration) {
35:             m_active = false;
36:             return;
37:         }
38:     }
39:     else {
40:         // Mode Normal: Berhenti jika jumlah tembakan sudah mencapai batas
41:         if (m_burstsFired >= m_params.burstCount) {
42:             m_active = false;
43:             return;
44:         }
45:     }
47:     // ========================================================
48:     // LOGIKA PENEMBAKAN
49:     // ========================================================
50:     m_burstTimer += dt;
51:     if (m_burstTimer >= m_params.burstDelay) {
52:         m_burstTimer -= m_params.burstDelay;
54:         // Alternate half-step offsets to create an interlocking pattern
55:         float step = XM_2PI / (float)m_params.count;
56:         float offset = (m_burstsFired % 2 == 1) ? (step * 0.5f) : 0.0f;
58:         FireBurst(boss, offset);
59:         m_burstsFired++;
60:     }
61: }
63: void AttackRadial::Render(ID3D11DeviceContext* context, Camera* camera, Boss* boss) {
64:     // Bullets are rendered by the phase's central render loop
65: }
67: void AttackRadial::Stop(Boss* boss) {
68:     m_active = false;
69: }
71: bool AttackRadial::IsFinished() const {
72:     return !m_active;
73: }
75: // ============================================================
76: // Internal
77: // ============================================================
79: void AttackRadial::FireBurst(Boss* boss, float angleOffset) {
80:     if (!m_pool || !boss) return;
82:     int   fired = 0;
83:     float angleStep = XM_2PI / (float)m_params.count;
85:     for (auto& bullet : *m_pool) {

170: void AttackRain::Render(ID3D11DeviceContext* context, Camera* camera, Boss* boss) {
171:     if (!m_active || !boss || !boss->GetWindowSystem()) return;
173:     auto shapeRenderer = Graphics::Instance().GetShapeRenderer();
174:     float actualW = GetActualWidth();
175:     float actualD = GetActualDepth();
176:     float halfW = actualW * 0.5f;
177:     float halfD = actualD * 0.5f;
179:     auto drawRect = [&](XMFLOAT3 center, float customAlpha) {
180:         // Two opposite corners of the zone on the ground (y = 0), projected through
181:         // the camera of the window being drawn. +Z is up on screen, so the far edge
182:         // is the top of the rect.
183:         const XMFLOAT2 topLeft{ WorldToViewportPixels(context, *camera,
184:             { center.x - halfW, 0.0f, center.z + halfD }) };
185:         const XMFLOAT2 bottomRight{ WorldToViewportPixels(context, *camera,
186:             { center.x + halfW, 0.0f, center.z - halfD }) };
188:         m_zonePrimitive->Rect(topLeft.x, topLeft.y,
189:             bottomRight.x - topLeft.x, bottomRight.y - topLeft.y,
190:             0.0f, 0.0f,
191:             0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f, customAlpha);
192:         };
194:     int zoneIndex = 0;
195:     int maxDrops = (m_mode == RainMode::DualPillar) ? 800 : 400;
197:     for (const auto& zone : m_zones) {
198:         if (zone.state == 1 || zone.state == 2 || zone.state == 3) {
200:             // 1. GAMBAR KOTAK MERAH 2D (Render Primitive Original)
201:             float alpha = 0.0f;
202:             if (zone.state == 1) {
203:                 float blink = (sinf(zone.stateTimer * 20.0f) + 1.0f) * 0.5f;
204:                 alpha = 0.2f + (blink * 0.4f);
205:             }
206:             else if (zone.state == 2) {
207:                 alpha = 0.6f;
208:             }
209:             else if (zone.state == 3) {
210:                 alpha = 0.6f * (1.0f - (zone.stateTimer / 1.0f));
211:             }
213:             drawRect(zone.center1, alpha);
214:             if (m_mode == RainMode::DualPillar) drawRect(zone.center2, alpha);
215:             m_zonePrimitive->Render(context);
217:             // 2. GAMBAR HUJAN VFX 3D
218:             if (zone.state == 2 || zone.state == 3) {
219:                 std::mt19937 gen(1337 + zoneIndex); // Seed berbeda tiap zona agar tidak numpuk
220:                 std::uniform_real_distribution<float> distSpeed(m_params.minSpeed, m_params.maxSpeed);
221:                 std::uniform_real_distribution<float> distSpawn(0.0f, m_params.activeDuration);
223:                 float globalTime = (zone.state == 2) ? zone.stateTimer : (m_params.activeDuration + zone.stateTimer);
224:                 int handleOffset = zoneIndex * maxDrops;
226:                 for (int i = 0; i < maxDrops; ++i) {
227:                     float speed = distSpeed(gen);
228:                     float spawnTime = distSpawn(gen);
229:                     float localTime = globalTime - spawnTime;
230:                     if (localTime < 0.0f) continue;
232:                     XMFLOAT3 dropPos = {};
233:                     bool     isActive = false;
234:                     float    yawAngle = 0.0f;
236:                     if (m_mode == RainMode::DualPillar) {
237:                         XMFLOAT3 activeCenter = (i % 2 == 0) ? zone.center1 : zone.center2;
238:                         std::uniform_real_distribution<float> distX(activeCenter.x - halfW, activeCenter.x + halfW);
239:                         float rx = distX(gen);
240:                         float topEdge = activeCenter.z + halfD + 5.0f;
241:                         float bottomEdge = activeCenter.z - halfD;
242:                         float z = topEdge - (localTime * speed);
243:                         if (z >= bottomEdge) {
244:                             dropPos = { rx, 1.0f, z };
245:                             isActive = true;
246:                             yawAngle = XM_PI;
247:                         }
248:                     }
249:                     else if (m_mode == RainMode::VerticalSweep || m_mode == RainMode::Targeted) {
250:                         std::uniform_real_distribution<float> distX(zone.center1.x - halfW, zone.center1.x + halfW);
251:                         float rx = distX(gen);
252:                         float topEdge = zone.center1.z + halfD + 5.0f;
253:                         float bottomEdge = zone.center1.z - halfD;
254:                         float z = topEdge - (localTime * speed);
255:                         if (z >= bottomEdge) {
256:                             dropPos = { rx, 1.0f, z };
257:                             isActive = true;
258:                             yawAngle = XM_PI;
259:                         }
260:                     }
261:                     else { // HorizontalSweep
262:                         std::uniform_real_distribution<float> distZ(zone.center1.z - halfD, zone.center1.z + halfD);
263:                         float rz = distZ(gen);
264:                         float dir = m_sweepDir;
265:                         float startX = (dir > 0) ? (zone.center1.x - halfW - 5.0f) : (zone.center1.x + halfW + 5.0f);
266:                         float endX = (dir > 0) ? (zone.center1.x + halfW) : (zone.center1.x - halfW);
267:                         float x = startX + (localTime * speed * dir);
268:                         bool inside = (dir > 0) ? (x <= endX) : (x >= endX);
269:                         if (inside) {
270:                             dropPos = { x, 1.0f, rz };
271:                             isActive = true;
272:                             yawAngle = (dir > 0) ? XM_PIDIV2 : -XM_PIDIV2;
273:                         }
274:                     }
276:                     int hIdx = handleOffset + i;
277:                     if (isActive) {
278:                         shapeRenderer->DrawSphere(dropPos, 0.4f, { 1.0f, 0.4f, 0.0f, 1.0f });
280:                         if (m_vfxHandles[hIdx] == -1) {
281:                             m_vfxHandles[hIdx] = EffectManager::Instance().Play(
282:                                 "Data/Effect/VFX_Boss_Asgore_Rain.efk", dropPos, 0.4f);
283:                             float rotX = XMConvertToRadians(90.0f);
284:                             EffectManager::Instance().SetRotation(
285:                                 m_vfxHandles[hIdx], { rotX, yawAngle, 0.0f });
286:                         }
287:                         else {
288:                             EffectManager::Instance().SetPosition(m_vfxHandles[hIdx], dropPos);
289:                         }
290:                     }
291:                     else {
292:                         if (m_vfxHandles[hIdx] != -1) {
293:                             EffectManager::Instance().Stop(m_vfxHandles[hIdx]);
294:                             m_vfxHandles[hIdx] = -1;
295:                         }
296:                     }
297:                 }
298:             }
299:         }
300:         zoneIndex++;
301:     }
302: }
304: void AttackRain::Stop(Boss* boss) {

306:     m_active = false;
307: }

19:     // Prepare randomized spawn indices
20:     m_spawnIndices.clear();
21:     for (int i = 0; i < m_params.count; ++i) {
22:         m_spawnIndices.push_back(i);
23:     }

28: void AttackSpears::Update(float dt, Boss* boss) {
29:     if (!boss || !boss->GetWindowSystem()) return;
31:     // 1. Spawning Rainbow Arc
32:     if (m_isSpawning) {
33:         m_spawnTimer -= dt;
34:         if (m_spawnTimer <= 0.0f) {
35:             m_spawnTimer = m_params.spawnDelay;
37:             float angleRange = m_params.arcMaxAngle - m_params.arcMinAngle;
38:             float step = (m_params.count > 1) ? (angleRange / (m_params.count - 1)) : 0.0f;
40:             int randomPositionIndex = m_spawnIndices[m_spawnedCount];
41:             float angleDeg = m_params.arcMinAngle + (randomPositionIndex * step);
42:             float rad = XMConvertToRadians(angleDeg);
44:             DirectX::XMFLOAT3 spawnPos = {
45:                 m_params.arcCenterX + cosf(rad) * m_params.arcRadius,
46:                 0.0f,
47:                 m_params.arcCenterZ + sinf(rad) * m_params.arcRadius
48:             };
50:             UndyneSpearWindow spear;
51:             spear.bullet = std::make_unique<Bullet>();
52:             spear.bullet->SetActive(true);
53:             spear.bullet->ApplyMovement(spawnPos, { 0, 0, 0 });
54:             spear.bullet->SetDamage(m_params.damage);
55:             spear.bullet->SetRadius(0.8f);
57:             spear.windowName = "Spear_" + std::to_string(rand() % 100000) + "_" + std::to_string(m_spawnedCount);
59:             TrackedWindowConfig config = { spear.windowName, "Spear.exe", 100, 100, 10 };
60:             boss->GetWindowSystem()->AddTrackedWindow(config, [raw = spear.bullet.get()]() {
61:                 return raw->GetMovement()->GetPosition();
62:                 });
64:             m_spears.push_back(std::move(spear));
66:             if (++m_spawnedCount >= m_params.count) {
67:                 m_isSpawning = false;
68:             }
69:         }
70:     }
72:     // 2. Spear Hover & Homing Update
73:     for (auto& spear : m_spears) {
74:         if (spear.isPreparedForDestroy) continue;
76:         spear.timer += dt;
77:         DirectX::XMFLOAT3 bPos = spear.bullet->GetMovement()->GetPosition();
79:         if (spear.state == 0 && m_playerTarget) {
80:             DirectX::XMFLOAT3 pPos = m_playerTarget->GetPosition();
81:             float dx = pPos.x - bPos.x;
82:             float dz = pPos.z - bPos.z;
83:             float dist = sqrtf(dx * dx + dz * dz);
85:             if (dist > 0.001f) {
86:                 spear.lockDir = { dx / dist, 0.0f, dz / dist };
87:                 spear.bullet->GetMovement()->SetRotationY(XMConvertToDegrees(atan2f(dx, dz)));
88:             }
90:             if (spear.timer >= m_params.hoverDuration) {
91:                 spear.state = 2; // Launch!
92:                 spear.timer = 0.0f;
93:                 spear.currentSpeed = m_params.startSpeed;
94:             }
95:         }
96:         else if (spear.state == 2) {
97:             spear.currentSpeed += m_params.acceleration * dt;
98:             if (spear.currentSpeed > m_params.maxSpeed) spear.currentSpeed = m_params.maxSpeed;
100:             spear.bullet->ApplyMovement(bPos, {
101:                 spear.lockDir.x * spear.currentSpeed,
102:                 0.0f,
103:                 spear.lockDir.z * spear.currentSpeed
104:                 });
105:             spear.bullet->Update(dt, nullptr);
107:             if (bPos.x < -40.0f || bPos.x > 40.0f || bPos.z < -40.0f || bPos.z > 40.0f) {
108:                 spear.isPreparedForDestroy = true;
109:                 spear.bullet->SetActive(false);
111:                 auto extracted = boss->GetWindowSystem()->ExtractForPool(spear.windowName);
112:                 if (extracted && extracted->window) {
113:                     WindowManager::Instance().DestroyWindow(extracted->window);
114:                 }
115:             }
116:         }
117:     }
118: }

171: // ShatterBijuudama — Called externally on parry
172: // ============================================================
174: void AttackUltimate::ShatterBijuudama(XMFLOAT3 parryPos, Boss* boss) {
175:     if (!m_pool || !boss) return;
177:     if (m_ball) {
178:         m_ball->SetActive(false);
179:         m_ball = nullptr;
180:     }
182:     CameraController::Instance().AddTrauma(0.8f);
183:     AudioManager::Instance().PlaySFX("Data/Sound/SE_Player_Parry_Boss.wav", 0.6f);
185:     std::mt19937 gen(std::random_device{}());
186:     std::uniform_int_distribution<>   distCount(m_params.shatterMinFragments, m_params.shatterMaxFragments);
187:     std::uniform_real_distribution<float> distSize(m_params.shatterMinRadius, m_params.shatterMaxRadius);
188:     std::uniform_real_distribution<float> distDur(m_params.shatterMinDuration, m_params.shatterMaxDuration);
189:     std::uniform_real_distribution<float> distAngle(-XM_PIDIV2, XM_PIDIV2);
191:     int fragments = distCount(gen);
192:     int spawned = 0;
194:     XMFLOAT3 bossPos = boss->GetPosition();
195:     float baseAngle = atan2f(bossPos.x - parryPos.x, bossPos.z - parryPos.z);
197:     for (auto& bullet : *m_pool) {
198:         if (!bullet->IsActive()) {
199:             bullet->SetActive(true);
200:             bullet->ApplyMovement(parryPos, { 0, 0, 0 });
201:             bullet->SetBossTarget(boss);
202:             bullet->SetParabolic(true);
203:             bullet->SetParryReturn(false);
204:             bullet->SetTurnSpeed(8.0f);
206:             float r = distSize(gen);
207:             bullet->SetRadius(r);
208:             bullet->scale = { r * 3.0f, r * 3.0f, r * 3.0f };
210:             float spreadAngle = baseAngle + distAngle(gen);
211:             XMFLOAT3 ctrlPoint = {
212:                 parryPos.x + sinf(spreadAngle) * m_params.shatterCurveOffset,
213:                 parryPos.y,
214:                 parryPos.z + cosf(spreadAngle) * m_params.shatterCurveOffset
215:             };
216:             bullet->SetParabolaParams(parryPos, ctrlPoint, distDur(gen));
217:             AudioManager::Instance().PlaySFX(
218:                 "Data/Sound/SE_Player_Parry_Boss.wav", 0.015f * m_params.sfxVolume);
220:             if (++spawned >= fragments) break;
221:         }
222:     }
224:     CancelCharge();
225:     m_ball = nullptr;
226:     m_state = State::Recovering;
227:     m_recoveryTimer = 0.0f;
228: }

245:             float dx = pPos.x - bPos.x;
246:             float dz = pPos.z - bPos.z;

249:             if (dist > 0.001f) {
250:                 float spd = m_params.shootSpeed;

22:     if (!m_active || !m_pool) return;
24:     m_waveTimer += dt;
25:     if (m_waveTimer >= m_params.waveDelay) {
26:         m_waveTimer -= m_params.waveDelay;
28:         FireWave(m_nextIsRight);
30:         m_nextIsRight = !m_nextIsRight; // Balikkan arah untuk gelombang berikutnya
32:         if (++m_wavesFired >= m_params.waves) {
33:             m_active = false;
34:         }
35:     }

50: // ============================================================
51: // Internal Logic
52: // ============================================================
53: void AttackWave::FireWave(bool fromRight) {
54:     if (!m_pool) return;
56:     int fired = 0;
57:     // Kanan = Track Ganjil (1, 3, 5...), Kiri = Track Genap (0, 2, 4...)
58:     int startIndex = fromRight ? 1 : 0;
60:     for (auto& bullet : *m_pool) {
61:         if (!bullet->IsActive()) {
62:             int trackIndex = startIndex + (fired * 2);
64:             // Cegah peluru spawn jika melewati batas total track
65:             if (trackIndex >= m_params.trackCount) break;
67:             // Kalkulasi posisi spawn di grid/track
68:             float zPos = m_params.startZ + (trackIndex * m_params.trackSpacing);
69:             float xPos = fromRight ? m_params.spawnX : -m_params.spawnX;
71:             DirectX::XMFLOAT3 spawnPos = { xPos, 1.0f, zPos };
72:             DirectX::XMFLOAT3 direction = { fromRight ? -1.0f : 1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f };
74:             // Setup bullet
75:             bullet->SetRadius(0.35f);
76:             bullet->scale = { 1.5f, 1.5f, 1.5f };
77:             bullet->SetHomingTarget(nullptr);
78:             bullet->SetBossTarget(nullptr);
79:             bullet->SetParabolic(false);
80:             bullet->SetParryReturn(false);
81:             bullet->SetTurnSpeed(8.0f);
82:             bullet->SetDamage(m_params.damage);
84:             bullet->Fire(spawnPos, direction, m_params.speed);
86:             if (++fired >= m_params.bulletsPerWave) break;
87:         }

9: // Base interface for all modular boss attacks to enforce SRP and DRY principles.
10: class IBossAttackPattern {
11: public:
12:     virtual ~IBossAttackPattern() = default;
14:     // Initializes resources, tracking windows, and VFX for the attack.
15:     virtual void Start(Boss* boss) = 0;
17:     // Processes bullet physics, window tracking, and spawning logic.
18:     virtual void Update(float dt, Boss* boss) = 0;
20:     // Renders specific 3D models or UI related to this attack.
21:     virtual void Render(ID3D11DeviceContext* context, Camera* camera, Boss* boss) = 0;
23:     // Cleans up tracking windows and VFX if the attack is forcefully stopped.
24:     virtual void Stop(Boss* boss) = 0;
26:     // Returns true when all projectiles are destroyed and the attack is over.
27:     virtual bool IsFinished() const = 0;
29:     // Returns active bullets for the global collision manager.
30:     virtual std::vector<Bullet*> GetActiveProjectiles() const = 0;
31: };

7: // ============================================================
8: // IPooledAttackPattern
9: //
10: // Extended interface for attack patterns that operate on a
11: // shared bullet pool owned by the parent phase.
12: //
13: // Use this for Phase 1 attacks (no OS windows, shared pool).
14: // Use IBossAttackPattern directly for Phase 2 attacks
15: // (self-owned bullets + OS windows).
16: // ============================================================
17: class IPooledAttackPattern : public IBossAttackPattern {
18: public:
19:     virtual ~IPooledAttackPattern() = default;
21:     // Called instead of Start(boss) when a shared pool is available.
22:     // Implementations should store the pointer and use it in Update().
23:     virtual void StartPooled(Boss* boss, std::vector<std::unique_ptr<Bullet>>* pool) = 0;
25:     // Base Start() should not be used directly for pooled patterns.
26:     // Provided as a no-op fallback to satisfy IBossAttackPattern.
27:     void Start(Boss* boss) override {}
28: };

138: void BossPhase01::Update(float dt, Boss* boss) {
139:     if (!boss) return;
141:     if (m_aiTarget && m_aiTarget->GetHP() <= 0) {
142:         AudioManager::Instance().StopMusic();
143:         if (boss->GetMainWindow())
144:             SDL_HideWindow(boss->GetMainWindow()->GetSDLWindow());
145:         return;
146:     }
148:     if (m_bossHP <= 0) {
149:         UpdateDeathSequence(dt, boss);
150:         return;
151:     }
153: #if !DEBUG_SKIP_INTRO
154:     if (m_isOpeningEvent) {
155:         if (m_dialogueBox && m_dialogueBox->IsActive()) {
156:             m_dialogueBox->Update(dt);
157:             int idx = m_dialogueBox->GetCurrentDialogueIndex();
159:             if (idx == 0) {
160:                 boss->SetWindowTitle("mat_grass.png");
161:                 boss->SetGridGrowthLimit(1.0f);
162:                 boss->SetFaceSpriteVisible(false);
163:             }
164:             else if (idx == 1) {
165:                 if (!m_hasSpawnedWindow) {
166:                     boss->SpawnHeadWindow();
167:                     m_hasSpawnedWindow = true;
168:                 }
169:                 float limit = boss->GetGridGrowthLimit();
170:                 if (limit < 8.0f)
171:                     boss->SetGridGrowthLimit(min(limit + dt * 3.5f, 8.0f));
172:                 boss->SetFaceSpriteVisible(false);
173:             }
174:             else if (idx == 2) {
175:                 boss->SetGridGrowthLimit(8.0f);
176:                 boss->SetFaceSpriteVisible(true);
177:             }
178:             return;
179:         }
180:         else {
181:             m_isOpeningEvent = false;
182:             m_aiEnabled = true;
183:             if (m_aiTarget) m_aiTarget->SetInputEnabled(true);
185:             float sfxVol = ParamManager::Instance().GetUltimateParams().sfxVolume;
186:             AudioManager::Instance().PlayMusic(
187:                 "Data/Sound/BGM_Boss_Phase_01.wav",
188:                 0.05f * sfxVol, true);
189:         }
190:     }
191: #endif
193:     UpdateGlitchVFX(dt, boss);
195:     // ----- AI Director -----
196:     if (m_ai) {
197:         m_ai->SetEnabled(m_aiEnabled);
198:         m_ai->Update(dt, boss);
199:     }
201:     for (auto& attack : m_activeAttacks) {
202:         attack->Update(dt, boss);
204:         if (auto* phalanx = dynamic_cast<AttackPhalanx*>(attack.get())) {
205:             if (phalanx->ShouldResetLerp()) {
206:                 m_currentMoveLerpSpeed = 0.0f;
207:                 phalanx->ClearResetFlag();
208:             }
209:             m_targetPosition = phalanx->GetTargetPosition();
210:             m_moveLerpSpeed = phalanx->GetMoveLerpSpeed();
211:         }
212:         else if (auto* ultimate = dynamic_cast<AttackUltimate*>(attack.get())) {
213:             if (ultimate->ShouldResetLerp()) {
214:                 m_currentMoveLerpSpeed = 0.0f;
215:                 ultimate->ClearResetFlag();
216:             }
217:             m_targetPosition = ultimate->GetTargetPosition();
218:             m_moveLerpSpeed = ultimate->GetMoveLerpSpeed();
219:         }
220:     }
222:     for (auto it = m_activeAttacks.begin(); it != m_activeAttacks.end(); ) {
223:         if ((*it)->IsFinished()) { it = m_activeAttacks.erase(it); }
224:         else { ++it; }
225:     }
227:     if (m_rainAttack) {
228:         m_rainAttack->Update(dt, boss);
229:         if (m_rainAttack->IsFinished())
230:             m_rainAttack.reset();
231:     }
233:     UpdateIdleHover(dt, boss);
234:     UpdateBossMovement(dt, boss);
236:     auto* ws = boss->GetWindowSystem();
237:     if (ws) {
238:         float newSize = 5.0f * ws->GetPixelToUnitRatio();
239:         boss->SetBaseWindowSize(newSize, newSize);
240:         boss->SetWindowSize(newSize, newSize);
241:     }
243:     UpdateBulletPool(dt, boss);
244: }
246: void BossPhase01::Render(ID3D11DeviceContext* context, Camera* currentCamera, Boss* boss) {
247:     if (!currentCamera) return;
249:     auto renderer = Graphics::Instance().GetModelRenderer();
250:     auto shapeRenderer = Graphics::Instance().GetShapeRenderer();
252:     for (auto& bullet : m_bulletPool) {
253:         if (!bullet->IsActive()) continue;
255:         XMFLOAT4 color = AttackParamManager::Instance().GetRadialNormalParams().color;
257:         if (bullet->GetBossTarget() != nullptr)
258:             color = AttackParamManager::Instance().GetUltimateParams().ballColor;
259:         else {
260:             XMFLOAT3 vel = bullet->GetVelocity();
261:             float speedSq = vel.x * vel.x + vel.z * vel.z;
262:             if (speedSq > 900.0f)
263:                 color = { 1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f, 1.0f };
264:         }
266:         renderer->Draw(ShaderId::Phong, bullet->GetModel(), color);
267:     }
269:     for (auto& attack : m_activeAttacks) {
270:         attack->Render(context, currentCamera, boss);
271:     }
272:     if (m_rainAttack)
273:         m_rainAttack->Render(context, currentCamera, boss);
275:     if (m_dialogueBox && m_dialogueBox->IsActive())
276:         m_dialogueBox->Render3D(context, currentCamera);

279: void BossPhase01::AddPooledAttack(std::unique_ptr<IPooledAttackPattern> attack) {
280:     if (!attack) return;

292:     }
293:     else if (dynamic_cast<AttackUltimate*>(attack.get())) {
294:         RainParams p = AttackParamManager::Instance().GetRainParams();
295:         p.activeDuration = 4.0f;
296:         TriggerRain(p, RainMode::DualPillar, true, 1.0f);
297:     }
299:     m_activeAttacks.push_back(std::move(attack));
300: }

331: void BossPhase01::TakeDamage(int damage, XMFLOAT3 hitPos) {
332:     if (m_bossHP <= 0) return;
333:     m_bossHP = max(0, m_bossHP - damage);
334:     m_hitFlashTimer = 0.05f;
336:     CameraController::Instance().AddTrauma(0.3f);
337:     AudioManager::Instance().PlaySFX("Data/Sound/SE_Boss_Hit.wav", 0.1f);
338:     EffectManager::Instance().Play("Data/Effect/VFX_Boss_Hit.efk", hitPos, 0.3f);
339: }
341: void BossPhase01::UpdateIdleHover(float dt, Boss* boss) {
342:     bool isFloating = m_activeAttacks.empty() || (
343:         !dynamic_cast<AttackPhalanx*>(m_activeAttacks.front().get()) &&
344:         !dynamic_cast<AttackUltimate*>(m_activeAttacks.front().get()));
346:     if (isFloating) {
347:         m_idleHoverTimer += dt;
348:         m_targetPosition.x = sinf(m_idleHoverTimer * 0.8f) * 6.0f;
349:         m_targetPosition.z = cosf(m_idleHoverTimer * 1.1f) * 3.0f;
350:         m_moveLerpSpeed += (1.5f - m_moveLerpSpeed) * 2.0f * dt;
351:     }
352: }
354: void BossPhase01::UpdateBossMovement(float dt, Boss* boss) {
355:     m_currentMoveLerpSpeed += (m_moveLerpSpeed - m_currentMoveLerpSpeed) * m_moveAcceleration * dt;
357:     XMFLOAT3 pos = boss->GetPosition();
358:     pos.x += (m_targetPosition.x - pos.x) * m_currentMoveLerpSpeed * dt;
359:     pos.z += (m_targetPosition.z - pos.z) * m_currentMoveLerpSpeed * dt;
360:     boss->SetPosition(pos);
361: }
363: void BossPhase01::UpdateBulletPool(float dt, Boss* boss) {
364:     // Bullets are recycled once they are this far outside the arena edge.
365:     constexpr float k_despawnMargin{ 30.0f };
366:     const float limitX{ (Beyond::Config::ARENA_WIDTH_UNITS * 0.5f) + k_despawnMargin };
367:     const float limitZ{ (Beyond::Config::ARENA_HEIGHT_UNITS * 0.5f) + k_despawnMargin };
369:     for (auto& bullet : m_bulletPool) {
370:         if (!bullet->IsActive()) continue;
371:         bullet->Update(dt, nullptr);
373:         XMFLOAT3 bp = bullet->GetMovement()->GetPosition();
374:         if (bp.x < -limitX || bp.x > limitX || bp.z < -limitZ || bp.z > limitZ)
375:             bullet->SetActive(false);
376:     }
377: }
379: void BossPhase01::UpdateGlitchVFX(float dt, Boss* boss) {
380:     m_bossGlitchVfxTimer += dt;
382:     if (m_bossGlitchVfxTimer >= 2.0f) {
383:         m_bossGlitchVfxTimer -= 2.0f;
385:         if (m_bossGlitchVfxHandle != -1 &&
386:             EffectManager::Instance().IsPlaying(m_bossGlitchVfxHandle)) {
387:             EffectManager::Instance().Stop(m_bossGlitchVfxHandle);
388:         }
390:         XMFLOAT3 spawnPos = boss->GetPosition();
391:         spawnPos.y += 0.05f;
392:         m_bossGlitchVfxHandle = EffectManager::Instance().Play(
393:             "Data/Effect/VFX_Boss_Glitch.efk", spawnPos, 0.6f);
395:         if (m_bossGlitchVfxHandle != -1) {
396:             float rotX = XMConvertToRadians(90.0f);
397:             EffectManager::Instance().SetRotation(
398:                 m_bossGlitchVfxHandle, { rotX, 0.0f, 0.0f });
399:         }
400:     }
402:     if (m_bossGlitchVfxHandle != -1 &&
403:         EffectManager::Instance().IsPlaying(m_bossGlitchVfxHandle)) {
404:         XMFLOAT3 trackPos = boss->GetPosition();
405:         trackPos.y += 0.05f;
406:         EffectManager::Instance().SetPosition(m_bossGlitchVfxHandle, trackPos);
407:     }
408: }
410: void BossPhase01::UpdateDeathSequence(float dt, Boss* boss) {

289:     }

295: void BossPhase02::ReplayAnimation() {
296:     m_wingState = WingState::Expanding;
297:     m_wingStateTimer = 0.0f;
298:     m_wingFlickerTimer = 0.0f;
299:     if (m_fxWindow) m_fxWindow->SetTargetFPS(0.0f);
300:     GenerateButterflyWings();
301: }
303: void BossPhase02::GenerateButterflyWings() {
304:     m_leftWingData.clear();
305:     m_rightWingData.clear();
306:     std::mt19937 gen(m_wingSeed);
307:     std::uniform_real_distribution<float> dist(0.0f, 1.0f);
308:     const int NODES_PER_WING = 120;
310:     for (int i = 0; i < NODES_PER_WING; ++i) {
311:         float linearT = (float)i / NODES_PER_WING;
312:         float t = pow(linearT, 2.0f);
313:         float angle = t * DirectX::XM_PI;
314:         float rEdge = (exp(cos(angle)) - 2 * cos(4 * angle) - pow(sin(angle / 12), 5)) * 3.0f;
315:         float randomFill = pow(dist(gen), 0.3f);
316:         float r = (i % 5 == 0) ? rEdge : (rEdge * randomFill);
317:         float scatterX = (dist(gen) - 0.5f) * 1.5f;
318:         float scatterY = (dist(gen) - 0.5f) * 1.5f;
320:         WingNode node;
321:         node.localOffset = { 0.0f, 0.0f };
322:         node.targetOffset.y = (cos(angle) * r) + scatterY;
323:         node.flapOffset = t * 2.0f;
325:         float randomScale = 0.5f + dist(gen);
326:         float baseSize = 45.0f;
327:         node.size = { baseSize * randomScale, baseSize * randomScale };
329:         node.targetOffset.x = -abs(sin(angle) * r) + scatterX;
330:         m_leftWingData.push_back(node);
331:         node.targetOffset.x = abs(sin(angle) * r) - scatterX;
332:         m_rightWingData.push_back(node);
333:     }
335:     std::shuffle(m_leftWingData.begin(), m_leftWingData.end(), gen);
336:     std::shuffle(m_rightWingData.begin(), m_rightWingData.end(), gen);
338:     for (size_t i = 0; i < m_leftWingData.size(); ++i) {
339:         float linearDelay = ((float)i / m_leftWingData.size()) * m_spawnDuration;
340:         m_leftWingData[i].spawnDelay = max(0.0f, linearDelay + (dist(gen) - 0.5f) * m_spawnChaos);
341:     }
342:     for (size_t i = 0; i < m_rightWingData.size(); ++i) {
343:         float linearDelay = ((float)i / m_rightWingData.size()) * m_spawnDuration;
344:         m_rightWingData[i].spawnDelay = max(0.0f, linearDelay + (dist(gen) - 0.5f) * m_spawnChaos);
345:     }
346: }
348: void BossPhase02::AddAttack(std::unique_ptr<IBossAttackPattern> attack) {

355: void BossPhase02::Update(float dt, Boss* boss) {
356:     m_glitchTimer += dt;
358:     if (boss && boss->GetWindowSystem()) {
359:         if (auto* blockerWin = boss->GetWindowSystem()->GetTrackedWindow("click_blocker")) {
360:             if (blockerWin->window && blockerWin->window->GetSDLWindow()) {
361:                 SDL_RaiseWindow(blockerWin->window->GetSDLWindow());
362:             }
363:         }
364:     }
366:     if (m_aiTarget && m_aiTarget->GetHP() <= 0) {
367:         // Hentikan semua BGM yang sedang berjalan
368:         AudioManager::Instance().StopMusic();
370:         // Sembunyikan main window boss jika perlu agar transisi bersih
371:         if (boss && boss->GetMainWindow()) {
372:             SDL_HideWindow(boss->GetMainWindow()->GetSDLWindow());
373:         }
375:         // Return segera agar logika boss/AI di bawahnya tidak dieksekusi
376:         return;
377:     }
379:     // =========================================================
380:     // [DEATH SEQUENCE] Boss Mati
381:     // =========================================================
382:     if (m_bossHP <= 0) {

385:             m_deathTimer = 0.0f;
386:             m_aiEnabled = false;
388:             DirectX::XMFLOAT3 deathVfxPos = boss->GetPosition();
389:             deathVfxPos.y += 5.0f;

391:             if (m_deathVfxHandle != -1) {
392:                 float rotX = DirectX::XMConvertToRadians(90.0f);
393:                 EffectManager::Instance().SetRotation(m_deathVfxHandle, { rotX, 0.0f, 0.0f });
394:             }
395:         }
397:         m_deathTimer += dt;
399:         if (m_deathVfxHandle != -1 && EffectManager::Instance().IsPlaying(m_deathVfxHandle)) {
400:             DirectX::XMFLOAT3 trackPos = boss->GetPosition();
401:             trackPos.y += 5.0f;
402:             EffectManager::Instance().SetPosition(m_deathVfxHandle, trackPos);
403:         }
405:         if (m_deathTimer >= 7.0f) {
406:             if (!m_deathCleanupDone) {
407:                 m_deathCleanupDone = true;
408:                 if (m_deathVfxHandle != -1) {
409:                     EffectManager::Instance().Stop(m_deathVfxHandle);
410:                     m_deathVfxHandle = -1;
411:                 }
412:                 AudioManager::Instance().StopMusic();
414:                 if (boss && boss->GetWindowSystem() && boss->GetWindowSystem()->GetTrackedWindow("navi_head")) {
415:                     boss->GetWindowSystem()->RemoveTrackedWindow("navi_head");
416:                 }
418:                 if (boss && boss->GetMainWindow() && boss->GetMainWindow()->GetSDLWindow()) {
419:                     SDL_HideWindow(boss->GetMainWindow()->GetSDLWindow());
420:                 }
421:             }
422:             return;
423:         }
425:         Beyond::Window* mainWindow = WindowManager::Instance().GetWindowByIndex(0);
426:         if (mainWindow && mainWindow->GetSDLWindow()) {
427:             SDL_Window* sdlWin = mainWindow->GetSDLWindow();
428:             SDL_ShowWindow(sdlWin);
429:             SDL_SetWindowAlwaysOnTop(sdlWin, true);
431:             mainWindow->SetPriority(0);
432:             WindowManager::Instance().MarkPriorityDirty();
433:         }
435:         if (m_fxWindow) {
436:             m_fxWindow->SetPriority(10);
437:             WindowManager::Instance().MarkPriorityDirty();
438:         }
440:         m_deathWindowRaised = true;
441:     }
443:     if (m_hitFlashTimer > 0.0f) {
444:         m_hitFlashTimer -= dt;
445:         if (m_hitFlashTimer < 0.0f) m_hitFlashTimer = 0.0f;
446:     }
448:     if (m_isDialogueActive && m_dialogueBox) {
449:         m_dialogueBox->Update(dt);
450:         if (!m_isPlayerCaged || m_overdriveAlpha > 0.0f) {
451:             m_isDialogueActive = false;
452:             if (boss && boss->GetWindowSystem()) {
453:                 boss->GetWindowSystem()->RemoveTrackedWindow(m_dialogueWindowName);
454:             }
455:             m_dialogueWindow = nullptr;
456:             m_dialogueCamera.reset();
457:             m_dialogueBox.reset();
458:             m_aiEnabled = (m_aiTarget != nullptr);
459:         }
460:     }
462:     if (m_bossHP <= 0) {
463:         m_aiEnabled = false;
464:     }
466:     m_cageWindowPos = m_cagePos;
467:     if (m_isPlayerCaged && m_cageShakeTimer > 0.0f) {
468:         m_cageShakeTimer -= dt;
469:         float t = (m_cageShakeDuration > 0.0f) ? (m_cageShakeTimer / m_cageShakeDuration) : 0.0f;
470:         float strength = max(0.0f, t) * m_cageShakeIntensity;
471:         float offsetX = (((rand() % 200) / 100.0f) - 1.0f) * strength;
472:         float offsetZ = (((rand() % 200) / 100.0f) - 1.0f) * strength;
473:         m_cageWindowPos = { m_cagePos.x + offsetX, m_cagePos.y, m_cagePos.z + offsetZ };
474:     }
476:     if (m_aiTarget && m_aiTarget->IsPowerUncapped() && m_isPlayerCaged) {
477:         m_overdriveAlpha += m_overdriveFadeSpeed * dt;
478:         if (m_overdriveAlpha > 1.0f) m_overdriveAlpha = 1.0f;
480:         if (!m_overdriveDialogueTriggered) {
481:             m_overdriveDialogueTriggered = true;
482:             if (m_isDialogueActive && boss && boss->GetWindowSystem()) {
