445: void PlayerShoot::Update(Player* player, float dt)
446: {
447:     // Dash Lockout Prevention
448:     if (IsDashInputTriggered()) // always allowed; Player::BeginDash decides full or penalized
449:     {
450:         player->GetStateMachine()->ChangeState(player, std::make_unique<PlayerDash>());
451:         return;
452:     }
454:     m_timer -= dt;
455:     m_minTapCooldown -= dt;
457:     const bool isHolding{ IsShootInputPressed(*player) };
459:     // Why outside the m_timer block: the melee button must interrupt shooting on the
460:     // frame it is pressed, without waiting for the gun cooldown.
461:     // allowShoot = false: only slash and parry are checked here.
462:     if (TryExecuteCombatAction(player, false)) return;
464:     // The Tap-Fire Reward Logic (Early Exit)
465:     if (!isHolding && m_minTapCooldown <= 0.0f)
466:     {
467:         if (player->IsMoving())
468:             player->GetStateMachine()->ChangeState(player, std::make_unique<PlayerMoving>());
469:         else
470:             player->GetStateMachine()->ChangeState(player, std::make_unique<PlayerIdle>());
471:         return;
472:     }
474:     // The Continuous Hold Logic (For Bullets Only)
475:     if (m_timer <= 0.0f)
476:     {
477:         if (isHolding)
478:         {
479:             // Lower-Body Animation Sync
480:             if (player->IsMoving()) {
481:                 player->GetAnimator()->SetPlaybackSpeed(player->IsBackpedaling() ? -1.0f : 1.0f);
482:                 if (!player->GetAnimator()->IsPlaying("RunPistol")) {
483:                     player->GetAnimator()->Play("RunPistol", true, PlayerConst::AnimBlendDefault);
484:                 }
485:             }
486:             else {
487:                 player->GetAnimator()->SetPlaybackSpeed(1.0f);
488:                 if (!player->GetAnimator()->IsPlaying("Idle")) {
489:                     player->GetAnimator()->Play("Idle", true, PlayerConst::AnimBlendDefault);
490:                 }
491:             }
493:             player->FireProjectile();
494:             PerformShootInternal(player, true);
495:         }
496:     }
497: }
499: void PlayerShoot::PerformShootInternal(Player* player, bool isHeld)
500: {
501:     const std::string shootSounds[]{
502:         "Data/Sound/SE_Player_Shoot_01.wav",
503:         "Data/Sound/SE_Player_Shoot_02.wav",
504:         "Data/Sound/SE_Player_Shoot_03.wav"
505:     };
507:     const int randomIndex{ rand() % 3 };
508:     AudioManager::Instance().PlaySFX(shootSounds[randomIndex], 0.1f);
510:     const float baseDelay{ player->GetShootDelay() };
512:     // --- FIRE RATE LOGIC TREE ---
513:     if (player->IsPowerUncapped())
514:     {
515:         // Absolute Priority: Overdrive bypasses all penalties
516:         m_minTapCooldown = 0.05f;
517:         m_timer = 0.05f;
518:     }
519:     else
520:     {
521:         // Always store the strict minimum delay to prevent spam exploits
522:         m_minTapCooldown = baseDelay;
524:         if (isHeld)
525:         {
526:             // Compile-time constant ensures zero runtime cost for the multiplier
527:             constexpr float HOLD_PENALTY_MULTIPLIER{ 1.5f };
528:             m_timer = baseDelay * HOLD_PENALTY_MULTIPLIER;
529:         }
530:         else
531:         {
532:             m_timer = baseDelay;
533:         }
534:     }
535: }

1: #pragma once
2: #include <memory>
3: #include "PlayerState.h"
5: class StateMachine
6: {
7: public:
8:     // currentState cleaned up automatically by unique_ptr
9:     ~StateMachine() = default;
11:     // Takes ownership of startState and immediately enters it
12:     void Initialize(std::unique_ptr<PlayerState> startState, Player* player)
13:     {
14:         currentState = std::move(startState);
15:         currentState->Enter(player);
16:     }
18:     // Exits current state, takes ownership of newState, enters it
19:     void ChangeState(Player* player, std::unique_ptr<PlayerState> newState)
20:     {
21:         if (currentState)
22:             currentState->Exit(player);
24:         currentState = std::move(newState);
25:         currentState->Enter(player);
26:     }
28:     void Update(Player* player, float elapsedTime)
29:     {
30:         if (currentState)
31:             currentState->Update(player, elapsedTime);
32:     }
34: private:
35:     std::unique_ptr<PlayerState> currentState;
36: };

30:         SDL_DestroyAudioStream(stream);
31:     }
32:     m_activeSFXStreams.clear();

42: void AudioManager::Update(float elapsedTime) {
44:     if (m_musicStream && m_isFadingOut)
45:     {
46:         m_fadeTimer -= elapsedTime;
48:         if (m_fadeTimer <= 0.0f)
49:         {
50:             StopMusic();
51:         }
52:         else
53:         {
54:             const float fadeRatio{ m_fadeTimer / m_fadeDuration };
55:             const float currentVolume{ fadeRatio * (m_localMusicVolume * m_globalMusicVolume) };
57:             SDL_SetAudioStreamGain(m_musicStream, currentVolume);
58:         }
59:     }
61:     auto it = std::remove_if(m_activeSFXStreams.begin(), m_activeSFXStreams.end(),
62:         [](SDL_AudioStream* stream) {
63:             if (SDL_GetAudioStreamAvailable(stream) == 0) {
64:                 SDL_DestroyAudioStream(stream);
65:                 return true;
66:             }
67:             return false;
68:         });
69:     m_activeSFXStreams.erase(it, m_activeSFXStreams.end());
72:     if (m_musicStream && m_isMusicLooping && m_currentMusicData)
73:     {
74:         if (SDL_GetAudioStreamAvailable(m_musicStream) == 0)
75:         {
76:             int bytesPerSample = SDL_AUDIO_BITSIZE(m_currentMusicData->spec.format) / 8;
77:             int frameSize = bytesPerSample * m_currentMusicData->spec.channels;
78:             int bytesPerSecond = m_currentMusicData->spec.freq * frameSize;
80:             Uint32 offsetBytes = (Uint32)(m_musicLoopStart * bytesPerSecond);
82:             if (offsetBytes >= m_currentMusicData->length) {
83:                 offsetBytes = 0;
84:             }
86:             Uint8* loopStartPointer = m_currentMusicData->buffer + offsetBytes;
87:             Uint32 loopLength = m_currentMusicData->length - offsetBytes;
89:             SDL_PutAudioStreamData(m_musicStream, loopStartPointer, loopLength);
90:         }
91:     }
93:     for (auto it = m_delayedSounds.begin(); it != m_delayedSounds.end(); ) {
94:         it->delayTimer -= elapsedTime;
95:         if (it->delayTimer <= 0.0f) {
96:             PlaySFX(it->filePath, it->volume); // Waktunya habis, mainkan!
97:             it = m_delayedSounds.erase(it);    // Hapus dari antrean
98:         }
99:         else {
100:             ++it;
101:         }
102:     }
105:     if (m_ambientFadeState != 0 && m_ambientStream)
106:     {
107:         if (m_ambientFadeState == 1)
108:         {
109:             m_ambientVolume += m_ambientFadeSpeed * elapsedTime;
110:             if (m_ambientVolume >= m_ambientTargetVolume)
111:             {
112:                 m_ambientVolume = m_ambientTargetVolume;
113:                 m_ambientFadeState = 0;
114:             }
115:         }
116:         else if (m_ambientFadeState == -1)
117:         {
118:             m_ambientVolume -= m_ambientFadeSpeed * elapsedTime;
119:             if (m_ambientVolume <= 0.0f)
120:             {
121:                 m_ambientVolume = 0.0f;
122:                 m_ambientFadeState = 0;
123:                 SDL_UnbindAudioStream(m_ambientStream);
124:                 SDL_DestroyAudioStream(m_ambientStream);
125:                 m_ambientStream = nullptr;
126:             }
127:         }
128:         SDL_SetAudioStreamGain(m_ambientStream, m_ambientVolume);
129:     }
130: }

134:         SoundData data;

136:             SDL_Log("Failed to load WAV: %s", path.c_str());
137:             return nullptr;
138:         }
139:         m_soundCache[path] = data;
140:     }
141:     return &m_soundCache[path];
142: }

<file path="Source/System/Collision.cpp" lines="574">
1: #include "Collision.h"
3: using namespace DirectX;
5: // =================================================================
6: // IntersectSegmentVsAABB (The "Solid Plane" Check)
7: // =================================================================
8: bool Collision::IntersectMovingSphereVsBoxInfiniteY(
9:     const DirectX::XMFLOAT3& prevPos,
10:     const DirectX::XMFLOAT3& currPos,
11:     float radius,
12:     const DebugWallData& wall,
13:     DirectX::XMFLOAT3& outHitPoint,
14:     DirectX::XMFLOAT3& outHitNormal,
15:     float& outT)
16: {
17:     // 1. Prepare Matrices
18:     XMMATRIX matRot = XMMatrixRotationRollPitchYaw(
19:         XMConvertToRadians(wall.Rotation.x),
20:         XMConvertToRadians(wall.Rotation.y),
21:         XMConvertToRadians(wall.Rotation.z)
22:     );
23:     XMMATRIX matInvRot = XMMatrixTranspose(matRot);
24:     XMVECTOR vWallPos = XMLoadFloat3(&wall.Position);
26:     // 2. Transform Positions to Local Space
27:     // We treat the wall as the center of the universe (0,0,0) with no rotation.
28:     XMVECTOR vPrev = XMLoadFloat3(&prevPos);
29:     XMVECTOR vCurr = XMLoadFloat3(&currPos);
31:     XMVECTOR vRelPrev = XMVectorSubtract(vPrev, vWallPos);
32:     XMVECTOR vRelCurr = XMVectorSubtract(vCurr, vWallPos);
34:     XMVECTOR vLocPrev = XMVector3TransformNormal(vRelPrev, matInvRot);
35:     XMVECTOR vLocCurr = XMVector3TransformNormal(vRelCurr, matInvRot);
37:     XMFLOAT3 p0, p1;
38:     XMStoreFloat3(&p0, vLocPrev);
39:     XMStoreFloat3(&p1, vLocCurr);
41:     // 3. Define the "Expanded" Box
42:     // We expand the box by the ball's radius.
43:     // This allows us to treat the ball as a single point (Raycast).
44:     float maxX = wall.Scale.x + radius;
45:     float minX = -maxX;
46:     float maxZ = wall.Scale.z + radius;
47:     float minZ = -maxZ;
49:     // Direction vector
50:     float dx = p1.x - p0.x;
51:     float dz = p1.z - p0.z;
53:     // Check if we are already inside (Deep Stuck Fix)
54:     // Ignore Y axis completely
55:     if (p0.x >= minX && p0.x <= maxX && p0.z >= minZ && p0.z <= maxZ)
56:     {
57:         // We started inside. Push out to nearest face.
58:         float dXPos = fabsf(maxX - p0.x);
59:         float dXNeg = fabsf(minX - p0.x);
60:         float dZPos = fabsf(maxZ - p0.z);
61:         float dZNeg = fabsf(minZ - p0.z);
63:         float minD = (std::min)({ dXPos, dXNeg, dZPos, dZNeg });
65:         outT = 0.0f;
66:         outHitPoint = prevPos;
68:         // Determine Normal in World Space
69:         XMVECTOR vNorm;
70:         if (minD == dXPos)      vNorm = XMVectorSet(1, 0, 0, 0);
71:         else if (minD == dXNeg) vNorm = XMVectorSet(-1, 0, 0, 0);
72:         else if (minD == dZPos) vNorm = XMVectorSet(0, 0, 1, 0);
73:         else                    vNorm = XMVectorSet(0, 0, -1, 0);
75:         vNorm = XMVector3TransformNormal(vNorm, matRot);
76:         XMStoreFloat3(&outHitNormal, vNorm);
77:         return true;
78:     }
80:     // 4. Ray-Slab Intersection (Slab Method) on X and Z
81:     // We want to find the first time 't' (0..1) the segment enters the box.
82:     float tEnter = 0.0f;
83:     float tExit = 1.0f;
84:     float tNormalX = 0.0f, tNormalZ = 0.0f; // Local normal components
86:     // --- X Axis ---
87:     if (fabsf(dx) < 1e-6f) // Parallel to X planes
88:     {
89:         if (p0.x < minX || p0.x > maxX) return false; // Parallel and outside
90:     }
91:     else
92:     {
93:         float invDir = 1.0f / dx;
94:         float t1 = (minX - p0.x) * invDir;
95:         float t2 = (maxX - p0.x) * invDir;
96:         float s = -1.0f; // Sign of normal if t1 is hit
98:         if (t1 > t2) { std::swap(t1, t2); s = 1.0f; }
100:         if (t1 > tEnter)
101:         {
102:             tEnter = t1;
103:             tNormalX = (invDir < 0) ? 1.0f : -1.0f;
104:             tNormalZ = 0.0f;
105:         }
106:         if (t2 < tExit) tExit = t2;
108:         if (tEnter > tExit) return false; // Miss
109:     }
111:     // --- Z Axis ---
112:     if (fabsf(dz) < 1e-6f) // Parallel to Z planes
113:     {
114:         if (p0.z < minZ || p0.z > maxZ) return false;
115:     }
116:     else
117:     {
118:         float invDir = 1.0f / dz;
119:         float t1 = (minZ - p0.z) * invDir;
120:         float t2 = (maxZ - p0.z) * invDir;
122:         if (t1 > t2) { std::swap(t1, t2); }
124:         if (t1 > tEnter)
125:         {
126:             tEnter = t1;
127:             tNormalX = 0.0f;
128:             tNormalZ = (invDir < 0) ? 1.0f : -1.0f;
129:         }
130:         if (t2 < tExit) tExit = t2;
132:         if (tEnter > tExit) return false;
133:     }
135:     // If we reached here, we have an intersection at tEnter
136:     outT = tEnter;
138:     // Transform Normal to World
139:     XMVECTOR vLocNorm = XMVectorSet(tNormalX, 0.0f, tNormalZ, 0.0f);
140:     XMVECTOR vWorldNorm = XMVector3TransformNormal(vLocNorm, matRot);
141:     XMStoreFloat3(&outHitNormal, vWorldNorm);
143:     // Calculate Hit Point in World
144:     XMVECTOR vHit = XMVectorAdd(vPrev, XMVectorScale(XMVectorSubtract(vCurr, vPrev), tEnter));
145:     XMStoreFloat3(&outHitPoint, vHit);
147:     return true;
148: }
149: // =================================================================
150: // IntersectRayVsOBB (Slab Method)
151: // =================================================================
152: bool Collision::IntersectRayVsOBB(
153:     const DirectX::XMFLOAT3& rayOrigin,
154:     const DirectX::XMFLOAT3& rayDir,
155:     float rayLength,
156:     const DebugWallData& wall,
157:     float& outDist,
158:     DirectX::XMFLOAT3& outNormal)
159: {
160:     XMVECTOR vRayOrigin = XMLoadFloat3(&rayOrigin);
161:     XMVECTOR vRayDir = XMLoadFloat3(&rayDir);
162:     XMVECTOR vWallPos = XMLoadFloat3(&wall.Position);
164:     // Create Rotation Matrix
165:     XMMATRIX matRot = XMMatrixRotationRollPitchYaw(
166:         XMConvertToRadians(wall.Rotation.x),
167:         XMConvertToRadians(wall.Rotation.y),
168:         XMConvertToRadians(wall.Rotation.z)
169:     );
170:     XMMATRIX matInvRot = XMMatrixTranspose(matRot);
172:     // Transform Ray to Local Space
173:     XMVECTOR vRelOrigin = XMVectorSubtract(vRayOrigin, vWallPos);
174:     XMVECTOR vLocalOrigin = XMVector3TransformNormal(vRelOrigin, matInvRot);
175:     XMVECTOR vLocalDir = XMVector3TransformNormal(vRayDir, matInvRot);
177:     XMFLOAT3 localOrigin; XMStoreFloat3(&localOrigin, vLocalOrigin);
178:     XMFLOAT3 localDir;    XMStoreFloat3(&localDir, vLocalDir);
180:     // [ROBUSTNESS] Inflate the box slightly for the ray check.
181:     // This helps catch cases where the ball center is slightly misaligned.
182:     // We treat Y as infinite.
183:     float padding = 0.1f;
184:     XMFLOAT3 extents = wall.Scale;
185:     extents.x += padding;
186:     extents.z += padding;
187:     extents.y = 10000.0f; // Infinite Height Hack
189:     float tMin = 0.0f;
190:     float tMax = rayLength;
192:     XMFLOAT3 localNormal = { 0, 0, 0 };
193:     int hitAxis = -1;
195:     // --- Check X Axis ---
196:     if (fabsf(localDir.x) > 1e-6f)
197:     {
198:         float invD = 1.0f / localDir.x;
199:         float t0 = (-extents.x - localOrigin.x) * invD;
200:         float t1 = (extents.x - localOrigin.x) * invD;
201:         if (invD < 0.0f) std::swap(t0, t1);
203:         if (t0 > tMin) { tMin = t0; hitAxis = 0; }
204:         if (t1 < tMax) { tMax = t1; }
205:         if (tMin > tMax) return false;
206:     }
207:     else if (localOrigin.x < -extents.x || localOrigin.x > extents.x) return false;
209:     // --- Check Y Axis ---
210:     if (fabsf(localDir.y) > 1e-6f)
211:     {
212:         float invD = 1.0f / localDir.y;
213:         float t0 = (-extents.y - localOrigin.y) * invD;
214:         float t1 = (extents.y - localOrigin.y) * invD;
215:         if (invD < 0.0f) std::swap(t0, t1);
217:         if (t0 > tMin) { tMin = t0; hitAxis = 1; }
218:         if (t1 < tMax) { tMax = t1; }
219:         if (tMin > tMax) return false;
220:     }
221:     // No "else" for Y because it's infinite, ray always "inside" Y-slab unless way off
223:     // --- Check Z Axis ---
224:     if (fabsf(localDir.z) > 1e-6f)
225:     {
226:         float invD = 1.0f / localDir.z;
227:         float t0 = (-extents.z - localOrigin.z) * invD;
228:         float t1 = (extents.z - localOrigin.z) * invD;
229:         if (invD < 0.0f) std::swap(t0, t1);
231:         if (t0 > tMin) { tMin = t0; hitAxis = 2; }
232:         if (t1 < tMax) { tMax = t1; }
233:         if (tMin > tMax) return false;
234:     }
235:     else if (localOrigin.z < -extents.z || localOrigin.z > extents.z) return false;
237:     // Construct Normal
238:     if (hitAxis == 0) localNormal = { (localDir.x < 0) ? 1.0f : -1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f };
239:     else if (hitAxis == 1) localNormal = { 0.0f, (localDir.y < 0) ? 1.0f : -1.0f, 0.0f };
240:     else if (hitAxis == 2) localNormal = { 0.0f, 0.0f, (localDir.z < 0) ? 1.0f : -1.0f };
242:     XMVECTOR vLocalNorm = XMLoadFloat3(&localNormal);
243:     XMVECTOR vWorldNorm = XMVector3TransformNormal(vLocalNorm, matRot);
244:     XMStoreFloat3(&outNormal, vWorldNorm);
246:     outDist = tMin;
247:     return true;
248: }
250: // =================================================================
251: // ResolveOBB (EXISTING)
252: // =================================================================
253: bool Collision::ResolveOBB(
254:     const DirectX::XMFLOAT3& entityPos,
255:     float entityRadius,
256:     const DebugWallData& wall,
257:     DirectX::XMFLOAT3& outFixPosition)
258: {
259:     XMVECTOR vEntityPos = XMLoadFloat3(&entityPos);
260:     XMVECTOR vWallPos = XMLoadFloat3(&wall.Position);
261:     XMVECTOR vRelPos = XMVectorSubtract(vEntityPos, vWallPos);
263:     XMMATRIX matRot = XMMatrixRotationRollPitchYaw(
264:         XMConvertToRadians(wall.Rotation.x),
265:         XMConvertToRadians(wall.Rotation.y),
266:         XMConvertToRadians(wall.Rotation.z)
267:     );
268:     XMMATRIX matInvRot = XMMatrixTranspose(matRot);
269:     XMVECTOR vLocalPos = XMVector3TransformNormal(vRelPos, matInvRot);
271:     float localX = XMVectorGetX(vLocalPos);
272:     float localY = XMVectorGetY(vLocalPos);
273:     float localZ = XMVectorGetZ(vLocalPos);
275:     float extentX = wall.Scale.x;
276:     float extentY = wall.Scale.y;
277:     float extentZ = wall.Scale.z;
279:     float overlapX = (extentX + entityRadius) - fabsf(localX);
280:     float overlapY = (extentY + entityRadius) - fabsf(localY);
281:     float overlapZ = (extentZ + entityRadius) - fabsf(localZ);
283:     if (overlapX <= 0 || overlapY <= 0 || overlapZ <= 0) return false;
285:     float pushX = 0, pushY = 0, pushZ = 0;
287:     if (overlapX < overlapY && overlapX < overlapZ)
288:         pushX = (localX > 0) ? overlapX : -overlapX;
289:     else if (overlapY < overlapZ)
290:         pushY = (localY > 0) ? overlapY : -overlapY;
291:     else
292:         pushZ = (localZ > 0) ? overlapZ : -overlapZ;
294:     XMVECTOR vLocalPush = XMVectorSet(pushX, pushY, pushZ, 0.0f);
295:     XMVECTOR vWorldPush = XMVector3TransformNormal(vLocalPush, matRot);
296:     XMVECTOR vNewPos = XMVectorAdd(vEntityPos, vWorldPush);
297:     XMStoreFloat3(&outFixPosition, vNewPos);
299:     return true;
300: }
301: // =================================================================
302: // RayCast
303: // =================================================================
304: bool Collision::RayCast(
305:     const DirectX::XMFLOAT3& start,
306:     const DirectX::XMFLOAT3& end,
307:     const DirectX::XMFLOAT4X4& worldTransform,
308:     const Model* model,
309:     DirectX::XMFLOAT3& hitPosition,
310:     DirectX::XMFLOAT3& hitNormal)
311: {
312:     if (!model) return false;
314:     bool hit = false;
315:     float nearestDist = FLT_MAX;
317:     XMVECTOR WorldRayStart = XMLoadFloat3(&start);
318:     XMVECTOR WorldRayEnd = XMLoadFloat3(&end);
319:     XMVECTOR WorldRayVec = XMVectorSubtract(WorldRayEnd, WorldRayStart);
320:     XMVECTOR WorldRayLengthVec = XMVector3Length(WorldRayVec);
322:     float rayLength = XMVectorGetX(WorldRayLengthVec);
323:     if (rayLength <= 0.0001f) return false;
325:     nearestDist = rayLength;
326:     XMMATRIX ParentWorldTransform = XMLoadFloat4x4(&worldTransform);
328:     const auto& meshes = model->GetMeshes();
329:     const auto& nodes = model->GetNodes();
331:     for (const auto& mesh : meshes)
332:     {
333:         if (mesh.nodeIndex < 0 || mesh.nodeIndex >= nodes.size()) continue;
335:         const Model::Node& node = nodes[mesh.nodeIndex];
336:         XMMATRIX GlobalTransform = XMLoadFloat4x4(&node.globalTransform);
337:         XMMATRIX MeshWorldTransform = XMMatrixMultiply(GlobalTransform, ParentWorldTransform);
338:         XMVECTOR Determinant;
339:         XMMATRIX InverseWorldTransform = XMMatrixInverse(&Determinant, MeshWorldTransform);
340:         XMVECTOR LocalRayStart = XMVector3TransformCoord(WorldRayStart, InverseWorldTransform);
341:         XMVECTOR LocalRayEnd = XMVector3TransformCoord(WorldRayEnd, InverseWorldTransform);
342:         XMVECTOR LocalRayVec = XMVectorSubtract(LocalRayEnd, LocalRayStart);
343:         XMVECTOR LocalRayDir = XMVector3Normalize(LocalRayVec);
345:         float localRayDist = XMVectorGetX(XMVector3Length(LocalRayVec));
347:         size_t indexCount = mesh.indices.size();
348:         for (size_t i = 0; i < indexCount; i += 3)
349:         {
350:             uint32_t i0 = mesh.indices[i];
351:             uint32_t i1 = mesh.indices[i + 1];
352:             uint32_t i2 = mesh.indices[i + 2];
354:             XMVECTOR V0 = XMLoadFloat3(&mesh.vertices[i0].position);
355:             XMVECTOR V1 = XMLoadFloat3(&mesh.vertices[i1].position);
356:             XMVECTOR V2 = XMLoadFloat3(&mesh.vertices[i2].position);
358:             float dist = 0.0f;
360:             if (TriangleTests::Intersects(LocalRayStart, LocalRayDir, V0, V1, V2, dist))
361:             {
362:                 if (dist > 0 && dist < localRayDist)
363:                 {
364:                     XMVECTOR LocalHitPos = XMVectorAdd(LocalRayStart, XMVectorScale(LocalRayDir, dist));
365:                     XMVECTOR WorldHitPos = XMVector3TransformCoord(LocalHitPos, MeshWorldTransform);
367:                     float worldDist = XMVectorGetX(XMVector3Length(XMVectorSubtract(WorldHitPos, WorldRayStart)));
369:                     if (worldDist < nearestDist)
370:                     {
371:                         XMVECTOR E1 = XMVectorSubtract(V1, V0);
372:                         XMVECTOR E2 = XMVectorSubtract(V2, V1);
373:                         XMVECTOR LocalNormal = XMVector3Cross(E1, E2);
374:                         LocalNormal = XMVector3Normalize(LocalNormal);
376:                         if (XMVectorGetX(XMVector3Dot(LocalRayDir, LocalNormal)) < 0.0f)
377:                         {
378:                             XMVECTOR WorldHitNormal = XMVector3TransformNormal(LocalNormal, MeshWorldTransform);
379:                             WorldHitNormal = XMVector3Normalize(WorldHitNormal);
380:                             nearestDist = worldDist;
381:                             XMStoreFloat3(&hitPosition, WorldHitPos);
382:                             XMStoreFloat3(&hitNormal, WorldHitNormal);
383:                             hit = true;
384:                         }
385:                     }
386:                 }
387:             }
388:         }
389:     }
390:     return hit;
391: }
393: // =================================================================
394: // IntersectSphereVsSphere
395: // =================================================================
396: bool Collision::IntersectSphereVsSphere(
397:     const DirectX::XMFLOAT3& positionA, float radiusA,
398:     const DirectX::XMFLOAT3& positionB, float radiusB,
399:     DirectX::XMFLOAT3& outPositionB)
400: {
401:     XMVECTOR PosA = XMLoadFloat3(&positionA);
402:     XMVECTOR PosB = XMLoadFloat3(&positionB);
403:     XMVECTOR Vec = XMVectorSubtract(PosB, PosA);
404:     XMVECTOR LenSq = XMVector3LengthSq(Vec);
406:     float lenSq;
407:     XMStoreFloat(&lenSq, LenSq);
408:     float range = radiusA + radiusB;
410:     if (lenSq > range * range) return false;
412:     XMVECTOR N = XMVector3Normalize(Vec);
413:     XMVECTOR Push = XMVectorScale(N, range - sqrtf(lenSq));
414:     XMVECTOR NewPosB = XMVectorAdd(PosB, Push);
416:     XMStoreFloat3(&outPositionB, NewPosB);
417:     return true;
418: }
420: // =================================================================
421: // IntersectSphereVsCylinder
422: // =================================================================
423: bool Collision::IntersectSphereVsCylinder(
424:     const DirectX::XMFLOAT3& spherePos, float sphereRad,
425:     const DirectX::XMFLOAT3& cylPos, float cylRad, float cylHeight,
426:     DirectX::XMFLOAT3& outCylPos)
427: {
428:     if (spherePos.y > cylPos.y + cylHeight + sphereRad) return false;
429:     if (spherePos.y < cylPos.y - sphereRad) return false;
431:     float vx = spherePos.x - cylPos.x;
432:     float vz = spherePos.z - cylPos.z;
433:     float distSq = vx * vx + vz * vz;
434:     float range = sphereRad + cylRad;
436:     if (distSq >= range * range) return false;
438:     float dist = sqrtf(distSq);
439:     if (dist > 0.0001f)
440:     {
441:         vx /= dist;
442:         vz /= dist;
443:         float pushAmt = range - dist;
444:         outCylPos = cylPos;
445:         outCylPos.x -= vx * pushAmt;
446:         outCylPos.z -= vz * pushAmt;
447:     }
448:     return true;
449: }
451: // =================================================================
452: // IntersectCubeVsCube
453: // =================================================================
454: bool Collision::IntersectCubeVsCube(
455:     const DirectX::XMFLOAT3& posA, const DirectX::XMFLOAT3& sizeA,
456:     const DirectX::XMFLOAT3& posB, const DirectX::XMFLOAT3& sizeB,
457:     DirectX::XMFLOAT3& outPosB)
458: {
459:     float minAx = posA.x - sizeA.x; float maxAx = posA.x + sizeA.x;
460:     float minAy = posA.y - sizeA.y; float maxAy = posA.y + sizeA.y;
461:     float minAz = posA.z - sizeA.z; float maxAz = posA.z + sizeA.z;
463:     float minBx = posB.x - sizeB.x; float maxBx = posB.x + sizeB.x;
464:     float minBy = posB.y - sizeB.y; float maxBy = posB.y + sizeB.y;
465:     float minBz = posB.z - sizeB.z; float maxBz = posB.z + sizeB.z;
467:     if (maxAx < minBx || minAx > maxBx) return false;
468:     if (maxAy < minBy || minAy > maxBy) return false;
469:     if (maxAz < minBz || minAz > maxBz) return false;
471:     float diffX1 = maxAx - minBx; float diffX2 = maxBx - minAx;
472:     float penX = (diffX1 < diffX2) ? diffX1 : -diffX2;
474:     float diffY1 = maxAy - minBy; float diffY2 = maxBy - minAy;
475:     float penY = (diffY1 < diffY2) ? diffY1 : -diffY2;
477:     float diffZ1 = maxAz - minBz; float diffZ2 = maxBz - minAz;
478:     float penZ = (diffZ1 < diffZ2) ? diffZ1 : -diffZ2;
480:     float absX = fabsf(penX);
481:     float absY = fabsf(penY);
482:     float absZ = fabsf(penZ);
484:     outPosB = posB;
486:     if (absX < absY && absX < absZ) outPosB.x += penX;
487:     else if (absY < absZ)           outPosB.y += penY;
488:     else                            outPosB.z += penZ;
490:     return true;
491: }
493: // =================================================================
494: // IntersectSphereVsCube
495: // =================================================================
496: bool Collision::IntersectSphereVsCube(
497:     const DirectX::XMFLOAT3& spherePos, float sphereRad,
498:     const DirectX::XMFLOAT3& cubePos, const DirectX::XMFLOAT3& cubeSize,
499:     DirectX::XMFLOAT3& outCubePos)
500: {
501:     float closestX = (std::max)(cubePos.x - cubeSize.x, (std::min)(spherePos.x, cubePos.x + cubeSize.x));
502:     float closestY = (std::max)(cubePos.y - cubeSize.y, (std::min)(spherePos.y, cubePos.y + cubeSize.y));
503:     float closestZ = (std::max)(cubePos.z - cubeSize.z, (std::min)(spherePos.z, cubePos.z + cubeSize.z));
505:     float dx = spherePos.x - closestX;
506:     float dy = spherePos.y - closestY;
507:     float dz = spherePos.z - closestZ;
509:     float distSq = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz;
511:     if (distSq > sphereRad * sphereRad) return false;
513:     float dist = sqrtf(distSq);
514:     if (dist > 0.0001f)
515:     {
516:         float push = sphereRad - dist;
517:         outCubePos = cubePos;
518:         outCubePos.x -= (dx / dist) * push;
519:         outCubePos.y -= (dy / dist) * push;
520:         outCubePos.z -= (dz / dist) * push;
521:     }
522:     else
523:     {
524:         outCubePos = cubePos;
525:         if (spherePos.x > cubePos.x) outCubePos.x -= sphereRad;
526:         else outCubePos.x += sphereRad;
527:     }
529:     return true;
530: }
532: // =================================================================
533: // IsPointInCube
534: // =================================================================
535: bool Collision::IsPointInCube(
536:     const DirectX::XMFLOAT3& p,
537:     const DirectX::XMFLOAT3& pos,
538:     const DirectX::XMFLOAT3& size)
539: {
540:     return (p.x >= pos.x - size.x && p.x <= pos.x + size.x &&
541:         p.y >= pos.y - size.y && p.y <= pos.y + size.y &&
542:         p.z >= pos.z - size.z && p.z <= pos.z + size.z);
543: }
545: // =================================================================
546: // IntersectCylinderVsCylinder
547: // =================================================================
548: bool Collision::IntersectCylinderVsCylinder(
549:     const DirectX::XMFLOAT3& posA, float radA, float hA,
550:     const DirectX::XMFLOAT3& posB, float radB, float hB,
551:     DirectX::XMFLOAT3& outPosB)
552: {
553:     if (posA.y > posB.y + hB) return false;
554:     if (posA.y + hA < posB.y) return false;
556:     float vx = posB.x - posA.x;
557:     float vz = posB.z - posA.z;
558:     float range = radA + radB;
559:     float distSq = vx * vx + vz * vz;
561:     if (distSq > range * range) return false;
563:     float dist = sqrtf(distSq);
564:     if (dist > 0.0001f)
565:     {
566:         vx /= dist;
567:         vz /= dist;
568:         float push = range - dist;
569:         outPosB = posB;
570:         outPosB.x += vx * push;
571:         outPosB.z += vz * push;
572:     }
573:     return true;
574: }

64: static float RayCastOBB(XMVECTOR rayOrigin, XMVECTOR rayDir, float rayLength, float radius, const DebugWallData& wall, XMVECTOR& outNormal)
65: {
66:     XMVECTOR vWallPos = XMLoadFloat3(&wall.Position);
67:     XMMATRIX matRot = XMMatrixRotationRollPitchYaw(
68:         XMConvertToRadians(wall.Rotation.x),
69:         XMConvertToRadians(wall.Rotation.y),
70:         XMConvertToRadians(wall.Rotation.z)
71:     );
72:     XMMATRIX matInvRot = XMMatrixTranspose(matRot);
74:     XMVECTOR vRelOrigin = XMVectorSubtract(rayOrigin, vWallPos);
75:     XMVECTOR vLocalOrigin = XMVector3TransformNormal(vRelOrigin, matInvRot);
76:     XMVECTOR vLocalDir = XMVector3TransformNormal(rayDir, matInvRot);
78:     float r = radius;
79:     float minX = -wall.Scale.x - r; float maxX = wall.Scale.x + r;
80:     float minZ = -wall.Scale.z - r; float maxZ = wall.Scale.z + r;
82:     float tMin = 0.0f;
83:     float tMax = rayLength;
85:     XMFLOAT3 start, dir;
86:     XMStoreFloat3(&start, vLocalOrigin);
87:     XMStoreFloat3(&dir, vLocalDir);
89:     if (abs(dir.x) < 1e-6f) {
90:         if (start.x < minX || start.x > maxX) return -1.0f;
91:     }
92:     else {
93:         float invD = 1.0f / dir.x;
94:         float t1 = (minX - start.x) * invD;
95:         float t2 = (maxX - start.x) * invD;
96:         if (t1 > t2) std::swap(t1, t2);
97:         tMin = (std::max)(tMin, t1);
98:         tMax = (std::min)(tMax, t2);
99:         if (tMin > tMax) return -1.0f;
100:     }
102:     if (abs(dir.z) < 1e-6f) {
103:         if (start.z < minZ || start.z > maxZ) return -1.0f;
104:     }
105:     else {
106:         float invD = 1.0f / dir.z;
107:         float t1 = (minZ - start.z) * invD;
108:         float t2 = (maxZ - start.z) * invD;
109:         if (t1 > t2) std::swap(t1, t2);
110:         tMin = (std::max)(tMin, t1);
111:         tMax = (std::min)(tMax, t2);
112:         if (tMin > tMax) return -1.0f;
113:     }
115:     XMFLOAT3 hitPoint;
116:     XMStoreFloat3(&hitPoint, vLocalOrigin + vLocalDir * tMin);
118:     float distMinX = abs(hitPoint.x - minX);
119:     float distMaxX = abs(hitPoint.x - maxX);
120:     float distMinZ = abs(hitPoint.z - minZ);
121:     float distMaxZ = abs(hitPoint.z - maxZ);
123:     float bestDist = distMinX;
124:     XMVECTOR localNormal = XMVectorSet(-1, 0, 0, 0);
126:     if (distMaxX < bestDist) { bestDist = distMaxX; localNormal = XMVectorSet(1, 0, 0, 0); }
127:     if (distMinZ < bestDist) { bestDist = distMinZ; localNormal = XMVectorSet(0, 0, -1, 0); }
128:     if (distMaxZ < bestDist) { bestDist = distMaxZ; localNormal = XMVectorSet(0, 0, 1, 0); }
130:     outNormal = XMVector3TransformNormal(localNormal, matRot);
132:     return tMin;
133: }
135: static float DistancePointToLineSegment2D(const DirectX::XMFLOAT3& A, const DirectX::XMFLOAT3& B, const DirectX::XMFLOAT3& P)
136: {
137:     float lineX = B.x - A.x;
138:     float lineZ = B.z - A.z;
139:     float px = P.x - A.x;
140:     float pz = P.z - A.z;
142:     float lineLengthSq = (lineX * lineX) + (lineZ * lineZ);
144:     // If the bullet didn't move this frame, just do a normal sphere check
145:     if (lineLengthSq == 0.0f) return std::sqrt((px * px) + (pz * pz));
147:     // Dot product to project the target's position onto the bullet's path line
148:     float t = ((px * lineX) + (pz * lineZ)) / lineLengthSq;
150:     // Clamp 't' between 0.0f and 1.0f
151:     t = (std::max)(0.0f, (std::min)(1.0f, t));
153:     // Find the closest point on the line
154:     float closestX = A.x + t * lineX;
155:     float closestZ = A.z + t * lineZ;
157:     float dx = P.x - closestX;
158:     float dz = P.z - closestZ;
160:     return std::sqrt((dx * dx) + (dz * dz));
161: }
163: [[nodiscard]] inline AABB CreateSweptAABB(const DirectX::XMFLOAT3& startPos,
164:     const DirectX::XMFLOAT3& endPos,
165:     const float radius) noexcept
166: {
167:     return AABB{
168:         { (std::min)(startPos.x, endPos.x) - radius,
169:           (std::min)(startPos.y, endPos.y) - radius,
170:           (std::min)(startPos.z, endPos.z) - radius },
172:         { (std::max)(startPos.x, endPos.x) + radius,
173:           (std::max)(startPos.y, endPos.y) + radius,
174:           (std::max)(startPos.z, endPos.z) + radius }
175:     };
176: }

194: void CollisionManager::Update(float elapsedTime)
195: {
196:     CheckEnemyProjectilesFull(elapsedTime);
197:     CheckPlayerProjectilesVsEnemies(elapsedTime);
198:     CheckPlayerProjectilesVsNavi(elapsedTime);
199:     CheckNaviAllyProjectilesVsPlayer(elapsedTime);
200:     CheckPlayerVsEnemies();
201:     CheckPlayerVsCheckpointLines();
202:     CheckPlayerVsTriggerLines();
203:     CheckPlayerVsVoidLines();
205:     if (m_itemManager)
206:     {
207:         CheckPlayerVsItems();
208:     }
210:     CheckNaviProjectilesVsEnemies(elapsedTime);
211:     CheckBossProjectilesVsPlayer(elapsedTime);
212:     CheckBossProjectilesVsBoss(elapsedTime);
214:     // =========================================================
215:     // DETEKSI PELURU PLAYER VS WINDOW BOSS (AABB COLLISION)
216:     // =========================================================
217:     if (m_Boss && m_player) {
218:         if (auto* normalPhase = dynamic_cast<BossPhase01*>(m_Boss->GetCurrentPhase())) {
220:             if (!normalPhase->IsDead()) {
221:                 DirectX::XMFLOAT3 bossPos = m_Boss->GetPosition();
223:                 // Ukuran Window di 3D World adalah 5.0f (Radius/Setengahnya adalah 2.5f)
224:                 float halfW = 2.5f;
225:                 float halfD = 2.5f;
227:                 // Asumsi: m_player memiliki fungsi GetProjectiles() yang me-return peluru player
228:                 for (auto& bullet : m_player->GetProjectiles()) {
229:                     if (!bullet->IsActive()) continue;
231:                     DirectX::XMFLOAT3 bPos = bullet->GetMovement()->GetPosition();
233:                     // Pengecekan Kotak (AABB): Apakah titik peluru berada di DALAM kotak Window?
234:                     if (bPos.x > (bossPos.x - halfW) && bPos.x < (bossPos.x + halfW) &&
235:                         bPos.z >(bossPos.z - halfD) && bPos.z < (bossPos.z + halfD))
236:                     {
237:                         // BOOM! Kena kaca window!
238:                         bullet->SetActive(false); // Hancurkan peluru player
239:                         normalPhase->TakeDamage(bullet->GetDamage(), bPos);
241:                         // Opsional: Mainkan suara kaca retak / benturan peluru di sini
242:                         // AudioManager::Instance().PlaySFX("Hit.wav");
243:                     }
244:                 }
245:             }
246:         }
247:         else if (auto* wkPhase = dynamic_cast<BossPhase02*>(m_Boss->GetCurrentPhase())) {
248:             if (!wkPhase->IsPlayerCaged() && !wkPhase->IsDead()) {
249:                 DirectX::XMFLOAT3 bossPos = m_Boss->GetPosition();
251:                 float halfW = 2.5f;
252:                 float halfD = 2.5f;
254:                 for (auto& bullet : m_player->GetProjectiles()) {
255:                     if (!bullet->IsActive()) continue;
257:                     DirectX::XMFLOAT3 bPos = bullet->GetMovement()->GetPosition();
259:                     if (bPos.x > (bossPos.x - halfW) && bPos.x < (bossPos.x + halfW) &&
260:                         bPos.z >(bossPos.z - halfD) && bPos.z < (bossPos.z + halfD))
261:                     {
262:                         bullet->SetActive(false);
263:                         wkPhase->TakeDamage(bullet->GetDamage(), bPos);
264:                     }
265:                 }
266:             }
267:         }
268:     }
269: }
271: void CollisionManager::CheckEnemyProjectilesFull(float elapsedTime)
272: {
273:     if (!m_enemyManager) return;
275:     for (auto& enemy : m_enemyManager->GetEnemies())
276:     {
277:         auto& projectiles = enemy->GetProjectiles();
278:         AttackType type = enemy->GetAttackType();
280:         for (auto it = projectiles.begin(); it != projectiles.end(); )
281:         {
282:             auto& bullet = *it;
283:             if (!bullet) { ++it; continue; }
285:             XMFLOAT3 currentPos = bullet->GetMovement()->GetPosition();
286:             XMFLOAT3 currentVel = bullet->GetVelocity();
287:             XMVECTOR vPos = XMLoadFloat3(&currentPos);
288:             XMVECTOR vVel = XMLoadFloat3(&currentVel);
289:             XMVECTOR vNextPos = vPos + (vVel * elapsedTime);
290:             XMVECTOR vDir = XMVector3Normalize(vVel);
292:             float speed = XMVectorGetX(XMVector3Length(vVel));
293:             float frameDist = speed * elapsedTime;
294:             float bulletRadius = bullet->GetRadius();
296:             bool hitWall = false;
297:             float closestT = frameDist;
298:             XMVECTOR hitNormal = XMVectorZero();
300:             if (m_stage)
301:             {
302:                 for (const auto& wall : m_stage->m_debugWalls)
303:                 {
304:                     float dx = currentPos.x - wall.Position.x;
305:                     float dz = currentPos.z - wall.Position.z;
306:                     float wallMax = (std::max)(wall.Scale.x, wall.Scale.z);
307:                     if ((dx * dx + dz * dz) > pow(wallMax + frameDist + 10.0f, 2)) continue;
309:                     XMVECTOR tempNormal;
310:                     float t = RayCastOBB(vPos, vDir, frameDist, bulletRadius, wall, tempNormal);
312:                     if (t >= 0.0f && t < closestT)
313:                     {
314:                         closestT = t;
315:                         hitNormal = tempNormal;
316:                         hitWall = true;
317:                     }
318:                 }
319:             }
321:             if (hitWall)
322:             {
323:                 if (type == AttackType::Static) {
324:                     it = projectiles.erase(it);
325:                     continue;
326:                 }
328:                 float safeDist = (std::max)(0.0f, closestT - 0.01f);
329:                 XMVECTOR vSafePos = vPos + (vDir * safeDist);
330:                 XMVECTOR vReflectedVel = XMVector3Reflect(vVel, hitNormal);
331:                 float remainingDist = frameDist - closestT;
332:                 vSafePos += (XMVector3Normalize(vReflectedVel) * remainingDist);
333:                 vSafePos += hitNormal * 0.05f;
335:                 XMFLOAT3 finalPos, finalVel;
336:                 XMStoreFloat3(&finalPos, vSafePos);
337:                 XMStoreFloat3(&finalVel, vReflectedVel);
338:                 finalPos.y = 0.0f; finalVel.y = 0.0f;
340:                 bullet->ApplyMovement(finalPos, finalVel);
341:                 ++it;
342:                 continue;
343:             }
345:             if (bullet->GetHomingTarget() != nullptr)
346:             {
347:                 Enemy* targetEnemy = static_cast<Enemy*>(bullet->GetHomingTarget());
349:                 // ---> BUG PREVENTION: The Dangling Pointer Guard <---
350:                 // Verify the target wasn't deleted from memory by a different attack (like a Slash)
351:                 bool isTargetAlive = false;
352:                 for (auto& activeEnemy : m_enemyManager->GetEnemies()) {
353:                     if (activeEnemy.get() == targetEnemy && activeEnemy->IsActive()) {
354:                         isTargetAlive = true;
355:                         break;
356:                     }
357:                 }
359:                 // If the target died while the bullet was mid-air, destroy the bullet to prevent a crash.
360:                 if (!isTargetAlive) {
361:                     it = projectiles.erase(it);
362:                     continue;
363:                 }
365:                 DirectX::XMFLOAT3 bPos = bullet->GetMovement()->GetPosition();
366:                 DirectX::XMFLOAT3 targetPos = targetEnemy->GetPosition();
368:                 float dx = bPos.x - targetPos.x;
369:                 float dz = bPos.z - targetPos.z;
370:                 float distSq = dx * dx + dz * dz;
372:                 // ---> DYNAMIC HITBOX MATH <---
373:                 float enemyScale = targetEnemy->GetScale().x;
374:                 float hitRadius = 1.0f * enemyScale;
376:                 if (targetEnemy->GetType() == EnemyType::Pentagon) hitRadius = 4.0f * enemyScale;
377:                 else if (targetEnemy->GetType() == EnemyType::Paddle) hitRadius = 0.8f * enemyScale;
379:                 float combinedHitRadius = hitRadius + bullet->GetRadius();
381:                 if (distSq < (combinedHitRadius * combinedHitRadius))
382:                 {
383:                     // ---> APPLY PARRY DAMAGE <---
384:                     constexpr int PARRY_DAMAGE = 30;
385:                     targetEnemy->TakeDamage(PARRY_DAMAGE);
387:                     // Destroy the bullet
388:                     it = projectiles.erase(it);
389:                     continue;
390:                 }
391:             }
393:             bool hitPlayer = false;
395:             // ----------------------------------------------------
396:             // ENEMY BULLET VS PLAYER COLLISION
397:             // ----------------------------------------------------
398:             XMFLOAT3 nextPosFloat;
399:             XMStoreFloat3(&nextPosFloat, vNextPos);
401:             if (m_player && bullet->GetHomingTarget() == nullptr && m_player->GetHP() > 0 && !m_player->IsInvincible())
402:             {
403:                 DirectX::XMFLOAT3 playerPos = m_player->GetMovement()->GetPosition();
405:                 constexpr int ENEMY_BULLET_DAMAGE = 10;
406:                 constexpr float PLAYER_HITBOX_RADIUS = 0.3f;
408:                 float combinedRadius = PLAYER_HITBOX_RADIUS + bulletRadius;
410:                 // Mathematical CCD (Prevents Tunneling)
411:                 float distToPath = DistancePointToLineSegment2D(currentPos, nextPosFloat, playerPos);
413:                 if (distToPath <= combinedRadius)
414:                 {
415:                     bool wasAlive = (m_player->GetHP() > 0);
416:                     m_player->TakeDamage(ENEMY_BULLET_DAMAGE);
418:                     // ---> THE SIMPLE DEATH STATE <---
419:                     if (m_player->GetHP() <= 0)
420:                     {
421:                         m_player->scale = { 0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f }; // Make the 3D model vanish
422:                         m_player->SetInputEnabled(false);       // Stop WASD and Spacebar input
423:                         m_player->GetMovement()->SetVelocity({ 0,0,0 }); // Stop sliding
424:                         m_player->GetStateMachine()->ChangeState(m_player, std::make_unique<PlayerDead>());
425:                     }
427:                     // Destroy the bullet and prevent crashes
428:                     it = projectiles.erase(it);
429:                     continue;
430:                 }
431:             }
433:             bullet->ApplyMovement(nextPosFloat, currentVel);
434:             ++it;
435:         }
436:     }
437: }
439: float CollisionManager::GetEnemyPushRadius(const Enemy* enemy) const
440: {
441:     float scale = enemy->GetScale().x;
443:     switch (enemy->GetType())
444:     {
445:     case EnemyType::Pentagon:   return 4.0f * scale;
446:     case EnemyType::Paddle:     return 0.8f * scale;
447:     case EnemyType::FakeBoss:   return 1.9f * scale;
448:     default:                    return 1.2f * scale;
449:     }
450: }
452: void CollisionManager::CheckPlayerVsEnemies()
453: {
454:     // FAST FAIL: Guard clauses
455:     if (!m_player || !m_enemyManager) return;
457:     // CPU OPTIMIZATION: If player is already dead, skip all enemy physics!
458:     if (m_player->GetHP() <= 0) return;
460:     auto& enemies{ m_enemyManager->GetEnemies() };
461:     DirectX::XMFLOAT3 playerPos{ m_player->GetMovement()->GetPosition() };
462:     DirectX::XMFLOAT3 playerVel{ m_player->GetMovement()->GetVelocity() };
464:     constexpr float PLAYER_RADIUS{ 0.25f };
465:     bool collidedAny{ false };
467:     for (const auto& enemy : enemies)
468:     {
469:         if (!enemy || !enemy->IsActive()) continue;
471:         const DirectX::XMFLOAT3 ePos{ enemy->GetPosition() };
473:         const float enemyRadius{ GetEnemyPushRadius(enemy.get()) };
474:         const float combinedRadius{ PLAYER_RADIUS + enemyRadius };
476:         // Zero-copy math
477:         float dx{ playerPos.x - ePos.x };
478:         float dz{ playerPos.z - ePos.z };
479:         const float distSq{ (dx * dx) + (dz * dz) };
481:         if (distSq < (combinedRadius * combinedRadius))
482:         {
483:             // =======================================================
484:             // THE KAMIKAZE INSTA-KILL MECHANIC
485:             // =======================================================
486:             if (enemy->GetAttackType() == AttackType::Tracking && !m_player->IsInvincible())
487:             {
488:                 // 1. Instantly nuke player HP
489:                 m_player->TakeDamage(9999);
491:                 // 2. Trigger standard death sequence
492:                 m_player->scale = { 0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f }; // Hide 3D model
493:                 m_player->SetInputEnabled(false);       // Lock controls
494:                 m_player->GetMovement()->SetVelocity({ 0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f }); // Stop sliding
495:                 m_player->GetStateMachine()->ChangeState(m_player, std::make_unique<PlayerDead>());
497:                 // 3. Kill the kamikaze enemy so it doesn't survive the explosion
498:                 enemy->TakeDamage(9999);
500:                 enemy->SetKilledPlayer(true);
502:                 // 4. INSTANT EXIT: Player is dead, absolutely zero need to check other enemies!
503:                 return;
504:             }
506:             // =======================================================
507:             // NORMAL PUSH PHYSICS (For Static / Standard Enemies)
508:             // =======================================================
509:             float dist{ std::sqrt(distSq) };
511:             // Divide-By-Zero Guard (NaN propagation)
512:             if (dist < 0.0001f)
513:             {
514:                 dx = 1.0f; dz = 0.0f; dist = 1.0f;
515:             }
517:             const float overlap{ combinedRadius - dist };
518:             playerPos.x += (dx / dist) * overlap;
519:             playerPos.z += (dz / dist) * overlap;
521:             collidedAny = true;
523:             // "Sticky Wall" Velocity Fix
524:             DirectX::XMVECTOR vVel{ DirectX::XMLoadFloat3(&playerVel) };
525:             const DirectX::XMVECTOR vNormal{ DirectX::XMVectorSet(dx / dist, 0.0f, dz / dist, 0.0f) };
527:             const float dot{ DirectX::XMVectorGetX(DirectX::XMVector3Dot(vVel, vNormal)) };
528:             if (dot < 0.0f)
529:             {
530:                 vVel = DirectX::XMVectorSubtract(vVel, DirectX::XMVectorScale(vNormal, dot));
531:                 DirectX::XMStoreFloat3(&playerVel, vVel);
532:             }
533:         }
534:     }
536:     // Only update memory if a collision actually happened
537:     if (collidedAny)
538:     {
539:         m_player->SetPosition(playerPos);
540:         m_player->GetMovement()->SetVelocity(playerVel);
541:     }
542: }
544: void CollisionManager::CheckPlayerVsCheckpointLines()
545: {
546:     if (!m_player || !m_stage || m_player->GetHP() <= 0) return;
548:     const float TRIGGER_RANGE_Z = 2.0f;
550:     for (const auto& line : m_stage->m_linesCheckpoint)
551:     {
552:         DirectX::XMVECTOR vLocalPos = TransformToLocalLine(m_player->GetMovement()->GetPosition(), line);
553:         DirectX::XMFLOAT3 localPos;
554:         DirectX::XMStoreFloat3(&localPos, vLocalPos);
555:         float lineHalfLength = line.Scale.x * 0.5f;
557:         // Check if player is between the left/right ends of the line
558:         if (localPos.x < -lineHalfLength || localPos.x > lineHalfLength) continue;
560:         // Check if player crosses the Z-depth of the line
561:         if (localPos.z > -TRIGGER_RANGE_Z && localPos.z < TRIGGER_RANGE_Z)
562:         {
563:             if (m_onCheckpointReachCallback)
564:             {
565:                 // line.Position is the exact center
566:                 m_onCheckpointReachCallback(line.Position);
567:             }
568:         }
569:     }
570: }
572: void CollisionManager::CheckPlayerVsTriggerLines()
573: {
574:     // Fast Fail: Guard against missing data or dead player
575:     if (!m_player || !m_stage || m_player->GetHP() <= 0) return;
577:     const float TRIGGER_RANGE_Z = 2.0f;
579:     for (int i = 0; i < m_stage->m_linesEnable.size(); ++i)
580:     {
581:         const auto& line = m_stage->m_linesEnable[i];
583:         // Transform player pos into the line's local space
584:         DirectX::XMVECTOR vLocalPos = TransformToLocalLine(m_player->GetMovement()->GetPosition(), line);
585:         DirectX::XMFLOAT3 localPos;
586:         DirectX::XMStoreFloat3(&localPos, vLocalPos);
588:         float lineHalfLength = line.Scale.x * 0.5f;
590:         // Check if player is standing on the line
591:         if (localPos.x >= -lineHalfLength && localPos.x <= lineHalfLength &&
592:             localPos.z > -TRIGGER_RANGE_Z && localPos.z < TRIGGER_RANGE_Z)
593:         {
594:             if (m_onEnableLineReachCallback)
595:             {
596:                 m_onEnableLineReachCallback(i);
597:             }
598:         }
599:     }
600: }

625: void CollisionManager::CheckPlayerVsItems()
626: {
627:     if (!m_player || !m_itemManager) return;
629:     XMFLOAT3 pPos = m_player->GetMovement()->GetPosition();
630:     float pRadius = 0.5f;
632:     for (auto& item : m_itemManager->GetItems())
633:     {
634:         if (!item->IsActive()) continue;
636:         XMFLOAT3 iPos = item->GetPosition();
637:         float iRadius = item->scale.x * 0.5f;
639:         float distSq = (pPos.x - iPos.x) * (pPos.x - iPos.x) +
640:             (pPos.z - iPos.z) * (pPos.z - iPos.z);
642:         float combinedRadius = pRadius + iRadius;
644:         if (distSq < combinedRadius * combinedRadius)
645:         {
646:             AudioManager::Instance().PlaySFX("Data/Sound/SE_Pop.wav", 0.4f);
648:             if (item->GetType() == ItemType::Invincible)
649:             {
650:             }
652:             item->SetActive(false);
653:         }
654:     }
655: }
657: void CollisionManager::CheckPlayerProjectilesVsEnemies(const float elapsedTime)
658: {
659:     // Cukup cek player di awal, agar logic menembak kandang tetap jalan
660:     // meskipun tidak ada musuh (atau m_enemyManager belum siap)
661:     if (!m_player) return;
663:     auto& projectiles{ m_player->GetProjectiles() };
665:     //constexpr int PLAYER_BULLET_DAMAGE = 10;
666:     constexpr float BULLET_HITBOX_RADIUS = 1.0f;
668:     for (auto& bullet : projectiles)
669:     {
670:         if (!bullet || !bullet->IsActive()) continue;
672:         const DirectX::XMFLOAT3 currentPos{ bullet->GetMovement()->GetPosition() };
674:         // =========================================================
675:         // [BARU] DETEKSI TABRAKAN PELURU VS KANDANG (CAGE)
676:         // =========================================================
677:         bool hitCage = false;
678:         if (m_Boss) {
679:             // Cek apakah sedang berada di fase Windowkill
680:             if (auto* wkPhase = dynamic_cast<BossPhase02*>(m_Boss->GetCurrentPhase())) {
681:                 if (wkPhase->IsPlayerCaged()) {
682:                     DirectX::XMFLOAT3 cPos = wkPhase->GetCagePos();
683:                     float halfSize = wkPhase->GetCageSize() * 0.5f;
685:                     // Jika posisi peluru MELEWATI batas kotak kandang
686:                     if (currentPos.x > cPos.x + halfSize || currentPos.x < cPos.x - halfSize ||
687:                         currentPos.z > cPos.z + halfSize || currentPos.z < cPos.z - halfSize)
688:                     {
689:                         // Kurangi HP kandang dan hancurkan peluru
690:                         wkPhase->DamageCage(bullet->GetDamage());
691:                         bullet->SetActive(false);
692:                         hitCage = true;
693:                     }
694:                 }
695:             }
696:         }
698:         // Jika peluru hancur menabrak kandang, lewati pengecekan musuh untuk peluru ini
699:         if (hitCage) continue;
701:         // =========================================================
702:         // DETEKSI PELURU VS MUSUH (Logika Aslimu)
703:         // =========================================================
704:         if (!m_enemyManager) continue; // Cek musuh di sini agar aman
705:         const auto& enemies{ m_enemyManager->GetEnemies() };
707:         const DirectX::XMFLOAT3 velocity{ bullet->GetVelocity() };
709:         // Calculate where the bullet was last frame
710:         const DirectX::XMFLOAT3 prevPos{
711:             currentPos.x - (velocity.x * elapsedTime),
712:             currentPos.y - (velocity.y * elapsedTime),
713:             currentPos.z - (velocity.z * elapsedTime)
714:         };
716:         // 1. Generate the Swept AABB for the bullet
717:         const AABB bulletAABB{ CreateSweptAABB(prevPos, currentPos, BULLET_HITBOX_RADIUS) };
719:         for (const auto& enemy : enemies)
720:         {
721:             if (!enemy || !enemy->IsActive()) continue;
723:             const DirectX::XMFLOAT3 ePos{ enemy->GetPosition() };
724:             const float enemyRadius{ GetEnemyPushRadius(enemy.get()) };
726:             // 2. Generate the static AABB for the enemy
727:             const AABB enemyAABB{
728:                 { ePos.x - enemyRadius, ePos.y - enemyRadius, ePos.z - enemyRadius },
729:                 { ePos.x + enemyRadius, ePos.y + enemyRadius, ePos.z + enemyRadius }
730:             };
732:             // 3. BROAD-PHASE: Are they even close?
733:             // This is a simple float comparison. It costs almost nothing.
734:             if (!CheckAABBIntersection(bulletAABB, enemyAABB))
735:             {
736:                 continue; // Skip the expensive math entirely!
737:             }
739:             // 4. NARROW-PHASE: The expensive exact math (Only runs if broad-phase passes)
740:             if (CheckSphereCollision(currentPos, ePos, BULLET_HITBOX_RADIUS + enemyRadius))
741:             {
742:                 enemy->TakeDamage(bullet->GetDamage());
743:                 bullet->SetActive(false);
744:                 break; // Stop checking this bullet against other enemies
745:             }
746:         }
747:     }
748: }
750: void CollisionManager::CheckNaviProjectilesVsEnemies(float elapsedTime)
751: {
752:     if (!m_navi || !m_enemyManager) return;
754:     auto& projectiles = m_navi->GetProjectiles();
755:     auto& enemies = m_enemyManager->GetEnemies();
757:     constexpr int NAVI_BULLET_DAMAGE = 1;
758:     constexpr float BULLET_HITBOX_RADIUS = 0.1f;
760:     for (auto& bullet : projectiles)
761:     {
762:         if (!bullet || !bullet->IsActive()) continue;
764:         DirectX::XMFLOAT3 currentPos = bullet->GetMovement()->GetPosition();
765:         DirectX::XMFLOAT3 vel = bullet->GetVelocity();
767:         // ---> CCD MATH: Calculate exactly where the bullet was last frame! <---
768:         DirectX::XMFLOAT3 prevPos = {
769:             currentPos.x - (vel.x * elapsedTime),
770:             currentPos.y - (vel.y * elapsedTime),
771:             currentPos.z - (vel.z * elapsedTime)
772:         };
774:         for (auto& enemy : enemies)
775:         {
776:             if (!enemy || !enemy->IsActive()) continue;
778:             DirectX::XMFLOAT3 ePos = enemy->GetPosition();
780:             // ---> DYNAMIC HITBOXES <---
781:             // Fetch the visual scale of the enemy so the hitbox matches the 3D model perfectly
782:             float enemyScale = enemy->GetScale().x;
783:             float enemyRadius = 1.0f * enemyScale; // Default Ball
785:             if (enemy->GetType() == EnemyType::Pentagon) enemyRadius = 4.0f * enemyScale;
786:             else if (enemy->GetType() == EnemyType::Paddle) enemyRadius = 0.6f * enemyScale;
788:             // Combine the enemy's size with the bullet's size
789:             float exactHitDistance = enemyRadius + BULLET_HITBOX_RADIUS;
791:             // ---> THE ANTI-TUNNELING CHECK <---
792:             // Draws an invisible math line from prevPos to currentPos.
793:             // If the enemy touches ANY part of that line, it's a guaranteed hit!
794:             float distToPath = DistancePointToLineSegment2D(prevPos, currentPos, ePos);
796:             if (distToPath <= exactHitDistance)
797:             {
798:                 enemy->TakeDamage(NAVI_BULLET_DAMAGE);
799:                 bullet->SetActive(false); // Send back to Object Pool instantly
800:                 break; // Stop checking this bullet against other enemies
801:             }
802:         }
803:     }
804: }
806: void CollisionManager::CheckPlayerProjectilesVsNavi(const float elapsedTime)
807: {
808:     // Fast fail: Early exit prevents unnecessary pointer dereferencing
809:     if (!m_player || !m_navi || !m_navi->IsAlive() || !m_navi->IsPotioned()) return;
811:     // Reference binding to avoid copying the container
812:     const auto& projectiles{ m_player->GetProjectiles() };
813:     const DirectX::XMFLOAT3 naviPos{ m_navi->GetMovement()->GetPosition() };
815:     constexpr float NAVI_HITBOX_RADIUS_XZ{ 0.8f };
816:     constexpr int PLAYER_BULLET_DAMAGE{ 10 };
818:     // CPU Optimization: Range-based for loop
819:     for (const auto& bullet : projectiles)
820:     {
821:         // Null and active state guard
822:         if (!bullet || !bullet->IsActive()) continue;
824:         // Brace initialization for zero-cost abstraction and preventing narrowing conversions
825:         const DirectX::XMFLOAT3 currentPos{ bullet->GetMovement()->GetPosition() };
826:         const DirectX::XMFLOAT3 vel{ bullet->GetVelocity() };
828:         const DirectX::XMFLOAT3 prevPos{
829:             currentPos.x - (vel.x * elapsedTime),
830:             currentPos.y - (vel.y * elapsedTime),
831:             currentPos.z - (vel.z * elapsedTime)
832:         };
834:         // Anti-tunneling CCD (Continuous Collision Detection)
835:         const float distToPath{ DistancePointToLineSegment2D(prevPos, currentPos, naviPos) };
837:         // 2D Cylinder Collision: Completely ignore the Y-axis vertical distance
838:         if (distToPath <= NAVI_HITBOX_RADIUS_XZ)
839:         {
840:             m_navi->TakeDamage(PLAYER_BULLET_DAMAGE);
841:             EffectManager::Instance().Play("Data/Effect/Hit.efk", naviPos, 1.0f);
842:             bullet->SetActive(false); // Instantly recycle the bullet into the object pool
843:         }
844:     }
845: }
847: void CollisionManager::CheckNaviAllyProjectilesVsPlayer(const float elapsedTime)

901: bool CollisionManager::CheckSphereCollision(const DirectX::XMFLOAT3& posA, const DirectX::XMFLOAT3& posB, float threshold)
902: {
903:     float dx = posA.x - posB.x;
904:     float dz = posA.z - posB.z;
905:     float distSq = (dx * dx) + (dz * dz);
906:     float thresholdSq = threshold * threshold;
908:     return distSq < thresholdSq;
909: }
911: Enemy* CollisionManager::GetTargetInSlashCone(const DirectX::XMFLOAT3& playerPos, const DirectX::XMFLOAT3& aimDir, float baseReach, float minDotProduct) const
912: {
913:     if (!m_enemyManager) return nullptr;
915:     Enemy* bestTarget{ nullptr };
916:     float closestDistSq{ (std::numeric_limits<float>::max)() };
918:     for (const auto& enemy : m_enemyManager->GetEnemies())
919:     {
920:         if (!enemy || !enemy->IsActive()) continue;
922:         const DirectX::XMFLOAT3 ePos{ enemy->GetPosition() };
923:         const float enemyScale{ enemy->GetScale().x };
924:         float enemyRadius{ 1.0f * enemyScale };
926:         if (enemy->GetType() == EnemyType::Pentagon) enemyRadius = 4.0f * enemyScale;
927:         else if (enemy->GetType() == EnemyType::Paddle) enemyRadius = 1.2f * enemyScale;
929:         // =========================================================
930:         // DYNAMIC HITBOX & TERNARY OPTIMIZATION
931:         // Kamikazes get a 3.5x reach multiplier to combat tunneling.
932:         // Using const initialization ensures zero mutation overhead.
933:         // =========================================================
934:         const bool isKamikaze{ enemy->GetAttackType() == AttackType::Tracking };
935:         const float dynamicReach{ isKamikaze ? (baseReach * 3.5f) : baseReach };
937:         const float exactSlashDistance{ 0.5f + enemyRadius + dynamicReach };
938:         const float exactSlashDistSq{ exactSlashDistance * exactSlashDistance };
940:         const float dx{ ePos.x - playerPos.x };
941:         const float dz{ ePos.z - playerPos.z };
942:         const float distSq{ (dx * dx) + (dz * dz) };
944:         // Fast fail distance check before expensive sqrt
945:         if (distSq < exactSlashDistSq && distSq > 0.0001f)
946:         {
947:             const float dist{ std::sqrt(distSq) };
948:             const float dirX{ dx / dist };
949:             const float dirZ{ dz / dist };
951:             const float dot{ (dirX * aimDir.x) + (dirZ * aimDir.z) };
953:             // STRICT FACING CHECK: If the dot product is less than the threshold
954:             // (e.g. Kamikaze is behind the player), this fails entirely. Player dies.
955:             if (dot >= minDotProduct)
956:             {
957:                 // =========================================================
958:                 // TARGET PRIORITIZATION (SHIELDING BUG PREVENTION)
959:                 // If it's a Kamikaze, we artificially multiply its distance
960:                 // by 0.1f during the comparison. This guarantees the Kamikaze
961:                 // wins the `bestTarget` check over standard enemies.
962:                 // =========================================================
963:                 const float prioritizationDistSq{ isKamikaze ? (distSq * 0.1f) : distSq };
965:                 if (prioritizationDistSq < closestDistSq)
966:                 {
967:                     closestDistSq = prioritizationDistSq;
968:                     bestTarget = enemy.get();
969:                 }
970:             }
971:         }
972:     }
974:     return bestTarget;
975: }
977: bool CollisionManager::GetParryableProjectile(const XMFLOAT3& playerPos, float threshold, Bullet** outBullet, Enemy** outNearestEnemy)
978: {
979:     // 1. Cek Musuh Biasa (JIKA ADA)
980:     if (m_enemyManager)
981:     {
982:         for (auto& enemy : m_enemyManager->GetEnemies())
983:         {
984:             if (enemy->GetAttackType() != AttackType::Tracking) continue;
986:             for (auto& bullet : enemy->GetProjectiles())
987:             {
988:                 if (!bullet->IsActive()) continue;
990:                 XMFLOAT3 bPos = bullet->GetMovement()->GetPosition();
992:                 if (CheckSphereCollision(playerPos, bPos, threshold))
993:                 {
994:                     if (outBullet) *outBullet = bullet.get();
996:                     // Cari musuh terdekat untuk dijadikan target homing parry
997:                     Enemy* nearest = nullptr;
998:                     float closestDistSq = 999999.0f;
999:                     for (auto& potential : m_enemyManager->GetEnemies())
1000:                     {
1001:                         if (!potential->IsActive()) continue;
1002:                         XMFLOAT3 targetPos = potential->GetPosition();
1003:                         float distSq = pow(playerPos.x - targetPos.x, 2) + pow(playerPos.z - targetPos.z, 2);
1004:                         if (distSq < closestDistSq) {
1005:                             closestDistSq = distSq;
1006:                             nearest = potential.get();
1007:                         }
1008:                     }
1009:                     if (outNearestEnemy) *outNearestEnemy = nearest ? nearest : enemy.get();
1011:                     return true;
1012:                 }
1013:             }
1014:         }
1015:     }
1017:     // =========================================================
1018:         // 2. DETEKSI BIJUUDAMA NAVI BOSS
1019:         // =========================================================
1020:     if (m_Boss)
1021:     {
1022:         auto* normalPhase = dynamic_cast<BossPhase01*>(m_Boss->GetCurrentPhase());
1023:         if (normalPhase)
1024:         {
1025:             // 1. Ambil serangan Bijuudama (Ultimate) yang sedang aktif
1026:             if (auto* ultAttack = normalPhase->GetActiveUltimate())
1027:             {
1028:                 // 2. Cek apakah bola sedang di-charge dan berada di dalam waktu Parry
1029:                 if (ultAttack->IsCharging() && ultAttack->IsInParryWindow())
1030:                 {
1031:                     Bullet* ball = ultAttack->GetBall();
1032:                     if (ball && ball->IsActive())
1033:                     {
1034:                         ball->SetParryReturn(true);
1036:                         if (outBullet) *outBullet = ball;
1037:                         if (outNearestEnemy) *outNearestEnemy = nullptr;
1039:                         // 3. Langsung picu efek pecah (Shatter) Bijuudama ke arah player
1040:                         normalPhase->OnBijuudamaParried(playerPos, m_Boss);
1042:                         return true;
1043:                     }
1044:                 }
1045:             }
1046:         }
1047:     }
1049:     return false;
1050: }
1052: void CollisionManager::CheckBossProjectilesVsPlayer(float elapsedTime)
1053: {
1054:     if (!m_player || !m_Boss || m_player->GetHP() <= 0) return;
1056:     // Radius standar hitbox player untuk peluru boss
1057:     float playerHitboxRadius = 0.3f;
1059:     // Fungsi helper (Lambda) untuk mengecek tabrakan 1 peluru vs Player
1060:     auto checkBulletHit = [&](Bullet* bullet) {
1061:         if (!bullet || !bullet->IsActive()) return;
1063:         // [PENTING] Jika peluru ini adalah hasil PARRY (mengarah balik ke bos), jangan lukai player!
1064:         if (bullet->GetBossTarget() != nullptr) return;
1066:         DirectX::XMFLOAT3 pPos = m_player->GetPosition();
1067:         DirectX::XMFLOAT3 bPos = bullet->GetMovement()->GetPosition();
1069:         // [FIX MUTLAK] Gunakan pengecekan 3D Penuh (X, Y, Z)
1070:         // Wajib agar serangan "Rain" dan "Bijuudama" yang melayang tinggi tidak mengenai player di bawahnya!
1071:         float dx = pPos.x - bPos.x;
1072:         float dy = pPos.y - bPos.y;
1073:         float dz = pPos.z - bPos.z;
1074:         float distSq = (dx * dx) + (dy * dy) + (dz * dz);
1076:         // Radius gabungan peluru dan player
1077:         float totalRadius = bullet->GetRadius() + playerHitboxRadius;
1079:         if (distSq <= (totalRadius * totalRadius)) {
1080:             // Player Kena Hit!
1081:             m_player->TakeDamage(bullet->GetDamage());
1082:             bullet->SetActive(false); // Matikan peluru
1084:             CameraController::Instance().AddTrauma(0.2f);
1085:             AudioManager::Instance().PlaySFX("Data/Sound/SE_Damage.wav", 0.3f);
1086:         }
1087:         };
1089:     // =========================================================
1090:     // 1. CEK PELURU PHASE 01 (NORMAL)
1091:     // =========================================================
1092:     if (auto* normalPhase = dynamic_cast<BossPhase01*>(m_Boss->GetCurrentPhase())) {
1093:         for (auto& bulletPtr : normalPhase->GetProjectiles()) {
1094:             checkBulletHit(bulletPtr.get());
1095:         }
1096:     }
1097:     // =========================================================
1098:     // 2. CEK PELURU PHASE 02 (WINDOWKILL)
1099:     // =========================================================
1100:     else if (auto* wkPhase = dynamic_cast<BossPhase02*>(m_Boss->GetCurrentPhase())) {
1101:         std::vector<Bullet*> activeBullets = wkPhase->GetProjectiles();
1102:         for (Bullet* bullet : activeBullets) {
1103:             checkBulletHit(bullet);
1104:         }
1105:     }
1106: }
1108: void CollisionManager::CheckBossProjectilesVsBoss(float elapsedTime)
1109: {

1112:     if (!normalPhase) return;

25: 	std::transform(extension.begin(), extension.end(), extension.begin(), tolower);	// 小文字化
27: 	tinygltf::TinyGLTF gltf;

35: 	{

37: 	}
38: 	else if (extension == ".gltf")
39: 	{
40: 		result = gltf.LoadASCIIFromFile(&gltfModel, &error, &warning, filepath.u8string());
41: 	}
42: 	if (!warning.empty())
43: 	{
44: 		OutputDebugStringA(warning.c_str());
45: 		OutputDebugStringA("\n");
46: 	}

48: 	{

50: 		OutputDebugStringA("\n");
51: 		_ASSERT_EXPR_A(result, error.c_str());

55: // ノードデータを読み込み
56: void GLTFImporter::LoadNodes(NodeList& nodes)
57: {
58: 	Model::Node& node = nodes.emplace_back();
59: 	node.name = filepath.filename().stem().string();
61: 	nodes.resize(gltfModel.nodes.size());
62: 	for (size_t gltfNodeIndex = 0; gltfNodeIndex < nodes.size(); ++gltfNodeIndex)
63: 	{
64: 		const tinygltf::Node& gltfNode = gltfModel.nodes.at(gltfNodeIndex);
65: 		Model::Node& node = nodes.at(gltfNodeIndex);
67: 		// データ取得
68: 		node.name = gltfNode.name;
70: 		for (int gltfChildNodeIndex : gltfNode.children)
71: 		{
72: 			nodes.at(gltfChildNodeIndex).parentIndex = static_cast<int>(gltfNodeIndex);
73: 		}
75: 		if (!gltfNode.matrix.empty())
76: 		{
77: 			DirectX::XMFLOAT4X4 m = gltfMatrixToXMFLOAT4X4(gltfNode.matrix);
79: 			DirectX::XMVECTOR S, R, T;
80: 			DirectX::XMMatrixDecompose(&S, &R, &T, DirectX::XMLoadFloat4x4(&m));
82: 			DirectX::XMStoreFloat3(&node.scale, S);
83: 			DirectX::XMStoreFloat4(&node.rotation, R);
84: 			DirectX::XMStoreFloat3(&node.position, T);
85: 		}
86: 		else
87: 		{
88: 			if (gltfNode.scale.size() > 0)
89: 			{
90: 				node.scale = gltfVector3ToXMFLOAT3(gltfNode.scale);
91: 			}
92: 			if (gltfNode.rotation.size() > 0)
93: 			{
94: 				node.rotation = gltfQuaternionToXMFLOAT4(gltfNode.rotation);
95: 			}
96: 			if (gltfNode.translation.size() > 0)
97: 			{
98: 				node.position = gltfVector3ToXMFLOAT3(gltfNode.translation);
99: 			}
100: 		}
101: 		// 座標系変換
102: 		ConvertNodeAxisSystem(node);
103: 	}
104: }
