107: void GLTFImporter::LoadMeshes(MeshList& meshes, const NodeList& nodes)
108: {
109: 	for (int gltfNodeIndex = 0; gltfNodeIndex < gltfModel.nodes.size(); ++gltfNodeIndex)
110: 	{
111: 		const tinygltf::Node& gltfNode = gltfModel.nodes.at(gltfNodeIndex);
112: 		if (gltfNode.mesh < 0) continue;
114: 		const tinygltf::Mesh& gltfMesh = gltfModel.meshes.at(gltfNode.mesh);
116: 		for (const tinygltf::Primitive& gltfPrimitive : gltfMesh.primitives)
117: 		{
118: 			Model::Mesh& mesh = meshes.emplace_back();
119: 			mesh.nodeIndex = gltfNodeIndex;
120: 			mesh.materialIndex = gltfPrimitive.material;
122: 			// ボーン
123: 			if (gltfNode.skin >= 0)
124: 			{
125: 				const tinygltf::Skin& gltfSkin = gltfModel.skins.at(gltfNode.skin);
126: 				const tinygltf::Accessor& gltfAccessor = gltfModel.accessors.at(gltfSkin.inverseBindMatrices);
127: 				const tinygltf::BufferView& gltfBufferView = gltfModel.bufferViews.at(gltfAccessor.bufferView);
129: 				for (int i = 0; i < gltfAccessor.count; ++i)
130: 				{
131: 					Model::Bone& bone = mesh.bones.emplace_back();
132: 					const DirectX::XMFLOAT4X4* offsetTransforms = reinterpret_cast<const DirectX::XMFLOAT4X4*>(gltfModel.buffers.at(gltfBufferView.buffer).data.data() + gltfBufferView.byteOffset + gltfAccessor.byteOffset);
133: 					bone.offsetTransform = offsetTransforms[i];
134: 					bone.nodeIndex = gltfSkin.joints.at(i);
135: 				}
136: 			}
138: 			// インデックスバッファ
139: 			{
140: 				const tinygltf::Accessor& gltfAccessor = gltfModel.accessors.at(gltfPrimitive.indices);
141: 				const tinygltf::BufferView& gltfBufferView = gltfModel.bufferViews.at(gltfAccessor.bufferView);
142: 				const void* indices = gltfModel.buffers.at(gltfBufferView.buffer).data.data() + gltfBufferView.byteOffset + gltfAccessor.byteOffset;
143: 				mesh.indices.resize(gltfAccessor.count);
144: 				if (gltfAccessor.componentType == TINYGLTF_COMPONENT_TYPE_UNSIGNED_INT)
145: 				{
146: 					const uint32_t* indicesU32 = static_cast<const uint32_t*>(indices);
147: 					for (size_t i = 0; i < gltfAccessor.count; ++i)
148: 					{
149: 						mesh.indices.at(i) = indicesU32[i];
150: 					}
151: 				}
152: 				else if (gltfAccessor.componentType == TINYGLTF_COMPONENT_TYPE_UNSIGNED_SHORT)
153: 				{
154: 					const uint16_t* indicesU16 = static_cast<const uint16_t*>(indices);
155: 					for (size_t i = 0; i < gltfAccessor.count; ++i)
156: 					{
157: 						mesh.indices.at(i) = indicesU16[i];
158: 					}
159: 				}
160: 				else
161: 				{
162: 					_ASSERT_EXPR_A(false, "This accessor component type is not supported.");;
163: 				}
164: 			}
166: 			// 頂点バッファ領域確保
167: 			{
168: 				std::map<std::string, int>::const_iterator gltfAttribute = gltfPrimitive.attributes.find("POSITION");
169: 				_ASSERT_EXPR(gltfAttribute != gltfPrimitive.attributes.end(), "");
170: 				const tinygltf::Accessor& gltfAccessor = gltfModel.accessors.at(gltfAttribute->second);
171: 				mesh.vertices.resize(gltfAccessor.count);
172: 			}
174: 			// 頂点バッファ
175: 			for (std::map<std::string, int>::const_reference gltfAttribute : gltfPrimitive.attributes)
176: 			{
177: 				const tinygltf::Accessor& gltfAccessor = gltfModel.accessors.at(gltfAttribute.second);
178: 				const tinygltf::BufferView& gltfBufferView = gltfModel.bufferViews.at(gltfAccessor.bufferView);
179: 				void* vertexBuffer = gltfModel.buffers.at(gltfBufferView.buffer).data.data() + gltfBufferView.byteOffset + gltfAccessor.byteOffset;
180: 				if (gltfAttribute.first == "POSITION")
181: 				{
182: 					const float* p = static_cast<const float*>(vertexBuffer);
183: 					for (size_t i = 0; i < gltfAccessor.count; ++i)
184: 					{
185: 						DirectX::XMFLOAT3& position = mesh.vertices.at(i).position;
186: 						position.x = p[0];
187: 						position.y = p[1];
188: 						position.z = p[2];
189: 						p += 3;
190: 					}
191: 				}
192: 				else if (gltfAttribute.first == "NORMAL")
193: 				{
194: 					const float* p = static_cast<const float*>(vertexBuffer);
195: 					for (size_t i = 0; i < gltfAccessor.count; ++i)
196: 					{
197: 						DirectX::XMFLOAT3& normal = mesh.vertices.at(i).normal;
198: 						normal.x = p[0];
199: 						normal.y = p[1];
200: 						normal.z = p[2];
201: 						p += 3;
202: 					}
203: 				}
204: 				else if (gltfAttribute.first == "TANGENT")
205: 				{
206: 					const float* p = static_cast<const float*>(vertexBuffer);
207: 					for (size_t i = 0; i < gltfAccessor.count; ++i)
208: 					{
209: 						DirectX::XMFLOAT4& tangent = mesh.vertices.at(i).tangent;
210: 						tangent.x = p[0];
211: 						tangent.y = p[1];
212: 						tangent.z = p[2];
213: 						tangent.w = p[3];
214: 						p += 4;
215: 					}
216: 				}
217: 				else if (gltfAttribute.first == "TEXCOORD_0")
218: 				{
219: 					switch (gltfAccessor.componentType)
220: 					{
221: 					case TINYGLTF_COMPONENT_TYPE_FLOAT:
222: 					{
223: 						const float* p = static_cast<const float*>(vertexBuffer);
224: 						for (size_t i = 0; i < gltfAccessor.count; ++i)
225: 						{
226: 							DirectX::XMFLOAT2& texcoord = mesh.vertices.at(i).texcoord;
227: 							texcoord.x = p[0];
228: 							texcoord.y = p[1];
229: 							p += 2;
230: 						}
231: 						break;
232: 					}
233: 					case TINYGLTF_COMPONENT_TYPE_UNSIGNED_BYTE:
234: 					{
235: 						const uint8_t* p = static_cast<const uint8_t*>(vertexBuffer);
236: 						for (size_t i = 0; i < gltfAccessor.count; ++i)
237: 						{
238: 							DirectX::XMFLOAT2& texcoord = mesh.vertices.at(i).texcoord;
239: 							texcoord.x = p[0] / static_cast<float>(0xFF);
240: 							texcoord.y = p[1] / static_cast<float>(0xFF);
241: 							p += 2;
242: 						}
243: 						break;
244: 					}
245: 					case TINYGLTF_COMPONENT_TYPE_UNSIGNED_SHORT:
246: 					{
247: 						const uint16_t* p = static_cast<const uint16_t*>(vertexBuffer);
248: 						for (size_t i = 0; i < gltfAccessor.count; ++i)
249: 						{
250: 							DirectX::XMFLOAT2& texcoord = mesh.vertices.at(i).texcoord;
251: 							texcoord.x = p[0] / static_cast<float>(0xFFFF);
252: 							texcoord.y = p[1] / static_cast<float>(0xFFFF);
253: 							p += 2;
254: 						}
255: 						break;
256: 					}
257: 					default:
258: 					{
259: 						_ASSERT_EXPR(0, L"");
260: 						continue;
261: 					}
262: 					}
263: 				}
264: 				else if (gltfAttribute.first == "JOINTS_0")
265: 				{
266: 					switch (gltfAccessor.componentType)
267: 					{
268: 					case TINYGLTF_COMPONENT_TYPE_UNSIGNED_BYTE:
269: 					{
270: 						const uint8_t* p = static_cast<const uint8_t*>(vertexBuffer);
271: 						for (size_t i = 0; i < gltfAccessor.count; ++i)
272: 						{
273: 							DirectX::XMUINT4& boneIndex = mesh.vertices.at(i).boneIndex;
274: 							boneIndex.x = p[0];
275: 							boneIndex.y = p[1];
276: 							boneIndex.z = p[2];
277: 							boneIndex.w = p[3];
278: 							p += 4;
279: 						}
280: 						break;
281: 					}
282: 					case TINYGLTF_COMPONENT_TYPE_UNSIGNED_SHORT:
283: 					{
284: 						const uint16_t* p = static_cast<const uint16_t*>(vertexBuffer);
285: 						for (size_t i = 0; i < gltfAccessor.count; ++i)
286: 						{
287: 							DirectX::XMUINT4& boneIndex = mesh.vertices.at(i).boneIndex;
288: 							boneIndex.x = p[0];
289: 							boneIndex.y = p[1];
290: 							boneIndex.z = p[2];
291: 							boneIndex.w = p[3];
292: 							p += 4;
293: 						}
294: 						break;
295: 					}
296: 					default:
297: 					{
298: 						_ASSERT_EXPR(0, L"");
299: 						continue;
300: 					}
301: 					}
302: 				}
303: 				else if (gltfAttribute.first == "WEIGHTS_0")
304: 				{
305: 					switch (gltfAccessor.componentType)
306: 					{
307: 					case TINYGLTF_COMPONENT_TYPE_FLOAT:
308: 					{
309: 						const float* p = static_cast<const float*>(vertexBuffer);
310: 						for (size_t i = 0; i < gltfAccessor.count; ++i)
311: 						{
312: 							DirectX::XMFLOAT4& boneWeights = mesh.vertices.at(i).boneWeight;
313: 							boneWeights.x = p[0];
314: 							boneWeights.y = p[1];
315: 							boneWeights.z = p[2];
316: 							boneWeights.w = p[3];
317: 							p += 4;
318: 						}
319: 						break;
320: 					}
321: 					case TINYGLTF_COMPONENT_TYPE_UNSIGNED_BYTE:
322: 					{
323: 						const uint8_t* p = static_cast<const uint8_t*>(vertexBuffer);
324: 						for (size_t i = 0; i < gltfAccessor.count; ++i)
325: 						{
326: 							DirectX::XMFLOAT4& boneWeights = mesh.vertices.at(i).boneWeight;
327: 							boneWeights.x = p[0] / static_cast<float>(0xFF);
328: 							boneWeights.y = p[1] / static_cast<float>(0xFF);
329: 							boneWeights.z = p[2] / static_cast<float>(0xFF);
330: 							boneWeights.w = p[3] / static_cast<float>(0xFF);
331: 							p += 4;
332: 						}
333: 						break;
334: 					}
335: 					case TINYGLTF_COMPONENT_TYPE_UNSIGNED_SHORT:
336: 					{
337: 						const uint16_t* p = static_cast<const uint16_t*>(vertexBuffer);
338: 						for (size_t i = 0; i < gltfAccessor.count; ++i)
339: 						{
340: 							DirectX::XMFLOAT4& boneWeights = mesh.vertices.at(i).boneWeight;
341: 							boneWeights.x = p[0] / static_cast<float>(0xFFFF);
342: 							boneWeights.y = p[1] / static_cast<float>(0xFFFF);
343: 							boneWeights.z = p[2] / static_cast<float>(0xFFFF);
344: 							boneWeights.w = p[3] / static_cast<float>(0xFFFF);
345: 							p += 4;
346: 						}
347: 						break;
348: 					}
349: 					default:
350: 					{
351: 						_ASSERT_EXPR(0, L"");
352: 						continue;
353: 					}
354: 					}
355: 				}
356: 			}
358: 			// タンジェントがなかった場合は自力で計算
359: 			if (gltfPrimitive.attributes.find("TANGENT") == gltfPrimitive.attributes.end() &&
360: 				gltfPrimitive.attributes.find("POSITION") != gltfPrimitive.attributes.end() &&
361: 				gltfPrimitive.attributes.find("TEXCOORD_0") != gltfPrimitive.attributes.end())
362: 			{
363: 				ComputeTangents(mesh.vertices, mesh.indices);
364: 			}
366: 			// 座標系変換
367: 			ConvertMeshAxisSystem(mesh);
368: 		}
369: 	}
371: }
373: // マテリアルデータを読み込み
374: void GLTFImporter::LoadMaterials(MaterialList& materials, ID3D11Device* device)
375: {
376: 	// ディレクトリパス取得
377: 	std::filesystem::path dirpath(filepath.parent_path());
379: 	for (const tinygltf::Material& gltfMaterial : gltfModel.materials)
380: 	{
381: 		Model::Material& material = materials.emplace_back();
382: 		material.name = gltfMaterial.name;
383: 		material.baseColor.x = static_cast<float>(gltfMaterial.pbrMetallicRoughness.baseColorFactor.at(0));
384: 		material.baseColor.y = static_cast<float>(gltfMaterial.pbrMetallicRoughness.baseColorFactor.at(1));
385: 		material.baseColor.z = static_cast<float>(gltfMaterial.pbrMetallicRoughness.baseColorFactor.at(2));
386: 		material.baseColor.w = static_cast<float>(gltfMaterial.pbrMetallicRoughness.baseColorFactor.at(3));
387: 		material.emissiveColor.x = static_cast<float>(gltfMaterial.emissiveFactor.at(0));
388: 		material.emissiveColor.y = static_cast<float>(gltfMaterial.emissiveFactor.at(1));
389: 		material.emissiveColor.z = static_cast<float>(gltfMaterial.emissiveFactor.at(2));
390: 		material.metalness = static_cast<float>(gltfMaterial.pbrMetallicRoughness.metallicFactor);
391: 		material.roughness = static_cast<float>(gltfMaterial.pbrMetallicRoughness.roughnessFactor);
392: 		material.occlusionStrength = static_cast<float>(gltfMaterial.occlusionTexture.strength);
393: 		material.alphaCutoff = static_cast<float>(gltfMaterial.alphaCutoff);
394: 		if (gltfMaterial.alphaMode == "BLEND")
395: 		{
396: 			material.alphaMode = Model::AlphaMode::Blend;
397: 		}
398: 		else if (gltfMaterial.alphaMode == "MASK")
399: 		{
400: 			material.alphaMode = Model::AlphaMode::Mask;
401: 		}
402: 		else
403: 		{
404: 			material.alphaMode = Model::AlphaMode::Opaque;
405: 		}
407: 		auto loadTexture = [&](int gltfTextureIndex, const char* textureType, std::string& textureFilename, ID3D11ShaderResourceView** srv)
408: 			{
409: 				if (gltfTextureIndex < 0) return;
411: 				const tinygltf::Texture& gltfTexture = gltfModel.textures.at(gltfTextureIndex);
412: 				const tinygltf::Image& gltfImage = gltfModel.images.at(gltfTexture.source);
413: 				if (gltfImage.bufferView >= 0 || !gltfImage.image.empty())
414: 				{
415: 					if (device != nullptr)
416: 					{
417: 						if (gltfImage.bufferView >= 0)
418: 						{
419: 							const tinygltf::BufferView& gltfBufferView = gltfModel.bufferViews.at(gltfImage.bufferView);
420: 							const tinygltf::Buffer& gltfBuffer = gltfModel.buffers.at(gltfBufferView.buffer);
421: 							const byte* data = gltfBuffer.data.data() + gltfBufferView.byteOffset;
422: 							GpuResourceUtils::LoadTexture(device, data, gltfBufferView.byteLength, srv);
423: 						}
424: 						else
425: 						{
426: 							HRESULT hr = GpuResourceUtils::LoadTexture(device, gltfImage.image.data(), gltfImage.image.size(), srv);
427: 							if (FAILED(hr))
428: 							{
429: 								D3D11_TEXTURE2D_DESC desc = { 0 };
430: 								desc.Width = gltfImage.width;
431: 								desc.Height = gltfImage.height;
432: 								desc.MipLevels = 1;
433: 								desc.ArraySize = 1;
434: 								desc.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;
435: 								desc.SampleDesc.Count = 1;
436: 								desc.SampleDesc.Quality = 0;
437: 								desc.Usage = D3D11_USAGE_DEFAULT;
438: 								desc.BindFlags = D3D11_BIND_SHADER_RESOURCE;
439: 								desc.CPUAccessFlags = 0;
440: 								desc.MiscFlags = 0;
441: 								D3D11_SUBRESOURCE_DATA data;
442: 								::memset(&data, 0, sizeof(data));
443: 								data.pSysMem = gltfImage.image.data();
444: 								data.SysMemPitch = gltfImage.width * (gltfImage.bits / 8);
446: 								Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID3D11Texture2D>	texture;
447: 								HRESULT hr = device->CreateTexture2D(&desc, &data, texture.GetAddressOf());
448: 								_ASSERT_EXPR(SUCCEEDED(hr), HRTrace(hr));
450: 								hr = device->CreateShaderResourceView(texture.Get(), nullptr, srv);
451: 								_ASSERT_EXPR(SUCCEEDED(hr), HRTrace(hr));
452: 							}
453: 						}
454: 					}
455: 					else
456: 					{
457: 						// テクスチャファイルパス作成
458: 						std::filesystem::path textureFilePath(gltfImage.uri);
459: 						if (textureFilePath == "")
460: 						{
461: 							// テクスチャファイル名がなかった場合はマテリアル名とテクスチャタイプから作成
462: 							std::string extension(std::filesystem::path(gltfImage.mimeType).filename().string());
463: 							textureFilePath = material.name + "_" + textureType + "." + extension;
464: 						}
465: 						textureFilePath = "Textures" / textureFilePath.filename();
467: 						// 埋め込みテクスチャを出力するディレクトリを確認
468: 						std::filesystem::path outputDirPath(dirpath / textureFilePath.parent_path());
469: 						if (!std::filesystem::exists(outputDirPath))
470: 						{
471: 							// なかったらディレクトリ作成
472: 							std::filesystem::create_directories(outputDirPath);
473: 						}
474: 						// 出力ディレクトリに画像ファイルを保存
475: 						std::filesystem::path outputFilePath(dirpath / textureFilePath);
476: 						if (!std::filesystem::exists(outputFilePath))
477: 						{
478: 							if (gltfImage.bufferView >= 0)
479: 							{
480: 								const tinygltf::BufferView& gltfBufferView = gltfModel.bufferViews.at(gltfImage.bufferView);
481: 								const tinygltf::Buffer& gltfBuffer = gltfModel.buffers.at(gltfBufferView.buffer);
482: 								const byte* data = gltfBuffer.data.data() + gltfBufferView.byteOffset;
484: 								std::ofstream os(outputFilePath.string().c_str(), std::ios::binary);
485: 								os.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(data), gltfBufferView.byteLength);
486: 							}
487: 							else
488: 							{
489: 								// リニアな画像データは.pngで出力
490: 								textureFilePath = textureFilePath.replace_extension(".png");
491: 								stbi_write_png(
492: 									outputFilePath.string().c_str(),
493: 									static_cast<int>(gltfImage.width),
494: 									static_cast<int>(gltfImage.height),
495: 									static_cast<int>(sizeof(uint32_t)),
496: 									gltfImage.image.data(), 0);
497: 							}
498: 						}
499: 						// テクスチャファイルパスを格納
500: 						textureFilename = textureFilePath.string();
501: 					}
502: 				}
503: 				else
504: 				{
505: 					textureFilename = gltfImage.uri;
506: 				}
507: 			};
508: 		loadTexture(gltfMaterial.pbrMetallicRoughness.baseColorTexture.index, "Base", material.baseTextureFileName, material.baseMap.GetAddressOf());
509: 		loadTexture(gltfMaterial.normalTexture.index, "Normal", material.normalTextureFileName, material.normalMap.GetAddressOf());
510: 		loadTexture(gltfMaterial.emissiveTexture.index, "Emissive", material.emissiveTextureFileName, material.emissiveMap.GetAddressOf());
511: 		loadTexture(gltfMaterial.occlusionTexture.index, "Occlusion", material.occlusionTextureFileName, material.occlusionMap.GetAddressOf());
512: 		loadTexture(gltfMaterial.pbrMetallicRoughness.metallicRoughnessTexture.index, "MetallicRoughness", material.metalnessRoughnessTextureFileName, material.metalnessRoughnessMap.GetAddressOf());
513: 	}
514: }
516: // アニメーションデータを読み込み
517: void GLTFImporter::LoadAnimations(AnimationList& animations, const NodeList& nodes, float sampleRate)
518: {
519: 	DirectX::XMVECTOR Epsilon = DirectX::XMVectorReplicate(0.00001f);
521: 	for (const tinygltf::Animation& gltfAnimation : gltfModel.animations)
522: 	{
523: 		Model::Animation& animation = animations.emplace_back();
524: 		animation.name = gltfAnimation.name;
525: 		animation.nodeAnims.resize(nodes.size());
526: 		animation.secondsLength = 0;
528: 		float minTime = FLT_MAX;
529: 		float maxTime = 0;
530: 		for (const tinygltf::AnimationChannel& gltfAnimationChannel : gltfAnimation.channels)
531: 		{
532: 			// ノードアニメーションデータを読み取り開始
533: 			Model::NodeAnim& nodeAnim = animation.nodeAnims.at(gltfAnimationChannel.target_node);
534: 			const tinygltf::AnimationSampler& gltfAnimationSampler = gltfAnimation.samplers.at(gltfAnimationChannel.sampler);
535: 			const tinygltf::Accessor& gltfInputAccessor = gltfModel.accessors.at(gltfAnimationSampler.input);
536: 			const tinygltf::Accessor& gltfOutputAccessor = gltfModel.accessors.at(gltfAnimationSampler.output);
537: 			const tinygltf::BufferView& gltfInputBufferView{ gltfModel.bufferViews.at(gltfInputAccessor.bufferView) };
538: 			const tinygltf::BufferView& gltfOutputBufferView = gltfModel.bufferViews.at(gltfOutputAccessor.bufferView);
540: 			const float* gltfKeyframeTimes = reinterpret_cast<const float*>(gltfModel.buffers.at(gltfInputBufferView.buffer).data.data() + gltfInputBufferView.byteOffset + gltfInputAccessor.byteOffset);
541: 			minTime = (std::min)(minTime, gltfKeyframeTimes[0]);
542: 			maxTime = (std::max)(animation.secondsLength, gltfKeyframeTimes[gltfInputAccessor.count - 1]);
544: 			if (gltfAnimationChannel.target_path == "scale")
545: 			{
546: 				// キーフレームデータ取得
547: 				const DirectX::XMFLOAT3* gltfKeyframeValues = reinterpret_cast<const DirectX::XMFLOAT3*>(gltfModel.buffers.at(gltfOutputBufferView.buffer).data.data() + gltfOutputBufferView.byteOffset + gltfOutputAccessor.byteOffset);
548: 				for (int i = 0; i < gltfInputAccessor.count; ++i)
549: 				{
550: 					Model::VectorKeyframe& keyframe = nodeAnim.scaleKeyframes.emplace_back();
551: 					keyframe.seconds = gltfKeyframeTimes[i];
552: 					keyframe.value = gltfKeyframeValues[i];
553: 				}
554: 				// キーフレームの値が全て同じなら最初のキーフレーム以外省く
555: 				bool result = true;
556: 				DirectX::XMVECTOR A = DirectX::XMLoadFloat3(&nodeAnim.scaleKeyframes.at(0).value);
557: 				for (size_t i = 1; i < nodeAnim.scaleKeyframes.size(); ++i)
558: 				{
559: 					DirectX::XMVECTOR B = DirectX::XMLoadFloat3(&nodeAnim.scaleKeyframes.at(i).value);
560: 					if (!DirectX::XMVector3NearEqual(A, B, Epsilon))
561: 					{
562: 						result = false;
563: 						break;
564: 					}
565: 				}
566: 				if (result)
567: 				{
568: 					nodeAnim.scaleKeyframes.resize(1);
569: 				}
570: 			}
571: 			else if (gltfAnimationChannel.target_path == "rotation")
572: 			{
573: 				// キーフレームデータ取得
574: 				const DirectX::XMFLOAT4* gltfKeyframeValues = reinterpret_cast<const DirectX::XMFLOAT4*>(gltfModel.buffers.at(gltfOutputBufferView.buffer).data.data() + gltfOutputBufferView.byteOffset + gltfOutputAccessor.byteOffset);
575: 				for (int i = 0; i < gltfInputAccessor.count; ++i)
576: 				{
577: 					// なぜかUnityで出力したアニメーションデータにはゴミと思われるキーフレームが存在している場合がある。
578: 					// 小数点が存在するフレーム（時間）がゴミデータっぽいので除外する。
579: 					float frame = gltfKeyframeTimes[i] * sampleRate;
580: 					if (fabs(std::round(frame) - frame) > 0.001) continue;
582: 					Model::QuaternionKeyframe& keyframe = nodeAnim.rotationKeyframes.emplace_back();
583: 					keyframe.seconds = gltfKeyframeTimes[i];
584: 					keyframe.value = gltfKeyframeValues[i];
585: 				}
587: 				// キーフレームの値が全て同じなら最初のキーフレーム以外省く
588: 				bool result = true;
589: 				DirectX::XMVECTOR A = DirectX::XMLoadFloat4(&nodeAnim.rotationKeyframes.at(0).value);
590: 				for (size_t i = 1; i < nodeAnim.rotationKeyframes.size(); ++i)
591: 				{
592: 					DirectX::XMVECTOR B = DirectX::XMLoadFloat4(&nodeAnim.rotationKeyframes.at(i).value);
593: 					if (!DirectX::XMVector4NearEqual(A, B, Epsilon))
594: 					{
595: 						result = false;
596: 						break;
597: 					}
598: 				}
599: 				if (result)
600: 				{
601: 					nodeAnim.rotationKeyframes.resize(1);
602: 				}
603: 			}
604: 			else if (gltfAnimationChannel.target_path == "translation")
605: 			{
606: 				// キーフレームデータ取得
607: 				const DirectX::XMFLOAT3* gltfKeyframeValues = reinterpret_cast<const DirectX::XMFLOAT3*>(gltfModel.buffers.at(gltfOutputBufferView.buffer).data.data() + gltfOutputBufferView.byteOffset + gltfOutputAccessor.byteOffset);
608: 				for (int i = 0; i < gltfInputAccessor.count; ++i)
609: 				{
610: 					Model::VectorKeyframe& keyframe = nodeAnim.positionKeyframes.emplace_back();
611: 					keyframe.seconds = gltfKeyframeTimes[i];
612: 					keyframe.value = gltfKeyframeValues[i];
613: 				}
615: 				// キーフレームの値が全て同じなら最初のキーフレーム以外省く
616: 				bool result = true;
617: 				DirectX::XMVECTOR A = DirectX::XMLoadFloat3(&nodeAnim.positionKeyframes.at(0).value);
618: 				for (size_t i = 1; i < nodeAnim.positionKeyframes.size(); ++i)
619: 				{
620: 					DirectX::XMVECTOR B = DirectX::XMLoadFloat3(&nodeAnim.positionKeyframes.at(i).value);
621: 					if (!DirectX::XMVector3NearEqual(A, B, Epsilon))
622: 					{
623: 						result = false;
624: 						break;
625: 					}
626: 				}
627: 				if (result)
628: 				{
629: 					nodeAnim.positionKeyframes.resize(1);
630: 				}
631: 			}
632: 		}
634: 		// 先頭キーフレームの時間が0じゃない場合があるので調整する
635: 		for (Model::NodeAnim& nodeAnim : animation.nodeAnims)
636: 		{
637: 			for (Model::VectorKeyframe& keyframe : nodeAnim.positionKeyframes)
638: 			{
639: 				keyframe.seconds -= minTime;
640: 			}
641: 			for (Model::QuaternionKeyframe& keyframe : nodeAnim.rotationKeyframes)
642: 			{
643: 				keyframe.seconds -= minTime;
644: 			}
645: 			for (Model::VectorKeyframe& keyframe : nodeAnim.scaleKeyframes)
646: 			{
647: 				keyframe.seconds -= minTime;
648: 			}
649: 		}
650: 		// アニメーション再生時間
651: 		animation.secondsLength = maxTime - minTime;
653: 		// 座標系変換
654: 		ConvertAnimationAxisSystem(animation);
656: 		// アニメーションがなかったノードに対して初期姿勢のキーフレームを追加する
657: 		for (size_t nodeIndex = 0; nodeIndex < animation.nodeAnims.size(); ++nodeIndex)
658: 		{
659: 			const Model::Node& node = nodes.at(nodeIndex);
660: 			Model::NodeAnim& nodeAnim = animation.nodeAnims.at(nodeIndex);
661: 			// 移動
662: 			if (nodeAnim.positionKeyframes.size() == 0)
663: 			{
664: 				Model::VectorKeyframe& keyframe = nodeAnim.positionKeyframes.emplace_back();
665: 				keyframe.seconds = 0.0f;
666: 				keyframe.value = node.position;
667: 			}
668: 			if (nodeAnim.positionKeyframes.size() == 1)
669: 			{
670: 				Model::VectorKeyframe& keyframe = nodeAnim.positionKeyframes.emplace_back();
671: 				keyframe.seconds = animation.secondsLength;
672: 				keyframe.value = nodeAnim.positionKeyframes.at(0).value;
673: 			}
674: 			// 回転
675: 			if (nodeAnim.rotationKeyframes.size() == 0)
676: 			{
677: 				Model::QuaternionKeyframe& keyframe = nodeAnim.rotationKeyframes.emplace_back();
678: 				keyframe.seconds = 0.0f;
679: 				keyframe.value = node.rotation;
680: 			}
681: 			if (nodeAnim.rotationKeyframes.size() == 1)
682: 			{
683: 				Model::QuaternionKeyframe& keyframe = nodeAnim.rotationKeyframes.emplace_back();
684: 				keyframe.seconds = animation.secondsLength;
685: 				keyframe.value = nodeAnim.rotationKeyframes.at(0).value;
686: 			}
687: 			// スケール
688: 			if (nodeAnim.scaleKeyframes.size() == 0)
689: 			{
690: 				Model::VectorKeyframe& keyframe = nodeAnim.scaleKeyframes.emplace_back();
691: 				keyframe.seconds = 0.0f;
692: 				keyframe.value = node.scale;
693: 			}
694: 			if (nodeAnim.scaleKeyframes.size() == 1)
695: 			{
696: 				Model::VectorKeyframe& keyframe = nodeAnim.scaleKeyframes.emplace_back();
697: 				keyframe.seconds = animation.secondsLength;
698: 				keyframe.value = nodeAnim.scaleKeyframes.at(0).value;
699: 			}
700: 		}
701: 	}
702: }

780: void GLTFImporter::ConvertMeshAxisSystem(Model::Mesh& mesh)
781: {
782: 	for (Model::Vertex& v : mesh.vertices)
783: 	{
784: 		ConvertPositionAxisSystem(v.position);
785: 		ConvertPositionAxisSystem(v.normal);
786: 		ConvertPositionAxisSystem(v.tangent);
787: 	}
789: 	for (size_t i = 0; i < mesh.indices.size(); i += 3)
790: 	{
791: 		uint32_t* p = &mesh.indices.at(i);
792: 		uint32_t temp = p[1];
793: 		p[1] = p[2];
794: 		p[2] = temp;
795: 	}
797: 	for (Model::Bone& bone : mesh.bones)
798: 	{
799: 		ConvertMatrixAxisSystem(bone.offsetTransform);
800: 	}
801: }
803: void GLTFImporter::ConvertAnimationAxisSystem(Model::Animation& animation)
804: {
805: 	for (Model::NodeAnim& nodeAnim : animation.nodeAnims)
806: 	{
807: 		for (Model::VectorKeyframe& keyframe : nodeAnim.positionKeyframes)
808: 		{
809: 			ConvertPositionAxisSystem(keyframe.value);
810: 		}
811: 		for (Model::QuaternionKeyframe& keyframe : nodeAnim.rotationKeyframes)
812: 		{
813: 			ConvertRotationAxisSystem(keyframe.value);
814: 		}
815: 	}
816: }
818: // タンジェント計算
819: void GLTFImporter::ComputeTangents(std::vector<Model::Vertex>& vertices, const std::vector<uint32_t>& indices)
820: {
821: 	size_t vertexCount = vertices.size();
822: 	std::unique_ptr<DirectX::XMFLOAT3[]> tan1 = std::make_unique<DirectX::XMFLOAT3[]>(vertexCount);
823: 	std::unique_ptr<DirectX::XMFLOAT3[]> tan2 = std::make_unique<DirectX::XMFLOAT3[]>(vertexCount);
825: 	for (size_t i = 0; i < indices.size(); i += 3)
826: 	{
827: 		const uint32_t i1 = indices[i + 0];
828: 		const uint32_t i2 = indices[i + 1];
829: 		const uint32_t i3 = indices[i + 2];
831: 		const Model::Vertex& v1 = vertices[i1];
832: 		const Model::Vertex& v2 = vertices[i2];
833: 		const Model::Vertex& v3 = vertices[i3];
835: 		const float x1 = v2.position.x - v1.position.x;
836: 		const float x2 = v3.position.x - v1.position.x;
837: 		const float y1 = v2.position.y - v1.position.y;
838: 		const float y2 = v3.position.y - v1.position.y;
839: 		const float z1 = v2.position.z - v1.position.z;
840: 		const float z2 = v3.position.z - v1.position.z;
842: 		const float s1 = v2.texcoord.x - v1.texcoord.x;
843: 		const float s2 = v3.texcoord.x - v1.texcoord.x;
844: 		const float t1 = v2.texcoord.y - v1.texcoord.y;
845: 		const float t2 = v3.texcoord.y - v1.texcoord.y;
847: 		// ---> BUG PREVENTION: The Divide-By-Zero Guard <---
848: 		float det = (s1 * t2 - s2 * t1);
849: 		float r = 0.0f;
851: 		// Only perform division if the UV area is larger than a microscopic threshold
852: 		if (std::abs(det) > 0.0001f)
853: 		{
854: 			r = 1.0f / det;
855: 		}
857: 		const DirectX::XMFLOAT3 sdir = { (t2 * x1 - t1 * x2) * r, (t2 * y1 - t1 * y2) * r, (t2 * z1 - t1 * z2) * r };
858: 		const DirectX::XMFLOAT3 tdir = { (s1 * x2 - s2 * x1) * r, (s1 * y2 - s2 * y1) * r, (s1 * z2 - s2 * z1) * r };
860: 		tan1[i1] = { tan1[i1].x + sdir.x, tan1[i1].y + sdir.y, tan1[i1].z + sdir.z };
861: 		tan1[i2] = { tan1[i2].x + sdir.x, tan1[i2].y + sdir.y, tan1[i2].z + sdir.z };
862: 		tan1[i3] = { tan1[i3].x + sdir.x, tan1[i3].y + sdir.y, tan1[i3].z + sdir.z };
864: 		tan2[i1] = { tan2[i1].x + tdir.x, tan2[i1].y + tdir.y, tan2[i1].z + tdir.z };
865: 		tan2[i2] = { tan2[i2].x + tdir.x, tan2[i2].y + tdir.y, tan2[i2].z + tdir.z };
866: 		tan2[i3] = { tan2[i3].x + tdir.x, tan2[i3].y + tdir.y, tan2[i3].z + tdir.z };
867: 	}
869: 	for (size_t i = 0; i < vertexCount; ++i)
870: 	{
871: 		Model::Vertex& v = vertices[i];
873: 		DirectX::XMVECTOR N = DirectX::XMLoadFloat3(&v.normal);
874: 		DirectX::XMVECTOR T1 = DirectX::XMLoadFloat3(&tan1[i]);
876: 		// Gram-Schmidt orthogonalize
877: 		DirectX::XMVECTOR T = DirectX::XMVectorSubtract(T1, DirectX::XMVectorScale(N, DirectX::XMVectorGetX(DirectX::XMVector3Dot(N, T1))));
879: 		// ---> BUG PREVENTION: Zero Vector Guard <---
880: 		// If the tangent is a zero vector, normalizing it will cause another NaN crash!
881: 		if (DirectX::XMVectorGetX(DirectX::XMVector3LengthSq(T)) > 0.0001f)
882: 		{
883: 			T = DirectX::XMVector3Normalize(T);
884: 		}
885: 		else
886: 		{
887: 			// Safe fallback tangent (pointing right) if math fails
888: 			T = DirectX::XMVectorSet(1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
889: 		}
891: 		// Calculate handedness
892: 		DirectX::XMVECTOR T2 = DirectX::XMLoadFloat3(&tan2[i]);
893: 		float handedness = (DirectX::XMVectorGetX(DirectX::XMVector3Dot(DirectX::XMVector3Cross(N, T1), T2)) < 0.0f) ? -1.0f : 1.0f;
894: 		DirectX::XMStoreFloat4(&v.tangent, DirectX::XMVectorSetW(T, handedness));
895: 	}
896: }
</file>

7: // 頂点シェーダー読み込み
8: HRESULT GpuResourceUtils::LoadVertexShader(
9: 	ID3D11Device* device,
10: 	const char* filename,
11: 	const D3D11_INPUT_ELEMENT_DESC inputElementDescs[],
12: 	UINT inputElementCount,
13: 	ID3D11InputLayout** inputLayout,
14: 	ID3D11VertexShader** vertexShader)
15: {
16: 	// ファイルを開く
17: 	FILE* fp = nullptr;
18: 	fopen_s(&fp, filename, "rb");
19: 	_ASSERT_EXPR_A(fp, "Vertex Shader File not found");
21: 	// ファイルのサイズを求める
22: 	fseek(fp, 0, SEEK_END);
23: 	long size = ftell(fp);
24: 	fseek(fp, 0, SEEK_SET);
26: 	// メモリ上に頂点シェーダーデータを格納する領域を用意する
27: 	std::unique_ptr<u_char[]> data = std::make_unique<u_char[]>(size);
28: 	fread(data.get(), size, 1, fp);
29: 	fclose(fp);
31: 	// 頂点シェーダー生成
32: 	HRESULT hr = device->CreateVertexShader(data.get(), size, nullptr, vertexShader);
33: 	_ASSERT_EXPR(SUCCEEDED(hr), HRTrace(hr));
35: 	// 入力レイアウト
36: 	if (inputLayout != nullptr)
37: 	{
38: 		hr = device->CreateInputLayout(inputElementDescs, inputElementCount, data.get(), size, inputLayout);
39: 		_ASSERT_EXPR(SUCCEEDED(hr), HRTrace(hr));
40: 	}
42: 	return hr;
43: }

73: // テクスチャ読み込み
74: HRESULT GpuResourceUtils::LoadTexture(
75: 	ID3D11Device* device,
76: 	const char* filename,
77: 	ID3D11ShaderResourceView** shaderResourceView,
78: 	D3D11_TEXTURE2D_DESC* texture2dDesc)

106: 		_ASSERT_EXPR(SUCCEEDED(hr), HRTrace(hr));
107: 	}
108: 	else if (extension == ".hdr")
109: 	{
110: 		hr = DirectX::GetMetadataFromHDRFile(wfilename.c_str(), metadata);
111: 		_ASSERT_EXPR(SUCCEEDED(hr), HRTrace(hr));
113: 		hr = DirectX::LoadFromHDRFile(wfilename.c_str(), &metadata, scratch_image);
114: 		_ASSERT_EXPR(SUCCEEDED(hr), HRTrace(hr));
115: 	}
116: 	else

119: 		_ASSERT_EXPR(SUCCEEDED(hr), HRTrace(hr));
121: 		hr = DirectX::LoadFromWICFile(wfilename.c_str(), DirectX::WIC_FLAGS_NONE, &metadata, scratch_image);
122: 		_ASSERT_EXPR(SUCCEEDED(hr), HRTrace(hr));
123: 	}
125: 	// シェーダーリソースビュー作成
126: 	hr = DirectX::CreateShaderResourceView(device, scratch_image.GetImages(), scratch_image.GetImageCount(),
127: 		metadata, shaderResourceView);
128: 	_ASSERT_EXPR(SUCCEEDED(hr), HRTrace(hr));
130: 	// テクスチャ情報取得

132: 	{

134: 		(*shaderResourceView)->GetResource(resource.GetAddressOf());
136: 		Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID3D11Texture2D> texture2d;
137: 		hr = resource->QueryInterface<ID3D11Texture2D>(texture2d.GetAddressOf());
138: 		_ASSERT_EXPR(SUCCEEDED(hr), HRTrace(hr));
139: 		texture2d->GetDesc(texture2dDesc);
140: 	}
141: 	return hr;
142: }

<file path="Source/System/HighResolutionTimer.h" lines="130">
1: #pragma once
3: #include <windows.h>
5: class HighResolutionTimer
6: {
7: public:
8: 	HighResolutionTimer() : delta_time(-1.0), paused_time(0), stopped(false)
9: 	{
10: 		LONGLONG counts_per_sec;
11: 		QueryPerformanceFrequency(reinterpret_cast<LARGE_INTEGER*>(&counts_per_sec));
12: 		seconds_per_count = 1.0 / static_cast<double>(counts_per_sec);
14: 		QueryPerformanceCounter(reinterpret_cast<LARGE_INTEGER*>(&this_time));
15: 		base_time = this_time;
16: 		last_time = this_time;
17: 	}
19: 	// Returns the total time elapsed since Reset() was called, NOT counting any
20: 	// time when the clock is stopped.
21: 	float TimeStamp() const  // in seconds
22: 	{
23: 		// If we are stopped, do not count the time that has passed since we stopped.
24: 		// Moreover, if we previously already had a pause, the distance
25: 		// stop_time - base_time includes paused time, which we do not want to count.
26: 		// To correct this, we can subtract the paused time from mStopTime:
27: 		//
28: 		//                     |<--paused_time-->|
29: 		// ----*---------------*-----------------*------------*------------*------> time
30: 		//  base_time       stop_time        start_time     stop_time    this_time
32: 		if (stopped)
33: 		{
34: 			return static_cast<float>(((stop_time - paused_time) - base_time)*seconds_per_count);
35: 		}
37: 		// The distance this_time - mBaseTime includes paused time,
38: 		// which we do not want to count.  To correct this, we can subtract
39: 		// the paused time from this_time:
40: 		//
41: 		//  (this_time - paused_time) - base_time
42: 		//
43: 		//                     |<--paused_time-->|
44: 		// ----*---------------*-----------------*------------*------> time
45: 		//  base_time       stop_time        start_time     this_time
46: 		else
47: 		{
48: 			return static_cast<float>(((this_time - paused_time) - base_time)*seconds_per_count);
49: 		}
50: 	}
52: 	float TimeInterval() const  // in seconds
53: 	{
54: 		return static_cast<float>(delta_time);
55: 	}
57: 	void Reset() // Call before message loop.
58: 	{
59: 		QueryPerformanceCounter(reinterpret_cast<LARGE_INTEGER*>(&this_time));
60: 		base_time = this_time;
61: 		last_time = this_time;
63: 		stop_time = 0;
64: 		stopped = false;
65: 	}
67: 	void Start() // Call when unpaused.
68: 	{
69: 		LONGLONG start_time;
70: 		QueryPerformanceCounter(reinterpret_cast<LARGE_INTEGER*>(&start_time));
72: 		// Accumulate the time elapsed between stop and start pairs.
73: 		//
74: 		//                     |<-------d------->|
75: 		// ----*---------------*-----------------*------------> time
76: 		//  base_time       stop_time        start_time
77: 		if (stopped)
78: 		{
79: 			paused_time += (start_time - stop_time);
80: 			last_time = start_time;
81: 			stop_time = 0;
82: 			stopped = false;
83: 		}
84: 	}
86: 	void Stop() // Call when paused.
87: 	{
88: 		if (!stopped)
89: 		{
90: 			QueryPerformanceCounter(reinterpret_cast<LARGE_INTEGER*>(&stop_time));
91: 			stopped = true;
92: 		}
93: 	}
95: 	void Tick() // Call every frame.
96: 	{
97: 		if (stopped)
98: 		{
99: 			delta_time = 0.0;
100: 			return;
101: 		}
103: 		QueryPerformanceCounter(reinterpret_cast<LARGE_INTEGER*>(&this_time));
104: 		// Time difference between this frame and the previous.
105: 		delta_time = (this_time - last_time)*seconds_per_count;
107: 		// Prepare for next frame.
108: 		last_time = this_time;
110: 		// Force nonnegative.  The DXSDK's CDXUTTimer mentions that if the
111: 		// processor goes into a power save mode or we get shuffled to another
112: 		// processor, then mDeltaTime can be negative.
113: 		if (delta_time < 0.0)
114: 		{
115: 			delta_time = 0.0;
116: 		}
117: 	}
119: private:
120: 	double seconds_per_count;
121: 	double delta_time;
123: 	LONGLONG base_time;
124: 	LONGLONG paused_time;
125: 	LONGLONG stop_time;
126: 	LONGLONG last_time;
127: 	LONGLONG this_time;
129: 	bool stopped;
130: };
</file>

<file path="Source/System/Input.cpp" lines="105">
1: #include "System/Input.h"
3: void Input::Initialize(HWND hWnd)
4: {
5: 	gamePad = std::make_unique<GamePad>();
6: 	mouse = std::make_unique<Mouse>(hWnd);
7: 	keyboard = std::make_unique<Keyboard>();
9:     ::GetCursorPos(&m_lastMousePos);
10: }
12: void Input::Update()
13: {
14:     gamePad->Update();
15:     mouse->SetSuppressed(m_isKbmSuppressed);
16:     mouse->Update();
17:     if (m_isKbmSuppressed) {
18:         keyboard->UpdateSuppressed();
19:     }
20:     else {
21:         keyboard->Update();
22:     }
24:     // ---------------------------------------------------------
25:     // GAMEPAD DETECTION
26:     // ---------------------------------------------------------
27:     constexpr float analogDeadzone{ 0.15f };
29:     const bool isGamepadActive{
30:         gamePad->GetButton() != 0 ||
31:         std::abs(gamePad->GetAxisLX()) > analogDeadzone ||
32:         std::abs(gamePad->GetAxisLY()) > analogDeadzone ||
33:         std::abs(gamePad->GetAxisRX()) > analogDeadzone ||
34:         std::abs(gamePad->GetAxisRY()) > analogDeadzone ||
35:         gamePad->GetTriggerL() > analogDeadzone ||
36:         gamePad->GetTriggerR() > analogDeadzone
37:     };
39:     // ---------------------------------------------------------
40:     // KEYBOARD & MOUSE DETECTION (With Jitter Guard)
41:     // ---------------------------------------------------------
42:     bool isKbmActive{ false };
44:     // Mouse Jitter Guard (Requires a move of > 1 pixel to trigger)
45:     POINT currentMousePos{};
46:     if (::GetCursorPos(&currentMousePos))
47:     {
48:         const int deltaX{ std::abs(currentMousePos.x - m_lastMousePos.x) };
49:         const int deltaY{ std::abs(currentMousePos.y - m_lastMousePos.y) };
51:         if (deltaX > 1 || deltaY > 1)
52:         {
53:             isKbmActive = true;
54:         }
55:         m_lastMousePos = currentMousePos; // Always update history
56:     }
58:     // B. Core Keyboard Polling (Only runs if mouse was idle, thanks to short-circuit !)
59:     if (!isKbmActive)
60:     {
61:         // Poll the absolute most common action keys.
62:         if ((GetAsyncKeyState('W') & 0x8000) || (GetAsyncKeyState('A') & 0x8000) ||
63:             (GetAsyncKeyState('S') & 0x8000) || (GetAsyncKeyState('D') & 0x8000) ||
64:             (GetAsyncKeyState(VK_SHIFT) & 0x8000) || (GetAsyncKeyState(VK_SPACE) & 0x8000) ||
65:             (GetAsyncKeyState(VK_LBUTTON) & 0x8000) || (GetAsyncKeyState(VK_RBUTTON) & 0x8000) ||
66:             (GetAsyncKeyState(VK_RETURN) & 0x8000) || (GetAsyncKeyState(VK_ESCAPE) & 0x8000))
67:         {
68:             isKbmActive = true;
69:         }
70:     }
72:     // ---------------------------------------------------------
73:     // RESOLVE CONFLICT & UPDATE OS
74:     // ---------------------------------------------------------
75:     // If someone mashes both, Gamepad wins priority to prevent rapid flickering
76:     if (isGamepadActive) {
77:         m_lastUsedDevice = InputDevice::Gamepad;
78:     }
79:     // Why: typing in the debug window must not flip the game's active device.
80:     else if (isKbmActive && !m_isKbmSuppressed) {
81:         m_lastUsedDevice = InputDevice::Keyboard;
82:     }
84:     UpdateCursorVisibility();
85: }
87: void Input::UpdateCursorVisibility() noexcept
88: {
89:     // The strict rule: Keyboard = Visible, Gamepad = Hidden.
90:     const bool shouldBeVisible{ m_isKbmSuppressed || m_lastUsedDevice == InputDevice::Keyboard };
91:     // Early Exit
92:     if (m_isCursorVisible == shouldBeVisible) return;
94:     m_isCursorVisible = shouldBeVisible;
96:     // The Win32 OS Bug Fix: Safely force the OS internal counter to cross the 0 threshold.
97:     if (shouldBeVisible)
98:     {
99:         while (::ShowCursor(TRUE) < 0);
100:     }
101:     else
102:     {
103:         while (::ShowCursor(FALSE) >= 0);
104:     }
105: }

<file path="Source/System/Keyboard.cpp" lines="39">
1: #include "Keyboard.h"
3: void Keyboard::Update()
4: {
5: 	// Simpan status frame lalu ke variabel previous
6: 	memcpy(previousKeys, currentKeys, sizeof(currentKeys));
8: 	// Ambil status keyboard terbaru dari Windows
9: 	if (!GetKeyboardState(currentKeys))
10: 	{
11: 		// Jika gagal (jarang terjadi), reset
12: 		memset(currentKeys, 0, sizeof(currentKeys));
13: 	}
14: }
16: void Keyboard::UpdateSuppressed()
17: {
18: 	// Why: keeping the previous/current history lets held keys release cleanly instead of sticking.
19: 	memcpy(previousKeys, currentKeys, sizeof(currentKeys));
20: 	memset(currentKeys, 0, sizeof(currentKeys));
21: }
23: bool Keyboard::IsTriggered(int key) const
24: {
25: 	// Triggered = Sekarang ditekan (High bits), Sebelumnya tidak
26: 	return (currentKeys[key] & 0x80) && !(previousKeys[key] & 0x80);
27: }
29: bool Keyboard::IsPress(int key) const
30: {
31: 	// Press = Sekarang ditekan
32: 	return (currentKeys[key] & 0x80);
33: }
35: bool Keyboard::IsReleased(int key) const
36: {
37: 	// Released = Sekarang tidak ditekan, Sebelumnya ditekan
38: 	return !(currentKeys[key] & 0x80) && (previousKeys[key] & 0x80);
39: }

22: 	// メッシュ用定数バッファ

29: // 開始処理
30: void LambertShader::Begin(const RenderContext& rc)
31: {
32: 	ID3D11DeviceContext* dc = rc.deviceContext;
34: 	// シェーダー設定
35: 	dc->IASetInputLayout(inputLayout.Get());
36: 	dc->VSSetShader(vertexShader.Get(), nullptr, 0);
37: 	dc->PSSetShader(pixelShader.Get(), nullptr, 0);
39: 	// 定数バッファ設定
40: 	ID3D11Buffer* cbs[] =
41: 	{
42: 		meshConstantBuffer.Get(),
43: 	};
44: 	dc->PSSetConstantBuffers(0, _countof(cbs), cbs);
45: }
47: // 更新処理

49: {

52: 	// メッシュ用定数バッファ更新
53: 	CbMesh cbMesh{};
54: 	cbMesh.materialColor = mesh.material->baseColor;
55: 	dc->UpdateSubresource(meshConstantBuffer.Get(), 0, 0, &cbMesh, 0, 0);
57: 	// シェーダーリソースビュー設定
58: 	ID3D11ShaderResourceView* srvs[] =
59: 	{
60: 		mesh.material->baseMap.Get(),
61: 	};
62: 	dc->PSSetShaderResources(0, _countof(srvs), srvs);
63: }
65: // 描画終了

73: 	dc->IASetInputLayout(nullptr);
75: 	// 定数バッファ設定解除
76: 	ID3D11Buffer* cbs[] = { nullptr };

79: 	// シェーダーリソースビュー設定解除

194: Model::Model(ID3D11Device* device, const char* filename, float sampleRate)
195: {
196: 	std::filesystem::path filepath(filename);
197: 	std::filesystem::path dirpath(filepath.parent_path());
199: 	std::filesystem::path extension = filepath.extension();
201: 	// 独自形式のモデルファイルの存在確認
202: 	filepath.replace_extension(".cereal");
203: 	if (std::filesystem::exists(filepath))
204: 	{
205: 		// 独自形式のモデルファイルの読み込み
206: 		Deserialize(filepath.string().c_str());
207: 	}
208: 	else if (extension == ".gltf" || extension == ".glb")
209: 	{
210: 		// 汎用モデルファイルの読み込み
211: 		GLTFImporter importer(filename);
213: 		// マテリアルデータ読み取り
214: 		importer.LoadMaterials(materials, device);
216: 		// ノードデータ読み取り
217: 		importer.LoadNodes(nodes);
219: 		// メッシュデータ読み取り
220: 		importer.LoadMeshes(meshes, nodes);
222: 		// アニメーションデータ読み取り
223: 		importer.LoadAnimations(animations, nodes, sampleRate);
225: 		// 独自形式のモデルファイルを保存
226: 		//Serialize(filepath.string().c_str());
227: 	}
228: 	else
229: 	{
230: 		_ASSERT_EXPR_A(false, "found not model file");
231: 	}
233: 	// マテリアル構築
234: 	for (Material& material : materials)
235: 	{
236: 		if (material.baseMap == nullptr)
237: 		{
238: 			if (material.baseTextureFileName.empty())
239: 			{
240: 				// ダミーテクスチャ作成
241: 				HRESULT hr = GpuResourceUtils::CreateDummyTexture(device, 0xFFFFFFFF,
242: 					material.baseMap.GetAddressOf());
243: 				_ASSERT_EXPR(SUCCEEDED(hr), HRTrace(hr));
244: 			}
245: 			else
246: 			{
247: 				// ベーステクスチャ読み込み
248: 				std::filesystem::path diffuseTexturePath(dirpath / material.baseTextureFileName);
249: 				HRESULT hr = GpuResourceUtils::LoadTexture(device, diffuseTexturePath.string().c_str(),
250: 					material.baseMap.GetAddressOf());
251: 				_ASSERT_EXPR(SUCCEEDED(hr), HRTrace(hr));
252: 			}
253: 		}
255: 		if (material.normalMap == nullptr)
256: 		{
257: 			if (material.normalTextureFileName.empty())
258: 			{
259: 				// 法線ダミーテクスチャ作成
260: 				HRESULT hr = GpuResourceUtils::CreateDummyTexture(device, 0xFFFF7F7F,
261: 					material.normalMap.GetAddressOf());
262: 				_ASSERT_EXPR(SUCCEEDED(hr), HRTrace(hr));
263: 			}
264: 			else
265: 			{
266: 				// 法線テクスチャ読み込み
267: 				std::filesystem::path texturePath(dirpath / material.normalTextureFileName);
268: 				HRESULT hr = GpuResourceUtils::LoadTexture(device, texturePath.string().c_str(),
269: 					material.normalMap.GetAddressOf());
270: 				_ASSERT_EXPR(SUCCEEDED(hr), HRTrace(hr));
271: 			}
272: 		}
273: 	}
275: 	// ノード構築
276: 	for (size_t nodeIndex = 0; nodeIndex < nodes.size(); ++nodeIndex)
277: 	{
278: 		Node& node = nodes.at(nodeIndex);
280: 		// 親子関係を構築
281: 		node.parent = node.parentIndex >= 0 ? &nodes.at(node.parentIndex) : nullptr;
282: 		if (node.parent != nullptr)
283: 		{
284: 			node.parent->children.emplace_back(&node);
285: 		}
286: 	}
288: 	// メッシュ構築
289: 	for (Mesh& mesh : meshes)
290: 	{
291: 		// 参照マテリアル設定
292: 		mesh.material = &materials.at(mesh.materialIndex);
294: 		// 参照ノード設定
295: 		mesh.node = &nodes.at(mesh.nodeIndex);
297: 		// 頂点バッファ
298: 		{
299: 			D3D11_BUFFER_DESC bufferDesc = {};
300: 			D3D11_SUBRESOURCE_DATA subresourceData = {};
302: 			bufferDesc.ByteWidth = static_cast<UINT>(sizeof(Vertex) * mesh.vertices.size());
303: 			bufferDesc.Usage = D3D11_USAGE_IMMUTABLE;
304: 			bufferDesc.BindFlags = D3D11_BIND_VERTEX_BUFFER;
305: 			bufferDesc.CPUAccessFlags = 0;
306: 			bufferDesc.MiscFlags = 0;
307: 			bufferDesc.StructureByteStride = 0;
308: 			subresourceData.pSysMem = mesh.vertices.data();
309: 			subresourceData.SysMemPitch = 0;
310: 			subresourceData.SysMemSlicePitch = 0;
312: 			HRESULT hr = device->CreateBuffer(&bufferDesc, &subresourceData, mesh.vertexBuffer.GetAddressOf());
313: 			_ASSERT_EXPR(SUCCEEDED(hr), HRTrace(hr));
314: 		}
316: 		// インデックスバッファ
317: 		{
318: 			D3D11_BUFFER_DESC bufferDesc = {};
319: 			D3D11_SUBRESOURCE_DATA subresourceData = {};
321: 			bufferDesc.ByteWidth = static_cast<UINT>(sizeof(uint32_t) * mesh.indices.size());
322: 			bufferDesc.Usage = D3D11_USAGE_IMMUTABLE;
323: 			bufferDesc.BindFlags = D3D11_BIND_INDEX_BUFFER;
324: 			bufferDesc.CPUAccessFlags = 0;
325: 			bufferDesc.MiscFlags = 0;
326: 			bufferDesc.StructureByteStride = 0;
327: 			subresourceData.pSysMem = mesh.indices.data();
328: 			subresourceData.SysMemPitch = 0;
329: 			subresourceData.SysMemSlicePitch = 0;
330: 			HRESULT hr = device->CreateBuffer(&bufferDesc, &subresourceData, mesh.indexBuffer.GetAddressOf());
331: 			_ASSERT_EXPR(SUCCEEDED(hr), HRTrace(hr));
332: 		}
334: 		// ボーン構築
335: 		for (Bone& bone : mesh.bones)
336: 		{
337: 			// 参照ノード設定
338: 			bone.node = &nodes.at(bone.nodeIndex);
339: 		}
340: 	}
342: 	// 行列初期化
343: 	DirectX::XMFLOAT4X4 worldTransform;
344: 	DirectX::XMStoreFloat4x4(&worldTransform, DirectX::XMMatrixIdentity());
345: 	UpdateTransform(worldTransform);
346: }
348: // アニメーション追加読み込み
349: void Model::AppendAnimations(const char* filename)
350: {
351: 	std::filesystem::path filepath(filename);
352: 	std::filesystem::path dirpath(filepath.parent_path());
354: 	if (filepath.extension() == ".gltf" ||
355: 		filepath.extension() == ".glb")
356: 	{
357: 		// 汎用モデルファイルの読み込み
358: 		GLTFImporter importer(filename);
360: 		// アニメーションデータ読み取り
361: 		importer.LoadAnimations(animations, nodes);
362: 	}
363: 	else
364: 	{
365: 		_ASSERT_EXPR_A(false, "found not model file");
366: 	}
367: }

395: // トランスフォーム更新処理
396: void Model::UpdateTransform(const DirectX::XMFLOAT4X4& worldTransform)
397: {
398: 	DirectX::XMMATRIX ParentWorldTransform = DirectX::XMLoadFloat4x4(&worldTransform);
400: 	for (Node& node : nodes)
401: 	{
402: 		// ローカル行列算出
403: 		DirectX::XMMATRIX S = DirectX::XMMatrixScaling(node.scale.x, node.scale.y, node.scale.z);
404: 		DirectX::XMMATRIX R = DirectX::XMMatrixRotationQuaternion(DirectX::XMLoadFloat4(&node.rotation));
405: 		DirectX::XMMATRIX T = DirectX::XMMatrixTranslation(node.position.x, node.position.y, node.position.z);
406: 		DirectX::XMMATRIX LocalTransform = S * R * T;
408: 		// グローバル行列算出
409: 		DirectX::XMMATRIX ParentGlobalTransform;
410: 		if (node.parent != nullptr)
411: 		{
412: 			ParentGlobalTransform = DirectX::XMLoadFloat4x4(&node.parent->globalTransform);
413: 		}
414: 		else
415: 		{
416: 			ParentGlobalTransform = DirectX::XMMatrixIdentity();
417: 		}
418: 		DirectX::XMMATRIX GlobalTransform = LocalTransform * ParentGlobalTransform;
420: 		// ワールド行列算出
421: 		DirectX::XMMATRIX WorldTransform = GlobalTransform * ParentWorldTransform;
423: 		// 計算結果を格納
424: 		DirectX::XMStoreFloat4x4(&node.localTransform, LocalTransform);
425: 		DirectX::XMStoreFloat4x4(&node.globalTransform, GlobalTransform);
426: 		DirectX::XMStoreFloat4x4(&node.worldTransform, WorldTransform);
427: 	}
428: }
430: void Model::ComputeAnimation(int animationIndex, int nodeIndex, float time, NodePose& nodePose) const
431: {
432: 	const Animation& animation = animations.at(animationIndex);
433: 	const NodeAnim& nodeAnim = animation.nodeAnims.at(nodeIndex);
435: 	// 位置
436: 	for (size_t index = 0; index < nodeAnim.positionKeyframes.size() - 1; ++index)
437: 	{
438: 		// 現在の時間がどのキーフレームの間にいるか判定する
439: 		const VectorKeyframe& keyframe0 = nodeAnim.positionKeyframes.at(index);
440: 		const VectorKeyframe& keyframe1 = nodeAnim.positionKeyframes.at(index + 1);
441: 		if (time >= keyframe0.seconds && time <= keyframe1.seconds)
442: 		{
443: 			// 再生時間とキーフレームの時間から補完率を算出する
444: 			float rate = (time - keyframe0.seconds) / (keyframe1.seconds - keyframe0.seconds);
446: 			// 前のキーフレームと次のキーフレームの姿勢を補完
447: 			DirectX::XMVECTOR V0 = DirectX::XMLoadFloat3(&keyframe0.value);
448: 			DirectX::XMVECTOR V1 = DirectX::XMLoadFloat3(&keyframe1.value);
449: 			DirectX::XMVECTOR V = DirectX::XMVectorLerp(V0, V1, rate);
450: 			// 計算結果をノードに格納
451: 			DirectX::XMStoreFloat3(&nodePose.position, V);
452: 		}
453: 	}
454: 	// 回転
455: 	for (size_t index = 0; index < nodeAnim.rotationKeyframes.size() - 1; ++index)
456: 	{
457: 		// 現在の時間がどのキーフレームの間にいるか判定する
458: 		const QuaternionKeyframe& keyframe0 = nodeAnim.rotationKeyframes.at(index);
459: 		const QuaternionKeyframe& keyframe1 = nodeAnim.rotationKeyframes.at(index + 1);
460: 		if (time >= keyframe0.seconds && time <= keyframe1.seconds)
461: 		{
462: 			// 再生時間とキーフレームの時間から補完率を算出する
463: 			float rate = (time - keyframe0.seconds) / (keyframe1.seconds - keyframe0.seconds);
465: 			// 前のキーフレームと次のキーフレームの姿勢を補完
466: 			DirectX::XMVECTOR Q0 = DirectX::XMLoadFloat4(&keyframe0.value);
467: 			DirectX::XMVECTOR Q1 = DirectX::XMLoadFloat4(&keyframe1.value);
468: 			DirectX::XMVECTOR Q = DirectX::XMQuaternionSlerp(Q0, Q1, rate);
469: 			// 計算結果をノードに格納
470: 			DirectX::XMStoreFloat4(&nodePose.rotation, Q);
471: 		}
472: 	}
473: 	// スケール
474: 	for (size_t index = 0; index < nodeAnim.scaleKeyframes.size() - 1; ++index)
475: 	{
476: 		// 現在の時間がどのキーフレームの間にいるか判定する
477: 		const VectorKeyframe& keyframe0 = nodeAnim.scaleKeyframes.at(index);
478: 		const VectorKeyframe& keyframe1 = nodeAnim.scaleKeyframes.at(index + 1);
479: 		if (time >= keyframe0.seconds && time <= keyframe1.seconds)
480: 		{
481: 			// 再生時間とキーフレームの時間から補完率を算出する
482: 			float rate = (time - keyframe0.seconds) / (keyframe1.seconds - keyframe0.seconds);
484: 			// 前のキーフレームと次のキーフレームの姿勢を補完
485: 			DirectX::XMVECTOR V0 = DirectX::XMLoadFloat3(&keyframe0.value);
486: 			DirectX::XMVECTOR V1 = DirectX::XMLoadFloat3(&keyframe1.value);
487: 			DirectX::XMVECTOR V = DirectX::XMVectorLerp(V0, V1, rate);
488: 			// 計算結果をノードに格納
489: 			DirectX::XMStoreFloat3(&nodePose.scale, V);
490: 		}
491: 	}
492: }
494: // アニメーション計算
495: void Model::ComputeAnimation(int animationIndex, float time, std::vector<NodePose>& nodePoses) const
496: {
497: 	if (nodePoses.size() != nodes.size())
498: 	{
499: 		nodePoses.resize(nodes.size());
500: 	}
501: 	for (size_t nodeIndex = 0; nodeIndex < nodePoses.size(); ++nodeIndex)
502: 	{
503: 		ComputeAnimation(animationIndex, static_cast<int>(nodeIndex), time, nodePoses.at(nodeIndex));
504: 	}
505: }
507: // ノードポーズ設定

511: 	{
512: 		const NodePose& pose = nodePoses.at(nodeIndex);

518: 	}
519: }

46: void ModelRenderer::Render(const RenderContext& rc)
47: {
48:     if (drawInfos.empty()) return;
50:     ID3D11DeviceContext* dc = rc.deviceContext;
52:     // シーン用定数バッファ更新
53:     {
54:         static LightManager defaultLightManager;
55:         const LightManager* lightManager = rc.lightManager ? rc.lightManager : &defaultLightManager;
57:         CbScene cbScene{};
58:         DirectX::XMMATRIX V = DirectX::XMLoadFloat4x4(&rc.camera->GetView());
59:         DirectX::XMMATRIX P = DirectX::XMLoadFloat4x4(&rc.camera->GetProjection());
60:         DirectX::XMStoreFloat4x4(&cbScene.viewProjection, V * P);
61:         const DirectionalLight& directionalLight = lightManager->GetDirectionalLight();
62:         cbScene.lightDirection.x = directionalLight.direction.x;
63:         cbScene.lightDirection.y = directionalLight.direction.y;
64:         cbScene.lightDirection.z = directionalLight.direction.z;
65:         cbScene.lightColor.x = directionalLight.color.x;
66:         cbScene.lightColor.y = directionalLight.color.y;
67:         cbScene.lightColor.z = directionalLight.color.z;
68:         const DirectX::XMFLOAT3& eye = rc.camera->GetPosition();
69:         cbScene.cameraPosition.x = eye.x;
70:         cbScene.cameraPosition.y = eye.y;
71:         cbScene.cameraPosition.z = eye.z;
72:         cbScene.psxEnabled = rc.psxEnabled ? 1.0f : 0.0f;
73:         cbScene.psxResWidth = (std::max)(1.0f, rc.psxResWidth);
74:         cbScene.psxResHeight = (std::max)(1.0f, rc.psxResHeight);
75:         dc->UpdateSubresource(sceneConstantBuffer.Get(), 0, 0, &cbScene, 0, 0);
76:     }
78:     ID3D11Buffer* vsConstantBuffers[] = {
79:         skeletonConstantBuffer.Get(),
80:         sceneConstantBuffer.Get(),
81:     };
82:     ID3D11Buffer* psConstantBuffers[] = {
83:         sceneConstantBuffer.Get(),
84:     };
85:     dc->VSSetConstantBuffers(6, _countof(vsConstantBuffers), vsConstantBuffers);
86:     dc->PSSetConstantBuffers(7, _countof(psConstantBuffers), psConstantBuffers);
87:     dc->PSSetConstantBuffers(2, 1, objectConstantBuffer.GetAddressOf());
89:     ID3D11SamplerState* samplerStates[] = {
90:         rc.renderState->GetSamplerState(SamplerState::PointClamp)
91:     };
92:     dc->PSSetSamplers(0, _countof(samplerStates), samplerStates);
94:     dc->OMSetDepthStencilState(rc.renderState->GetDepthStencilState(DepthState::TestAndWrite), 0);
95:     dc->RSSetState(rc.renderState->GetRasterizerState(RasterizerState::SolidCullBack));
97:     auto drawMesh = [&](const Model::Mesh& mesh, Shader* shader, bool useManual, const DirectX::XMFLOAT4X4& manualMatrix)
98:         {
99:             UINT stride = sizeof(Model::Vertex);
100:             UINT offset = 0;
101:             dc->IASetVertexBuffers(0, 1, mesh.vertexBuffer.GetAddressOf(), &stride, &offset);
102:             dc->IASetIndexBuffer(mesh.indexBuffer.Get(), DXGI_FORMAT_R32_UINT, 0);
103:             dc->IASetPrimitiveTopology(D3D11_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY_TRIANGLELIST);
105:             CbSkeleton cbSkeleton{};
106:             if (mesh.bones.size() > 0)
107:             {
108:                 for (size_t i = 0; i < mesh.bones.size(); ++i)
109:                 {
110:                     const Model::Bone& bone = mesh.bones.at(i);
111:                     DirectX::XMMATRIX WorldTransform = useManual
112:                         ? DirectX::XMLoadFloat4x4(&manualMatrix)
113:                         : DirectX::XMLoadFloat4x4(&bone.node->worldTransform);
114:                     DirectX::XMMATRIX OffsetTransform = DirectX::XMLoadFloat4x4(&bone.offsetTransform);
115:                     DirectX::XMStoreFloat4x4(&cbSkeleton.boneTransforms[i], OffsetTransform * WorldTransform);
116:                 }
117:             }
118:             else
119:             {
120:                 cbSkeleton.boneTransforms[0] = useManual ? manualMatrix : mesh.node->worldTransform;
121:             }
122:             dc->UpdateSubresource(skeletonConstantBuffer.Get(), 0, 0, &cbSkeleton, 0, 0);
124:             shader->Update(rc, mesh);
125:             dc->DrawIndexed(static_cast<UINT>(mesh.indices.size()), 0, 0);
126:         };
128:     DirectX::XMVECTOR CameraPosition = DirectX::XMLoadFloat3(&rc.camera->GetPosition());
129:     DirectX::XMVECTOR CameraFront = DirectX::XMLoadFloat3(&rc.camera->GetFront());
131:     // [FIX] Untuk transparent window, JANGAN override blend state.
132:     // SceneBoss sudah set TransparentWindow blend state yang menjaga alpha channel
133:     // di render target agar terisi penuh (dibutuhkan saat CPU readback → UpdateLayeredWindow).
134:     // Untuk window biasa, pakai Opaque seperti biasa.
135:     if (!rc.isTransparentWindow)
136:     {
137:         dc->OMSetBlendState(rc.renderState->GetBlendState(BlendState::Opaque), nullptr, 0xFFFFFFFF);
138:     }
140:     // 不透明描画処理
141:     for (DrawInfo& drawInfo : drawInfos)
142:     {
143:         Shader* shader = shaders[static_cast<int>(drawInfo.shaderId)].get();
144:         shader->Begin(rc);
146:         CbObject cbObject;
147:         cbObject.color = drawInfo.color;
148:         dc->UpdateSubresource(objectConstantBuffer.Get(), 0, 0, &cbObject, 0, 0);
150:         for (const Model::Mesh& mesh : drawInfo.model->GetMeshes())
151:         {
152:             if (mesh.material->alphaMode == Model::AlphaMode::Blend ||
153:                 (mesh.material->baseColor.w > 0.01f && mesh.material->baseColor.w < 0.99f))
154:             {
155:                 TransparencyDrawInfo& transparencyDrawInfo = transparencyDrawInfos.emplace_back();
156:                 transparencyDrawInfo.mesh = &mesh;
157:                 transparencyDrawInfo.shaderId = drawInfo.shaderId;
158:                 transparencyDrawInfo.color = drawInfo.color;
159:                 transparencyDrawInfo.useManualMatrix = drawInfo.useManualMatrix;
160:                 transparencyDrawInfo.worldMatrix = drawInfo.worldMatrix;
162:                 DirectX::XMFLOAT4X4 transformMatrix = drawInfo.useManualMatrix
163:                     ? drawInfo.worldMatrix : mesh.node->worldTransform;
164:                 DirectX::XMVECTOR Position = DirectX::XMVectorSet(
165:                     transformMatrix._41, transformMatrix._42, transformMatrix._43, 0.0f);
166:                 DirectX::XMVECTOR Vec = DirectX::XMVectorSubtract(Position, CameraPosition);
167:                 transparencyDrawInfo.distance = DirectX::XMVectorGetX(DirectX::XMVector3Dot(CameraFront, Vec));
168:                 continue;
169:             }
171:             drawMesh(mesh, shader, drawInfo.useManualMatrix, drawInfo.worldMatrix);
172:         }
174:         shader->End(rc);
175:     }
176:     drawInfos.clear();
178:     // [FIX] Sama  transparent window tidak override blend state untuk transparent mesh pass.
179:     // TransparentWindow blend state sudah handle alpha preservation dengan benar.
180:     if (!rc.isTransparentWindow)
181:     {
182:         dc->OMSetBlendState(rc.renderState->GetBlendState(BlendState::Transparency), nullptr, 0xFFFFFFFF);
183:     }
185:     // カメラから遠い順にソート
186:     std::sort(transparencyDrawInfos.begin(), transparencyDrawInfos.end(),
187:         [](const TransparencyDrawInfo& lhs, const TransparencyDrawInfo& rhs)
188:         {
189:             return lhs.distance > rhs.distance;
190:         });
192:     // 半透明描画処理
193:     for (const TransparencyDrawInfo& transparencyDrawInfo : transparencyDrawInfos)
194:     {
195:         Shader* shader = shaders[static_cast<int>(transparencyDrawInfo.shaderId)].get();
196:         shader->Begin(rc);
198:         CbObject cbObject;
199:         cbObject.color = transparencyDrawInfo.color;
200:         dc->UpdateSubresource(objectConstantBuffer.Get(), 0, 0, &cbObject, 0, 0);
202:         drawMesh(*transparencyDrawInfo.mesh, shader,
203:             transparencyDrawInfo.useManualMatrix, transparencyDrawInfo.worldMatrix);
205:         shader->End(rc);
206:     }
207:     transparencyDrawInfos.clear();
209:     // 定数バッファ設定解除
210:     for (ID3D11Buffer*& vsConstantBuffer : vsConstantBuffers) { vsConstantBuffer = nullptr; }
211:     for (ID3D11Buffer*& psConstantBuffer : psConstantBuffers) { psConstantBuffer = nullptr; }
212:     dc->VSSetConstantBuffers(6, _countof(vsConstantBuffers), vsConstantBuffers);
213:     dc->PSSetConstantBuffers(7, _countof(psConstantBuffers), psConstantBuffers);
215:     ID3D11Buffer* nullBuffer = nullptr;
216:     dc->PSSetConstantBuffers(2, 1, &nullBuffer);
218:     for (ID3D11SamplerState*& samplerState : samplerStates) { samplerState = nullptr; }
219:     dc->PSSetSamplers(0, _countof(samplerStates), samplerStates);
220: }

121: DirectX::XMFLOAT3 Mouse::GetWorldPosition(const DirectX::XMFLOAT4X4& viewMatrix, const DirectX::XMFLOAT4X4& projMatrix) const
122: {
123: 	// 1. Ambil posisi yang sudah disesuaikan dengan viewport (menggunakan variabel internal Mouse)
124: 	float mouseX = static_cast<float>(positionX[0]);
125: 	float mouseY = static_cast<float>(positionY[0]);
127: 	// 2. Setup vektor awal
128: 	DirectX::XMVECTOR mouseNear = DirectX::XMVectorSet(mouseX, mouseY, 0.0f, 1.0f);
129: 	DirectX::XMVECTOR mouseFar = DirectX::XMVectorSet(mouseX, mouseY, 1.0f, 1.0f);
131: 	// 3. Load matriks
132: 	DirectX::XMMATRIX view = DirectX::XMLoadFloat4x4(&viewMatrix);
133: 	DirectX::XMMATRIX proj = DirectX::XMLoadFloat4x4(&projMatrix);
134: 	DirectX::XMMATRIX world = DirectX::XMMatrixIdentity();
136: 	// 4. Unproject (Gunakan screenWidth dan screenHeight yang tersimpan di class Mouse)
137: 	DirectX::XMVECTOR pNear = DirectX::XMVector3Unproject(
138: 		mouseNear, 0, 0, static_cast<float>(screenWidth), static_cast<float>(screenHeight),
139: 		0.0f, 1.0f, proj, view, world
140: 	);
141: 	DirectX::XMVECTOR pFar = DirectX::XMVector3Unproject(
142: 		mouseFar, 0, 0, static_cast<float>(screenWidth), static_cast<float>(screenHeight),
143: 		0.0f, 1.0f, proj, view, world
144: 	);
146: 	// 5. Kalkulasi Raycast ke lantai (Y = 0)
147: 	DirectX::XMVECTOR rayDir = DirectX::XMVector3Normalize(DirectX::XMVectorSubtract(pFar, pNear));
149: 	// Cegah division by zero jika kamera menatap lurus sejajar lantai (jarang terjadi di top-down)
150: 	float dirY = DirectX::XMVectorGetY(rayDir);
151: 	if (std::abs(dirY) < 0.0001f) {
152: 		return { 0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f };
153: 	}
155: 	float t = -DirectX::XMVectorGetY(pNear) / dirY;
156: 	DirectX::XMVECTOR groundPoint = DirectX::XMVectorAdd(pNear, DirectX::XMVectorScale(rayDir, t));
158: 	DirectX::XMFLOAT3 result;
159: 	DirectX::XMStoreFloat3(&result, groundPoint);
160: 	return result;
161: }

71: // グリッド描画
72: void PrimitiveRenderer::DrawGrid(int subdivisions, float scale)
73: {
74: 	int numLines = (subdivisions + 1) * 2;
75: 	int vertexCount = numLines * 2;
77: 	float corner = 0.5f;
78: 	float step = 1.0f / static_cast<float>(subdivisions);
80: 	int index = 0;
81: 	float s = -corner;
83: 	const DirectX::XMFLOAT4 white = DirectX::XMFLOAT4(1, 1, 1, 1);
85: 	// Create vertical lines
86: 	float scaling = static_cast<float>(subdivisions) * scale;
87: 	DirectX::XMMATRIX M = DirectX::XMMatrixScaling(scaling, scaling, scaling);
88: 	DirectX::XMVECTOR V, P;
89: 	DirectX::XMFLOAT3 position;
90: 	for (int i = 0; i <= subdivisions; i++)
91: 	{
92: 		V = DirectX::XMVectorSet(s, 0, corner, 0);
93: 		P = DirectX::XMVector3TransformCoord(V, M);
94: 		DirectX::XMStoreFloat3(&position, P);
95: 		AddVertex(position, white);
97: 		V = DirectX::XMVectorSet(s, 0, -corner, 0);
98: 		P = DirectX::XMVector3TransformCoord(V, M);
99: 		DirectX::XMStoreFloat3(&position, P);
100: 		AddVertex(position, white);
102: 		s += step;
103: 	}
105: 	// Create horizontal lines
106: 	s = -corner;
107: 	for (int i = 0; i <= subdivisions; i++)
108: 	{
109: 		V = DirectX::XMVectorSet(corner, 0, s, 0);
110: 		P = DirectX::XMVector3TransformCoord(V, M);
111: 		DirectX::XMStoreFloat3(&position, P);
112: 		AddVertex(position, white);
114: 		V = DirectX::XMVectorSet(-corner, 0, s, 0);
115: 		P = DirectX::XMVector3TransformCoord(V, M);
116: 		DirectX::XMStoreFloat3(&position, P);
117: 		AddVertex(position, white);
119: 		s += step;
120: 	}
122: 	// X軸
123: 	{
124: 		const DirectX::XMFLOAT4 red = DirectX::XMFLOAT4(1, 0, 0, 1);
125: 		V = DirectX::XMVectorSet(0, 0, 0, 0);
126: 		P = DirectX::XMVector3TransformCoord(V, M);
127: 		DirectX::XMStoreFloat3(&position, P);
128: 		AddVertex(position, red);
130: 		V = DirectX::XMVectorSet(corner, 0, 0, 0);
131: 		P = DirectX::XMVector3TransformCoord(V, M);
132: 		DirectX::XMStoreFloat3(&position, P);
133: 		AddVertex(position, red);
134: 	}
136: 	// Y軸
137: 	{
138: 		const DirectX::XMFLOAT4 green = DirectX::XMFLOAT4(0, 1, 0, 1);
139: 		V = DirectX::XMVectorSet(0, 0, 0, 0);
140: 		P = DirectX::XMVector3TransformCoord(V, M);
141: 		DirectX::XMStoreFloat3(&position, P);
142: 		AddVertex(position, green);
144: 		V = DirectX::XMVectorSet(0, corner, 0, 0);
145: 		P = DirectX::XMVector3TransformCoord(V, M);
146: 		DirectX::XMStoreFloat3(&position, P);
147: 		AddVertex(position, green);
148: 	}
150: 	// Z軸
151: 	{
152: 		const DirectX::XMFLOAT4 blue = DirectX::XMFLOAT4(0, 0, 1, 1);
153: 		V = DirectX::XMVectorSet(0, 0, 0, 0);
154: 		P = DirectX::XMVector3TransformCoord(V, M);
155: 		DirectX::XMStoreFloat3(&position, P);
156: 		AddVertex(position, blue);
158: 		V = DirectX::XMVectorSet(0, 0, corner, 0);
159: 		P = DirectX::XMVector3TransformCoord(V, M);
160: 		DirectX::XMStoreFloat3(&position, P);

165: // 描画実行
166: void PrimitiveRenderer::Render(
167: 	ID3D11DeviceContext* dc,
168: 	const DirectX::XMFLOAT4X4& view,
169: 	const DirectX::XMFLOAT4X4& projection,
170: 	D3D11_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY primitiveTopology)
171: {
172: 	// シェーダー設定
173: 	dc->VSSetShader(vertexShader.Get(), nullptr, 0);
174: 	dc->PSSetShader(pixelShader.Get(), nullptr, 0);
175: 	dc->IASetInputLayout(inputLayout.Get());
177: 	// 定数バッファ設定
178: 	dc->VSSetConstantBuffers(0, 1, constantBuffer.GetAddressOf());
180: 	// ビュープロジェクション行列作成
181: 	DirectX::XMMATRIX V = DirectX::XMLoadFloat4x4(&view);
182: 	DirectX::XMMATRIX P = DirectX::XMLoadFloat4x4(&projection);
183: 	DirectX::XMMATRIX VP = V * P;
185: 	// 定数バッファ更新
186: 	CbScene cbScene;
187: 	DirectX::XMStoreFloat4x4(&cbScene.viewProjection, VP);
188: 	dc->UpdateSubresource(constantBuffer.Get(), 0, 0, &cbScene, 0, 0);
190: 	// 頂点バッファ設定
191: 	UINT stride = sizeof(Vertex);
192: 	UINT offset = 0;
193: 	dc->IASetPrimitiveTopology(primitiveTopology);
194: 	dc->IASetIndexBuffer(nullptr, DXGI_FORMAT_R32_UINT, 0);
195: 	dc->IASetVertexBuffers(0, 1, vertexBuffer.GetAddressOf(), &stride, &offset);
197: 	// 描画
198: 	UINT totalVertexCount = static_cast<UINT>(vertices.size());
199: 	UINT start = 0;
200: 	UINT count = (totalVertexCount < VertexCapacity) ? totalVertexCount : VertexCapacity;
202: 	while (start < totalVertexCount)
203: 	{
204: 		D3D11_MAPPED_SUBRESOURCE mappedSubresource;
205: 		HRESULT hr = dc->Map(vertexBuffer.Get(), 0, D3D11_MAP_WRITE_DISCARD, 0, &mappedSubresource);
206: 		_ASSERT_EXPR(SUCCEEDED(hr), HRTrace(hr));
208: 		memcpy(mappedSubresource.pData, &vertices[start], sizeof(Vertex) * count);
210: 		dc->Unmap(vertexBuffer.Get(), 0);
212: 		dc->Draw(count, 0);
214: 		start += count;
215: 		if ((start + count) > totalVertexCount)
216: 		{
217: 			count = totalVertexCount - start;
218: 		}
219: 	}
221: 	vertices.clear();
222: }

<file path="Source/System/ResourceManager.cpp" lines="24">
1: #include "ResourceManager.h"
3: void ResourceManager::LoadFont(const std::string& keyName, const std::string& texturePath, const std::string& dataPath)
4: {
5:     if (fonts.find(keyName) != fonts.end()) return;
6:     fonts[keyName] = std::make_unique<BitmapFont>(texturePath, dataPath);
7: }
9: BitmapFont* ResourceManager::GetFont(const std::string& keyName)
10: {
11:     auto it = fonts.find(keyName);
13:     if (it != fonts.end())
14:     {
15:         return it->second.get();
16:     }
18:     return nullptr;
19: }
21: void ResourceManager::UnloadAll()
22: {
23:     fonts.clear();
24: }

86: void ShapeRenderer::DrawCapsule(

110: 		World.r[1] = DirectX::XMVectorScale(Transform.r[1], height);
111: 		World.r[2] = DirectX::XMVectorScale(Transform.r[2], radius);
112: 		World.r[3] = Transform.r[3];

114: 		instance.color = color;
115: 	}

122: 		Transform.r[3] = DirectX::XMVectorSet(0, 0, 0, 1);

126: 		World.r[2] = DirectX::XMVectorScale(World.r[2], radius);

224: void ShapeRenderer::CreateSphereMesh(ID3D11Device* device, float radius, int subdivisions)
225: {
226: 	float step = DirectX::XM_2PI / subdivisions;
228: 	std::vector<DirectX::XMFLOAT3> vertices;
230: 	// XZ平面
231: 	for (int i = 0; i < subdivisions; ++i)
232: 	{
233: 		for (int j = 0; j < 2; ++j)
234: 		{
235: 			float theta = step * ((i + j) % subdivisions);
237: 			DirectX::XMFLOAT3& p = vertices.emplace_back();
238: 			p.x = sinf(theta) * radius;
239: 			p.y = 0.0f;
240: 			p.z = cosf(theta) * radius;
241: 		}
242: 	}
243: 	// XY平面
244: 	for (int i = 0; i < subdivisions; ++i)
245: 	{
246: 		for (int j = 0; j < 2; ++j)
247: 		{
248: 			float theta = step * ((i + j) % subdivisions);
250: 			DirectX::XMFLOAT3& p = vertices.emplace_back();
251: 			p.x = sinf(theta) * radius;
252: 			p.y = cosf(theta) * radius;
253: 			p.z = 0.0f;
254: 		}
255: 	}
256: 	// YZ平面
257: 	for (int i = 0; i < subdivisions; ++i)
258: 	{
259: 		for (int j = 0; j < 2; ++j)
260: 		{
261: 			float theta = step * ((i + j) % subdivisions);
263: 			DirectX::XMFLOAT3& p = vertices.emplace_back();
264: 			p.x = 0.0f;
265: 			p.y = sinf(theta) * radius;
266: 			p.z = cosf(theta) * radius;
267: 		}
268: 	}
270: 	// メッシュ生成
271: 	CreateMesh(device, vertices, sphereMesh);
272: }

276: {
277: 	std::vector<DirectX::XMFLOAT3> vertices;
279: 	float theta_step = DirectX::XM_2PI / subdivisions;
281: 	// XZ平面

285: 		{

288: 			DirectX::XMFLOAT3& v = vertices.emplace_back();
290: 			v.x = sinf(theta) * radius;
291: 			v.y = 0.0f;
292: 			v.z = cosf(theta) * radius;
293: 		}
294: 	}
295: 	// XY平面
296: 	for (int i = 0; i < subdivisions / 2; ++i)
297: 	{
298: 		for (int j = 0; j < 2; ++j)
299: 		{
300: 			float theta = theta_step * ((i + j) % subdivisions) - DirectX::XM_PIDIV2;
302: 			DirectX::XMFLOAT3& v = vertices.emplace_back();

308: 	}
309: 	// YZ平面
310: 	for (int i = 0; i < subdivisions / 2; ++i)
311: 	{
312: 		for (int j = 0; j < 2; ++j)
313: 		{
314: 			float theta = theta_step * ((i + j) % subdivisions);
316: 			DirectX::XMFLOAT3& v = vertices.emplace_back();
318: 			v.x = 0.0f;
319: 			v.y = sinf(theta) * radius;
320: 			v.z = cosf(theta) * radius;
321: 		}

328: // 円柱
329: void ShapeRenderer::CreateCylinderMesh(ID3D11Device* device, float radius1, float radius2, float start, float height, int subdivisions)
330: {
331: 	std::vector<DirectX::XMFLOAT3> vertices;
333: 	float theta_step = DirectX::XM_2PI / subdivisions;
335: 	// XZ平面
336: 	for (int i = 0; i < subdivisions; ++i)
337: 	{
338: 		for (int j = 0; j < 2; ++j)
339: 		{
340: 			float theta = theta_step * ((i + j) % subdivisions);
342: 			DirectX::XMFLOAT3& v = vertices.emplace_back();
344: 			v.x = sinf(theta) * radius1;
345: 			v.y = start;
346: 			v.z = cosf(theta) * radius1;
347: 		}
348: 	}
349: 	for (int i = 0; i < subdivisions; ++i)
350: 	{
351: 		for (int j = 0; j < 2; ++j)
352: 		{
353: 			float theta = theta_step * ((i + j) % subdivisions);
355: 			DirectX::XMFLOAT3& v = vertices.emplace_back();
357: 			v.x = sinf(theta) * radius2;
358: 			v.y = start + height;
359: 			v.z = cosf(theta) * radius2;
360: 		}
361: 	}
362: 	// XY平面
363: 	{
364: 		vertices.emplace_back(DirectX::XMFLOAT3(0.0f, start, radius1));
365: 		vertices.emplace_back(DirectX::XMFLOAT3(0.0f, start + height, radius2));
366: 		vertices.emplace_back(DirectX::XMFLOAT3(0.0f, start, -radius1));
367: 		vertices.emplace_back(DirectX::XMFLOAT3(0.0f, start + height, -radius2));
368: 	}
369: 	// YZ平面
370: 	{
371: 		vertices.emplace_back(DirectX::XMFLOAT3(radius1, start, 0.0f));
372: 		vertices.emplace_back(DirectX::XMFLOAT3(radius2, start + height, 0.0f));
373: 		vertices.emplace_back(DirectX::XMFLOAT3(-radius1, start, 0.0f));
374: 		vertices.emplace_back(DirectX::XMFLOAT3(-radius2, start + height, 0.0f));
375: 	}
377: 	// メッシュ生成
378: 	CreateMesh(device, vertices, cylinderMesh);
379: }

406: 	vertices.emplace_back(positions[0]);

408: 	vertices.emplace_back(positions[0]);
409: 	vertices.emplace_back(positions[4]);
410: 	vertices.emplace_back(positions[4]);
411: 	vertices.emplace_back(positions[2]);

430: // 描画実行
431: void ShapeRenderer::Render(
432: 	ID3D11DeviceContext* dc,
433: 	const DirectX::XMFLOAT4X4& view,
434: 	const DirectX::XMFLOAT4X4& projection)
435: {
436: 	// シェーダー設定
437: 	dc->VSSetShader(vertexShader.Get(), nullptr, 0);
438: 	dc->PSSetShader(pixelShader.Get(), nullptr, 0);
439: 	dc->IASetInputLayout(inputLayout.Get());
441: 	// 定数バッファ設定
442: 	dc->VSSetConstantBuffers(0, 1, constantBuffer.GetAddressOf());
444: 	// ビュープロジェクション行列作成
445: 	DirectX::XMMATRIX V = DirectX::XMLoadFloat4x4(&view);
446: 	DirectX::XMMATRIX P = DirectX::XMLoadFloat4x4(&projection);
447: 	DirectX::XMMATRIX VP = V * P;
449: 	// プリミティブ設定
450: 	UINT stride = sizeof(DirectX::XMFLOAT3);
451: 	UINT offset = 0;
452: 	dc->IASetPrimitiveTopology(D3D11_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY_LINELIST);
454: 	for (const Instance& instance : instances)
455: 	{
456: 		// 頂点バッファ設定
457: 		dc->IASetVertexBuffers(0, 1, instance.mesh->vertexBuffer.GetAddressOf(), &stride, &offset);
459: 		// ワールドビュープロジェクション行列作成
460: 		DirectX::XMMATRIX W = DirectX::XMLoadFloat4x4(&instance.worldTransform);
461: 		DirectX::XMMATRIX WVP = W * VP;
463: 		// 定数バッファ更新
464: 		CbMesh cbMesh;
465: 		DirectX::XMStoreFloat4x4(&cbMesh.worldViewProjection, WVP);
466: 		cbMesh.color = instance.color;
468: 		dc->UpdateSubresource(constantBuffer.Get(), 0, 0, &cbMesh, 0, 0);
470: 		// 描画
471: 		dc->Draw(instance.mesh->vertexCount, 0);
472: 	}
473: 	instances.clear();
474: }

15: {
16: 	HRESULT hr = S_OK;
18: 	// 頂点バッファの生成
19: 	{
20: 		// 頂点バッファを作成するための設定オプション
21: 		const int MAX_VERTICES = 10000;
22: 		D3D11_BUFFER_DESC buffer_desc = {};
23: 		buffer_desc.ByteWidth = sizeof(Vertex) * MAX_VERTICES;
24: 		buffer_desc.Usage = D3D11_USAGE_DYNAMIC;
25: 		buffer_desc.BindFlags = D3D11_BIND_VERTEX_BUFFER;
26: 		buffer_desc.CPUAccessFlags = D3D11_CPU_ACCESS_WRITE;
27: 		buffer_desc.MiscFlags = 0;
28: 		buffer_desc.StructureByteStride = 0;
29: 		// 頂点バッファオブジェクトの生成
30: 		hr = device->CreateBuffer(&buffer_desc, nullptr, vertexBuffer.GetAddressOf());
31: 		_ASSERT_EXPR(SUCCEEDED(hr), HRTrace(hr));
32: 	}
34: 	// 頂点シェーダー
35: 	{
36: 		// 入力レイアウト
37: 		D3D11_INPUT_ELEMENT_DESC inputElementDesc[] =
38: 		{
39: 			{ "POSITION", 0, DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32B32_FLOAT,    0, D3D11_APPEND_ALIGNED_ELEMENT, D3D11_INPUT_PER_VERTEX_DATA, 0 },
40: 			{ "COLOR",    0, DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32B32A32_FLOAT, 0, D3D11_APPEND_ALIGNED_ELEMENT, D3D11_INPUT_PER_VERTEX_DATA, 0 },
41: 			{ "TEXCOORD", 0, DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32_FLOAT,       0, D3D11_APPEND_ALIGNED_ELEMENT, D3D11_INPUT_PER_VERTEX_DATA, 0 },
42: 		};
43: 		hr = GpuResourceUtils::LoadVertexShader(
44: 			device,
45: 			"Data/Shader/SpriteVS.cso",
46: 			inputElementDesc,
47: 			ARRAYSIZE(inputElementDesc),
48: 			inputLayout.GetAddressOf(),
49: 			vertexShader.GetAddressOf());
50: 		_ASSERT_EXPR(SUCCEEDED(hr), HRTrace(hr));
52: 	}
54: 	// ピクセルシェーダー
55: 	{
56: 		hr = GpuResourceUtils::LoadPixelShader(
57: 			device,
58: 			"Data/Shader/SpritePS.cso",
59: 			pixelShader.GetAddressOf());
60: 		_ASSERT_EXPR(SUCCEEDED(hr), HRTrace(hr));
61: 	}
63: 	// テクスチャの生成
64: 	if (filename != nullptr)
65: 	{

69: 		_ASSERT_EXPR(SUCCEEDED(hr), HRTrace(hr));
71: 		textureWidth = static_cast<float>(desc.Width);
72: 		textureHeight = static_cast<float>(desc.Height);

79: 			&desc);
80: 		_ASSERT_EXPR(SUCCEEDED(hr), HRTrace(hr));

83: 		textureHeight = static_cast<float>(desc.Height);
