87: // 描画実行
88: void Sprite::Render(ID3D11DeviceContext* dc,
89: 	float dx, float dy,					// 左上位置
90: 	float dz,							// 奥行
91: 	float dw, float dh,					// 幅、高さ
92: 	float sx, float sy,					// 画像切り抜き位置
93: 	float sw, float sh,					// 画像切り抜きサイズ
94: 	float angle,						// 角度
95: 	float r, float g, float b, float a	// 色
96: 	) const
97: {
98: 	// 頂点座標
99: 	DirectX::XMFLOAT2 positions[] = {
100: 		DirectX::XMFLOAT2(dx,      dy),			// 左上
101: 		DirectX::XMFLOAT2(dx + dw, dy),			// 右上
102: 		DirectX::XMFLOAT2(dx,      dy + dh),	// 左下
103: 		DirectX::XMFLOAT2(dx + dw, dy + dh),	// 右下
104: 	};
106: 	// テクスチャ座標
107: 	DirectX::XMFLOAT2 texcoords[] = {
108: 		DirectX::XMFLOAT2(sx,      sy),			// 左上
109: 		DirectX::XMFLOAT2(sx + sw, sy),			// 右上
110: 		DirectX::XMFLOAT2(sx,      sy + sh),	// 左下
111: 		DirectX::XMFLOAT2(sx + sw, sy + sh),	// 右下
112: 	};
114: 	// スプライトの中心で回転させるために４頂点の中心位置が
115: 	// 原点(0, 0)になるように一旦頂点を移動させる。
116: 	float mx = dx + dw * 0.5f;
117: 	float my = dy + dh * 0.5f;
118: 	for (auto& p : positions)
119: 	{
120: 		p.x -= mx;
121: 		p.y -= my;
122: 	}
124: 	// 頂点を回転させる
125: 	float theta = DirectX::XMConvertToRadians(angle);
126: 	float c = cosf(theta);
127: 	float s = sinf(theta);
128: 	for (auto& p : positions)
129: 	{
130: 		DirectX::XMFLOAT2 r = p;
131: 		p.x = c * r.x + -s * r.y;
132: 		p.y = s * r.x + c * r.y;
133: 	}
135: 	// 回転のために移動させた頂点を元の位置に戻す
136: 	for (auto& p : positions)
137: 	{
138: 		p.x += mx;
139: 		p.y += my;
140: 	}
142: 	// 現在設定されているビューポートからスクリーンサイズを取得する。
143: 	D3D11_VIEWPORT viewport;
144: 	UINT numViewports = 1;
145: 	dc->RSGetViewports(&numViewports, &viewport);
146: 	float screenWidth = viewport.Width;
147: 	float screenHeight = viewport.Height;
149: 	// スクリーン座標系からNDC座標系へ変換する。
150: 	for (DirectX::XMFLOAT2& p : positions)
151: 	{
152: 		p.x = 2.0f * p.x / screenWidth - 1.0f;
153: 		p.y = 1.0f - 2.0f * p.y / screenHeight;
154: 	}
156: 	// 頂点バッファの内容の編集を開始する。
157: 	D3D11_MAPPED_SUBRESOURCE mappedSubresource;
158: 	HRESULT hr = dc->Map(vertexBuffer.Get(), 0, D3D11_MAP_WRITE_DISCARD, 0, &mappedSubresource);
159: 	_ASSERT_EXPR(SUCCEEDED(hr), HRTrace(hr));
161: 	// 頂点バッファの内容を編集
162: 	Vertex* v = static_cast<Vertex*>(mappedSubresource.pData);
163: 	for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
164: 	{
165: 		v[i].position.x = positions[i].x;
166: 		v[i].position.y = positions[i].y;
167: 		v[i].position.z = dz;
169: 		v[i].color.x = r;
170: 		v[i].color.y = g;
171: 		v[i].color.z = b;
172: 		v[i].color.w = a;
174: 		v[i].texcoord.x = texcoords[i].x / textureWidth;
175: 		v[i].texcoord.y = texcoords[i].y / textureHeight;
176: 	}
178: 	// 頂点バッファの内容の編集を終了する。
179: 	dc->Unmap(vertexBuffer.Get(), 0);
181: 	// GPUに描画するためのデータを渡す
182: 	UINT stride = sizeof(Vertex);
183: 	UINT offset = 0;
184: 	dc->IASetVertexBuffers(0, 1, vertexBuffer.GetAddressOf(), &stride, &offset);
185: 	dc->IASetInputLayout(inputLayout.Get());
186: 	dc->IASetPrimitiveTopology(D3D11_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY_TRIANGLESTRIP);
187: 	dc->VSSetShader(vertexShader.Get(), nullptr, 0);
188: 	dc->PSSetShader(pixelShader.Get(), nullptr, 0);
189: 	dc->PSSetShaderResources(0, 1, shaderResourceView.GetAddressOf());
191: 	// 描画
192: 	dc->Draw(4, 0);
193: }
195: // 描画実行（テクスチャ切り抜き指定なし）
196: void Sprite::Render(ID3D11DeviceContext* dc,
197: 	float dx, float dy,					// 左上位置
198: 	float dz,							// 奥行
199: 	float dw, float dh,					// 幅、高さ
200: 	float angle,						// 角度
201: 	float r, float g, float b, float a	// 色
202: 	) const
203: {
204: 	Render(dc, dx, dy, dz, dw, dh, 0, 0, textureWidth, textureHeight, angle, r, g, b, a);
205: }
207: // 描画実行（3D空間にスプライトを描画、細分割バージョン）
208: void Sprite::Render(ID3D11DeviceContext* dc,
209: 	const Camera* camera,
210: 	float wx, float wy, float wz,
211: 	float w, float h,
212: 	float pitch, float yaw, float roll,
213: 	float r, float g, float b, float a) const
214: {
215: 	using namespace DirectX;
217: 	// 分割設定
218: 	const int divX = 40;
219: 	const int divY = 40;
221: 	std::vector<Vertex> vertices;
222: 	vertices.reserve(divX * divY * 6);
224: 	// 行列計算
225: 	XMMATRIX matWorld = XMMatrixRotationRollPitchYaw(pitch, yaw, roll) * XMMatrixTranslation(wx, wy, wz);
226: 	XMMATRIX matVP = XMLoadFloat4x4(&camera->GetView()) * XMLoadFloat4x4(&camera->GetProjection());
228: 	float cellW = w / divX;
229: 	float cellH = h / divY;
230: 	float startX = -w / 2.0f;
231: 	float startY = h / 2.0f;
233: 	for (int y = 0; y < divY; ++y)
234: 	{
235: 		for (int x = 0; x < divX; ++x)
236: 		{
237: 			// 座標とUVの計算
238: 			float x0 = startX + x * cellW;
239: 			float y0 = startY - y * cellH;
240: 			float x1 = startX + (x + 1) * cellW;
241: 			float y1 = startY - (y + 1) * cellH;
243: 			float u0 = (float)x / divX;
244: 			float v0 = (float)y / divY;
245: 			float u1 = (float)(x + 1) / divX;
246: 			float v1 = (float)(y + 1) / divY;
248: 			// ローカル頂点定義
249: 			XMFLOAT3 localPos[6] = {
250: 				{ x0, y0, 0 }, { x1, y0, 0 }, { x0, y1, 0 },
251: 				{ x1, y0, 0 }, { x1, y1, 0 }, { x0, y1, 0 }
252: 			};
253: 			XMFLOAT2 localUV[6] = {
254: 				{ u0, v0 }, { u1, v0 }, { u0, v1 },
255: 				{ u1, v0 }, { u1, v1 }, { u0, v1 }
256: 			};
258: 			XMVECTOR clipPos[6];
259: 			bool isValid[6];
261: 			// 座標変換とクリッピング判定
262: 			for (int i = 0; i < 6; ++i)
263: 			{
264: 				XMVECTOR vPos = XMVector3TransformCoord(XMLoadFloat3(&localPos[i]), matWorld);
265: 				clipPos[i] = XMVector3Transform(vPos, matVP); // W成分が必要なためTransformを使用
267: 				// カメラ手前(NearZ)の判定
268: 				isValid[i] = (XMVectorGetW(clipPos[i]) > 0.1f);
269: 			}
271: 			// 三角形生成ラムダ式
272: 			auto AddTriangle = [&](int i0, int i1, int i2)
273: 				{
274: 					if (isValid[i0] && isValid[i1] && isValid[i2])
275: 					{
276: 						int indices[] = { i0, i1, i2 };
277: 						for (int idx : indices)
278: 						{
279: 							XMVECTOR finalPos = clipPos[idx] / XMVectorGetW(clipPos[idx]); // 透視除算
280: 							Vertex vert;
281: 							XMStoreFloat3(&vert.position, finalPos);
282: 							vert.color = XMFLOAT4(r, g, b, a);
283: 							vert.texcoord = localUV[idx];
284: 							vertices.push_back(vert);
285: 						}
286: 					}
287: 				};
289: 			// 2つの三角形を追加
290: 			AddTriangle(0, 1, 2);
291: 			AddTriangle(3, 4, 5);
292: 		}
293: 	}
295: 	if (vertices.empty()) return;
297: 	// GPUバッファ更新
298: 	D3D11_MAPPED_SUBRESOURCE ms;
299: 	if (SUCCEEDED(dc->Map(vertexBuffer.Get(), 0, D3D11_MAP_WRITE_DISCARD, 0, &ms)))
300: 	{
301: 		memcpy(ms.pData, vertices.data(), sizeof(Vertex) * vertices.size());
302: 		dc->Unmap(vertexBuffer.Get(), 0);
303: 	}
305: 	// 描画設定
306: 	UINT stride = sizeof(Vertex);
307: 	UINT offset = 0;
308: 	dc->IASetVertexBuffers(0, 1, vertexBuffer.GetAddressOf(), &stride, &offset);
309: 	dc->IASetInputLayout(inputLayout.Get());
310: 	dc->IASetPrimitiveTopology(D3D11_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY_TRIANGLELIST); // LISTを使用
312: 	dc->VSSetShader(vertexShader.Get(), nullptr, 0);
313: 	dc->PSSetShader(pixelShader.Get(), nullptr, 0);
314: 	dc->PSSetShaderResources(0, 1, shaderResourceView.GetAddressOf());
316: 	dc->Draw(static_cast<UINT>(vertices.size()), 0);
317: }
319: void Sprite::Render3D(ID3D11DeviceContext* dc,
320: 	const Camera* camera,
321: 	float wx, float wy, float wz,
322: 	float w, float h,
323: 	float sx, float sy,
324: 	float sw, float sh,
325: 	float pitch, float yaw, float roll,
326: 	float r, float g, float b, float a) const
327: {
328: 	using namespace DirectX;
330: 	// 1. Setup Data Vertex (Hanya 1 Quad / 4 Titik)
331: 	// Urutan: Kiri-Atas, Kanan-Atas, Kiri-Bawah, Kanan-Bawah (Triangle Strip)
332: 	Vertex vertices[4];
334: 	// Hitung UV dalam 0.0 - 1.0
335: 	float u0 = sx / textureWidth;
336: 	float v0 = sy / textureHeight;
337: 	float u1 = (sx + sw) / textureWidth;
338: 	float v1 = (sy + sh) / textureHeight;
340: 	// Set UV & Warna
341: 	vertices[0].texcoord = { u0, v0 }; vertices[0].color = { r, g, b, a };
342: 	vertices[1].texcoord = { u1, v0 }; vertices[1].color = { r, g, b, a };
343: 	vertices[2].texcoord = { u0, v1 }; vertices[2].color = { r, g, b, a };
344: 	vertices[3].texcoord = { u1, v1 }; vertices[3].color = { r, g, b, a };
346: 	// 2. Hitung Matrix
347: 	// Pivot huruf ada di tengah
348: 	XMMATRIX matWorld = XMMatrixRotationRollPitchYaw(pitch, yaw, roll) * XMMatrixTranslation(wx, wy, wz);
349: 	XMMATRIX matVP = XMLoadFloat4x4(&camera->GetView()) * XMLoadFloat4x4(&camera->GetProjection());
351: 	// 3. Transformasi Vertex Manual (Billboard Logic)
352: 	float halfW = w / 2.0f;
353: 	float halfH = h / 2.0f;
355: 	// Posisi lokal relatif terhadap titik tengah (wx, wy, wz)
356: 	XMFLOAT3 localPos[4] = {
357: 		{ -halfW,  halfH, 0 }, // Kiri Atas
358: 		{  halfW,  halfH, 0 }, // Kanan Atas
359: 		{ -halfW, -halfH, 0 }, // Kiri Bawah
360: 		{  halfW, -halfH, 0 }  // Kanan Bawah
361: 	};
363: 	for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
364: 	{
365: 		// Local -> World
366: 		XMVECTOR vPos = XMLoadFloat3(&localPos[i]);
367: 		vPos = XMVector3TransformCoord(vPos, matWorld);
369: 		// World -> Clip Space (Wajib untuk Shader)
370: 		// Disini kita lakukan trik: Kita kirim posisi World ke Buffer,
371: 		// tapi Shader VS kamu sepertinya mengharapkan posisi Clip Space (Screen).
372: 		// Karena SpriteVS.cso kamu didesain untuk 2D Screen Space (-1 s/d 1),
373: 		// kita harus melakukan transformasi VP di CPU sini.
375: 		XMVECTOR vClip = XMVector3Transform(vPos, matVP);
377: 		// Perspective Divide (Penting agar menjadi -1 s/d 1 NDC)
378: 		// PERHATIAN: Shader 2D kamu mungkin tidak handle W component.
379: 		// Idealnya kamu punya Shader 3D terpisah.
380: 		// TAPI, agar kompatibel dengan Shader 2D "SpriteVS" yang ada:
381: 		// Kita simpan hasil proyeksi yang sudah dibagi W.
383: 		float vW = XMVectorGetW(vClip);
384: 		if (vW < 0.1f) vW = 0.1f; // Cegah bagi nol
386: 		XMStoreFloat3(&vertices[i].position, vClip / vW);
388: 		// Simpan Z asli untuk Depth Buffer (Optional, tergantung shader)
389: 		// vertices[i].position.z = XMVectorGetZ(vClip) / vW;
390: 	}
392: 	// 4. Update Buffer & Draw
393: 	D3D11_MAPPED_SUBRESOURCE ms;
394: 	if (SUCCEEDED(dc->Map(vertexBuffer.Get(), 0, D3D11_MAP_WRITE_DISCARD, 0, &ms)))
395: 	{
396: 		memcpy(ms.pData, vertices, sizeof(Vertex) * 4);
397: 		dc->Unmap(vertexBuffer.Get(), 0);
398: 	}
400: 	UINT stride = sizeof(Vertex);
401: 	UINT offset = 0;
402: 	dc->IASetVertexBuffers(0, 1, vertexBuffer.GetAddressOf(), &stride, &offset);
403: 	dc->IASetInputLayout(inputLayout.Get());
404: 	dc->IASetPrimitiveTopology(D3D11_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY_TRIANGLESTRIP);
406: 	dc->VSSetShader(vertexShader.Get(), nullptr, 0);
407: 	dc->PSSetShader(pixelShader.Get(), nullptr, 0);
408: 	dc->PSSetShaderResources(0, 1, shaderResourceView.GetAddressOf());
410: 	dc->Draw(4, 0);
411: }
413: void Sprite::Render3DBatch(ID3D11DeviceContext* dc,
414: 	const Camera* camera,
415: 	const std::vector<Sprite3DBatchData>& batchData) const
416: {
417: 	using namespace DirectX; // <--- TAMBAHKAN BARIS INI DI SINI!
419: 	if (batchData.empty()) return;
421: 	std::vector<Vertex> vertices;
422: 	vertices.reserve(batchData.size() * 6); // 1 Kotak = 6 Titik (2 Segitiga)
424: 	XMMATRIX matVP = XMLoadFloat4x4(&camera->GetView()) * XMLoadFloat4x4(&camera->GetProjection());
426: 	for (const auto& data : batchData)
427: 	{
428: 		// Fitur Auto-Full Texture: Jika sw/sh 0, anggap pakai seluruh gambar
429: 		float actualSW = (data.sw <= 0.001f) ? textureWidth : data.sw;
430: 		float actualSH = (data.sh <= 0.001f) ? textureHeight : data.sh;
432: 		// Kalkulasi UV 0.0 -> 1.0
433: 		float u0 = data.sx / textureWidth;
434: 		float v0 = data.sy / textureHeight;
435: 		float u1 = (data.sx + actualSW) / textureWidth;
436: 		float v1 = (data.sy + actualSH) / textureHeight;
438: 		DirectX::XMFLOAT4 color = { data.r, data.g, data.b, data.a };
440: 		XMMATRIX matWorld = XMMatrixRotationRollPitchYaw(data.pitch, data.yaw, data.roll) * XMMatrixTranslation(data.wx, data.wy, data.wz);
442: 		float halfW = data.w / 2.0f;
443: 		float halfH = data.h / 2.0f;
445: 		// Posisi lokal (Kiri-Atas, Kanan-Atas, Kiri-Bawah, Kanan-Bawah)
446: 		DirectX::XMFLOAT3 localPos[4] = {
447: 			{ -halfW,  halfH, 0 },
448: 			{  halfW,  halfH, 0 },
449: 			{ -halfW, -halfH, 0 },
450: 			{  halfW, -halfH, 0 }
451: 		};
453: 		Vertex v[4];
454: 		for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
455: 		{
456: 			XMVECTOR vPos = XMVector3TransformCoord(XMLoadFloat3(&localPos[i]), matWorld);
457: 			XMVECTOR vClip = XMVector3Transform(vPos, matVP);
459: 			float vW = XMVectorGetW(vClip);
460: 			if (vW < 0.1f) vW = 0.1f; // Cegah error dibagi nol
462: 			XMStoreFloat3(&v[i].position, vClip / vW);
463: 			v[i].color = color;
464: 		}
466: 		v[0].texcoord = { u0, v0 };
467: 		v[1].texcoord = { u1, v0 };
468: 		v[2].texcoord = { u0, v1 };
469: 		v[3].texcoord = { u1, v1 };
471: 		// Susun Triangle List (6 Titik)
472: 		vertices.push_back(v[0]); vertices.push_back(v[1]); vertices.push_back(v[2]); // Segitiga Atas
473: 		vertices.push_back(v[1]); vertices.push_back(v[3]); vertices.push_back(v[2]); // Segitiga Bawah
474: 	}
476: 	// --- SATU KALI BUKA VRAM UNTUK SEMUA SAYAP ---
477: 	D3D11_MAPPED_SUBRESOURCE ms;
478: 	if (SUCCEEDED(dc->Map(vertexBuffer.Get(), 0, D3D11_MAP_WRITE_DISCARD, 0, &ms)))
479: 	{
480: 		memcpy(ms.pData, vertices.data(), sizeof(Vertex) * vertices.size());
481: 		dc->Unmap(vertexBuffer.Get(), 0);
482: 	}
484: 	UINT stride = sizeof(Vertex);
485: 	UINT offset = 0;
486: 	dc->IASetVertexBuffers(0, 1, vertexBuffer.GetAddressOf(), &stride, &offset);
487: 	dc->IASetInputLayout(inputLayout.Get());
488: 	dc->IASetPrimitiveTopology(D3D11_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY_TRIANGLELIST); // <--- KUNCI BATCHING
490: 	dc->VSSetShader(vertexShader.Get(), nullptr, 0);
491: 	dc->PSSetShader(pixelShader.Get(), nullptr, 0);
492: 	dc->PSSetShaderResources(0, 1, shaderResourceView.GetAddressOf());
494: 	// --- SATU KALI DRAW CALL UNTUK SEMUA SAYAP ---
495: 	dc->Draw(static_cast<UINT>(vertices.size()), 0);
496: }
</file>

<file path="Source/System/TransformUtils.cpp" lines="39">
1: #include "TransformUtils.h"
3: // 行列からヨー、ピッチ、ロールを行列を計算する。
4: bool TransformUtils::MatrixToRollPitchYaw(const DirectX::XMFLOAT4X4& m, float& pitch, float& yaw, float& roll)
5: {
6: 	float xRadian = asinf(-m._32);
7: 	pitch = xRadian;
8: 	if (xRadian < DirectX::XM_PI / 2.0f)
9: 	{
10: 		if (xRadian > -DirectX::XM_PI / 2.0f)
11: 		{
12: 			roll = atan2f(m._12, m._22);
13: 			yaw = atan2f(m._31, m._33);
14: 			return true;
15: 		}
16: 		else
17: 		{
18: 			roll = (float)-atan2f(m._13, m._11);
19: 			yaw = 0.0f;
20: 			return false;
21: 		}
22: 	}
23: 	else
24: 	{
25: 		roll = (float)atan2f(m._13, m._11);
26: 		yaw = 0.0f;
27: 		return false;
28: 	}
29: }
31: // クォータニオンからヨー、ピッチ、ロールを行列を計算する。
32: bool TransformUtils::QuaternionToRollPitchYaw(const DirectX::XMFLOAT4& q, float& pitch, float& yaw, float& roll)
33: {
34: 	DirectX::XMVECTOR Q = DirectX::XMLoadFloat4(&q);
35: 	DirectX::XMMATRIX M = DirectX::XMMatrixRotationQuaternion(Q);
36: 	DirectX::XMFLOAT4X4 m;
37: 	DirectX::XMStoreFloat4x4(&m, M);
38: 	return MatrixToRollPitchYaw(m, pitch, yaw, roll);
39: }
